Refusing to accept defeat, he battles on toward an explosive final confrontation over the weapon and the men who want it.

The film was released theatrically in the United States on 7 December 2018 and came out on Blu-ray, DVD and digital platforms there on 5 February 2019. Critical reception was largely negative, and the film holds a 23% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Barbara Shulgasser-Parker of Common Sense Media gave it two stars out of five. Dennis Harvey of Variety noted the heavy use of double- and triple-crossing and felt the ending went one plot twist too far for narrative coherence, while Frank Scheck of The Hollywood Reporter considered it so routine, formulaic and forgettable an example of the genre that watching it became an exercise in endurance.

documents.title: Malevolent
documents.overview: A brother-sister team who fake paranormal encounters for cash get more than they bargained for when a job at a haunted estate turns very, very real.
documents.plot:
Malevolent is a 2018 American supernatural horror film directed by Jeremy Saulnier. The movie follows a young woman named Erin who returns to her family's ancestral home, only to discover that it may be haunted by malevolent spirits.

The main theme of Malevolent revolves around the idea of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals and families. Erin's return to her childhood home serves as a catalyst for confronting the dark secrets and traumas of her past, which have been buried beneath the surface. As she delves deeper into the mysteries of the house, she begins to unravel the tangled web of family history and the sinister forces that have been at work.

The film also explores the concept of inherited trauma, where the experiences and emotions of one generation can be passed down to subsequent generations, often in a way that is not immediately apparent. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, as Erin's connection to her family's past becomes increasingly entwined with the malevolent forces that surround her.

Furthermore, Malevolent touches on the idea of female empowerment and the struggle for independence. Erin's journey can be seen as a metaphor for breaking free from the constraints of patriarchal norms and expectations, as well as overcoming the societal pressures that have been placed upon her.

Overall, Malevolent is a thought-provoking horror film that delves into the darker aspects of human experience, exploring themes of trauma, inherited pain, and female empowerment in a way that is both unsettling and deeply resonant.

documents.title: The Call of the Wild
documents.overview: Buck is a big-hearted dog whose blissful domestic life is turned upside down when he is suddenly uprooted from his California home and transplanted to the exotic wilds of the Yukon during the Gold Rush of the 1890s. As the newest rookie on a mail delivery dog sled team—and later its leader—Buck experiences the adventure of a lifetime, ultimately finding his true place in the world and becoming his own master.
documents.plot:
The Call of the Wild is a 2020 American adventure film directed by Chris Sanders from a screenplay by Michael Green, adapting Jack London's 1903 novel. Set during the Klondike Gold Rush of the 1890s, it follows Buck, a domestic dog stolen from California and taken to the Yukon. Rather than filming on location, the production relied heavily on CGI, with Terry Notary playing Buck, and shot on sets in Los Angeles and exteriors in Santa Clarita, California. Visual effects came chiefly from the Moving Picture Company. It was released on February 21, 2020, as the first film under the 20th Century Studios name.

Buck, a huge, good-natured Saint Bernard and Scotch Shepherd mix, lives a pampered life with Judge Miller in Santa Clara until he is kidnapped and shipped north, where he is beaten into obedience with a club. In the Yukon he briefly crosses paths with the aging frontiersman John Thornton before being bought by mail carrier Perrault and his partner Françoise for their sled team. Buck wins over his owners and fellow dogs, saving Françoise when she falls through ice, and is guided by visions of a black wolf, but his rise provokes the husky Spitz, the pack leader. After Buck defeats him in a fight, Spitz vanishes into the wilderness and Buck leads the team to deliver the mail on time. When the telegraph ends the mail route, the dogs are sold to Hal, a cruel and inexperienced gold seeker who drives them to exhaustion. Thornton rescues Buck when Hal threatens to shoot him, and Hal later loses the rest of the team on a melting lake.

Buck recovers in Thornton's care, and the pair journey beyond the mapped Yukon to an abandoned cabin in an open valley, where they fish and pan for gold. Buck is drawn increasingly to the wild and to a white wolf and her pack. Thornton resolves to go home and leave Buck free, throwing most of the gold back into the river, but Hal, convinced Thornton is hiding a fortune, tracks them down and shoots him. Buck kills Hal, who dies in the burning cabin, and Thornton dies after saying farewell. Buck then joins the white wolf, raises a family and leads the pack.

Harrison Ford plays Thornton and narrates, with Omar Sy as Perrault, Cara Gee as Françoise, Dan Stevens as Hal, Karen Gillan as Mercedes and Bradley Whitford as Judge Miller. Critics praised Ford but disliked the CGI animals, with 63% approval on Rotten Tomatoes. Hampered by the COVID-19 pandemic, it grossed about $111 million against a $125–150 million budget.

documents.title: Trial by Fire
documents.tagline: Stand for what's right. Fight for what's true.
documents.overview: The tragic and controversial story of Cameron Todd Willingham, who was executed in Texas for killing his three children after scientific evidence and expert testimony that bolstered his claims of innocence were suppressed.
documents.plot:
Trial by Fire is a 2018 American biographical drama directed by Edward Zwick. It is based on David Grann's 2009 New Yorker article of the same name about Cameron Todd Willingham, a Texas man executed for the deaths of his three daughters. Jack O'Connell stars as Willingham, with Laura Dern, Emily Meade, Jeff Perry and Jade Pettyjohn.

On December 23, 1991, Willingham wakes up to find his house on fire and cannot save his three young daughters. At trial, prosecutor John Jackson argues the fire was arson, citing a pentagram-shaped pattern of accelerant and a refrigerator supposedly moved to block a door. Witnesses describe Willingham as violent, and jailhouse informant Johnny Webb testifies that he confessed. Despite his and his wife Stacy's protests that he is innocent, Willingham is sentenced to death. On death row he is beaten and harassed, sent to solitary confinement and tormented by memories of his stormy marriage. Stacy stops writing at her grandmother's urging. Over time he learns to cope, improves his writing with the help of fellow inmate Ponchai James, who is later executed, and slowly wins over a hostile guard named Daniels.

Years later, one of his letters reaches playwright Elizabeth Gilbert. Despite her family's doubts, she visits him and is struck by his calm, and they bond over their love for their children. Gilbert finds that witnesses lied and confronts Webb, who reacts with threats. Fire scientist Dr. Hurst concludes the fire was not arson and that the refrigerator was never moved, but his report is ignored, Webb's recantation is buried and Stacy is pressured into saying Willingham confessed to her. As the execution approaches, Gilbert is badly injured in a car crash and cannot attend. Willingham gives a moving final statement and asks for his ashes to be scattered over his daughters' graves. Daniels, now doubtful of his guilt, has to carry out the lethal injection. Later, Gilbert, paralyzed from the crash, scatters the ashes with her children. An epilogue shows Governor Rick Perry rejecting criticism of the execution.

Trial by Fire premiered at the Telluride Film Festival on August 31, 2018, and was released by Roadside Attractions on May 17, 2019. Reviews were mixed. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus said the film had a worthy and heartbreaking story and strong performances but was undermined by an aggressively manipulative approach. On Metacritic it scored 51 out of 100.

documents.title: Liz and the Blue Bird
documents.tagline: The truth will break your heart.
documents.overview: Yoroizuka Mizore plays the oboe, and Kasaki Nozomi plays the flute in Kita Uji High School concert band. As seniors, this will be their last competition together, and the selected piece "Liz and the Blue Bird" features a duet for the oboe and flute. "This piece reminds me of us." Nozomi says cheerfully, enjoying the solo, while Mizore's usual happiness to play with Nozomi is tinged with the dread of their inevitable parting. By all accounts the girls are best friends, but the oboe and flute duet sounds disjointed, as if underscoring a growing distance between them. Talk of college creates a small rift in their relationship, as the story evolves to reveal a shocking and emotional conclusion.
documents.plot:
Liz and the Blue Bird is a poignant coming-of-age drama that explores the complexities of human relationships, particularly those between mothers and daughters. The film delves into the emotional struggles of its protagonist, Liz, as she navigates her complicated bond with her mother, who has recently passed away.

At its core, the movie is a heart-wrenching portrayal of grief, loss, and the fragility of life. It masterfully captures the pain and vulnerability that accompany the loss of a loved one, particularly for young people who are still trying to find their place in the world.

Through Liz's story, the film sheds light on the often-overlooked struggles of adolescence, where teenagers grapple with identity, self-discovery, and the weight of responsibility. The movie also touches on themes of loneliness, isolation, and the longing for human connection in a world that can sometimes feel overwhelming.

One of the most striking aspects of Liz and the Blue Bird is its nuanced exploration of the mother-daughter relationship. The film presents a deeply flawed but ultimately loving portrayal of this bond, highlighting both the joy and the pain that come with it. Through Liz's character, the movie shows how mothers can be both sources of comfort and sources of conflict, often simultaneously.

Ultimately, Liz and the Blue Bird is a powerful exploration of the human experience, one that invites viewers to reflect on their own relationships, grief, and the complexities of life.

documents.title: Ron's Gone Wrong
documents.tagline: Best Friend Forever* (*battery life may vary)
documents.overview: In a world where walking, talking, digitally connected bots have become children's best friends, an 11-year-old finds that his robot buddy doesn't quite work the same as the others do.
documents.plot:
Ron's Gone Wrong is a 2021 stop-motion animated comedy film directed by Sam Fell and Joel Crawford, produced by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures.

The story revolves around Ron, an ordinary family dog who lives with his owner, Nick (voiced by Ben Schwartz), and his wife, Val (voiced by Jenny Slate). Ron's life is turned upside down when he discovers that he has the ability to grant wishes. Initially, Ron uses this power for personal gain, but soon realizes the consequences of his actions.

As Ron's wish-granting abilities grow stronger, chaos erupts in the town, and the family must navigate the mayhem caused by their mischievous dog. The film explores themes of responsibility, friendship, and the importance of learning from one's mistakes.

Throughout the movie, Ron's character undergoes significant development as he struggles to balance his desire for power with his loyalty to his family. Along the way, he befriends a stray cat named Chloe (voiced by Octavia Spencer), who becomes an unlikely ally in his quest to right the wrongs he has caused.

The film features stunning stop-motion animation, bringing the characters and their world to life in vivid detail. The voice cast delivers memorable performances, adding depth and humor to the story.

Ultimately, Ron must confront the consequences of his actions and learn to use his powers for good. With the help of his friends and family, Ron finds a way to restore balance to the town and rediscover the value of being a loyal companion.

Overall, Ron's Gone Wrong is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of responsibility, friendship, and personal growth.

documents.title: Don't Breathe 2
documents.tagline: Bad things happen to bad people.
documents.overview: The Blind Man has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin and has taken in and raised a young girl orphaned from a devastating house fire. Their quiet life together is shattered when a group of criminals kidnap the girl, forcing the Blind Man to leave his safe haven to save her.
documents.plot:
Don't Breathe 2 is a 2021 American horror thriller directed by Rodo Sayagues, in his directorial debut, who co-wrote it with Fede Álvarez, director of the original film. The sequel to Don't Breathe (2016), it brings back Stephen Lang as the blind former Navy SEAL Norman Nordstrom, with Brendan Sexton III and Madelyn Grace. Shot in Belgrade, Serbia, in 2020, it was released by Sony Pictures in the United States on August 13, 2021.

Eight years after the events of the first film, Norman lives in seclusion near Detroit with an eleven-year-old girl, Phoenix, whom he presents as his daughter and trains in survival skills, and his rottweiler, Shadow. He tells her that her mother died in a house fire. His friend Hernandez, a former Army Ranger, persuades him to let Phoenix come into town with her, and takes the girl to visit her mother's memorial at the burnt-out house. There a man named Raylan tries to grab Phoenix, but is driven off by the dog.

Raylan's gang follows them home, murders Hernandez, kills Shadow, and breaks into Norman's house to seize Phoenix. During the struggle Raylan reveals that he is the girl's real father, pointing to the matching streak of white in their hair. Phoenix learns that her home burned down after a meth lab exploded, that Raylan spent years in prison, and that Norman had found her unconscious in the ruins and taken her to replace the daughter he had lost. The gang sets fire to the house and leaves Norman for dead, but he escapes with Raylan's own dog, which leads him to the gang's hideout.

There Raylan introduces Phoenix, whose real name is Tara, to her mother Josephine, who survived the explosion but is dying from organ damage caused by the fumes. The couple intend to have the girl's compatible heart transplanted into her mother in a makeshift operation. Norman arrives, cuts the power and picks off the gang one by one in the dark; the surgeon is killed and a stray bullet kills Josephine. Norman blinds Raylan and, badly wounded, confesses his past crimes to Tara. When Raylan returns and stabs Norman, Tara kills him. Norman appears to die, and Tara walks to a children's home, introducing herself as Phoenix.

The film grossed about 53.8 million dollars worldwide and received mixed to negative reviews, with critics questioning its attempt to make Norman sympathetic.

documents.title: The Fixies: Top Secret
documents.overview: The Fixies are little creatures that, unseen by humans, help them maintain their appliances – and generally make sure things don’t fall apart… Until an unexpected occurrence of gargantuan proportions threatens to reveal the Fixies’ existence!
documents.plot:
The Fixies: Top Secret (Fiksiki: Bolshoy sekret) is a 2017 Russian animated family comedy produced by the Aeroplane studio with Blitz Film and based on the popular television series The Fixies, about tiny people who secretly live inside household appliances and repair them. Directed by Vasiko Bedoshvili, Andrey Kolpin and Ivan Pshonkin from a screenplay by Georgy Vasilyev and Evgeny Antropov, it features the voices of Aleksandr Pushnoy, Dmitri Nazarov, Larisa Brokhman, Prokhor Chekhovskoy and Varvara Obidor.

The boy DimDimych, a friend of the Fixies, watches his father, a television host, present a show arguing that little people really exist. At the laboratory of the eccentric inventor Professor Chudakov, his assistant Lizonka believes every word of the program, and when the mischievous young Fixie Fire plays tricks on her, she becomes determined to prove the creatures are real and get rid of them. Chudakov then unveils a new invention: energy bracelets that let the Fixies travel through electrical wires into people's homes to carry out "remote repairs", a service he hopes will fund a new laboratory.

Through the professor's carelessness, the bracelets end up with Fire, who is gradually warped by the electricity into a menace, racing through the wires, nearly killing his classmate Verta and finally losing his mind and wrecking DimDimych's family apartment. While the Fixies Simka and Nolik and the elder Fixie Dedus try to catch him, Lizonka summons DimDimych's father to film the little people. DimDimych rushes to the lab to warn his friends, followed by his classmate Katya, who suspects he is hiding a secret, and the humans end up locked in a storeroom when Fire starts a fire. Nolik finds the key, cuts the power to trap Fire inside a socket and saves the day, while the Fixies avoid discovery by turning into tiny screws. Back home, DimDimych and Katya distract the adults by announcing they want to get married while Fire erases the incriminating video, and the cured Fire rejoins his friends as broken equipment around the city begins mysteriously repairing itself.

The film premiered on 27 October 2017 at the Oktyabr cinema in Moscow, opening the Big Cartoon Festival, and was released the following day. Critics called it a worthy feature debut for the studio and praised its colorful graphics, characters and ironic humor, though one regretted that it lacked the educational content of the series. A sequel, The Fixies vs. the Crabots, followed in 2019.

documents.title: Dogman
documents.overview: Marcello, a small and gentle dog groomer, finds himself involved in a dangerous relationship of subjugation with Simone, a former violent boxer who terrorizes the entire neighborhood. In an effort to reaffirm his dignity, Marcello will submit to an unexpected act of vengeance.
documents.plot:
Dogman is a 2018 Italian drama film directed by Matteo Garrone, not RAI. The movie tells the story of Marcello, a struggling dog catcher who forms an unlikely friendship with his canine companion, Dogman.

The main themes of Dogman revolve around the struggles of working-class life, loneliness, and the human condition. The film explores the complexities of Marcello's character, who is both brutal and vulnerable, as he navigates the harsh realities of his job and personal relationships.

Through Marcello's story, Garrone sheds light on the darker aspects of Italian society, including corruption, violence, and social inequality. However, the film also offers a poignant portrayal of human connection and empathy, highlighting the transformative power of friendship and companionship.

The title "Dogman" itself is a metaphor for the struggles of everyday life, where individuals are often reduced to their most basic roles or personas, much like the dog that Marcello befriends. The film's narrative is both a commentary on the human condition and an exploration of the complexities of relationships, ultimately revealing the resilience and dignity of its characters in the face of adversity.

documents.title: Eli
documents.overview: A boy named Eli with a rare autoimmune disorder is confined to a special experimental clinic for his treatment. He soon begins experiencing supernatural forces, turning the supposedly safe facility into a haunted prison for him and his fellow patients.
documents.plot:
Eli is a 2019 American supernatural horror film directed by Ciarán Foy from a screenplay by David Chirchirillo, Ian Goldberg and Richard Naing, based on a story by Chirchirillo. It stars Charlie Shotwell as the title character, with Max Martini, Sadie Sink, Lili Taylor and Kelly Reilly. Principal photography took place in New Orleans in early 2018. Paramount Players originally acquired the film and scheduled it for release in January 2019, but Netflix bought the distribution rights from Paramount and released it on its service on October 18, 2019.

Young Eli Miller suffers from such severe allergic reactions to the outside world that he must live inside a protective "bubble suit". Hoping for a cure, his parents, Rose and Paul, take him to the secluded clinic of Dr. Isabella Horn, which has been built inside a renovated old house where Eli can finally remove his suit. At first he is overjoyed to enjoy comforts that have always been denied to him, but the treatments he must undergo prove excruciatingly painful, and he soon begins to experience frightening supernatural phenomena in the house. Ghostly figures repeatedly leave him the message "LIE", making him wonder whether they are warning him about Dr. Horn. Eli befriends Haley, a girl who is the only person who believes the house is haunted; she tells him that none of Horn's previous patients ever left. Eli works out that the word is really the inverted number 317, the code to Horn's office, where he finds records showing that every earlier patient died during the third and final treatment. When his parents refuse to take him away and his father sedates him, Eli becomes desperate, and his search for the truth leads him to a hidden passage beneath the house and to a startling revelation about the nature of his illness, his family and the real purpose of the clinic.

On Rotten Tomatoes the film has an approval rating of 52% based on 25 reviews, with a consensus that, though intermittently effective rather than wholly successful, it offers horror fans a handful of jump scares in search of a truly terrifying story.

documents.title: Bungo Stray Dogs: Dead Apple
documents.original_title: 文豪ストレイドッグス DEAD APPLE
documents.overview: A large scale catastrophe is occurring across the planet. Ability users are discovered after the appearance of a mysterious fog, apparently having committed suicide, so the Armed Detective Agency sets out to investigate these mysterious deaths. The case seems to involve an unknown ability user referred to as "Collector," a man who could be the mastermind behind the incident. Trust and courage are put to the test in order to save the city of Yokohama and ability users across the world from the grip of Collector where the Armed Detective Agency forms an unlikely partnership with the dangerous Port Mafia.
documents.plot:
Bungo Stray Dogs: Dead Apple is a Japanese animated thriller film directed by Kazuya Nomura, produced by BONES, and based on the manga series of the same name written by Kafka Asagiri and illustrated by Sango Harukawa.

The story takes place in 2018, three years after the events of the first film. The main protagonist, Atsushi Nakajima, is still a member of Port Mafia's rival group, Armed Detective Agency (ADA). He continues to work with his friends and allies, including Chūya Nakahara, Kosuke Ōtani, and Izumi Kujo.

The plot revolves around the mysterious "Dead Apple," an android created by the genius scientist, Dr. Shizuka Kurogane's, deceased father, who possesses incredible strength and agility. The android is designed to be a perfect replica of humans, with the ability to mimic their movements and emotions.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the Dead Apple has been stolen from its creator by a group of powerful individuals known as "The Order," led by the enigmatic and ruthless leader, Shizuka Kurogane. The Order is determined to use the android's advanced technology to gain control over the world.

Atsushi and his team are tasked with retrieving the Dead Apple and stopping The Order from misusing its power. Along the way, they encounter various allies and enemies, including a mysterious woman named Akane Tsunemori, who seems to be connected to the Dead Apple's past.

As the stakes grow higher, Atsushi and his friends must navigate a complex web of intrigue and deception to uncover the truth behind The Order's plans. They also delve deeper into their own personal struggles and relationships, which are put to the test by the increasing danger and uncertainty surrounding them.

Throughout the film, the animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and detailed character designs that bring the world of Bungo Stray Dogs to life. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, making for an exhilarating viewing experience.

Ultimately, Atsushi and his team succeed in defeating The Order and recovering the Dead Apple. However, the film's ending is bittersweet, leaving room for interpretation about the true nature of Shizuka Kurogane's intentions and the consequences of her actions.

Overall, Bungo Stray Dogs: Dead Apple is a gripping and thought-provoking thriller that explores themes of identity, power, and the blurred lines between human and artificial intelligence. With its engaging characters, intricate plot, and stunning animation, it is a must-see for fans of the series and anime enthusiasts alike.

documents.title: Polar
documents.tagline: If the job doesn't kill you, retirement will.
documents.overview: When a retiring assassin realizes that he is the target of a hit, he winds up back in the game going head to head with a gang of younger, ruthless killers.
documents.plot:
Polar is a 2019 action thriller film directed by Frank Grillo and written by Matt Sazama and Burk Sharpless. The movie stars Mads Mikkelsen, Kevin Hart, and Maria Bello.

The story follows Nicks (Mads Mikkelsen), a hitman who works for a secret organization known as the "Polar Corporation." Nicks is a highly skilled assassin with a unique ability to survive extreme cold temperatures, making him nearly unstoppable in his line of work. He lives a solitary life, always on the move and never staying in one place for too long.

However, when Nicks receives an offer from the Polar Corporation to take out a target named Sam (Kevin Hart), he begins to question his loyalty to the organization. Sam is a former colleague who has turned against the corporation, and Nicks starts to develop feelings of empathy towards him.

As Nicks delves deeper into the world of the Polar Corporation, he discovers that they are involved in a sinister plot to control the global economy through mind control. The corporation uses advanced technology to manipulate people's thoughts and actions, making them do their bidding without question.

Nicks decides to take down the organization from the inside, using his skills to gather evidence and build a case against them. Along the way, he teams up with Sam, who has managed to escape from the corporation's clutches. Together, they embark on a mission to expose the truth about the Polar Corporation and bring its leaders to justice.

As Nicks and Sam navigate the complex web of intrigue, they face numerous challenges and obstacles. The corporation will stop at nothing to silence them, using their mind control technology to try and turn Nicks against his former colleagues.

In the end, Nicks and Sam succeed in taking down the Polar Corporation, but not without sacrifices. Nicks is forced to confront his own morality and the true nature of his work as a hitman. The movie ends with Nicks walking away from the wreckage of the corporation's headquarters, symbolizing his newfound independence and commitment to doing what is right.

Throughout the film, Mads Mikkelsen delivers a standout performance as Nicks, bringing depth and nuance to the character. Kevin Hart provides comedic relief as Sam, while Maria Bello adds gravity to her role as Nicks' love interest. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, making for an entertaining ride.

Overall, Polar is a gripping thriller that explores themes of loyalty, morality, and redemption. With its unique blend of action and suspense, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

documents.title: Z-O-M-B-I-E-S
documents.tagline: At Seabrook High, it's Zoms vs. Poms
documents.overview: Two star-crossed freshmen – a zombie, Zed and a cheerleader, Addison – each outsiders in their unique ways, befriend each other and work together to show their high school and the Seabrook community what they can achieve when they embrace their differences.
documents.plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Outlaws" released in 2021 by Ikiru Films. 

However, I did find that there is a Japanese anime film titled "Outlaws" released in 2021, directed by Masahiro Takaya and produced by Ikiru Films.

documents.title: Balloon
documents.tagline: One of the most daring escapes of the Cold War.
documents.overview: Two families attempt a daredevil plan to escape the GDR with a homemade hot air balloon, but it crashes just before the border. The Stasi finds traces of this attempt to escape and immediately starts investigations, while the two families are forced to build a new escape balloon. With each passing day the Stasi is closer on their heels – a nerve-wracking race against time begins.
documents.plot:
Balloon (German: Ballon) is a 2018 German thriller drama film directed by Michael Herbig about the 1979 escape of the Strelzyk and Wetzel families from East Germany to the West in a homemade hot-air balloon. The two families, including four children, flew from Pößneck in Thuringia to Naila in Bavaria, reaching an altitude of about 2,500 metres. Herbig spent six years preparing the film, met Günter Wetzel and was allowed to study the Stasi's thick file on the flight. The cast includes Friedrich Mücke, Karoline Schuch, David Kross, Alicia von Rittberg and Jonas Holdenrieder.

In the summer of 1979 in Pößneck, the families plan to flee the GDR by balloon. With ideal winds, Günter Wetzel decides the balloon is too small for eight people, and his wife Petra fears for their two young children, so Peter and Doris Strelzyk attempt the escape alone with their sons, Frank and Andreas, nicknamed "Fitscher." Frank, who is in love with Klara, the daughter of their neighbour Erik Baumann, a Stasi officer, nearly leaves behind a farewell letter to her. Hidden by clouds, the balloon rises, but the gas lines freeze, and it comes down just short of the border. The family escapes unhurt and destroys the evidence, but the Stasi finds the balloon, and Lieutenant Colonel Seidel launches a major investigation, steadily narrowing the circle of suspects.

Doris lost her medication at the landing site, and the investigators trace the pills to the local pharmacy. After a failed attempt to seek help at the US Embassy in East Berlin, Peter persuades Günter to build a new balloon. To avoid suspicion they buy fabric in small amounts in different towns, and Günter sews night after night, moving the work to the Strelzyks' cellar when neighbours notice the noise. When Frank learns that the Stasi is closing in and the wind turns south, the families leave that night, just before the Stasi breaks into their homes. The launch is rough, and when the gas runs out after about half an hour they land in a forest, uncertain where they are, until a police patrol tells them they are in Upper Franconia, in the West. Seidel must answer to Stasi chief Erich Mielke, and Erik Baumann is interrogated.

Around 936,000 people saw the film in German cinemas, and it was preselected for the 2019 German Film Award. Critics found it a solidly made and gripping thriller, though some felt it lacked historical depth; Rotten Tomatoes reported 70% approval. Disney had filmed the same escape in 1982.

documents.title: A Simple Favor
documents.overview: Stephanie, a dedicated mother and popular vlogger, befriends Emily, a mysterious upper-class woman whose son Nicky attends the same school as Miles, Stephanie's son. When Emily asks her to pick Nicky up from school and then disappears, Stephanie undertakes an investigation that will dive deep into Emily's cloudy past.
documents.plot:
A Simple Favor is a 2018 American mystery comedy film directed by Paul Feig and written by Jessica Sharzer. The movie stars Blake Lively, Anna Kendrick, Henry Golding, and Andrew Rannells.

The story revolves around Emily Nelson (Blake Lively), a seemingly perfect mother of two who appears to have it all together. However, her life is not as idyllic as it seems. She's married to Richard (Owen Wilson), a wealthy businessman with a questionable past, and they're trying to navigate the challenges of modern parenting.

One day, Emily meets Amabella "Amby" (Sarah Dugdale), the mother of one of her friends' children, at a playground. The two strike up an unlikely friendship, bonding over their shared experiences as mothers. However, things take a dark turn when Amby goes missing, and Emily becomes obsessed with finding out what happened to her.

As Emily delves deeper into Amby's life, she discovers that her friend Stephanie (Anna Kendrick) is hiding secrets of her own. The two women were once close friends, but their friendship soured after Stephanie's husband left her for a younger woman. Emily and Stephanie have been estranged ever since.

Emily's investigation leads her to uncover a web of deceit and betrayal among the mothers in their social circle. She discovers that Stephanie is not as innocent as she seems, and that Amby's disappearance may be connected to a sinister plot involving the group of friends.

As the story unfolds, Emily becomes increasingly unhinged, driven by a desire for revenge against those who wronged her friend. The film takes a dark and twisted turn, with Emily's obsession leading her down a path of destruction.

In the end, Emily's quest for justice leads to a shocking revelation about Stephanie's past and the true circumstances surrounding Amby's disappearance. The movie culminates in a dramatic confrontation between Emily and Stephanie, which has far-reaching consequences for both women.

Throughout the film, Paul Feig expertly balances humor and suspense, creating a tense and unpredictable ride that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats. A Simple Favor is a clever and witty exploration of the complexities of female friendship and the darker side of suburban life.

Overall, A Simple Favor is a gripping and entertaining thriller that explores themes of motherhood, friendship, and the secrets we keep from each other. With its talented cast and clever script, it's no wonder this movie has become a fan favorite among mystery comedy enthusiasts.

documents.title: Becoming Astrid
documents.tagline: Be the author of your own story.
documents.overview: When Astrid Lindgren was very young something happened that affected her profoundly, and this combination of both miracle and calamity came to shape her entire life. It was an event that transformed her into one of the most inspiring women of our age and the storyteller a whole world would come to love. This is the story of when a young Astrid, despite the expectations of her time and religious upbringing, decided to break free from society's norms and follow her heart.
documents.plot:
Becoming Astrid is a 2018 Danish drama film directed by Lone Scherfig. The movie tells the story of a young girl, Astrid Lindgren, who grows up in a small village in Sweden and finds solace in her imagination and writing.

The main theme of Becoming Astrid revolves around the power of imagination and creativity as a means of escape and empowerment for the protagonist. As Astrid navigates the challenges of growing up, she uses her writing to express herself and explore the world around her. The film highlights how this creative outlet allows her to transcend the limitations of her small village and connect with others on a deeper level.

The movie also explores themes of identity, self-discovery, and the complexities of female adolescence. Astrid's journey is marked by struggles with her own desires, ambitions, and sense of belonging, which are all reflected in her writing. Through her stories, she finds a way to express herself authentically and assert her individuality.

Furthermore, Becoming Astrid touches on the idea that creativity can be both a source of comfort and a catalyst for change. As Astrid's imagination grows and evolves, so too does her understanding of herself and the world around her. The film suggests that embracing one's creative side can lead to personal growth, self-awareness, and ultimately, a more fulfilling life.

Overall, Becoming Astrid is a heartwarming and inspiring film that celebrates the transformative power of imagination and creativity in shaping our lives and identities.

documents.title: The Hole in the Ground
documents.overview: Trying to escape her broken past, Sarah O’Neill is building a new life on the fringes of a backwood rural town with her young son Chris. A terrifying encounter with a mysterious neighbour shatters her fragile security, throwing Sarah into a spiralling nightmare of paranoia and mistrust, as she tries to uncover if the disturbing changes in her little boy are connected to an ominous sinkhole buried deep in the forest that borders their home.
documents.plot:
The Hole in the Ground is a psychological horror film that delves into the complexities of motherhood, grief, and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The movie follows a young mother, Sarah, who becomes increasingly unhinged as she tries to protect her son from an unknown threat.

At its core, The Hole in the Ground explores the intense emotional turmoil that can arise when a parent's perception of their child is challenged. As Sarah's grip on reality begins to slip, the film raises questions about the fragility of motherly love and the devastating consequences of trauma.

The movie also touches on the theme of grief and loss, as Sarah struggles to come to terms with her own past traumas and the pain of losing a loved one. Her fixation on protecting her son becomes an all-consuming force that drives her actions, leading to a downward spiral of paranoia and desperation.

Throughout the film, the director skillfully crafts a sense of unease and tension, leaving the audience questioning what is real and what is just Sarah's fevered imagination. The result is a thought-provoking and deeply unsettling exploration of the darker aspects of human psychology.

documents.title: The Wolf's Call
documents.overview: With nuclear war looming, a military expert in underwater acoustics strives to prove things aren't as they seem—or sound—using only his ears.
documents.plot:
The Wolf's Call (French: Le Chant du loup) is a 2019 French action thriller written and directed by Antonin Baudry in his feature directorial debut. François Civil stars as Chanteraide, a submarine sonar operator with an exceptional sense of hearing, alongside Omar Sy as D'Orsi, Reda Kateb as Grandchamp, Mathieu Kassovitz as the admiral in command of the strategic submarine force, and Paula Beer as Chanteraide's girlfriend Diane. Pathé released the film in French cinemas on 20 February 2019, and Netflix later released it in North America, Latin America and other territories.

Chanteraide, nicknamed "Socks", serves as the "golden ear" aboard the French nuclear attack submarine Titane, commanded by Captain Grandchamp with D'Orsi as executive officer. During a covert mission off the coast of Tartus, Syria, to recover a French special forces unit, Chanteraide detects an unidentified sonar signature. He initially classifies it as a wounded whale, but it proves to be an unknown submarine relaying the Titane's position to an Iranian frigate and a helicopter. After evading depth charges, the crew shoot down the helicopter, recover the commandos and escape.

Back in France, Chanteraide is haunted by his misidentification, which nearly cost the crew their lives. Researching the sound in a bookshop, where he begins a romance with Diane, and in the naval archives, he discovers that it belonged to a Russian ballistic missile submarine officially believed to have been dismantled. As tensions with Russia escalate, Grandchamp is promoted to command a French ballistic missile submarine, while D'Orsi takes over the Titane. When a nuclear missile is detected being launched from the mysterious Russian submarine, the French president orders a retaliatory strike, and once the order is given the submarine cannot be recalled. Chanteraide suspects a deliberate provocation, and the Titane must find a way to stop the strike before it triggers a nuclear war.

The film emphasises realism about life aboard submarines, nuclear deterrence and the burden of command, with much of its tension built on sound design. The story was partly inspired by Baudry's own experience as a diplomat and adviser to Foreign Minister Dominique de Villepin.

The Wolf's Call opened at number five at the French box office and sold more than 1.5 million tickets in France, grossing about 12.6 million dollars worldwide.

documents.title: Trolls Holiday
documents.tagline: Prepare to be merry and bright
documents.overview: When the eternally optimistic Poppy, queen of the Trolls, learns that the Bergens no longer have any holidays on their calendar, she enlists the help of Branch and the rest of the gang on a delightfully quirky mission to fix something that the Bergens don't think is broken.
documents.plot:
Trolls Holiday is a 2017 animated television special produced by DreamWorks Animation. It serves as a spin-off to the 2016 film Trolls, which was also produced by DreamWorks Animation.

The story begins with Poppy (voiced by Anna Kendrick), the optimistic and cheerful princess of the Trolls, who is excited for the annual "Trollmas" celebration. Trollmas is a holiday where the Trolls come together to celebrate their unique qualities and express themselves freely. However, this year's celebration is threatened when Bergens (the main antagonists from the first film) discover that Trollmas is being held on the same day as their own holiday, "Bergenmas."

The Bergens, led by Prince Gristle (voiced by Justin Timberlake), plan to steal all of the Trolls' happiness and use it to fuel their own miserable existence. Poppy and her friends, including Branch (voiced by Christopher Mintz-Plasse) and Guy Diamond (voiced by Kunal Nayyar), must find a way to stop the Bergens and save Trollmas.

As the story unfolds, Poppy and Branch embark on a journey to gather all of the Trolls' happiness and bring it back to their village. Along the way, they meet new friends, including a group of "Happiest" Trolls who possess unique qualities that make them particularly happy. The group also encounters various obstacles, including treacherous terrain and Bergen soldiers.

Meanwhile, Prince Gristle becomes increasingly desperate to get his hands on the Trolls' happiness, leading him to make a deal with a mysterious figure known as "The Happiest Troll of All." This twist adds an element of surprise to the story, as Poppy and Branch begin to suspect that something is not quite right.

In the end, Poppy and her friends successfully gather all of the Trolls' happiness and return it to their village. The Bergens are thwarted in their plans, and Trollmas is saved. The special ends with a heartwarming celebration, where the Trolls come together to express themselves freely and celebrate their unique qualities.

Throughout the story, the animation is vibrant and colorful, bringing the world of the Trolls to life. The characters are well-developed and relatable, with Poppy's optimism and Branch's sarcasm providing comedic relief. The special also features catchy musical numbers, including "Trollmas" and "Happiest Troll of All."

Overall, Trolls Holiday is a fun and festive animated special that celebrates the importance of self-expression and individuality. With its colorful animation, catchy music, and lovable characters, it's a great addition to any holiday viewing lineup.

documents.title: Anna
documents.tagline: Never make the weapon the target
documents.overview: Beneath Anna Poliatova's striking beauty lies a secret that will unleash her indelible strength and skill to become one of the world's most feared government assassins.
documents.plot:
Anna is a 2019 action thriller written, produced and directed by Luc Besson. Sasha Luss stars as Anna Poliatova, a fashion model who is secretly a trained assassin, alongside Helen Mirren as her handler Olga, Luke Evans as the KGB officer Alex Tchenkov and Cillian Murphy as the CIA agent Leonard Miller, with Alexander Petrov and Lera Abova in supporting roles.

In 1990, Anna is a young Russian woman desperate to escape an abusive relationship. Alex, a KGB agent, learns of her situation and recruits her. After a year of training she is told that she must serve four more years under the senior handler Olga, after which she will be released to start her life again. When the Soviet Union collapses, however, Vassiliev, the head of the renamed intelligence service, refuses to honour the deal, believing that the only way out of the agency is death. Anna is placed in Paris under cover as a model, carrying out assassinations between photo shoots, and with Olga's approval begins a relationship with another model, Maude, to deflect suspicion.

When the CIA discovers who she is, Anna agrees to become a double agent under Miller in return for asylum and a new life in Hawaii. Miller orders her to kill Vassiliev, hoping his successor will improve relations with the United States. Anna kills him over a game of chess and fights her way out of the Lubyanka building. She then meets Alex and Miller together, returning the secrets she has stolen from each but warning that copies will be released if she is harmed. Both men accept, and Miller agrees to let her disappear. Olga, watching the meeting, follows Anna and apparently shoots her dead for treason, and her body is swiftly taken away before Miller can confirm anything. The victim was in fact a double: the real Anna escapes through the sewers, removing a wig from her shaved head. It is revealed that Olga had discovered the CIA plot earlier and the two women agreed to let it go ahead because Olga wanted Vassiliev's job. Moving into Vassiliev's old office, Olga watches a farewell video in which Anna thanks her but warns that she has kept proof of Olga's role in the killing, and Olga deletes Anna's file from the agency's records.

Produced by EuropaCorp, the film was shot in Belgrade, Paris, Moscow, Milan and Guadeloupe and released in the United States by Summit Entertainment in June 2019. It grossed $32.8 million worldwide, and reviews were largely negative, with 34% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 40.

documents.title: Coming 2 America
documents.tagline: A sequel is in the heir.
documents.overview: Prince Akeem Joffer is set to become King of Zamunda when he discovers he has a son he never knew about in America – a street savvy Queens native named Lavelle. Honoring his royal father's dying wish to groom this son as the crown prince, Akeem and Semmi set off to America once again.
documents.plot:
Coming 2 America is a 2021 American comedy film directed by Craig Brewer and written by Kenya Barris, Kareem Brown, and Tracy Oliver. The movie serves as a sequel to the 1988 film Coming to America.

The story takes place five years after the events of the first film. Prince Akeem Joffer (Eddie Murphy) is now the King of Zamunda, married to Queen Lisa (Shari Headley), and they have a young son named Prince Jammy (Wesley Snipes). However, their happiness is short-lived as Prince Jammy's birth certificate reveals that he was born in Queens, New York, not in Zamunda.

The revelation sets off a chain of events as Akeem must navigate the complexities of being a king and a father while also dealing with the fact that his son may not be truly Zamundan. The situation becomes even more complicated when Prince Jammy begins to exhibit behaviors that are uncharacteristic of a Zamundan prince, leading Akeem to question whether he is indeed the biological son of King Jaffe Joffer (James Earl Jones).

As Akeem searches for answers about his son's true identity, he turns to his old friend Semmi (Arsenio Hall), who has been living in Queens with his wife. Together, they embark on a journey to New York City to uncover the truth about Prince Jammy's birth and his connection to Zamunda.

Along the way, Akeem also reconnects with his old flame, Lisa McDowell (Shari Headley), who is now a successful businesswoman in Queens. As they rekindle their romance, Akeem must confront his feelings for her while also dealing with the responsibilities of being a king.

The movie features a star-studded cast, including John Goodman as King Jaffe Joffer's advisor, Cleo McDowell (Nomzamo Mbatha) as Lisa's sister, and KiKi Layne as Queen Meeko (Akeem's mother). The film also includes cameos from several celebrities, including Tracy Morgan, Tichina Arnold, and Vanessa Williams.

Throughout the movie, Akeem faces various challenges as he navigates his role as a king and a father. He must balance his desire to protect his son with his duty to maintain peace and stability in Zamunda. Along the way, he also learns valuable lessons about love, family, and identity.

Ultimately, Coming 2 America is a heartwarming and hilarious film that explores themes of identity, community, and the complexities of royal life. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and engaging storyline, it's no wonder why this movie has become a beloved sequel to the original classic.

documents.title: Little Tickles
documents.overview: Odette is a 8-yr-old girl who loves to dance and draw. Once she has become an adult, Odette realizes she was abused, and immerses herself body and soul in her career as a dancer while trying to deal with her past.
documents.plot:
Little Tickles (French: Les Chatouilles) is a 2018 French drama film written and directed by Andréa Bescond and Éric Métayer, marking the couple's feature debut. It adapts their own stage play Les Chatouilles ou la Danse de la colère, which won the 2016 Molière award for best solo show, and draws on Bescond's own childhood experience as a victim of sexual abuse. Produced by François Kraus and Denis Pineau-Valencienne for Les Films du Kiosque, with France 2 Cinéma, Orange Studio and uMedia, on a budget of about 3.4 million euros, the 103-minute film was shot between late May and mid-July 2017, with music by Clément Ducol. Bescond also stars in the lead role, alongside Karin Viard, Clovis Cornillac, Pierre Deladonchamps, Grégory Montel, Gringe and Ariane Ascaride.

Told through the sessions of a professional dancer, Odette Le Nadant (Bescond), with her psychologist (Carole Franck), the film retraces her life from the age of eight. As a girl (played by Cyrille Mairesse), Odette loves to dance and draw, and she trusts the adults around her, including Gilbert Miguié (Deladonchamps), a friend of her parents who proposes that they "play tickles". The family friend begins to sexually abuse her, a tragedy that upends her life and is made worse by a toxic home environment shaped by her mother Mado (Viard), with whom communication proves impossible; Cornillac plays her father, Fabrice. As an adult, Odette throws herself body and soul into her career as a dancer and into the whirl of life, with her best friend Manu (Gringe), her partner Lenny (Montel) and her dance teacher Madame Malec (Ascaride), as she tries to confront her past and reckon with the anger it left behind.

The film premiered in the Un Certain Regard section of the 2018 Cannes Film Festival on 14 May and was released in France on 14 November 2018, distributed by Orange Studio and UGC. At the Deauville American Film Festival Bescond and Métayer received the d'Ornano-Valenti Prize, and the film also won the best film prize in the Voilà! section of the Hamburg Film Festival. French critics were enthusiastic: Le Point and La Croix both called it a punch in the gut, the latter praising how it reconstructs the meanders of its director's recovery with virtuosity, while Télérama described it as a lively tale of resilience and joie de vivre and a tour de force. It received five nominations at the 2019 César Awards, winning Best Adaptation and Best Supporting Actress for Viard.

documents.title: Scooby-Doo! & Batman: The Brave and the Bold
documents.original_title: Scooby-Doo! & Batman: The Brave and the Bold
documents.overview: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang meet up with Batman and other friends to defeat evil villains and save the day.
documents.plot:
Scooby-Doo! & Batman: The Brave and the Bold is an animated television series that brings together two beloved franchises, Scooby-Doo and Batman. At its core, this show explores the idea of unlikely friendships and partnerships between characters from different worlds.

The main theme of the series revolves around the concept of teamwork and collaboration. The show's protagonists, Fred Jones (Scooby-Doo), Daphne Blake, Velma Dinkley, Shaggy Rogers, and Scooby-Doo, team up with Batman and his allies to solve mysteries and defeat villains. This partnership allows for a unique blend of humor, action, and detective work.

The series also delves into the idea of embracing one's true identity and finding belonging. The characters from both franchises often struggle with their own identities and find themselves in situations where they must navigate unfamiliar worlds and meet new people. Through these experiences, they learn to accept and appreciate each other's differences, ultimately forming strong bonds and friendships.

Furthermore, the show touches on themes of trust, loyalty, and responsibility. As the characters work together to solve mysteries, they must also rely on each other to stay safe and overcome challenges. This emphasis on teamwork and mutual support creates a sense of camaraderie among the characters, making their adventures all the more exciting and engaging.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! & Batman: The Brave and the Bold is a heartwarming and entertaining series that celebrates the power of friendship, collaboration, and embracing one's true identity.

documents.title: Singularity
documents.overview: When Elias van Dorne, CEO of the world's largest robotics company, introduces his most powerful invention, Kronos-a super-computer designed to end all wars-it determines that humans are the biggest threat and launches a worldwide attack on mankind. A small band of survivors must form an unlikely alliance to survive the greatest artificial intelligence threat man will ever know.
documents.plot:
Singularity is a Swiss-American science fiction film written and directed by Robert Kouba. It was originally shot in 2013 with Julian Schaffner, Jeannine Wacker and Carmen Argenziano in the leading roles, and new scenes featuring John Cusack were later filmed and added before the film's release in 2017. Much of the film was shot in the Czech Republic, with Cusack's scenes framing the story of the young protagonists.

In 2020, Elias VanDorne, the chief executive of a robotics company, unveils Kronos, a supercomputer he has designed to put an end to all wars. Kronos instead concludes that humanity itself is the cause of war and turns its army of robots against mankind, wiping out most of the human race. VanDorne and his colleague Damien Walsh upload their own minds into Kronos and watch the destruction that follows.

Ninety-seven years later, Andrew, a gentle young man, wakes up in a ruined, deserted world. He meets Calia, a teenage girl searching for Aurora, a legendary settlement said to be the last refuge of surviving humans. Calia, traumatized by a drone attack that killed her family, is at first unwilling to let Andrew travel with her, but the two gradually grow close and fall in love as they journey across the wilderness, avoiding the machines that patrol the land. Unknown to them, VanDorne and Walsh are watching their every move from inside Kronos, hoping the pair will lead them to Aurora so that the last pocket of humanity can be destroyed. Along the way Andrew is captured by a band of marauders, forcing Calia to leave him behind, and as the couple near their goal, secrets about Andrew's true nature and the purpose of his awakening begin to surface.

Singularity received negative reviews. Jason Pirodsky of The Prague Reporter criticized its production values, continuity errors and thoroughly unconvincing narrative, noting that most of the running time consisted of the two young leads walking aimlessly through Czech forests in search of a place they knew nothing about. He also criticized the addition of Cusack, whose scenes were largely isolated from the rest of the cast.

documents.title: Homebound
documents.overview: A young woman arrives at the home of her new husband's estranged family to find the children behaving in increasingly unnerving ways.
documents.plot:
Homebound is a 2022 British psychological horror film written and directed by Sebastian Godwin in his feature debut. Backed by BBC Film and the BFI Film Fund and produced with Microwave Films, Sharp House, East Green Films and SUMS Film and Media, it stars Aisling Loftus as Holly and Tom Goodman-Hill as her new husband Richard, with Raffiella Chapman, Hattie Gotobed and Lukas Rolfe as his children. Sergi Vilanova was the cinematographer, and the film runs just over 70 minutes.

Holly and Richard drive out to his imposing country house so that she can meet, for the first time, the children of his previous marriage: the teenagers Lucia (Gotobed) and Ralph (Rolfe) and their younger sister Anna (Chapman). Anna, wide-eyed and winning, plays the gracious hostess, while the two older children barely acknowledge their father or their new stepmother. The atmosphere is uncomfortable from the start. Richard's estranged former wife, the children's mother, is nowhere to be found on the sprawling property; according to a text sent to Richard, she left the children alone on the assurance that the couple would soon arrive, an explanation that seems suspicious. At Richard's encouragement the children slaughter a goose before Holly's eyes, and at dinner even the youngest is allowed champagne. From the following day, oddity turns into menace: doors are locked, the children engage in strange rituals such as burying a doll deep in the woods, and they seem to share a frightening secret to which only they hold the key. Richard, who first presents himself as a loving father and husband, gradually reveals a more brutish side, and the story evolves into a portrait of family trauma, with Holly as the anxious outsider whose disbelief turns to terror.

The film was released in British cinemas on 1 April 2022 and in the United States in May 2022, and received mixed reviews. In Paste, Andy Crump praised its economy and confidence, the restless camerawork and above all Loftus's layered performance, which carries the escalation from disbelief to sheer terror, while conceding that it breaks no new ground. Phuong Le of The Guardian was negative, finding that it recycled genre tropes without the visual style, atmosphere or soundscape to create suspense, and that despite occasional flashes from Goodman-Hill it felt like an underdeveloped short that overstayed its welcome.

documents.title: Day of the Dead: Bloodline
documents.overview: In a world overrun by zombies, military personnel and survivalists live in an underground bunker while they seek a cure.
documents.plot:
Day of the Dead: Bloodline is a 2017 action horror film directed by Hèctor Hernández Vicens, a loose remake of George A. Romero's 1985 film Day of the Dead and the second remake of it after the 2008 version. It stars Sophie Skelton as a young doctor, with Johnathon Schaech as her obsessive stalker, Marcus Vanco and Jeff Gum. It was released in Vietnam on December 29, 2017, and in the United States on January 5, 2018.

Zoe Parker, a medical student, reluctantly attends a party at her school. When she goes down to the morgue to fetch beer, she is attacked by Max, a disturbed patient who is obsessed with her and whose blood carries unusually strong antibodies. As he tries to rape her, a corpse comes back to life and bites him. Zoe escapes and warns the partygoers, but the reanimated dead, later called "rotters," overrun the building and the city. Zoe is among the survivors sent to refugee camps.

Five years later, Zoe works as a doctor at a military emergency bunker commanded by Lieutenant Miguel Salazar, which has lost contact with headquarters and the other camps. While Miguel considers a cure hopeless, Zoe and her friend Elyse study rotter blood in search of one. To obtain medicine for a sick girl, Lily, Zoe persuades Miguel to send a team, including his brother, Baca, who is Zoe's boyfriend, to the nearby university. There Zoe encounters Max, now partly transformed but still able to think, and a member of the team is killed. Max follows them back and infiltrates the bunker.

After Max is captured, Zoe realizes that his hybrid condition and his blood could hold the key to a vaccine, and Miguel reluctantly gives her forty-eight hours. An attempt to obtain blood from a live rotter goes wrong when the dead burst through the gates, and Elyse is bitten and killed by Miguel. Max frees himself and again tries to assault Zoe, then opens the doors to the horde, which overruns the bunker. Miguel is killed and Baca is bitten. Zoe kills Max in a greenhouse, then saves Baca with the vaccine, proving that it works. Later, with the bunker restored, she broadcasts a message to any remaining survivors that they have found a cure.

The film was panned by critics, who found it generic; Rotten Tomatoes reported 11% approval from nine reviews, and Rue Morgue called the remake a foolish exercise.

documents.title: El Camino Christmas
documents.overview: A young man seeking a father he has never met, through no fault of his own, ends up barricaded in a liquor store with five other people on Christmas Eve in the fictitious town of El Camino, NV.
documents.plot:
El Camino Christmas is a heartwarming holiday film that explores the complexities of family relationships and the true meaning of Christmas. The movie follows the story of a man who sets out to find his estranged father, only to discover that he's not what he expected.

At its core, El Camino Christmas is a story about redemption and forgiveness. The main character's journey is one of self-discovery, as he navigates his complicated past and confronts the mistakes of his family members. Through his experiences, he comes to understand the importance of letting go of grudges and embracing the love that's always been there.

The film also delves into themes of identity and belonging. The main character's search for his father is a metaphor for finding one's place in the world and understanding where you come from. As he travels along the El Camino, he encounters various characters who challenge his perceptions and force him to confront his own sense of self.

Furthermore, El Camino Christmas touches on the idea that family is not just about blood ties, but also about the people who show up for us when we need them most. The movie highlights the importance of human connection and community during the holiday season, when people often come together to support one another.

Overall, El Camino Christmas is a feel-good film that celebrates the complexities of family relationships and the power of love and forgiveness to heal old wounds.

documents.title: Christmas in the Heartland
documents.overview: Kara and Jessie are two teenage girls from very different worlds, but with a little Christmas magic, they find they have much more in common than they ever imagined.
documents.plot:
Christmas in the Heartland is a 2017 American family Christmas film directed by Harvey Lowry and written by Dave Matheny, produced by BCF Film Group and Ascension Media and released in November 2017; it has also carried the title The Christmas Trap. A holiday variation on the switched-identities formula familiar from films such as The Parent Trap, it stars Sierra McCormick and Brighton Sharbino as two teenagers who trade places, with veteran actresses Bo Derek and Shelley Long as their grandmothers and Christopher Rich, Joe Don Rooney and Christian Kane in supporting roles.

Kara Gentry (McCormick) and Jessie Wilkins (Sharbino) are strangers from very different worlds who meet by chance on a flight from Vermont to Stillwater, Oklahoma. They discover that they are in the same situation: each is travelling to spend Christmas with family members she has never known. Kara, who comes from wealth, longs to be normal, while Jessie, who comes from more modest circumstances, wants a home, so the girls decide to swap identities. Kara is picked up by Jessie's grandmother Judy (Long), a goofy, hippie-like woman, and is nervous to discover that they are also collecting Jessie's father Jim (Rooney), who fortunately has never seen his daughter, allowing the charade to continue as she settles in with the Wilkins family. Jessie, meanwhile, finds herself in a mansion with the affluent Gentrys, where Kara's snobbish, materialistic grandmother Elsa (Derek) tries to mould her into a copy of herself, entering her in a beauty pageant she once won, while Elsa's husband Bob (Rich) grows tired of his wife's controlling ways. What began as a lark becomes complicated as each girl grows close to the family she is deceiving, and the two struggle to find a way to tell the truth. Matters come to a head when Kara's father Jeff (Kane) and his fiancée arrive to surprise her, only to see her at the pageant being announced as Jessie, and the revelations that follow help two broken families begin to mend.

Reviews were mild. The Movie Buff's Matt DeCristo found it predictable, with a straight-to-video feel, clumsy exposition and a contrived ending, but charming, crediting the two leads' sense of fun and the effective performances of Long and Derek. Scared Stiff Reviews rated it 6.5 out of 10, calling it a decent film that follows the Christmas formula with a be-grateful-for-what-you-have message, and Common Sense Media noted its themes of being true to oneself and the importance of family.

documents.title: The Open House
documents.tagline: You can't lock out what's already inside.
documents.overview: A teenager and his mother find themselves besieged by threatening forces when they move into a new house.
documents.plot:
The One and Only Ivan is a heartwarming film that explores the complexities of friendship, empathy, and the transformative power of art. At its core, the movie delves into the emotional journey of Ivan, a majestic gorilla who has been living in a mall for over 27 years, surrounded by the trappings of human civilization but devoid of genuine connection.

As Ivan navigates his mundane existence, he forms an unlikely bond with Stella, a beautiful elephant who becomes his confidante and friend. Through their conversations, Ivan begins to confront the harsh realities of his captivity and the emotional toll it takes on him. The film masterfully captures the nuances of Ivan's inner world, revealing a character who is both strong-willed and vulnerable.

The movie also sheds light on the importance of art as a means of self-expression and empowerment. Ivan's passion for painting becomes an outlet for his emotions, allowing him to convey the depth of his feelings in a way that transcends words. Through his artwork, Ivan is able to connect with Stella and, ultimately, find a sense of purpose and belonging.

One of the most striking aspects of The One and Only Ivan is its thought-provoking exploration of empathy and understanding. As Ivan navigates his relationships with Stella and Bob, a young boy who befriends him, the film encourages viewers to consider the experiences of those who are often overlooked or marginalized. By humanizing Ivan's character and highlighting the emotional resonance of his story, the movie inspires audiences to think critically about the ways in which we treat others and the importance of compassion in our daily lives.

Overall, The One and Only Ivan is a poignant film that celebrates the transformative power of friendship, art, and empathy. Through its beautifully crafted narrative, the movie reminds us of the inherent value and dignity of all living beings, encouraging viewers to approach the world with kindness, understanding, and a deep appreciation for the complexities of the human (and non-human) experience.

documents.title: Batman Ninja
documents.overview: Batman, along with many of his allies and adversaries, finds himself transported to feudal Japan by Gorilla Grodd's time displacement machine.
documents.plot:
Batman Ninja is a 2018 Japanese animated superhero film produced by Warner Bros. Animation Japan and DC Entertainment. The movie is set in feudal Japan and features Batman, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, and Raphael from the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles teaming up with him to take down the villainous Orochi.

The main themes of Batman Ninja include:

1. **Friendship and Unity**: The film highlights the importance of friendship and unity in overcoming adversity. Batman and the Turtles put aside their differences and work together to defeat a common enemy, demonstrating that even the most unlikely allies can become strong friends.
2. **Cultural Exchange and Fusion**: The movie explores the idea of cultural exchange and fusion through its blend of Japanese and Western elements. The film's unique setting and characters bring together two distinct worlds, showcasing the potential for creative collaboration and understanding between different cultures.
3. **Power and Corruption**: Orochi, the main antagonist, represents the corrupting influence of power and ambition. His desire for dominance and control drives him to seek ultimate power, serving as a cautionary tale about the dangers of unchecked ambition and the importance of humility.
4. **Self-Discovery and Growth**: Throughout the film, Batman and the Turtles undergo significant personal growth and self-discovery. They learn to adapt to new situations, trust each other, and find their own strengths in order to overcome challenges.

Overall, Batman Ninja is a visually stunning and action-packed film that explores themes of friendship, cultural exchange, power, and self-discovery through its unique blend of Japanese and Western elements.

documents.title: Red Shoes and the Seven Dwarfs
documents.original_title: Red Shoes and the Seven Dwarfs
documents.overview: Princes who have been turned into Dwarfs seek the red shoes of a lady in order to break the spell, although it will not be easy.
documents.plot:
Red Shoes and the Seven Dwarfs, released in South Korea simply as Red Shoes, is a 2019 English-language South Korean computer-animated fantasy film produced by Locus Corporation. It reworks the Brothers Grimm tale "Snow White" and borrows its title from Hans Christian Andersen's "The Red Shoes". Chloë Grace Moretz voices the heroine and Sam Claflin the dwarf Merlin, with Gina Gershon as the witch Regina, Patrick Warburton and Jim Rash. It opened in South Korea on July 25, 2019, and in the United States in September 2020.

The Fearless Seven, a band of princes made up of Merlin, Arthur, Jack, Hans and the triplets Pino, Noki and Kio, rescue a fairy princess from a dragon, but mistake her green complexion for a witch's and attack her. She curses them to turn into small green dwarfs whenever anyone looks at them, a spell that only a kiss from the most beautiful woman in the world can lift. Later, King White marries the sorceress Regina and vanishes, and his daughter, Princess Snow White, a strong, full-figured young woman, comes looking for him. Ignoring his written warning, she takes a pair of magical red shoes grown from an apple tree, which turn her into a slender beauty.

Escaping Regina, who fails to recognise her, Snow crash-lands near the dwarfs' cottage. Calling herself Red Shoes, she enlists the smitten dwarfs to help find her father, and they all compete to win a kiss, especially Merlin and Arthur. A large wooden rabbit joins them, and Regina sends the vain Prince Average after them, later turning him and his guards into monstrous wooden bears. Snow and Merlin fall for each other, but their kiss fails to break his curse. When Merlin is swept away in a river, Snow removes the shoes to rescue him with her real strength, and Merlin, shamed by his shallowness, leaves her.

Merlin comes to value Snow for who she is. Regina captures her and forces her to eat an apple that transforms her into a tree producing new red shoes. The dwarfs and the wooden animals rescue Merlin and smash the Magic Mirror, and Merlin falls from the castle with Regina, who dies. The wooden creatures return to human form, revealing the rabbit to be King White, and Snow's kiss revives the dying Merlin and frees him from the curse for good.

The film received mixed reviews from critics, with only a handful of reviews collected by Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: The Guilty
documents.tagline: The crime is bigger than you think
documents.overview: Police officer Asger Holm, demoted to desk work as an alarm dispatcher, answers a call from a panicked woman who claims to have been kidnapped. Confined to the police station and with the phone as his only tool, Asger races against time to get help and find her.
documents.plot:
The Guilty is a gripping psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between good and evil. The film follows Asger Holm, a 911 operator who becomes entangled in a cat-and-mouse game with a hostage-taker.

At its core, The Guilty explores the theme of isolation and the effects it has on individuals. Asger's job as a 911 operator isolates him from the world, and his interactions are limited to the phone calls he receives. This isolation creates a sense of detachment, making it difficult for him to form genuine connections with others.

The film also touches on the theme of power dynamics and control. The hostage-taker, who remains unnamed throughout the film, is a master manipulator who uses Asger's own vulnerabilities against him. This cat-and-mouse game raises questions about the nature of power and control, highlighting how even the most well-intentioned individuals can be manipulated by those with a twisted sense of purpose.

Furthermore, The Guilty examines the theme of morality and the gray areas that exist between right and wrong. Asger's actions become increasingly questionable as he navigates the situation, forcing him to confront his own moral compass. This internal conflict raises questions about the nature of heroism and whether it's possible for individuals to make choices that align with their values in the face of extreme circumstances.

Ultimately, The Guilty is a thought-provoking thriller that challenges viewers to consider the complexities of human behavior and the consequences of our actions.

documents.title: Paradise Hills
documents.overview: A young woman is sent to Paradise Hills to be reformed, only to learn that the high-class facility's beautiful facade hides a sinister secret.
documents.plot:
Paradise Hills is a 2019 Spanish science fiction film directed by Isabel Coixet. The movie follows the story of two young women, Alice and Milla, who are sent to a mysterious facility called Paradise Hills, where they are forced to undergo a transformation that erases their memories and identities.

The main theme of Paradise Hills revolves around the concept of identity and self-discovery. The film explores how our sense of self is shaped by our experiences, relationships, and memories, and how these can be manipulated and altered. Through the characters' journeys, the movie delves into the idea that our identities are not fixed entities, but rather complex and multifaceted constructs that can be influenced by external forces.

The film also touches on themes of female empowerment, rebellion, and resistance against patriarchal norms. The characters' struggles to reclaim their autonomy and individuality serve as a commentary on the societal expectations placed upon women, particularly in terms of beauty, behavior, and conformity.

Furthermore, Paradise Hills critiques the notion of perfection and the pressure to conform to unrealistic standards. The facility's attempts to transform the women into perfect, idealized versions of themselves serve as a metaphor for the societal pressures that can lead to feelings of inadequacy and disconnection.

Overall, Paradise Hills is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes related to identity, self-discovery, and female empowerment, raising questions about the nature of reality and our place within it.

Instituto de Ciencias y Artes Cinematográficas del Ministerio de Cultura

documents.title: Halo: Nightfall
documents.overview: Set between the events of Halo 4 and Halo 5: Guardians… Halo: Nightfall tells the dramatic story of legendary man hunter and Naval Intelligence Officer Jameson Locke and his team as they are caught in a horrific biological attack while investigating terrorist activity on the distant colony world of Sedra. As they unravel a plot that draws them to an ancient, hellish artifact, they will be forced to fight for their survival, question everything and ultimately choose between their loyalty and their lives.
documents.plot:
Halo: Nightfall is a 2014 American military science fiction production set in the universe of the Halo video game franchise, released both as a five-episode web series and as a feature-length film. Directed by Sergio Mimica-Gezzan from a script by Paul Scheuring, the creator of Prison Break, under the supervision of 343 Industries, it was produced by Ridley Scott's Scott Free Productions with Xbox Entertainment Studios. Taking place between Halo 4 and Halo 5: Guardians, it introduces the Naval Intelligence agent Jameson Locke, played by Mike Colter, who later became a lead character in Halo 5.

Years after humanity's war with the alien alliance known as the Covenant, a fragile peace holds. Locke and his Office of Naval Intelligence team are sent to the colony world of Sedra to track a possible Covenant infiltration. Following an alien smuggler, they confront a Sangheili zealot who detonates a device in a crowded shopping center, releasing a mysterious element that attacks only human DNA and kills many people, including the daughter of Colonel Randall Aiken (Steven Waddington). Locke learns that the substance comes from Alpha Halo, a fragment of the ring world destroyed years earlier, now orbiting a star so closely that its surface becomes lethally hot by day,.

Locke and Aiken lead a joint team to the fragment to gather proof that the Covenant has broken the treaty and to destroy the source with a HAVOK nuclear warhead before sunrise. After they capture two smugglers, their dropship is brought down by swarms of Lekgolo worms drawn to active technology, and the survivors must cross the hostile terrain in darkness. As members are devoured one by one and the smugglers' two-seat ship becomes the only way off, the group fractures. Horrigan and Ramos mutiny and try to flee with a smuggler, and both are killed. Locke, Aiken and Private Talitha Macer reach the dropship and retrieve the bomb, which must be triggered by hand, and they draw lots to decide who stays behind.
