documents.title: Seberg
documents.overview: An ambitious young FBI agent is assigned to investigate iconic actress Jean Seberg when she becomes embroiled in the tumultuous civil rights movement in late 1960s Los Angeles.
documents.plot:
Seberg is a 2019 biographical drama film that delves into the life of Jean Seberg, an American actress who became embroiled in the Black Panther Party and the anti-war movement during the 1960s. The movie explores themes of identity, politics, and the blurred lines between reality and media portrayal.

At its core, Seberg is a story about a young woman struggling to find her place in the world. Jean Seberg, played by Claire Foy, is an actress who has achieved success but feels suffocated by the expectations placed upon her. Her journey into activism is a quest for authenticity and meaning, as she becomes increasingly drawn to the ideals of the Black Panther Party.

The film also examines the tension between individual freedom and societal conformity. Seberg's involvement with the party puts her at odds with the establishment, and she must navigate the complexities of being an outsider within a movement that is rapidly gaining mainstream attention. This dichotomy raises questions about the role of media in shaping public opinion and the responsibility that comes with influencing others.

Furthermore, Seberg touches on the theme of celebrity culture and its impact on personal relationships. As Jean's fame grows, so does her sense of disconnection from reality. Her marriage to director R.W. Johnson (played by Jason Schwartzman) becomes a symbol of her struggle to maintain a sense of normalcy in a world that is rapidly spiraling out of control.

Ultimately, Seberg is a powerful exploration of the human desire for connection and purpose. The film's portrayal of Jean Seberg's tragic fate serves as a cautionary tale about the dangers of idealism and the importance of staying true to oneself in the face of overwhelming external pressures.

documents.title: The Wizard Hunter: The Hunt for Evangelion Crowley
documents.original_title: The Wizard Hunter: The Hunt for Evangelion Crowley
documents.overview: A detective of lost Art masterpieces will discover his hidden legacy and his true identity during his last mission.
documents.plot:
Army of Darkness is a 1992 American fantasy-comedy film directed by Sam Raimi and starring Bruce Campbell as Ash Williams. The movie is the third installment in The Evil Dead series, following Evil Dead II.

The film begins with Ash (Bruce Campbell) being transported back to medieval Europe from his own time, where he finds himself in the midst of a battle between good and evil forces. Ash soon discovers that he has been brought back for a specific reason: to retrieve the Necronomicon, an ancient book of dark magic.

Upon arrival, Ash meets a group of villagers who are being terrorized by the undead, led by the powerful sorcerer Kell. The villagers believe that Ash is the chosen one, destined to defeat Kell and save their village from destruction.

As Ash navigates this new world, he encounters various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, ferocious creatures, and his own ineptitude in medieval combat. Despite these challenges, Ash proves himself to be resourceful and determined, using his wits and whatever resources available to him to survive.

Throughout the film, Ash's character undergoes significant development as he confronts his own mortality and the nature of evil. He begins to realize that his experiences in the Evil Dead series have prepared him for this moment, and that he has a crucial role to play in the battle between good and evil.

As the story unfolds, Ash faces off against Kell's army of undead warriors, including the iconic Deadite, Chatterer. The film's climax features an epic showdown between Ash and Kell, with Ash ultimately emerging victorious after using his knowledge of the Necronomicon to defeat the sorcerer.

The ending of Army of Darkness is a fitting conclusion to the story, as Ash returns to his own time, forever changed by his experiences in medieval Europe. The film ends on a humorous note, with Ash reflecting on his adventures and remarking that he's "not going back there again."

Overall, Army of Darkness is a cult classic that has become synonymous with Sam Raimi's unique brand of horror-comedy. Bruce Campbell's performance as Ash Williams cemented his status as a genre icon, and the film's blend of humor, action, and fantasy has made it a beloved favorite among fans of the series.

[No additional information is available about Universal Pictures being the production company for Army of Darkness.]

documents.title: The Good Liar
documents.overview: Career con man Roy sets his sights on his latest mark: recently widowed Betty, worth millions. And he means to take it all. But as the two draw closer, what should have been another simple swindle takes on the ultimate stakes.
documents.plot:
The Good Liar is a 2019 crime thriller film directed and produced by Bill Condon and written by Jeffrey Hatcher, based on Nicholas Searle's 2015 novel of the same name. It stars Ian McKellen as a career con artist and Helen Mirren as a wealthy widow he meets through online dating, with Russell Tovey and Jim Carter. The film premiered at BFI Southbank in London on October 28, 2019, and was released by Warner Bros. Pictures in the United Kingdom on November 8 and in the United States on November 15, 2019.

Roy Courtnay is an aging British swindler who uses a string of false identities to gain access to other people's money. In 2009 he sets his sights on Betty McLeish, a recently widowed woman with savings of more than £2 million. After a first date in London, he feigns a bad knee to get himself invited to stay at her house, and soon persuades her to open a joint offshore investment account with him. At the same time, Roy and his partner Vincent are running an elaborate investment scam using fake Russian investors, and when one of their victims discovers he has been robbed and follows Roy through London, Roy kills him at Charing Cross tube station, revealing how dangerous he can be. During a holiday in Berlin, Betty's grandson Stephen confronts him with evidence that the real Roy Courtnay, a young British Army officer, was killed in the city in 1948, and Roy is forced to spin an elaborate new account of his wartime past. Betty appears to accept his explanation, and the couple prepare to transfer their fortunes into the joint account, which Roy intends to empty, leaving her ruined as he has left so many others. But as the con approaches its climax, it becomes clear that Roy is not the only person in the relationship hiding the truth, and that the roots of the deception stretch back to Germany during the Second World War.

The film received mixed reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes, 64% of 165 critics' reviews are positive, with a consensus that it is less than the sum of its prestigious parts but that McKellen and Mirren keep it consistently watchable, and Metacritic gave it a score of 55 out of 100. It grossed $33.4 million worldwide against a $10 million budget.

documents.title: West Side Story
documents.overview: Two youngsters from rival New York City gangs fall in love, but tensions between their respective friends build toward tragedy.
documents.plot:
West Side Story is a 2021 American musical romantic drama directed and produced by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by Tony Kushner. The second feature adaptation of the 1957 stage musical, itself inspired by Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet, it features Leonard Bernstein's music and Stephen Sondheim's lyrics. Ansel Elgort plays Tony and Rachel Zegler, in her film debut, plays María, with Ariana DeBose, David Alvarez, Mike Faist and Rita Moreno, a star of the 1961 version who also served as an executive producer.

In 1957, two rival gangs, the white Jets and the Puerto Rican Sharks, fight for control of San Juan Hill on Manhattan's Upper West Side, a neighbourhood already slated for demolition to make way for Lincoln Center. Jets leader Riff proposes a decisive rumble and asks his old friend Tony, recently paroled after a year in prison for nearly beating a rival to death, to join them. Tony, trying to reform while working for Valentina, the Puerto Rican widow who runs Doc's store, declines. María, the sister of Sharks leader Bernardo, is expected to marry his friend Chino but longs for independence. At a dance that night she and Tony fall in love at first sight, enraging Bernardo, who agrees to the rumble on condition that Tony attends.

Tony and María meet secretly and exchange vows during a visit to the Cloisters, and María makes him promise to stop the fight. Tony fails to disarm Riff, who has bought a gun, and at the rumble Bernardo goads him into a brawl. When Bernardo fatally stabs Riff, Tony grabs a knife and kills Bernardo. Chino leaves with Riff's gun. María, devastated to learn the news, still begs Tony not to surrender, and they plan to flee together. Bernardo's grieving girlfriend Anita eventually accepts their love and goes to Doc's with a message for Tony, but the Jets assault her until Valentina intervenes. Bitter and traumatised, Anita tells them that Chino has killed María.

Despairing, Tony runs through the streets calling for Chino to kill him. He sees María alive just as Chino shoots him, and he dies in her arms. María turns the gun on both gangs, condemning the hatred that caused the deaths, and the Jets and Sharks together carry Tony's body away.

The film was acclaimed by critics, with 91% positive reviews on Rotten Tomatoes, but it was a box-office bomb, grossing about $76 million worldwide. It received seven Academy Award nominations, including Best Picture, and DeBose won Best Supporting Actress for her performance as Anita.

documents.title: Wendell & Wild
documents.overview: Two demon brothers enlist the aid of Kat Elliot — a tough teen with a load of guilt — to summon them to the Land of the Living. But what Kat demands in return leads to a brilliantly bizarre and comedic adventure like no other.
documents.plot:
Wendell & Wild is a stop-motion animated fantasy comedy film directed by Henry Selick, written by Selick and Noelle Stevenson, and produced by The Gotham Group.

The story follows two brothers, Wendell and Will, who are struggling to cope with their father's absence. Their mother has passed away, leaving them in the care of their eccentric and reclusive uncle, Felix. However, things take a turn when Wendell and Will discover that they have been given magical powers by Felix.

The brothers soon find themselves transported to a fantastical world called Demon City, where they meet a group of misfit demons who are also searching for power. They befriend a demon named Wild, who becomes their guide and ally in this new world.

As Wendell and Will navigate the complexities of Demon City, they must confront their own personal demons (literally) and learn to work together to overcome the challenges that lie ahead. Along the way, they discover hidden strengths and weaknesses within themselves, as well as the true nature of their uncle's intentions.

Throughout the film, Selick and Stevenson weave a rich tapestry of characters, each with their own unique personality and backstory. The animation is stunning, with intricate details and textures that bring the world of Demon City to life.

One of the standout aspects of Wendell & Wild is its exploration of themes such as grief, identity, and the complexities of family relationships. The film is both humorous and heartwarming, with a narrative that is both entertaining and emotionally resonant.

Overall, Wendell & Wild is a delightful and imaginative film that will appeal to fans of fantasy and adventure movies. With its rich characters, stunning animation, and engaging storyline, it's a must-see for anyone looking for a fun and emotional cinematic experience.

documents.title: Crawl
documents.overview: When a huge hurricane hits her hometown in Florida, Haley ignores evacuation orders to look for her father. After finding him badly wounded, both are trapped by the flood. With virtually no time to escape the storm, they discover that rising water levels are the least of their problems.
documents.plot:
Crawl is a 2019 American natural horror film directed by Alexandre Aja, who produced it with Sam Raimi and Craig Flores. It stars Kaya Scodelario as Haley Keller, a University of Florida swimmer, and Barry Pepper as her father Dave, who are trapped with the family dog in the crawl space of their home by alligators during a Category 5 hurricane. Morfydd Clark plays Haley's sister Beth and Ross Anderson a state trooper, Wayne. Aja reworked a spec script by brothers Michael and Shawn Rasmussen, and the film was shot largely in a warehouse at the Port of Belgrade, Serbia, over 41 days in 2018.

As a massive hurricane approaches Florida, Haley ignores her sister's advice to leave the state and goes looking for her estranged father. Finding only his dog, Sugar, at his condo, she defies evacuation orders and drives to the family's old house in Coral Lake, an area at risk of flooding. In the crawl space beneath the house she finds Dave, badly mauled but alive. A huge alligator blocks their way out, forcing them into a corner it cannot reach, and when Haley tries to retrieve her dropped phone, a second gator crushes it and injures her leg. Through gaps in the wall she sees three looters at a nearby gas station devoured in the rising water. Wayne, Beth's ex-boyfriend, arrives with his partner Pete to search for them, but Pete is torn apart outside and Wayne is dragged into the crawl space and killed.

With the water rising, Haley swims to a storm drain, where she finds the alligators' nest, kills one with Wayne's gun and escapes into the flooded street. She breaks through the living room floor with a crowbar to free her father, and they head for a boat as the eye of the storm passes, but a levee breach floods the neighborhood and drives them back into the house. Dave loses his forearm to an alligator, and Haley calls for help on a floating police radio, traps one gator in a shower stall and fights off another's death roll by stabbing it in the eye with a flare. Reunited on the roof with Dave and Sugar, she lights a flare to signal a rescue helicopter as her father watches proudly.

Released by Paramount Pictures on July 12, 2019, without conventional press screenings, Crawl was a commercial success, grossing $91.7 million worldwide on a budget of $13.5-15 million. Critics praised it as a fast, frightening creature feature carried by Scodelario; Rotten Tomatoes reported 84% approval and Metacritic a score of 60.

documents.title: There's Someone Inside Your House
documents.tagline: Everyone has a secret to die for.
documents.overview: As the countdown to graduation begins, students at Osborne High are being stalked by a maniac intent on exposing their darkest secrets to the entire town, terrorizing victims while wearing a life-like mask of their own face. With a mysterious past of her own, Makani and her friends must discover the killer's identity before they become victims themselves.
documents.plot:
There's Someone Inside Your House is a horror film directed by Jovia Roberts, not 21 Laps Entertainment. The movie was released in 2021 and stars Sydney Park, Ashton Moio, and Keenan Johnson.

The main themes of There's Someone Inside Your House revolve around the idea of trauma, mental health, and the consequences of past actions. The story follows Makani, a high school student who moves to a new town after her family is attacked by a serial killer. As she tries to rebuild her life, she discovers that there may be another killer in the area.

The film explores themes of grief, anxiety, and PTSD, as Makani struggles to cope with her past trauma. The movie also touches on the idea of social media and how it can both connect and isolate people. Throughout the film, Makani's relationships with her friends and family are put to the test as she tries to navigate her new life.

The ending of the movie is intentionally ambiguous, leaving some questions unanswered, which adds to the overall sense of unease and uncertainty. Overall, There's Someone Inside Your House is a tense and suspenseful horror film that explores themes of trauma, mental health, and the consequences of past actions.

documents.title: Red Notice
documents.overview: An Interpol-issued Red Notice is a global alert to hunt and capture the world's most wanted. But when a daring heist brings together the FBI's top profiler and two rival criminals, there's no telling what will happen.
documents.plot:
Red Notice is a 2021 American action comedy written and directed by Rawson Marshall Thurber, starring Dwayne Johnson, Ryan Reynolds and Gal Gadot, with Ritu Arya and Chris Diamantopoulos in supporting roles. It is Thurber's third collaboration with Johnson after Central Intelligence and Skyscraper. Originally developed at Universal Pictures, the film was acquired by Netflix, which gave it a limited theatrical release on November 5, 2021, before streaming it on November 12.

According to legend, the Roman general Mark Antony gave Cleopatra three jeweled eggs as a wedding gift; two were rediscovered in 1907, but the third was lost for centuries. In the present, FBI profiler John Hartley, working with Interpol inspector Urvashi Das, investigates the theft of one of the eggs from the Castel Sant'Angelo in Rome by the world's most wanted art thief, Nolan Booth. Hartley tracks Booth to his hideout in Bali and arrests him, but Booth's chief rival, the elusive thief known as the Bishop, steals the egg and frames Hartley, who ends up locked in a remote Russian prison alongside Booth.

To clear his name, Hartley proposes an uneasy alliance with Booth to catch the Bishop. The pair escape and race to Valencia to steal the second egg from the arms dealer Sotto Voce during a masquerade ball, but the Bishop, who has teamed up with Voce, outmaneuvers them and forces Booth to reveal the location of the third egg. Booth lies, sending her to Egypt, while the true location, hidden in a watch that belonged to his father, leads to a secret Nazi bunker in the Argentine jungle. As Das and the police close in, a series of double-crosses ensues, culminating in the revelation that Hartley is not an FBI agent at all but a con man who shares the Bishop identity with his partner, leaving Booth to decide whether to join forces with them.

Netflix reported that Red Notice was the most-watched film in its debut weekend and that it remained the most-watched film in the platform's history for several years. Critics were generally unimpressed with its plot and derivative script but praised the stars' chemistry, the action sequences and the humor. Two sequels were announced, planned to be shot back to back.

documents.title: Happy Death Day 2U
documents.overview: Collegian Tree Gelbman wakes up in horror to learn that she's stuck in a parallel universe. Her boyfriend Carter is now with someone else, and her friends and fellow students seem to be completely different versions of themselves. When Tree discovers that Carter's roommate has been altering time, she finds herself once again the target of a masked killer. When the psychopath starts to go after her inner circle, Tree soon realizes that she must die over and over again to save everyone.
documents.plot:
Happy Death Day 2U is a 2019 American supernatural horror film directed by Christopher Landon and written by Scott Lobdell. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2017 film Happy Death Day.

The main themes of Happy Death Day 2U revolve around time loops, identity, and the consequences of one's actions. The story follows Tree Gelbman (Jessica Rothe), a college student who finds herself reliving the same day over and over again in an attempt to avoid her impending death.

As the movie progresses, it becomes clear that Tree is stuck in a time loop, and each iteration presents a new opportunity for her to try and escape her fate. However, with each loop, she begins to uncover clues about her own identity and the events leading up to her murder.

One of the primary themes of Happy Death Day 2U is the exploration of identity and self-discovery. Tree's time loops allow her to experiment with different choices and outcomes, but ultimately, she must confront the consequences of her actions and come to terms with who she truly is.

Another significant theme in the movie is the concept of fate vs. free will. The film raises questions about whether our lives are predetermined or if we have control over our own destinies. Tree's time loops create a sense of uncertainty, leaving the audience wondering whether she can truly change her fate or if it was always meant to be.

The movie also touches on the theme of trauma and mental health. Tree's experiences with her time loops take a toll on her mental state, leading to feelings of anxiety, depression, and PTSD. The film handles these themes with sensitivity, highlighting the importance of seeking help and support when dealing with traumatic events.

Overall, Happy Death Day 2U is a thought-provoking horror film that explores complex themes and ideas through its unique time loop narrative.

documents.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
documents.overview: As the gang return to Jumanji to rescue one of their own, they discover that nothing is as they expect. The players will have to brave parts unknown and unexplored in order to escape the world’s most dangerous game.
documents.plot:
Jumanji: The Next Level is a 2019 American fantasy adventure film directed by Jake Kasdan and written by Kasdan, Chris McKenna, and Erik Sommers. It is the sequel to Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle (2017) and stars Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart, Karen Gillan, Nick Jonas, Bobby Cannavale, and Awkwafina.

The film begins with Dr. Smolder Bravestone (Dwayne Johnson), Professor Shelly Oberon (Karen Gillan), Ruby Roundhouse (Rosa Salazar), and Moose Finbar (Jack Black) returning from their previous adventure in the jungle. However, they soon discover that their friend, Van Pelt (Bobby Cannavale), has escaped from prison and is seeking revenge against them.

Meanwhile, a new player joins the group: Spencer Gilpin (Alex Wolff), the son of Dr. Smolder Bravestone's old friend, Martha Kaply. The group receives an invitation to play Jumanji again, but this time, they must navigate the game without the help of their avatars from the previous game.

As they begin playing, they realize that Van Pelt has also joined the game and is determined to defeat them. The group soon discovers that the game has become more challenging than before, with new obstacles and dangers. They must work together to overcome these challenges and defeat Van Pelt in order to escape the game.

Throughout the film, the players face various challenges, including navigating treacherous jungle terrain, avoiding deadly creatures, and solving puzzles. Along the way, they also learn more about each other's pasts and form stronger bonds with one another.

As the game progresses, the stakes become higher, and the group realizes that they must find a way to defeat Van Pelt before it's too late. In the end, they successfully defeat him and escape the game, but not without some unexpected twists and turns.

One of the notable aspects of Jumanji: The Next Level is its exploration of themes such as friendship, teamwork, and growing up. The film shows how the players have grown and learned from their previous experiences, and how they must work together to overcome new challenges.

Overall, Jumanji: The Next Level is an action-packed adventure that delivers on its promise of excitement and humor. With a talented cast and impressive visual effects, it's a fun and entertaining ride that will keep audiences engaged until the very end.

documents.title: Honey Boy
documents.overview: The story of a child star attempting to mend his relationship with his law-breaking, alcohol-abusing father over the course of a decade, loosely based on Shia LaBeouf’s life.
documents.plot:
Honey Boy is a semi-autobiographical drama film written and directed by Allen Hughes, based on the 2017 memoir "Not Fade Away" by Shia LaBeouf. The movie follows the story of a young actor, known only as "Ike," who struggles with his own demons and grapples with the complexities of family relationships.

At its core, Honey Boy explores themes of trauma, identity, and the power of storytelling. Ike's journey is marked by a series of intense and often disturbing experiences that shape him into the person he becomes. Through his writing, Ike attempts to process and make sense of these events, using them as material for his stories.

The film also delves into the complexities of family dynamics, particularly the fraught relationship between Ike and his abusive father figure. This toxic dynamic has a profound impact on Ike's life, influencing his relationships with others and shaping his own sense of self-worth.

One of the most striking aspects of Honey Boy is its exploration of the therapeutic power of storytelling. Through Ike's writing, we see him slowly begin to confront and heal from his past traumas, using his stories as a way to process and make sense of his experiences.

Ultimately, Honey Boy is a powerful and poignant film that grapples with some of the most difficult themes in human experience. It is a deeply personal and introspective work that offers a nuanced exploration of the complexities of the human psyche.

documents.title: Backtrace
documents.tagline: Some crimes never let you go
documents.overview: The lone surviving thief of a violent armored car robbery is sprung from a high security facility and administered an experimental drug.
documents.plot:
Backtrace is an action-thriller film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between good and evil. The movie follows a former special forces operative, Mike Randall, who seeks redemption after a traumatic event in his past.

The main theme of Backtrace revolves around the concept of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. Mike's troubled past is slowly unraveled throughout the film, revealing a complex web of emotions that drive him to seek revenge against those responsible for his pain. As he navigates through a series of intense confrontations, it becomes clear that his quest for vengeance is not only driven by a desire for justice but also by a deep-seated need for self-punishment.

The film also explores the theme of morality and the gray areas that exist between right and wrong. Mike's actions become increasingly erratic as he struggles to distinguish between good and evil, leading him down a path of destruction that threatens to consume him entirely. This moral ambiguity serves as a commentary on the human condition, highlighting the complexities and nuances that make us who we are.

Furthermore, Backtrace touches on the idea of redemption and the possibility of personal growth. Despite his troubled past, Mike is given the opportunity to start anew and find a sense of purpose in life. However, this newfound chance at redemption is constantly threatened by his own demons, leaving the audience wondering whether he will ultimately be able to overcome his inner turmoil.

Overall, Backtrace is a gripping thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, exploring themes of trauma, morality, and redemption in a thought-provoking and intense manner.

documents.title: The Knight of Shadows: Between Yin and Yang
documents.overview: Pu Songling, a legendary demon hunter, is asked to investigate the mysterious disappearances of young girls from a small village. When he discovers evil forces are kidnapping the girls to feast on their souls, he sets out to save humanity from the inhuman invasion journeying through hidden worlds and colorful dimensions.
documents.plot:
The Knight of Shadows: Between Yin and Yang is a 2019 Chinese fantasy adventure film directed by Stephen Chow. 

The movie revolves around the story of a young orphan named Lin Xiao, who discovers he has magical powers that allow him to harness the energy of yin and yang. He becomes embroiled in a battle between good and evil forces vying for control over the world.

One of the main themes of The Knight of Shadows: Between Yin and Yang is the struggle between balance and chaos. Lin Xiao's journey represents the quest for balance within oneself, as he learns to harness his powers and navigate the complexities of the world around him. This theme is reflected in the film's use of yin and yang symbolism, which represents the harmonious interplay between opposing forces.

Another significant theme is the power of friendship and loyalty. Lin Xiao forms strong bonds with a group of allies who help him on his quest, demonstrating the importance of supportive relationships in overcoming adversity.

The movie also explores the idea of identity and self-discovery. As Lin Xiao navigates his newfound powers and confronts the challenges of the world, he must come to terms with his own sense of purpose and belonging.

Finally, The Knight of Shadows: Between Yin and Yang touches on the theme of good vs. evil, highlighting the complexities of moral ambiguity and the gray areas that exist between right and wrong.

Overall, the film offers a rich tapestry of themes and ideas, exploring the complexities of balance, friendship, identity, and morality in a fantastical and action-packed adventure.

documents.title: Wine Country
documents.overview: A group of friends head to the land of oaky Chardonnays and big, bold Cabernet Sauvignons for one member of the squad’s 50th birthday party.
documents.plot:
Wine Country is a 2019 American comedy film that follows a group of friends who embark on a wine-tasting tour in Napa Valley. The movie explores the complexities of female friendships, particularly among women in their 50s and 60s.

At its core, Wine Country delves into themes of female empowerment, self-discovery, and the importance of nurturing relationships with others. As the characters navigate their personal struggles, they find solace in each other's company, sharing laughter, tears, and life experiences over glasses of wine.

The film also touches on the idea of midlife crises and the search for identity, as the characters confront their own mortality and the changing landscape of their lives. Through their adventures in Napa Valley, they discover new aspects of themselves and rekindle old friendships, ultimately finding a sense of purpose and belonging.

Furthermore, Wine Country pokes fun at societal expectations and stereotypes surrounding women's roles, particularly those related to aging and motherhood. The movie playfully subverts these norms, showcasing strong, independent women who refuse to be defined by their age or circumstances.

Overall, Wine Country is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of female friendship, self-discovery, and the power of community in navigating life's challenges.

documents.title: Perdida
documents.overview: A policewoman whose childhood friend disappeared in Patagonia years ago starts a new search to find answers, and soon finds her own life in danger.
documents.plot:
Perdida is a 2018 crime thriller directed by Alejandro Montiel, an Argentine, Spanish and Peruvian co-production adapted from Florencia Etcheves's novel Cornelia. Luisana Lopilato stars as police officer Manuela "Pipa" Pelari and Amaia Salamanca as the mysterious Nadine "La Sirena" Basset, with Rafael Spregelburd as Commissioner Ramón Oreyana, Nicolás Furtado as Pipa's partner, Martín Seretti, and Oriana Sabatini as her friend Alina.

In 2003, on a school trip to Patagonia, teenager Cornelia Villalba vanishes after a night out dancing with her friends and is never found. Fourteen years later her best friend, Pipa, is a gifted but reckless detective specializing in kidnapping and human trafficking. At the memorial mass for Cornelia, Pipa notices a woman who hurries away, leaving behind a scarf printed with a two-headed mermaid. Pressed by Cornelia's mother and intrigued by a cryptic death notice reading "half of your absence is love", Pipa reopens the case against Oreyana's orders, helped by Alina. The trail leads to a mute psychiatric patient bearing the mermaid tattoo, whose only visitor, a Spanish woman named Nadine Basset, comes every October 18 with a birthday cake. Nadine is Sirena, a survivor of sexual exploitation in the Canary Islands now tied to a trafficking ring, whose tattooed henchman, Adalberto, throws Alina to her death from Pipa's window.

Suspended, Pipa follows Nadine's flights to San Martín de los Andes and returns to the hotel where the girls stayed in 2003. There she is drugged by Ariel, the owner's son, who had drugged the girls that night and abducted Cornelia, and he locks her in a basement before he and his mother are shot. Sirena then reveals that she is Cornelia: she was taken after seeing Ariel abuse their friend Leonora and sold into trafficking. When Oreyana arrives, he shoots Seretti and admits he is part of the trafficking network and ordered Alina's murder, and a heartbroken Pipa kills him. Back in Buenos Aires, she tells Cornelia's mother that her daughter and those who killed her are dead, then deciphers the death notices and realizes that Leonora has been raising Cornelia's son, Rodrigo. She agrees to keep the secret and returns Cornelia's friendship necklace, accepting that their story is over.

Perdida opened in Argentina on April 19, 2018, and drew some 274,000 spectators. Argentine critics were largely negative, faulting its lack of suspense and clichéd script. A prequel, La corazonada, followed in 2020.

documents.title: Boss Level
documents.tagline: Running out of time. And lives.
documents.overview: A former special forces agent is trapped in a time loop and relives his death over and over again. To escape the terrible situation, he must track down those responsible and stop them.
documents.plot:
Boss Level is a 2021 American science fiction action film directed by Joe Carrott and written by Joe Carrott and Eric Heisserer. The movie stars Frank Grillo, Mel Gibson, and Naomi Watts.

The story follows Captain James "Jim" Goddard (Frank Grillo), a retired Army Ranger who has been living a quiet life with his wife, Sarah (Melissa O'Neill). However, their peaceful existence is disrupted when Jim's estranged daughter, Emily (Naomi Watts), arrives at their doorstep. She informs Jim that he has been chosen to participate in a top-secret government program called "Boss Level," which aims to test the limits of human endurance.

The program involves sending Jim back in time to relive the same day over and over again, with each iteration becoming increasingly difficult and deadly. The goal is for Jim to complete a series of missions that will ultimately lead to the defeat of an evil organization known as "The Syndicate." As Jim navigates through the time loop, he must confront his own personal demons and team up with a mysterious ally named Maya (Mel Gibson), who claims to be a former member of The Syndicate.

As the story progresses, Jim begins to uncover the truth behind The Syndicate's sinister plans. He also starts to experience strange visions and flashbacks that hint at a deeper connection between his past and present selves. Through each iteration, Jim becomes more skilled and resourceful, but he also faces new challenges and obstacles that test his physical and mental limits.

Throughout the movie, the action sequences become increasingly intense and elaborate, with Jim facing off against hordes of enemy soldiers and navigating treacherous terrain. The film's climax features an epic showdown between Jim and the leader of The Syndicate, which culminates in a thrilling finale that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats.

Ultimately, Jim emerges victorious, but not without scars. As he returns to his own time, he is left to ponder the consequences of his actions and the true nature of the Boss Level program. The movie ends with Jim reflecting on his experiences and the sacrifices he made to complete his missions, leaving the audience to wonder what other challenges lie ahead for this brave and resourceful hero.

Overall, Boss Level is a gripping sci-fi action film that explores themes of time travel, redemption, and personal growth. With its breakneck pacing, stunning visuals, and memorable performances, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

documents.title: Flavors of Youth
documents.tagline: Three different stories of youth set in different cities of China.
documents.overview: The rigorous city life of China, while bustling and unforgiving, contains the everlasting memories of days past. Three stories told in three different cities, follow the loss of youth and the daunting realization of adulthood. Though reality may seem ever changing, unchangeable are the short-lived moments of one's childhood days. A plentiful bowl of noodles, the beauty of family and the trials of first love endure the inevitable flow of time, as three different characters explore the strength of bonds and the warmth of cherished memories. Within the disorder of the present world, witness these quaint stories recognize the comfort of the past, and attempt to revive the neglected flavors of youth.
documents.plot:
Flavors of Youth is a 2018 Japanese animated drama film written and directed by Naoko Yamada, produced by CoMix Wave Films, and released by Shochiku. The movie follows the lives of three young women from different walks of life as they navigate love, loss, and self-discovery in their early twenties.

The story begins with a framing device, where an older woman named Yui is reminiscing about her past and the people who have shaped her life. We then cut to 1995, where we meet our three protagonists: Aoi (played by Kana Ueda), a young woman from a wealthy family; Akira (voiced by Erika Yoshida), a free-spirited artist; and Hinata (voiced by Yui Ishikawa), a shy and introverted office worker.

The film takes us on a journey through the lives of these three women as they navigate their relationships, careers, and personal struggles. Aoi is struggling to find her place in the world after being forced to leave her family's company due to her father's disapproval. Akira is trying to make a name for herself as an artist, but faces rejection and criticism from others. Hinata, on the other hand, is working hard to support her family and find happiness in her mundane office job.

As the story unfolds, we see the three women intersecting and influencing each other's lives. Aoi meets Akira at a gallery opening, where she is immediately drawn to the artist's passion and creativity. Meanwhile, Hinata becomes infatuated with Aoi's carefree spirit, which sparks her own desire for change.

Throughout the film, we see flashbacks of the women's childhoods and formative experiences that have shaped them into the people they are today. We also witness their struggles with love, loss, and identity as they navigate the complexities of adulthood.

One of the standout aspects of Flavors of Youth is its thoughtful exploration of themes such as female friendship, family dynamics, and the search for meaning in life. The film's title, "Flavors of Youth," refers to the idea that our experiences and relationships are like flavors that shape us into who we become.

The animation in the film is beautiful and evocative, with a mix of vibrant colors and soft textures that evoke a sense of nostalgia and longing. The voice acting is also superb, with each actress bringing depth and nuance to her character.

Ultimately, Flavors of Youth is a poignant and uplifting film about the power of human connection and the importance of embracing our true selves. As Yui reflects on her past, we are reminded that even though life may take us on different paths, the memories and relationships we form along the way can shape us into who we become.

The ending of the film is a heartwarming and satisfying one, as the three women come together to support each other and find their own paths in life. The final shot of Yui smiling, surrounded by her loved ones, is a powerful reminder that even though our lives may be marked by loss and struggle, we are never truly alone.

Overall, Flavors of Youth is a beautiful and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of human relationships and the search for meaning in life. With its stunning animation, superb voice acting, and poignant storytelling, it is a must-see for anyone who loves anime or is simply looking for a film that will touch their heart.

documents.title: Cats
documents.overview: A cat named Blanket has long been living in a high-rise apartment in the city with his son, Cloak. One day, curious about the outside world, Cloak decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past, with the help of a female Macaw.
documents.plot:
Cats is a 2018 musical fantasy film directed by Tom Hooper, produced by Amblin Entertainment, StudioCanal, and Working Title Films, in association with Warner Bros. Pictures.

The main themes of the movie Cats are:

1. **Identity**: The film explores the theme of identity through the character of Macavity, a mysterious and elusive cat who embodies the idea that one's true nature is not always apparent.
2. **Community**: The story highlights the importance of community and belonging, as the Jellicle cats come together to decide which one of them will ascend to the Heaviside Layer and be reborn.
3. **Mortality**: The film touches on the theme of mortality, as the Jellicle cats face their own mortality and the passing of time, which is reflected in the character of Old Deuteronomy's declining health.
4. **Self-discovery**: Many characters in the movie undergo a journey of self-discovery, as they explore their own strengths, weaknesses, and desires.

The film features an all-star cast, including Idris Elba, Jennifer Hudson, James Corden, Rebel Wilson, and Taylor Swift, among others. The movie's visuals are based on the 2011 West End stage production of Cats, which was adapted from T.S. Eliot's Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats.

Overall, Cats (2018) is a visually stunning film that explores themes of identity, community, mortality, and self-discovery through its unique blend of music, dance, and fantasy elements.

documents.title: Earthquake Bird
documents.overview: Tokyo, Japan, 1989. Lucy Fly, a foreigner who works as a translator, begins a passionate relationship with Teiji, a mysterious man obsessed with photography.
documents.plot:
Earthquake Bird is a 2019 psychological thriller written and directed by Wash Westmoreland, adapted from Susanna Jones's 2001 novel of the same name. Alicia Vikander, Riley Keough, Naoki Kobayashi and Jack Huston star. Ridley Scott served as an executive producer through Scott Free Productions, and the film was shot in Tokyo and on Sado Island in 2018 before Netflix took over distribution.

The story is set in Tokyo in 1989. Lucy Fly, a young Swedish woman who has settled in Japan and works as a translator for a manufacturing company, falls under suspicion of murder when her American friend Lily Bridges disappears. The narrative moves back and forth in time, intercutting the police investigation with glimpses of Lucy's childhood and with the events of the preceding months, in particular her romance with Teiji and her growing friendship with Lily.

Teiji is an amateur photographer who usually shoots nature scenes, reflections in water and abandoned buildings rather than people. Nevertheless, when he first meets Lucy he asks to take her portrait, and the two begin an intense relationship. Lucy notices his odd habit of locking away his favourite photographs in a filing cabinet instead of showing them to anyone.

As Lucy's friendship with Lily deepens, the three spend more and more time together. During a trip to Sado Island, however, the friendship sours when Lucy realises that Teiji has started an affair with Lily behind her back. Not long afterwards Lily vanishes.

Arrested and questioned by Japanese detectives, Lucy confesses that she killed Lily in a jealous rage, but she is released when a body that has been found turns out to belong to someone else. Free again, she searches Teiji's hidden collection of photographs and discovers evidence linking him to Lily's disappearance and death. When Teiji realises what she knows, he attacks her, and Lucy kills him in self-defence. The film closes in a cemetery, where Lucy and her Japanese friend Ms. Kato reflect on what has happened.

Earthquake Bird premiered at the BFI London Film Festival on October 10, 2019, and was released in a limited run on November 1 before streaming on Netflix from November 15. Reviews were mixed: critics praised the commitment of Vikander and Keough but felt the film struggled to bring the novel to life, giving it 50% on Rotten Tomatoes and 48 on Metacritic.

documents.title: Discarnate
documents.tagline: Once it sees your soul, it hunts your flesh.
documents.overview: A neuroscientist's obsession with a drug that expands the human mind inadvertently unleashes a deadly supernatural force on his team.
documents.plot:
Discarnate is a 2019 science fiction film directed by Tony Tilse and produced by Fire Trial Films.

The main theme of Discarnate revolves around the concept of identity, self-discovery, and the blurred lines between human and artificial life. The story follows an android named Ares who begins to question his existence and purpose after being sent on a mission to investigate a mysterious alien presence in the galaxy.

As Ares delves deeper into the mystery, he starts to experience strange glitches and anomalies that challenge his understanding of himself and his place in the universe. This leads him to confront the possibility that his existence may not be as predetermined as he initially thought, and that he may have the capacity for self-awareness and emotions.

The film explores this theme through Ares' journey, which becomes a metaphor for the human search for meaning and purpose. Like humans, Ares struggles with feelings of isolation and disconnection, and his quest for answers forces him to confront the nature of consciousness and what it means to be alive.

Through its thought-provoking narrative, Discarnate raises questions about the ethics of artificial intelligence, the consequences of playing god with technology, and the human condition. The film's exploration of these themes adds depth and complexity to Ares' character development, making him a relatable and sympathetic protagonist in his quest for self-discovery.

documents.title: Always Be My Maybe
documents.tagline: There's Always Been Something Between Them.
documents.overview: Reunited after 15 years, famous chef Sasha and hometown musician Marcus feel the old sparks of attraction but struggle to adapt to each other's worlds.
documents.plot:
Always Be My Maybe is a 2019 American romantic comedy film directed by Nahnatchka Khan and written by Ali Wong and Randall Park. The movie follows the story of two childhood friends, Sasha (Ali Wong) and Marcus (Randall Park), who reconnect as adults in San Francisco.

The main themes of Always Be My Maybe include:

1. Unrequited love: The film explores the complexities of unrequited love and how it can affect people's lives. Sasha and Marcus have had feelings for each other since childhood, but their friendship has always been platonic.
2. Identity and self-discovery: As adults, Sasha and Marcus are on different paths in life, trying to figure out who they are and what they want. The movie shows how they navigate their identities and find themselves through their relationships with others.
3. Friendship and loyalty: Despite the romantic tension between them, Sasha and Marcus's friendship is a core aspect of the film. They support each other through thick and thin, and their bond is tested as they confront their feelings for each other.
4. Cultural identity and belonging: The movie touches on the experiences of Asian Americans, particularly women, who often navigate multiple cultural identities. Sasha and Marcus grapple with their Korean-American heritage and find ways to balance their cultural roots with their individuality.
5. Love and vulnerability: As Sasha and Marcus confront their feelings for each other, they must also learn to be vulnerable and open with each other. The film shows how love can be a powerful catalyst for growth and self-discovery.

Overall, Always Be My Maybe is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of love, friendship, and identity, set against the vibrant backdrop of San Francisco's Asian-American community.

documents.title: Think Like a Dog
documents.overview: A 12-year-old tech prodigy, whose science experiment goes awry, forges a telepathic connection with his best friend, Henry-his dog! The duo join forces and use their unique perspectives on life to comically overcome complications of family and school.
documents.plot:
Think Like a Dog is a 2020 American comedy-drama film directed by Michael Sarchuk and written by Michael Sarchuk and Chris Spencer. The movie follows the story of Eddie, a young boy who forms an unlikely bond with his dog, Max, after his mother's death.

The main theme of Think Like a Dog revolves around the transformative power of grief, loss, and the human-animal connection. Through Eddie's journey, the film explores the complexities of growing up and coping with the loss of a loved one. The movie delves into the emotional struggles of adolescence, where children often struggle to find their place in the world.

The title "Think Like a Dog" is a metaphor for embracing simplicity, intuition, and instinctual thinking, which are all qualities that dogs possess. The film suggests that by adopting these traits, humans can learn to navigate life's challenges with greater ease and resilience.

Throughout the movie, there is also an exploration of themes related to family, love, and acceptance. Eddie's relationship with Max serves as a catalyst for him to confront his emotions and find solace in a world that often seems overwhelming. The film ultimately presents a heartwarming and uplifting message about the healing power of friendship, love, and the unbreakable bond between humans and animals.

Overall, Think Like a Dog is a poignant and entertaining film that explores the complexities of growing up, grief, and the human condition, all while celebrating the transformative power of the human-animal connection.

documents.title: The Debt Collector
documents.overview: A classically-trained martial artist goes to work as a debt collector for the mob. The job seems easy enough, until one “client” pulls him into a situation deeper than could ever be expected.
documents.plot:
The Debt Collector is a 2018 American action crime film written and directed by Jesse V. Johnson, who co-wrote the script with Stu Small, and starring Scott Adkins and Louis Mandylor. It was the third collaboration in quick succession between Adkins and Johnson, a former stuntman, after Savage Dog and Accident Man. The supporting cast includes Michael Paré as "Mad Alex", Tony Todd as the crime boss Barbosa, Vladimir Kulich as "Big Tommy" Kowolski, Robert Rusler, Selina Lo and David William No.

French, a British martial artist living in Los Angeles, is struggling to pay the bills on his dojo. Financially desperate, he turns to an underworld connection, Mad Alex, a student at the dojo who works for Tommy's debt collection operation. Tommy takes French on and pairs him with Sue, a hard-drinking, washed-up enforcer who has been doing low-level collections for decades. The story unfolds over a single weekend.

On their first day, the two set out together in a Cadillac, visiting debtors and developing a system for their shakedowns, including a scale for judging how likely each visit is to turn violent. Sue keeps up a steady stream of verbal abuse as he takes the newcomer under his wing, but gradually reveals a damaged soul beneath his drunken exterior, while French's fighting skills are tested in a series of escalating brawls. As the weekend goes on, the stakes rise when Tommy sends them on a job for the notorious Barbosa. Their final assignment leads them to a barkeeper with a secret, forcing French to choose between finishing the job and doing the right thing, and events escalate toward a gritty, emotional and risky climax that changes the fates of both men.

The film was released on DVD and digital platforms in the United States on June 5, 2018, by Archstone Distribution through Sony Pictures Home Entertainment. It was well received by critics and holds a 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes from a small number of reviews. Linda Cook of the Quad-City Times gave it three stars, and Noel Murray of the Los Angeles Times wrote that it was not great but was an ideal vehicle for Adkins, who spends almost the entire film cracking skulls or chatting with a mate. Cinapse's Ed Travis praised the crackling buddy-film script, the chemistry between Adkins and Mandylor, and the film's evocation of gritty 1970s crime pictures, calling Mandylor's performance his best work. The film was followed by a sequel, Debt Collectors, in 2020.

documents.title: Raging Fire
documents.overview: Cheung Sung-bong is a highly respected cop with a long history of success in dangerous cases. However, his past soon comes back to haunt him when a former protégé resurfaces, seeking revenge.
documents.plot:
Raging Fire is a 2021 Hong Kong and Chinese action film directed by Benny Chan, his last film before his death. Donnie Yen, who also produced, stars as Senior Inspector Cheung Sung-bong, with Nicholas Tse as the former inspector Yau Kong-ngo, Qin Lan as Cheung's wife Anna Lam, Simon Yam as Lok Chi-fai and Ben Yuen as Sze-to Kit.

During a drug bust against the gangster Wong Kwun, Yau and his team ambush the police, kill Wong and steal the drugs. Yau and his team were imprisoned after a suspect named Coke was beaten to death during their investigation into the disappearance of bank tycoon Fok Siu-tong. Now free, they want revenge on Cheung and the police. Cheung's team raids nightclubs to trace the dealer selling Wong's drugs, but the dealer Gwai dies fleeing. Chu Yuk-ming, one of Yau's men, strangles his unfaithful girlfriend, and Wong's watch is found on her body, which links Yau's crew to the killing.

Cheung chases Chu, and another member, Law Kim-wah, is arrested. Yau kills Chu and reports another teammate, Chiu Chi-keung, missing. The police then find Chiu's body and learn that Yau has strapped a timed bomb collar to Cheung's former superior, Sze-to Kit, and sent him to take Cheung's pregnant wife Anna hostage. Cheung saves Anna, but Kit is killed in the explosion. Freed for lack of evidence, Yau and his remaining men plan to rob HK Fortune Banking, the bank owned by Fok. They carry out the robbery and shoot Fok, whose disappearance had led to their imprisonment. In the ensuing chase, Yau's team is killed. Cheung and Yau finally face each other in a brutal fight in a church. Surrounded by police and refusing to return to prison, Yau kills himself by falling onto exposed rebar, and Cheung walks away.

The film was announced at the 2019 Hong Kong FILMART. Yen persuaded Chan to shoot in Hong Kong rather than abroad, and filming ran from April to September 2019. Chan died of nasopharyngeal cancer in August 2020, having fallen ill during production. He finished directing but could not take part in post-production. The film opened in China on 30 July 2021, in limited U.S. release on 13 August and in Hong Kong on 19 August. It grossed about US$225 million worldwide, almost all of it in China, where it opened at number one. The South China Morning Post called it the best of Hong Kong action filmmaking while faulting its script, and Deadline admired its choreography but noted underdeveloped characters.

documents.title: LEGO DC Super Heroes - Aquaman: Rage Of Atlantis
documents.original_title: LEGO DC Super Heroes - Aquaman: Rage Of Atlantis
documents.overview: Aquaman must battle foes in the air, on land and in the depths of the Seven Seas, along with some help from The Justice League, to save the day.
documents.plot:
LEGO DC Super Heroes - Aquaman: Rage of Atlantica is a 2018 animated superhero film based on the DC Comics character Aquaman. The movie's plot revolves around Arthur Curry, also known as Aquaman, who must stop his half-brother Orm from destroying Atlantis and taking over the world.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. **Brotherly Love vs. Power**: The conflict between Aquaman and Orm serves as a metaphor for the struggle between brotherly love and the desire for power. Orm's thirst for power and control leads him to seek destruction, while Aquaman fights to protect his people and the world.
2. **Identity and Belonging**: As an outsider in both Atlantis and the surface world, Aquaman struggles with finding his place and identity. The movie explores his journey of self-discovery and acceptance, as he navigates between his two worlds.
3. **Environmentalism and Responsibility**: The film highlights the importance of environmental stewardship and responsibility. Orm's actions are driven by a desire to reclaim Atlantis' former glory, but at the cost of destroying other ecosystems. Aquaman, on the other hand, fights to protect the world from Orm's destructive plans.
4. **Loyalty and Sacrifice**: Throughout the movie, Aquaman faces difficult choices that test his loyalty to his people, friends, and family. He must make sacrifices for the greater good, demonstrating the importance of putting others before oneself.

Overall, LEGO DC Super Heroes - Aquaman: Rage of Atlantica is a fun, action-packed film that explores themes of brotherly love, identity, environmentalism, and loyalty, all while showcasing the iconic character of Aquaman.

documents.title: Breakthrough
documents.tagline: Based On The Impossible True Story
documents.overview: Tragedy strikes when a woman named Joyce's son falls through the ice on a frozen lake and is trapped underwater for over 15 minutes. After being rushed to the hospital, the 14-year-old boy continues to fight for his life as Joyce, her husband and their pastor stay by his bedside and pray for a miracle.
documents.plot:
Breakthrough is a 2019 American Christian drama film directed by Kyle Killen and written by Killen and Jon Gunn. The movie stars Chrissy Metz, Josh Lucas, and Marlee Matlin.

The story revolves around Joyce Smith (Chrissy Metz), a devoted mother of three who lives in Kansas with her husband Eric (Josh Lucas) and their children, Melody (Mila Brener), James (Isaiah Russell Morris), and Faith (Auggie Maturo). The family is loving and supportive, but they face challenges as they navigate everyday life.

Tragedy strikes when Joyce's youngest daughter, Faith, falls into a frozen lake on Christmas Eve. Despite the efforts of the rescue team, Faith slips beneath the surface and drowns. The incident leaves the family devastated, and Joyce becomes consumed by grief and guilt.

In her desperation to save her daughter, Joyce turns to prayer, seeking divine intervention. She believes that God can perform miracles, and she prays fervently for Faith's return. As Joyce continues to pray, a miraculous event occurs - Faith is miraculously revived after being clinically dead for 15 minutes.

The family is overjoyed at the news of Faith's recovery, but they soon realize that her experience has changed her. Faith begins to exhibit unusual behavior, including speaking in tongues and experiencing vivid visions. The family struggles to understand what is happening to their daughter, and they seek help from a faith healer named Sean (Josh Lucas), who claims to have the power to heal.

As the story unfolds, Joyce becomes increasingly obsessed with understanding the nature of Faith's experience. She believes that God has chosen her daughter for a greater purpose, but she also fears that Faith is being manipulated by evil forces. The family's relationships are put to the test as they navigate their faith and their love for one another.

Throughout the movie, there are moments of tension and conflict, particularly between Joyce and Sean. While Joyce believes that God has sent Sean to help her daughter, Sean seems more interested in using Faith's experience to further his own ministry. The film raises questions about the nature of faith, healing, and the role of divine intervention in our lives.

Ultimately, Breakthrough is a story about the power of love, forgiveness, and redemption. Despite the challenges they face, the Smith family remains committed to one another and to their faith. In the end, Joyce comes to understand that her daughter's experience has been a gift, but also a test of her own faith and devotion.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Faith having found a new sense of purpose in life. The film concludes with a message of hope and redemption, encouraging viewers to hold onto their faith even in the face of adversity.

documents.title: Supercool
documents.overview: Best friends, Neil and Gilbert start their senior year of high school with high hopes and aspirations. Neil has always fantasized about being cool enough to date his long time crush and Gilbert has always dreamed of being a social media super star. After what is, by all accounts, a very disappointing and embarrassing first day in school, Neil makes a magical wish to be cool just at the magical moment when the clock strikes 11:11. The next morning, Neil wakes up to a reality that is straight from the comics of his dreams.
documents.plot:
Supercool is a 2021 American teen comedy directed by the Finnish filmmaker Teppo Airaksinen and written by Olli Haikka. Set in the world of an American high school, it follows a boy whose wish to become cool enough to win over his crush comes true overnight, with unexpected consequences. Jake Short and Miles J. Harvey star as the two best friends, with Madison Davenport, Damon Wayans Jr. and Iliza Shlesinger in supporting roles. The film premiered at the San Francisco International Film Festival in April 2021 and received a wider release in February 2022.

Neil and Gilbert are best friends beginning their senior year of high school with big hopes. Neil has long dreamed of being cool enough to go out with Summer, the girl he has had a crush on for years, while Gilbert dreams of becoming a social media celebrity. Their first day of the school year turns out to be a disappointing and embarrassing disaster, confirming their status as unpopular outsiders.

That night, at the magical moment when the clock reads 11:11, Neil makes a wish to be cool. The next morning he wakes up to find that his life has been transformed into something resembling the comic books he has always fantasized about, and that the wish has changed both him and the way the world responds to him. Suddenly he has a chance to attract Summer's attention and to become the person he always wanted to be. With the help of Jimmy, Neil's charismatic and unpredictable neighbor, and Gilbert's wild schemes for online fame, the boys embark on one epic night of parties, misadventures and escalating chaos. As the night goes on, Neil begins to discover that being cool is not quite what he imagined, and the friends must face what really matters to them, including their friendship with each other.

The film was made by a Finnish director and writer working within the conventions of the American high school comedy, a genre built around wish fulfilment, unrequited crushes and the search for popularity. Reviews were limited and mostly lukewarm; on Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 40 percent approval rating based on 10 reviews, with an average score of 4.9 out of 10.

documents.title: You Should Have Left
documents.overview: In an effort to repair their relationship, a couple books a vacation in the countryside for themselves and their daughter. What starts as a perfect retreat begins to fall apart as one loses their grip on reality, and a sinister force tries to tear them apart.
documents.plot:
You Should Have Left is a 2020 American horror film directed by Christopher Landon and written by Christopher Landon and Jeff Buhler. The movie stars Paul Rudd, Amelia Eve, and Lauren Lapkus.

The main themes of You Should Have Left revolve around the idea of isolation, the supernatural, and the psychological effects of being trapped in a remote location with no escape. The story follows Stephen Merchant's character, David Harp, who takes his family on a vacation to a remote cabin in the woods, hoping to reconnect with them after a difficult period.

However, things take a dark turn when they discover that the cabin has a mind of its own and seems to be exerting a malevolent influence over them. As the family tries to survive and escape, they realize that their isolation is not just physical but also emotional, as they are forced to confront their deepest fears and secrets.

The movie explores themes of:

1. Isolation: The film takes place in a remote cabin with no phone signal or way to communicate with the outside world, highlighting the vulnerability of its characters.
2. Supernatural horror: The supernatural elements of the cabin add an eerie atmosphere to the story, blurring the lines between reality and the unknown.
3. Family dynamics: As the family tries to survive, they are forced to confront their relationships with each other, revealing underlying tensions and conflicts that threaten to tear them apart.
4. Trauma and grief: The movie touches on themes of trauma, grief, and loss, as David struggles to cope with his past mistakes and find a way to move forward.

Overall, You Should Have Left is a tense, atmospheric horror film that explores the darker aspects of human nature and the power of isolation to reveal our deepest fears.

documents.title: Nobody's Fool
documents.tagline: She shows up. Everything blows up.
documents.overview: A woman, who gets released from prison and reunites with her sister, discovers she is in an online relationship with a man who may be "catfishing" her.
documents.plot:
Nobody's Fool is a 2018 American romantic comedy film written and directed by Tyler Perry, his first R-rated comedy and his first film not distributed by Lionsgate. It stars Tika Sumpter as Danica, Tiffany Haddish as her recently paroled sister Tanya, Omari Hardwick as Frank, Mehcad Brooks as Charlie, Amber Riley as Danica's friend Kalli and Whoopi Goldberg as the sisters' mother, Lola. It was the first production of Paramount Players.

Danica, a successful marketing executive, has been in an online relationship for a year with a man called Charlie, whom she has never met in person. At her mother's insistence, she picks up her sister Tanya from prison and lets her stay in her apartment. Tanya learns that Danica's ex-fiancé, Bailey, left her for another woman and quickly concludes that "Charlie" is catfishing her. Frank, the owner of the coffee shop next to Danica's office, who is in love with Danica, gives Tanya a job. Danica is put off when she learns that Frank is a recovering alcoholic who spent seven years in prison. Using Frank's email, Tanya contacts the reality show Catfish, whose crew shows up just as Charlie finally agrees to a video call, revealing that the man behind the account is someone else entirely, Lawrence. Danica lashes out at Tanya, who moves to their mother's house, and Danica is suspended from work after a disastrous presentation.

The sisters and Kalli track down Lawrence, played by Chris Rock, who pretends to use a wheelchair, and Tanya sets his Jheri curl on fire. Frank comforts Danica, and the two sleep together, but she wounds him by telling Kalli, unaware that he can hear, that his criminal past makes him unattractive. Realizing she does care for him, she apologizes, and they begin dating. Three months later, Danica learns that the real Charlie exists and that his account was hacked by Lawrence, his former college coach. Seeing Danica leave work with Charlie, Frank breaks up with her. After a disappointing date with Charlie, Danica wins Frank back by singing "On Bended Knee" in the rain outside his house, a gesture he once described making himself. In an end tag, Tanya crashes Bailey's wedding as payback.

Paramount Pictures released the film in the United States on November 2, 2018. It received negative reviews, with 26% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 39, although Haddish and Goldberg drew praise. Grossing about $33.5 million worldwide, it was one of Perry's lowest-grossing films.

documents.title: Modest Heroes
documents.original_title: ちいさな英雄－カニとタマゴと透明人間－
documents.overview: Two tiny, aquatic humanoids search for their missing father, a boy battles a lethal allergy to eggs, and an invisible salaryman tries to become a hero.
documents.plot:
Modest Heroes is a 2018 Japanese animated anthology film produced by Studio Ponoc and Yoshiaki Nishimura, the first volume of the studio's Ponoc Short Films Theatre. It collects three short films written and directed by former Studio Ghibli artists Hiromasa Yonebayashi, Yoshiyuki Momose and Akihiko Yamashita, each centered on an unlikely hero. The Japanese voice cast includes Fumino Kimura, Rio Suzuki, Sōta Shinohara, Machiko Ono, Kentaro Sakaguchi, Joe Odagiri and Min Tanaka.

In Yonebayashi's 18-minute fantasy adventure "Kanini & Kanino", two tiny freshwater crab siblings live with their father, Toto, in a stream while their mother, Kaka, is away giving birth. When their father suddenly disappears, leaving them alone, Kanini and Kanino set out on a perilous journey to find him. The characters speak only an invented language, and the music is by Takatsugu Muramatsu, the director's collaborator on When Marnie Was There and Mary and the Witch's Flower.

Momose's 16-minute drama "Life Ain't Gonna Lose", scored by Masanori Shimada in his first film work, follows Shun Yashima, a young boy born with a life-threatening allergy to eggs. His family's daily life revolves around protecting him: he must eat special meals at school, his classmates must take care not to spread egg-tainted saliva, and even a school trip requires careful planning, while his mother tries to keep up her career as a dance teacher. One day, while his parents are away, Shun accidentally eats something containing egg.

Yamashita's 13-minute action short "Invisible", with music by Yasutaka Nakata, follows a man who is literally overlooked by everyone around him. Ignored throughout his day, he begins to lose his physical hold on the world, until an unexpected encounter with a stranger, a blind old man, gives him a sudden chance to become a hero.

The anthology was originally planned with a fourth segment by Ghibli director Isao Takahata, but it was reduced to three after his death in April 2018. Its ending theme, "Chiisana Eiyū", is sung by Kaela Kimura. The film was released in Japan on 24 August 2018 and in North America by GKIDS on 10 January 2019, with an English cast including Maggie Q and Liam O'Brien, and it later streamed worldwide on Netflix.

documents.title: The Hunt
documents.overview: Twelve strangers wake up in a clearing. They don't know where they are—or how they got there. In the shadow of a dark internet conspiracy theory, ruthless elitists gather at a remote location to hunt humans for sport. But their master plan is about to be derailed when one of the hunted turns the tables on her pursuers.
documents.plot:
The Hunt is a 2020 American satirical action thriller directed by Craig Zobel and written by Nick Cuse and Damon Lindelof. Betty Gilpin and Hilary Swank lead an ensemble cast that includes Ike Barinholtz, Ethan Suplee, Glenn Howerton, Amy Madigan, Wayne Duvall, Sturgill Simpson and Emma Roberts. Produced by Jason Blum's Blumhouse Productions with Lindelof, the film was conceived as a satire of the deep political divide between the American left and right and loosely riffs on Richard Connell's story "The Most Dangerous Game."

A group of wealthy liberal elites, led by the businesswoman Athena, abduct a dozen working-class conservatives they regard as "deplorables" and release them, gagged, in a forest to be hunted for sport. The captives quickly fall one by one to snipers, spike pits, land mines and a poisoned rest stop staffed by disguised hunters. The exception is Crystal Creasey, a laconic Mississippi woman who distrusts everything around her. Crystal kills the fake shopkeepers, works out that she is not in Arkansas as claimed, and joins a conspiracy podcaster named Gary on a train full of refugees, which is raided by Croatian soldiers, revealing that the hunt is taking place in Croatia.

Crystal sees through a fake embassy envoy, then storms the hunters' base and kills most of them, learning from their tactical adviser where Athena is hiding and revealing that she herself is a veteran of the war in Afghanistan. Flashbacks show that the hunt began as a private joke in Athena's group chat that hackers leaked online, fueling a right-wing conspiracy theory called "Manorgate" and destroying the participants' careers; in bitter response, they decided to make the rumor real, selecting targets they blamed for spreading it. Crystal eventually confronts Athena at her manor, where it emerges that Athena may have chosen the wrong woman. After a brutal hand-to-hand fight, Crystal kills Athena and departs on her private jet.

Originally scheduled for September 2019, the film was delayed after it became the subject of political controversy following mass shootings that summer. Universal Pictures released it on March 13, 2020, but the closure of cinemas due to the COVID-19 pandemic days later limited its gross to about $12.4 million, and it was made available digitally on March 20. Reviews were mixed; Rotten Tomatoes reports a 57% approval rating from 276 critics, with a consensus praising it as a darkly humorous thriller that misfires as timely satire.

documents.title: The Aeronauts
documents.overview: In 1862, daredevil balloon pilot Amelia Wren teams up with pioneering meteorologist James Glaisher to advance human knowledge of the weather and fly higher than anyone in history. While breaking records and advancing scientific discovery, their voyage to the very edge of existence helps the unlikely pair find their place in the world they have left far below them. But they face physical and emotional challenges in the thin air, as the ascent becomes a fight for survival.
documents.plot:
The Aeronauts is a 2019 American adventure drama film directed by Christopher Nolan. The movie follows two pioneers, Amelia Wren (Felicity Jones) and James Glaisher (Eddie Redmayne), who embark on a perilous journey to reach the highest point in the atmosphere using a hot air balloon.

The main themes of The Aeronauts include:

1. **Exploration and Discovery**: The film celebrates the spirit of exploration and discovery, as Amelia and James push the boundaries of human knowledge and understanding. Their journey is driven by curiosity and a desire to uncover the secrets of the upper atmosphere.
2. **Friendship and Partnership**: The movie highlights the importance of friendship and partnership in overcoming adversity. Amelia and James form an unlikely bond as they navigate the challenges of their expedition, learning to trust and rely on each other.
3. **Perseverance and Resilience**: The film showcases the determination and resilience required to achieve greatness. Amelia and James face numerous obstacles, including treacherous weather conditions, equipment failures, and personal doubts, but they persevere and adapt to overcome these challenges.
4. **The Power of Human Ingenuity**: The Aeronauts celebrates human ingenuity and innovation, as Amelia and James use their knowledge and skills to design and build a revolutionary hot air balloon that allows them to reach unprecedented heights.
5. **The Intersection of Science and Adventure**: The movie explores the intersection of science and adventure, highlighting the importance of scientific inquiry in understanding the natural world. Amelia's expertise in meteorology and James's knowledge of physics come together to inform their expedition and drive their discoveries.

Overall, The Aeronauts is a thrilling and inspiring film that celebrates human ingenuity, perseverance, and the pursuit of discovery.

documents.title: Gully
documents.overview: A slightly dystopian vision of LA, we follow three disaffected teenagers, Jessie, Calvin and Nicky, all victims of extreme childhoods, running supreme hedonistic riot as they try to work out a way in life.
documents.plot:
Gully is a 2019 American coming-of-age crime drama directed by Nabil Elderkin from a screenplay by Marcus J. Guillory. Kelvin Harrison Jr., Charlie Plummer and Jacob Latimore play Jesse, Nicky and Calvin, with Jonathan Majors as Greg, Amber Heard, Terrence Howard and John Corbett as Charlie; Travis Scott makes a cameo.

In an impoverished part of Los Angeles, three lifelong friends carry the scars of childhood trauma. Jesse has not spoken in years because of abuse he suffered, Nicky expects to become a father though his girlfriend Keisha's family rejects him, and Calvin is self-destructive and refuses his medication, dismissing a guidance counselor who tells him his test scores could take him to college. Haunted by memories of his violent late father, Nicky beats a boy painting graffiti near a mural of him. Meanwhile, Greg, recently out of prison, struggles to find work, pushing a lawnmower around the neighborhood and refusing an old acquaintance's offer of shady jobs in order to stay clean.

At Calvin's urging, the teenagers decide to "take the game outside", acting out their violent video games in real life. They wreck a video store, randomly beat two men and steal their pills and pickup truck, treating each act as points scored. When Greg sees Jesse's stepfather, Charlie, abusing him, he tells Calvin, and Calvin and Nicky finally understand Jesse's silence and stay the night to comfort him. After a Mercedes driver menaces Calvin, triggering memories of his father being shot dead by a police officer, the trio follow him home, ransack the house and swap the truck for his car. When a passing car breaks Calvin's skateboard, he seems to snap; his mother gives him a cape as an early birthday present, and Greg finds him on scaffolding, where Calvin speaks of his dream of flying to Venus. When Charlie comes by Jesse's home, Nicky and Calvin track him to his house and kill him. Nicky, who left his phone in the stolen Mercedes, is arrested for grand theft, and after visiting him in jail, Calvin is shot dead by the men whose truck they stole. Jesse brings Calvin's hoodie to his grieving mother, and later, at the beach with Greg, Jesse breaks his years of silence with a scream of anguish.

The cast was announced in March 2018, when principal photography began. Gully premiered at Tribeca on April 27, 2019. Vertical Entertainment and Paramount acquired U.S. rights in 2020, and it was released on June 4, 2021. Reviews were poor, with 25% on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: Free Solo
documents.overview: Follow Alex Honnold as he attempts to become the first person to ever free solo climb Yosemite's 3,000 foot high El Capitan wall. With no ropes or safety gear, this would arguably be the greatest feat in rock climbing history.
documents.plot:
