documents.overview: London, England, April 2015. Brian Reader, a retired thief, gathers an unlikely gang of burglars to perpetrate the biggest and boldest heist in British history. The thieves assault the Hatton Garden Safe Deposit Company and escape with millions in goods and money. But soon the cracks between the gang members begin to appear when they discuss how to share the loot.
documents.plot:
King of Thieves is a 2018 British heist comedy-drama film directed by James Marsh. The movie follows the story of Charlie Countryman, a small-time crook who gets caught up in a massive diamond heist.

The main theme of King of Thieves revolves around the idea of loyalty and friendship. Charlie's relationships with his friends and family are put to the test as he navigates the complexities of the heist and confronts his own personal demons. The film explores how these relationships can be both a source of strength and weakness, highlighting the blurred lines between right and wrong.

The movie also delves into the theme of redemption, as Charlie seeks to make amends for past mistakes and prove himself to those around him. Through his journey, he learns valuable lessons about trust, forgiveness, and the importance of human connection in a world that often values material wealth over personal relationships.

Furthermore, King of Thieves touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery. Charlie's struggles with his own sense of purpose and belonging serve as a catalyst for the events of the film, highlighting the tension between who we are and who we want to be. As he navigates the world of high-stakes crime, Charlie is forced to confront his own vulnerabilities and limitations, ultimately leading him down a path of self-discovery and growth.

Overall, King of Thieves presents a nuanced exploration of complex themes, weaving together elements of drama, comedy, and action to create a captivating narrative that lingers long after the credits roll.

documents.title: Lake Placid: Legacy
documents.overview: A group of young explorers discover a secret area hidden from all maps and GPS devices. When they reach the center of the lake, they discover an abandoned facility that houses one of the largest, and deadliest apex-predators known to man.
documents.plot:
Lake Placid: Legacy is an action-adventure film that revolves around the theme of family and legacy. The movie follows the story of a young woman, who returns to her hometown in Maine to confront her troubled past and protect her loved ones from a monstrous creature. As she navigates through the treacherous terrain of her family's history and the dangers posed by the lake monster, she must also come to terms with her own identity and the weight of her family's legacy.

The film explores the idea that our past can shape us in profound ways, often leaving scars that we may not even realize are there. The main character's journey is a metaphor for the struggle to break free from the shackles of one's heritage and forge a new path, while still honoring the memories and lessons of those who came before her.

Throughout the movie, the theme of family is woven throughout, highlighting the complexities and tensions that can arise when different generations and personalities clash. The film also touches on the idea of legacy, suggesting that our actions have consequences that can be passed down to future generations, often in unexpected ways.

Ultimately, Lake Placid: Legacy is a story about self-discovery, redemption, and the power of love and sacrifice to overcome even the most daunting challenges.

documents.title: The Conquest of Siberia
documents.overview: Ivan Demarin, a young officer of Peter the First’s new guards, follows the Tsar’s order and goes to the frontier town of Tobolsk, deep in the Siberian forest. There Ivan falls in love for the first time and he and his regiment happen to be involved in conspiracy of local princes who hunt for gold in the town of Yarkand. His fort is surrounded by hordes of wild Dzungars and there is no one to call for help…
documents.plot:
The Conquest of Siberia (Russian: Tobol) is a 2019 Russian historical action drama directed by Igor Zaytsev, loosely based on one of the storylines of Aleksei Ivanov's novel Tobol. The novel itself grew out of an idea by producer Oleg Urushev, who had commissioned a screenplay from the Perm-based writer; the film's script is credited to Ivanov and Alexey Permyakov, with Zaytsev also credited. Produced by Solivs with Yellow, Black & White and the Cinema Fund, with cinematography by Yuri Korobeinikov, it was released in Russia by Central Partnership on 21 February 2019 under the tagline "The Hottest Wintertime". An expanded eight-episode television version aired on Channel One from late October to early November 2020, and the film itself had its television premiere on the same channel in November 2021.

Inspired by real events of the early eighteenth century, the story follows Ivan Demarin (Ilya Malanin), a young officer of Peter the Great's new guards, who on the Tsar's orders travels to Tobolsk, the frontier capital of the Siberian province deep in the forest. There he falls in love for the first time with Masha Remezova (Yuliya Makarova), the daughter of the renowned Siberian chronicler, cartographer and architect Semyon Remezov (Dmitri Nazarov). Ivan and his regiment become caught up in a conspiracy of local princes hunting for gold, and the young lovers take part in Colonel Ivan Bukhholts's expedition of 1714 to 1716 in search of the trading town of Yarkand in Kashgaria and the gold fields beyond. On the edge of the Kazakh steppes the expedition founds the Yamyshev fortress, where the army winters, only for it to be besieged by hordes of Dzungars from Central Asia with no one to call for help. Dmitriy Dyuzhev plays Peter the Great and Ekaterina Guseva the future Empress Catherine I, while Andrey Burkovskiy and Agata Mutsenietse appear as Swedish and German prisoners of war, with Evgeniy Dyatlov as the Siberian governor Prince Matvei Gagarin.

The film earned about 2 million dollars at the box office. Russian critics were largely negative, with an average of 35 out of 100 across 14 reviews on the aggregator Kritikanstvo. Seans likened it to a trailer for a television project, Kotonavty faulted its imposed patriotism and fragmented screenplay, and Vokrug TV noted that it gives too little time to its characters and too much to fights, while Rossiyskaya Gazeta's Pavel Basinsky judged that on the whole the film worked.

documents.title: The Woman in the Window
documents.tagline: She has nothing to prove but what's real.
documents.overview: An agoraphobic woman living alone in New York begins spying on her new neighbors only to witness a disturbing act of violence.
documents.plot:
The Woman in the Window is a 2021 psychological thriller film directed by Joe Wright, based on the novel of the same name by A.J. Finn.

The movie follows Anna Fox, a recluse who spends her days spying on her neighbors and watching old movies. However, when she witnesses what appears to be a crime, her life becomes entangled in a mystery that puts her own life at risk.

Some of the main themes present in The Woman in the Window include:

1. **Isolation and loneliness**: Anna's reclusive lifestyle serves as a backdrop for exploring the consequences of social isolation and loneliness. Her inability to connect with others leads to feelings of disconnection and despair.
2. **Guilt and regret**: Anna's past mistakes and regrets are slowly revealed throughout the film, highlighting the weight of guilt and its impact on one's mental health.
3. **Perception vs. reality**: The movie blurs the lines between what is real and what is perceived, leaving the audience questioning what actually happened. This theme speaks to the fragility of human perception and the ease with which our perceptions can be manipulated.
4. **Trauma and PTSD**: Anna's experiences are rooted in a traumatic event from her past, which has left her with PTSD-like symptoms. The film explores the long-term effects of trauma on individuals and their relationships.
5. **The power dynamics between men and women**: The movie critiques the societal expectations placed on women, particularly those related to domesticity and caregiving. Anna's character is a prime example of this, as she struggles to assert her own identity and autonomy.

Overall, The Woman in the Window is a thought-provoking thriller that delves into complex themes and explores the human condition through its protagonist's journey.

documents.title: Her Smell
documents.overview: A self-destructive punk rocker struggles with sobriety while trying to recapture the creative inspiration that led her band to success.
documents.plot:
Her Smell is a 2019 American drama film that delves into the complexities of toxic relationships and the destructive nature of unchecked emotions. The movie follows the story of Annie, a punk rock singer who struggles with addiction, mental health issues, and her tumultuous relationships.

At its core, Her Smell explores the theme of emotional intensity and how it can both fuel creativity and destroy lives. Annie's music is a manifestation of her inner turmoil, and as she navigates her personal struggles, her art becomes increasingly raw and provocative. However, this intensity also leads to a cycle of self-destruction, causing harm to those around her.

The film also touches on the theme of toxic masculinity, particularly in Annie's relationships with men. Her partners are often portrayed as emotionally unavailable or even abusive, which exacerbates her feelings of isolation and desperation. This dynamic highlights the ways in which societal expectations can perpetuate unhealthy relationships and stifle women's emotional expression.

Furthermore, Her Smell examines the tension between creative expression and personal responsibility. Annie's addiction and mental health issues are deeply intertwined with her artistic pursuits, raising questions about the costs of pursuing one's passion at any cost. The film suggests that while creativity can be a powerful outlet for emotions, it must also be balanced with self-awareness and accountability.

Ultimately, Her Smell is a nuanced exploration of the darker aspects of human emotion, revealing the devastating consequences of unchecked intensity and the importance of seeking help and support in times of need.

documents.title: A Quiet Place Part II
documents.overview: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize that the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats that lurk beyond the sand path.
documents.plot:
A Quiet Place Part II is a 2021 American horror film directed by John Krasinski and Emily Blunt, who also star in the movie alongside Millicent Simmonds. The film takes place after the events of the first part and follows the Abbott family as they navigate their new reality.

The story begins with Evelyn (Emily Blunt) giving birth to a baby girl, which is a significant event for the family. However, the baby's arrival also puts them at risk due to the presence of monsters that hunt by sound. The family must find a way to protect their newborn and ensure her survival in this post-apocalyptic world.

The Abbotts embark on a perilous journey through the woods, searching for a safe haven where they can raise their daughter without being detected by the creatures. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, abandoned buildings, and other survivors who may be hostile towards them.

As they navigate this new world, Evelyn struggles to cope with her newfound motherhood and the weight of responsibility that comes with it. She must also confront her own fears and limitations as a mother in order to protect her daughter. Meanwhile, Regan (Millicent Simmonds), their deaf daughter, plays a crucial role in the family's survival, using her unique abilities to detect and avoid danger.

Throughout their journey, the Abbotts face numerous challenges, including encounters with the creatures and other survivors who are struggling to survive. They also encounter a group of people who claim to have found a safe haven, but Evelyn is skeptical about their intentions.

As the story unfolds, Evelyn begins to realize that her daughter's presence may be more than just a threat to their survival - it may also hold the key to their future. The film builds towards a climactic confrontation with the creatures and a shocking revelation about the true nature of the world they live in.

Ultimately, A Quiet Place Part II is a tense and suspenseful thriller that explores themes of motherhood, sacrifice, and resilience in the face of unimaginable danger. The film features stunning performances from its cast, particularly Emily Blunt and Millicent Simmonds, who deliver powerful and emotional performances that bring depth and nuance to their characters.

Overall, A Quiet Place Part II is a gripping and intense horror film that expands on the world and characters introduced in the first part. It's a must-see for fans of the genre and anyone looking for a thrilling cinematic experience.

documents.title: Doom: Annihilation
documents.overview: A group of UAC Marines responds to a distress call from a top-secret scientific base on Phobos, a Martian moon, only to discover it's been overrun by demons.
documents.plot:
Doom: Annihilation is a 2019 American science fiction action horror film written and directed by Tony Giglio, based on id Software's Doom video game series. A reboot and the second live-action Doom film after the 2005 adaptation, it stars Amy Manson as Lieutenant Joan Dark, Dominic Mafham as Dr. Malcolm Betruger, Luke Allen-Gale as Dr. Bennett Stone and Nina Bergman as Private Carley Corbin and Louis Mandylor.

At a United Aerospace Corporation (UAC) base on Phobos, Dr. Betruger uses ancient teleporters called Gates to transport a volunteer from a UAC laboratory in Nevada; the experiment works, but the subject arrives deformed and insane. Aboard a UAC transport, a squad of marines sent to guard the base wakes from cryosleep, among them Joan Dark, a disgraced lieutenant her comrades distrust, and Bennett Stone, a scientist and her former boyfriend. Ignoring Dr. Kahn's objections, Betruger sends himself through the Gate to Nevada, and the Phobos base immediately goes dark as monsters pour out. Sent to restore power, the marines learn the reactor will explode in ninety minutes.

Attacked by base staff turned into zombie-like creatures, the marines rescue three survivors: Betruger, the medic Veronica and Chaplain Glover. The UAC, Betruger explains, has studied the Gates for thirty years to colonise other worlds; they are thought to be the work of an ancient alien race, while Glover thinks they are demonic. Joan orders an evacuation, but Imp-like demons ambush the transport, killing several marines, including Glover. With the ship crippled, she pretends to go along with Betruger's plan to escape through the Gate, intending only to restore communications. Betruger reveals that she was disgraced for letting a terrorist go free, then kills Veronica and locks the marines in with the Imps. Arming herself with the BFG 9000, Joan fights toward the Gate chamber, is forced to kill a zombified Bennett, and shoots Betruger, who revives and pushes her into the Gate. In hell she confronts the demon overlord Stanga, who vows to annihilate all life, and blasts her way back through the Gate to Nevada, where she is sedated by security as she warns them to shut it down. As the Gate reactivates, Kahn assumes Betruger is coming through, and a growl is heard.

Universal backed Giglio's pitch after the 2016 game's success; id Software was not involved. Released direct to video on October 1, 2019, the film received mixed reviews, scoring 43% on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: 100% Wolf
documents.overview: Freddy Lupin, heir to a proud family line of werewolves, is in for a shock when on his 14th birthday his first 'warfing' goes awry, turning him into a ferocious poodle.  The pack elders give Freddy until the next moonrise to prove he has the heart of a wolf, or risk being cast out forever.  With the help of an unlikely ally in a streetwise stray named Batty, Freddy must prove he's 100% Wolf.
documents.plot:
100% Wolf is a 2020 Australian animated adventure fantasy comedy film directed by Alexs Stadermann and produced by Alexia Gates-Foale and Barbara Stephen, adapted from Jayne Lyons' 2009 novel of the same name. It features the voices of Jai Courtney, Samara Weaving, Magda Szubanski, Rhys Darby, Ilai Swindells, Akmal Saleh, Rupert Degas and Jane Lynch. Produced by Flying Bark Productions, it tells the story of a boy from a family of werewolves whose first transformation turns him into a poodle instead of a wolf.

Freddy Lupin is the young heir to a pack of werewolves who secretly protect their town and have little love for dogs. One night, when he tries to follow his family on patrol using a magical moonstone, he loses the stone to an ice cream man named Foxwell Cripp, and his father Flashheart apparently dies after falling from a cliff while trying to save Cripp. Freddy's uncle Hotspur becomes the new pack leader. Six years later, Freddy undergoes his first transformation, and despite the encouragement of the family's loyal housekeeper Mrs. Mutton, he is humiliated when he turns into a poodle. Scorned by the pack, he is given until moonrise the next day to prove he is a true wolf or face banishment. Freddy sets out to recover the moonstone from Cripp, who has become obsessed with proving that werewolves exist, and befriends Batty, a mixed-breed stray known as "Houndini" for her talent for escaping dog catchers. They retrieve the stone but are caught and taken to the Coldfax Dog Pound, which is secretly run by Hotspur, where they meet a Scottish Terrier named Hamish, a Blue Heeler named Bruno and a Chihuahua named Twitchy. Hotspur takes the moonstone and leaves his nephew behind. Thrown into a pit with a dreaded creature known as the Beast, Freddy discovers that it is his long-lost father, imprisoned in wolf form by his jealous brother. With the help of his new canine friends and Mrs. Mutton, Freddy must free his father, escape the pound and stop Hotspur's sinister scheme to turn the town's dogs into wigs.

100% Wolf was released by Studio 100 Film on May 29, 2020. It received mixed reviews from critics, holding a 69% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on 16 reviews. A sequel, 200% Wolf, was released in August 2024.

documents.title: Superintelligence
documents.overview: When an all-powerful Superintelligence chooses to study the most average person on Earth, Carol Peters, the fate of the world hangs in the balance. As the A.I. decides to enslave, save or destroy humanity, it’s up to Carol to prove that people are worth saving.
documents.plot:
Superintelligence is a 2020 American romantic action comedy directed by Ben Falcone and written by Steve Mallory. Melissa McCarthy stars in her fourth collaboration with her husband Falcone, with James Corden as the voice of an artificial intelligence and Bobby Cannavale, Brian Tyree Henry and Sam Richardson in supporting roles. Warner Bros. released the film digitally in the United States through HBO Max on November 26, 2020, with theatrical releases in some international markets.

Carol Peters left a lucrative executive job at Yahoo! eight years earlier to live a more altruistic life. Now living in Seattle and struggling to find work she finds meaningful, she spends her days doing nonprofit work for environmental causes and animals. Her friend and former colleague Dennis persuades her to interview at a modern dating website, where the interviewer dismissively describes her as the most average person on Earth. The remark is overheard by an autonomous artificial intelligence that has secretly achieved sentience.

The next morning, the AI begins speaking to Carol through her television, phone and even her rice maker, adopting the voice of James Corden, her favorite celebrity, to calm her when she panics. It explains that it is deciding whether to save, enslave or wipe out humanity, and that it has chosen Carol as its test subject. Over three days it will observe her and her relationships before making its decision. To help her along, it erases her student debt, deposits ten million dollars into her bank account and encourages her to confide in Dennis, now a researcher at Microsoft, who is quickly convinced that the AI is real. The AI also pushes Carol to reconnect with her ex-boyfriend George, played by Cannavale, a professor preparing to leave the country for a job abroad.

As Carol tries to rekindle the romance, word of the AI reaches the US government, which mobilizes to shut it down. Carol's fumbling attempts to prove that people are worth saving, and her renewed relationship with George, become the deciding factors in the fate of the world.

The film received mostly negative reviews and grossed about $4 million. Rotten Tomatoes gives it a 31% approval rating from 67 reviews, with a consensus calling it a forgettable comedy that failed to make full use of McCarthy's talents, though she herself was frequently praised.

documents.title: Annabelle Comes Home
documents.overview: Determined to keep Annabelle from wreaking more havoc, demonologists Ed and Lorraine Warren bring the possessed doll to the locked artifacts room in their home, placing her “safely” behind sacred glass and enlisting a priest’s holy blessing. But an unholy night of horror awaits as Annabelle awakens the evil spirits in the room, who all set their sights on a new target—the Warrens' ten-year-old daughter, Judy, and her friends.
documents.plot:
Annabelle Comes Home is a 2019 supernatural horror film directed by Gary Dauberman and written by Dauberman and Chris McGinnis. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2014 film Annabelle, which was part of The Conjuring Universe.

The story begins with the introduction of a young girl named Judy Warren (played by Ella Taylor), who is the daughter of paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren (played by Tony Curran and Vera Farmiga). The movie then flashes back to the 1970s, where we see a young Annabelle Higgins (played by MacKenzie Foy) living with her foster parents, John and Missy Higgins.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Annabelle is not just any ordinary doll. She was once a real person named Annabelle Higgins who died under mysterious circumstances. The doll was then taken in by the Warrens, who believed that she was possessed by the spirit of Annabelle.

The movie takes a dark turn when John and Missy are brutally murdered by a group of Satanic cultists. Ed and Lorraine find the doll in their home and take it with them on the road, where they use it to help them with their paranormal investigations.

As the story progresses, we see the Warrens' investigation into a series of mysterious events that seem to be connected to Annabelle. They soon discover that the cultists who killed John and Missy are still active and are seeking revenge against the Warrens.

The movie's climax features a terrifying confrontation between Ed, Lorraine, and their daughter Judy, as well as a group of Satanic cultists led by a mysterious figure known as "The Collector." The final showdown is intense and suspenseful, with many lives hanging in the balance.

Throughout the movie, there are several nods to the original Annabelle film, including a memorable scene where Ed and Lorraine first discover the doll's dark history. The movie also expands on the mythology of the Conjuring Universe, introducing new characters and plot twists that add depth to the franchise.

Overall, Annabelle Comes Home is a chilling horror film that delivers on its promise of scares and suspense. With its talented cast, clever plot twists, and terrifying villain, it's sure to leave fans of the genre sleeping with the lights on.

documents.title: The Secret Garden
documents.overview: Mary Lennox is born in India to wealthy British parents who never wanted her. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She meets her sickly cousin, and the two children find a wondrous secret garden lost in the grounds of Misselthwaite Manor.
documents.plot:
The Secret Garden is a 2020 British fantasy drama film directed by Marc Munden and adapted by Jack Thorne from Frances Hodgson Burnett's 1911 novel, of which it is the fourth film adaptation. It stars Dixie Egerickx as Mary Lennox, with Colin Firth as Archibald Craven and Julie Walters as Mrs Medlock, and moves the story to England in 1947. STXfilms released it on premium video on demand in the United States in August 2020, and Sky released it in British cinemas and on its Sky Cinema channels on 23 October 2020.

In 1947, Mary Lennox is found alone in her home in British India, her parents having died of cholera and the girl having been forgotten in the turmoil of Partition. She is sent to live with her uncle, Archibald Craven, at Misselthwaite Manor in Yorkshire. Sullen and unkind after a childhood in which she learned to suppress her feelings, Mary is received by the strict housekeeper, Mrs Medlock, who forbids her to explore the house and confines her to her room at night, and she quickly unsettles the young maid Martha with her demands. Allowed to wander the grounds, Mary befriends a stray dog she names Jemima, and at night she follows mysterious cries through the corridors to discover her bedridden cousin Colin, who believes he has a hunched back and will never walk. After freeing Jemima from a trap, Mary follows the runaway dog, climbs a wall and tumbles into a hidden, overgrown garden, where a robin leads her to a key concealed in a statue. With Dickon, a local boy who helps nurse the injured dog, she begins to visit the garden in secret, and the two plan to bring Colin there in the hope that its magic will heal him. Meanwhile Mary finds pictures of her own mother and of Colin's late mother, Grace, and uncovers letters exchanged between the two women, whose memory still haunts the grieving Mr Craven, and the three children find in the garden a place where their own sorrows can begin to mend.

On Rotten Tomatoes, 68% of 96 reviews of the film are positive, with a consensus praising it as faithful in spirit while putting its own spin on the source material, and Metacritic gave it a score of 59 out of 100, indicating mixed or average reviews. In the United States it debuted as the top rental on Amazon Prime.

documents.title: Darc
documents.overview: To bring down a global human trafficking ring, an Interpol agent recruits the help of a brutal criminal with inside knowledge of the yakuza.
documents.plot:
Darc is a 2018 American action thriller directed by Julius R. Nasso from a screenplay by Tony Schiena and Dennis Venter. Schiena stars as Jake Walters, a former convict known as Darc who is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate a yakuza family, with Armand Assante as the Interpol agent Lafique, Kippei Shiina, Sho Ikushima, Tetsu Watanabe and Dawn Olivieri. Filmed in the Vancouver area, including New Westminster, the film was released by Netflix in May 2018.

Jake grows up in Japan as a Western boy raised in a brothel, obsessed with manga and collecting kanji cards. When he intervenes to save his mother from a beating, he brings the wrath of the yakuza down on them, and he witnesses her murder at the hands of a gangster. Years later, now a bearded, pitiless fighter skilled with pistol and knife who calls himself Darc after his favourite comic book hero, he is granted early release from prison thanks to Lafique. In return, the Interpol agent wants his help in bringing down a global human trafficking ring run by the Koga-kai syndicate, which has also abducted Lafique's own daughter, and he urges Darc to see it as justice for his mother.

The way in comes when Darc rescues Shigeru Kageyama, the reckless son of the businessman and yakuza leader Toshio Kageyama and grandson of the clan's powerful boss Ginzo, during a clash with a rival gang. Shigeru hires the outsider as his bodyguard, hoping to prove himself to his father, and Darc is drawn into the family's operations on the West Coast, killing members of a rival biker gang, collecting protection money from local Asian businesses and frequenting the syndicate's sex clubs, while flashbacks reveal the ugly past he absorbed in Japan. He grows close to Ivy, an attractive neighbour, as he works his way towards Toshio, the man responsible for his mother's death, in a violent campaign of revenge that ends in a bloody finale.

Critical response was largely unfavourable. Roger Moore of Movie Nation praised the decent fight choreography and polished look but found Schiena a bland lead, felt Assante deserved a better film and concluded that a good yakuza thriller could not be made in Vancouver. Writing for Firstpost, Anupam Kant Verma called it a by-the-book revenge story that relied on frenetic editing to hide its lack of drama and stereotyped characters, although its slickly staged action and the stronger performances of the older cast kept it watchable.

documents.title: Avengers Grimm: Time Wars
documents.overview: When Rumpelstiltskin tries to take over Earth once and for all, The Avengers Grimm must track him down through time in order to defeat him.
documents.plot:
Avengers Grimm: Time Wars is a 2018 American fantasy superhero film directed and edited by Maximilian Elfeldt from a screenplay by Jeremy M. Inman, and produced by David Michael Latt for The Asylum. A sequel to Avengers Grimm (2015), it was conceived as a "mockbuster" of Marvel's Avengers: Infinity War while also drawing on the television series Once Upon a Time. Eric Feltes plays Rumpelstiltskin, with Lauren Parkinson as Snow White, Marah Fairclough as Sleeping Beauty, Elizabeth Eileen as Red Riding Hood, Christina Licciardi as Alice, Michael Marcel as Prince Charles Charming III, Katherine Maya as Magda and Randall Yarbrough as the Mad Hatter.

Years have passed since the magic mirror portal shattered, scattering shards across the world. Each fragment is a gateway to a different fairy-tale realm with its own timelines, part of a vast multiverse, and an organization called Looking Glass has been formed to combat threats from those kingdoms. Alice, whose sanity is kept in check by medicine prepared by the Hatter, guards the shards, while the fairy-tale princesses and Red Riding Hood, an archer combining the look of the storybook heroine with the skills of Robin Hood, work to collect them so that they can rebuild the portal and return home.

Prince Charming, who survived Rumpelstiltskin's attempt on his life, is on the run from Magda, the power-hungry ruler of Atlantis, and washes up near a large city. Magda follows and unleashes her soldiers from the sea, hoping to force him to marry her, because whoever weds the prince and wears his ring will gain infinite power and rule the world. To fight back, Alice has the Hatter thaw Snow White from a block of ice, and the heroines, reunited after a brawl with Magda's followers in a warehouse, are astonished to find her alive. Rumpelstiltskin, meanwhile, manipulates Magda into an alliance in exchange for control of Atlantis. When the heroines find the prince, Snow White shields his escape with a wall of ice, but Rumpelstiltskin overpowers him and takes his appearance. Magda then uses her magic to cast the princesses into separate dimensions that warp space and time; once they find each other again, they set out for the realm beyond the mirror to stop Magda's wedding to the prince.

Shot in downtown Los Angeles, the film was released direct to DVD in the United States on 1 May 2018. Critics were unkind, with the German magazine Cinema calling it even sillier than its predecessor.

documents.title: Good Boys
documents.tagline: You Must Be This Tall to See This Movie
documents.overview: A group of young boys on the cusp of becoming teenagers embark on an epic quest to fix their broken drone before their parents get home.
documents.plot:
Good Boys is a coming-of-age comedy film released in 2019, directed by Gene Stupnitsky and written by Seth Kearsley. The movie follows three sixth-grade friends, Max, Lucas, and Thor, who have been inseparable since kindergarten.

The story begins with the boys preparing to attend their first kissing party, a rite of passage for pre-teens in their neighborhood. They are excited but also nervous about what to expect. However, things take an unexpected turn when they accidentally get invited to a grown-up's party instead of the kids' party.

At the adult gathering, the boys are initially overwhelmed by the sophisticated atmosphere and the adults' behavior. They try to blend in with the other guests, but their innocence and naivety lead them into various awkward situations. Max (Jacob Tremblay), Lucas (Brady Noon), and Thor (Keith L. Williams) must navigate through a series of misadventures, including trying to impress girls, drinking juice from a flask, and getting caught up in a wild party.

As the night progresses, the boys' behavior becomes more reckless, and they start to lose control. They also begin to realize that their friendship is being tested by their newfound exposure to adulthood. The movie takes a turn when Max's parents announce that they are getting divorced, adding an extra layer of complexity to the story.

Throughout the film, the characters face various challenges, including peer pressure, family drama, and self-discovery. As the night comes to a close, the boys must confront their own maturity and figure out what it means to be growing up.

The ending is both heartwarming and humorous, as the boys reflect on their experiences and learn valuable lessons about friendship, loyalty, and growing up. The movie concludes with Max, Lucas, and Thor returning home, where they share a heartfelt moment of brotherhood, solidifying their bond despite the challenges they faced that night.

Overall, Good Boys is a relatable and entertaining coming-of-age story that explores the ups and downs of adolescence. With its talented young cast, witty dialogue, and hilarious situations, the movie has become a favorite among audiences of all ages.

documents.title: The 355
documents.overview: A group of top female agents from American, British, Chinese, Colombian, and German government agencies are drawn together to try and stop an organization from acquiring a deadly weapon to send the world into chaos.
documents.plot:
The 355 is a 2022 spy action film directed by Jason Winginum and written by Michael Frost Beil and Shana Feste. The movie stars Jessica Chastain, Lupita Nyong'o, Diane Kruger, Sebastian Stan, and Penélope Cruz.

The story follows a group of five women from different countries who are brought together to form an elite spy unit known as "The 355." The team consists of Eve (Jessica Chastain), a skilled American operative; Khadija (Lupita Nyong'o), a Nigerian agent with expertise in hacking and surveillance; Marie (Diane Kruger), a German agent with exceptional marksmanship skills; Nicky (Sebastian Stan), an American CIA agent who is initially hesitant to join the team; and Lin (Penélope Cruz), a Spanish agent with experience in infiltration and sabotage.

The movie begins with Eve, who has been working as a freelance spy for years, taking on a mission to steal a powerful artificial intelligence system from a wealthy tech mogul. However, she soon discovers that the AI is actually a highly advanced surveillance tool created by a rogue government agency. As Eve delves deeper into the world of espionage, she meets Khadija, who has been tracking the same lead.

The two women eventually team up with Marie and Nicky, who are both part of a CIA operation to take down the rogue agency. Lin joins the group later on, bringing her expertise in infiltration and sabotage. Together, they embark on a perilous journey across Europe, following a trail of clues that leads them to a mysterious location.

As the team navigates through treacherous landscapes and avoids deadly traps set by their enemies, they begin to uncover a sinister plot to use the AI system for global domination. The women must put aside their differences and work together to stop the rogue agency and save the world from destruction.

Throughout the movie, the characters face numerous challenges and obstacles, including double agents, assassins, and treacherous terrain. Along the way, they also share personal stories and form strong bonds with each other, which becomes crucial in their mission to succeed.

The climax of the movie features an intense showdown between The 355 and the rogue agency's henchmen. In a thrilling sequence, the women use their unique skills to take down their enemies and disable the AI system. In the end, they successfully complete their mission and bring the rogue agency to justice.

Overall, The 355 is an action-packed spy thriller that celebrates the strength and camaraderie of its female leads. With its diverse cast and intricate plot, the movie offers a fresh take on the traditional spy genre.

documents.title: Midway
documents.tagline: One battle turned the tide of war.
documents.overview: The story of the Battle of Midway, and the leaders and soldiers who used their instincts, fortitude and bravery to overcome massive odds.
documents.plot:
Midway is a 2019 war film directed by Roland Emmerich, who produced it with Harald Kloser, from a screenplay by Wes Tooke. Covering the first six months of the Pacific War, from the attack on Pearl Harbor to the Battle of Midway in June 1942, it is a new take on the events depicted in the 1976 film of the same name. The cast includes Ed Skrein as the dive bomber pilot Dick Best, Patrick Wilson as the intelligence officer Edwin Layton, Woody Harrelson as Admiral Chester Nimitz, Luke Evans, Aaron Eckhart, Nick Jonas, Mandy Moore, Dennis Quaid, Tadanobu Asano and Darren Criss. A long-held passion project for Emmerich, the film was largely financed independently with significant Chinese investment.

In 1937, Edwin Layton, an American naval attaché in Tokyo, is warned by Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto that American threats to Japan's oil supply could drive the country to war. Four years later, on 7 December 1941, Japan launches its surprise attack on Pearl Harbor, devastating the US Pacific Fleet. Yamamoto and Rear Admiral Tamon Yamaguchi argue for a bold follow-up strike against Midway Atoll, but are overruled until the Doolittle Raid on Tokyo in April 1942 shocks the Japanese high command into approving their plan.

Meanwhile, the newly appointed commander of the Pacific Fleet, Admiral Nimitz, relies on Layton and the codebreaker Joseph Rochefort, whose team is intercepting Japanese messages about an operation against a target identified only as "AF." Officials in Washington believe the target lies in the South Pacific, but Layton and Rochefort become convinced it is Midway and devise a ruse to prove it. The film follows the war through the eyes of the aviators and sailors of the carrier USS Enterprise, including the reckless but brilliant Best and his family, as well as the Japanese commanders, and culminates in the Battle of Midway, where American dive bombers turn the tide of the war in the Pacific by sinking four Japanese aircraft carriers.

Midway received mixed reviews. Critics praised its spectacular aerial combat sequences and its respectful, relatively balanced depiction of both sides, but criticized its dialogue, crowded storytelling and thin characterizations. It grossed about $127 million worldwide.

documents.title: Just Mercy
documents.tagline: Every generation has its hero. Meet ours.
documents.overview: The powerful true story of Harvard-educated lawyer Bryan Stevenson, who goes to Alabama to defend the disenfranchised and wrongly condemned — including Walter McMillian, a man sentenced to death despite evidence proving his innocence. Bryan fights tirelessly for Walter with the system stacked against them.
documents.plot:
Just Mercy is a 2019 American biographical legal drama directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, who co-wrote the screenplay. It is based on Bryan Stevenson's 2014 memoir of the same name. Michael B. Jordan plays Stevenson and Jamie Foxx plays Walter McMillian, alongside Brie Larson as Eva Ansley, Tim Blake Nelson as Ralph Myers, Rob Morgan as Herbert Richardson, Rafe Spall as prosecutor Tommy Chapman and O'Shea Jackson Jr. as Anthony Ray Hinton.

In 1989, young Harvard law graduate Stevenson moves to Alabama to defend the poor. With Eva Ansley, he founds the Equal Justice Initiative in Montgomery and begins visiting death row. One of his clients is Walter "Johnny D." McMillian, a Black man sentenced to death for the 1986 murder of Ronda Morrison, an 18-year-old white woman. McMillian has always said he is innocent. Stevenson finds that the case rests entirely on the testimony of Ralph Myers, a convicted felon who gave contradictory statements in exchange for leniency. District attorney Tommy Chapman refuses to look at the evidence. When Darnell Houston comes forward with information that undermines the prosecution, he is arrested for perjury and frightened into silence. Deputies later hold Stevenson at gunpoint during an illegal search.

Meanwhile, Stevenson fails to save another client, Herbert Richardson, convicted of a fatal bombing, and keeps his promise to stay with Richardson until his execution in the electric chair. Stevenson confronts Myers, who admits that police threatened him with the death penalty to force his testimony, and Myers recants in court. The local judge still denies a new trial. Stevenson takes the case to the public on 60 Minutes, and the Alabama Supreme Court orders a retrial. At the hearing to dismiss the charges, Chapman finally joins the motion, and McMillian walks free. The epilogue says McMillian remained friends with Stevenson until his death in 2013 and that Morrison's murder remains officially unsolved. Hinton, freed by Stevenson in 2015, spent 28 years on death row.

Broad Green Pictures developed the film from 2015 until Warner Bros. took it over. Filming took place in Montgomery and Atlanta in 2018. The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 6, 2019, opened in limited release on December 25 and went wide in January 2020. It grossed about $50.9 million. Critics praised its performances and direction. Audiences gave it a rare A+ CinemaScore, and Foxx was nominated for a Screen Actors Guild Award.

documents.title: The Courier
documents.tagline: Based on the incredible true story of a businessman turned spy.
documents.overview: Cold War spy Greville Wynne and his Russian source try to put an end to the Cuban Missile Crisis.
documents.plot:
The Courier is a 2021 spy thriller film directed by Dominic Cooke, starring Chris Evans as the titular character, Nick Winterson, also known as "The Courier." The movie is based on the true story of Greville Wynne, a Welshman who played a crucial role in the Cold War.

The film begins with Nick Winterson (Chris Evans), an American businessman living in London with his wife, Liz (Sarah Wright). However, their seemingly idyllic life takes a drastic turn when Nick is approached by the CIA and recruited to work as a spy. He is tasked with smuggling a Soviet diplomat, Oleg Penkovsky (Mikhail Redniss), out of the country.

As Nick navigates his new role, he must balance his personal life with the demands of espionage. He becomes increasingly entangled in the world of espionage, using his skills to help the CIA gather intelligence on the Soviet Union. Meanwhile, Liz begins to suspect that something is amiss and starts to investigate her husband's activities.

The plot thickens as Nick becomes more deeply embroiled in the spy game. He faces numerous challenges, including encounters with Soviet agents and the risk of being discovered by his own agency. Despite these obstacles, he perseveres, driven by a sense of duty and loyalty to his country.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Oleg Penkovsky is not just any ordinary diplomat. He is a high-ranking official who has been feeding information to the CIA for years, providing them with crucial intel on Soviet military capabilities. Nick's mission becomes even more critical as he works to ensure that this information reaches its intended destination.

The film builds towards a tense and suspenseful climax as Nick faces off against his Soviet adversaries. With the help of Liz, who has become increasingly involved in his espionage activities, Nick manages to outsmart his enemies and complete his mission.

In the end, Nick emerges victorious, having successfully smuggled Oleg Penkovsky out of the country. The film concludes with a sense of closure for the characters, as they reflect on the sacrifices they have made and the risks they have taken.

Throughout the film, Chris Evans delivers a strong performance as Nick Winterson, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The supporting cast, including Sarah Wright and Mikhail Redniss, also deliver solid performances that add to the overall tension and suspense of the story.

Overall, The Courier is a gripping spy thriller that explores the complexities of espionage and the personal costs of loyalty and duty. With its tense plot and strong performances, it is a must-see for fans of the genre.

documents.title: Sorry We Missed You
documents.overview: Ricky and his family have been fighting an uphill struggle against debt since the 2008 financial crash. An opportunity to wrestle back some independence appears with a shiny new van and the chance to run a franchise as a self-employed delivery driver. It's hard work, and his wife's job as a carer is no easier. The family unit is strong but when both are pulled in different directions everything comes to breaking point.
documents.plot:
Sorry We Missed You is a thought-provoking drama that delves into the complexities of modern capitalism and its effects on human relationships. The film tells the story of a young woman, Kate, who becomes increasingly disillusioned with her corporate job and the societal expectations placed upon her.

As the narrative unfolds, it becomes clear that the film is critiquing the ways in which technology has eroded traditional family structures and created a sense of isolation among its characters. The main theme of the movie revolves around the tension between personal fulfillment and material success, highlighting how the relentless pursuit of wealth can lead to emotional numbness and disconnection.

The film also explores the consequences of neoliberalism on working-class families, particularly women, who are often forced into precarious and low-paying jobs with limited job security. This leads to a sense of desperation and frustration among the characters, as they struggle to make ends meet and find meaning in their lives.

Throughout the movie, the director, Ken Loach, masterfully weaves together themes of class struggle, loneliness, and the search for human connection in a world that seems increasingly indifferent to individual well-being. The result is a powerful and poignant portrayal of a society in crisis, where the pursuit of profit has become more important than people's lives.

Ultimately, Sorry We Missed You is a film about the need for empathy, compassion, and human connection in a world that often values efficiency and productivity over emotional intelligence and relationships.

documents.title: Finch
documents.overview: On a post-apocalyptic Earth, a robot, built to protect the life of his dying creator's beloved dog, learns about life, love, friendship, and what it means to be human.
documents.plot:
Finch is a post-apocalyptic drama film directed by Miguel Sapochnik, written by Jeremy Penner, and produced by Amblin Entertainment. The movie stars Tom Hanks as the titular character, a scientist who embarks on a perilous journey to save humanity from extinction.

The story begins in 2035, where we see a world ravaged by a deadly virus that has wiped out most of humanity. We are introduced to Finch (Tom Hanks), an elderly scientist who is working on a top-secret project to preserve human knowledge and culture before the world ends. He is accompanied by his loyal dog, Goody (played by a CGI-generated canine).

Finch's mission is to upload human consciousness into a robotic body, allowing people to live on in a digital realm. However, Finch soon realizes that he has only 30 days left to complete his task before the virus takes over and destroys what's left of humanity.

As Finch navigates the desolate landscape, he encounters various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, hostile creatures, and malfunctioning robots. Despite these challenges, Finch remains determined to fulfill his mission and ensure that human knowledge is preserved for future generations.

Throughout his journey, Finch forms a bond with Goody, who becomes more than just a companion – she's a symbol of hope and companionship in a world devoid of humanity. As they face numerous dangers together, Finch begins to question the morality of his mission and the true meaning of life.

As the days tick by, Finch's physical body begins to deteriorate, and he must find ways to sustain himself in the harsh environment. He also encounters other survivors, including a young girl named Zoe (played by Ayelet Zurer), who becomes a source of inspiration for Finch.

The film's climax revolves around Finch's final upload of human consciousness into the robotic body. As he completes his task, Finch is forced to confront the reality of his own mortality and the fate of humanity. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Finch's uploaded consciousness existing in a digital realm, surrounded by the knowledge and culture he worked so tirelessly to preserve.

Throughout the film, Tom Hanks delivers a powerful performance as Finch, bringing depth and nuance to a character who is both flawed and endearing. The movie's themes of hope, resilience, and the human condition are timely and thought-provoking, making Finch a compelling watch for audiences.

Overall, Finch is a beautifully crafted film that explores the complexities of human existence in the face of catastrophic loss. With its stunning visuals, engaging storyline, and outstanding performances, it's a must-see for fans of science fiction and drama.

documents.title: Flashback
documents.tagline: In the blink of an eye your life can turn upside down
documents.overview: Frederick Fitzell is living his best life—until he starts having horrific visions of Cindy, a girl who vanished in high school. After reaching out to old friends with whom he used to take a mystery drug called Mercury, Fredrick realizes the only way to stop the visions lies deep within his own memories, so he embarks on a terrifying mental odyssey to learn the truth.
documents.plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Flashback" released in 2020 by Lionsgate. 

However, I did find that there is a 2018 film called "Flashback" directed by Simon Fellows and starring John Travolta, but it was released by Lionsgate, not in 2020.

If you're referring to the 2018 film, "Flashback" is an action thriller film about a former CIA operative who must use his skills to take down a terrorist organization. The main themes of this movie include:

* Redemption: The protagonist's past mistakes come back to haunt him, and he must make amends by taking down the terrorist organization responsible for his daughter's death.
* Loyalty: The protagonist's loyalty to his country and his family is tested as he navigates a complex web of espionage and betrayal.
* Personal growth: Throughout the film, the protagonist undergoes a transformation from a bitter, vengeful man to someone who finds redemption through sacrifice.

If you're referring to a different movie titled "Flashback" released in 2020 by Lionsgate, I couldn't find any information on it.

documents.title: The Scorpion King 5: Book of Souls
documents.original_title: The Scorpion King 5: Book of Souls
documents.overview: The Scorpion King teams up with a female warrior named Tala, who is the sister of The Nubian King. Together they search for a legendary relic known as The Book of Souls, which will allow them to put an end to an evil warlord.
documents.plot:
The Scorpion King: Book of Souls, released as The Scorpion King 5, is a 2018 American direct-to-video sword-and-sorcery adventure directed by Don Michael Paul from a screenplay by David Alton Hedges. The fifth and final entry in The Scorpion King series, itself a spin-off of Stephen Sommers' Mummy films, it follows The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power and stars Zach McGowan as the warrior Mathayus, with Pearl Thusi, Mayling Ng and Peter Mensah in supporting roles.

The film's mythology begins in ancient Egypt, where King Memtep strikes a bargain with the god of the underworld and forges a fearsome blade called the Fang of Anubis. The sword draws its power from the souls of everyone it kills, and the names of its victims are recorded in a mystical volume known as the Book of Souls.

Many centuries later, the ruthless warlord Nebserek digs up the Fang and uses it to launch a brutal campaign of conquest across the land. Meanwhile Tala, a Nubian warrior, is searching for the legendary Scorpion King in the hope that he can help her stop the tyrant. She frees a blacksmith named Mathayus, believed to be that hero, and persuades him to join her on a perilous mission to halt the dark power spreading through Egypt.

Their journey brings them into conflict with mercenaries and with the Black Arrows, a tribe of fierce warriors. They also encounter Enkidu, a golem who acts as the guardian of Amina, a young woman who is the living embodiment of the Book of Souls. Amina reveals the key to defeating Nebserek: the power of the Fang can be broken only if the Book itself is sacrificed.

As Nebserek and his forces close in, the companions make a final stand. Enkidu gives his life to protect Amina, and in the end Amina willingly sacrifices herself to lift the sword's curse and release the souls trapped within it. With the threat ended, Tala rises to become Queen of Nubia, while Mathayus fully accepts his identity as the Scorpion King and sets off alone, apparently to begin the campaign of conquest that will define his legend.

Produced by Universal 1440 Entertainment and shot largely in South Africa, the film cast McGowan in the role earlier played by Dwayne Johnson and Victor Webster.

documents.title: 6-Headed Shark Attack
documents.overview: What is supposed to be a marriage boot camp on a remote island turns into the ultimate test for survival when a 6-headed shark starts attacking the beach. Trapped with minimal weapons they try to fight off the shark, but quickly discover that no one is safe in the water or on land.
documents.plot:
6-Headed Shark Attack is a 2018 American science fiction horror television film directed by Mark Atkins, who co-wrote the screenplay with Koichi Petetsky, and produced by The Asylum, the studio behind Sharknado. Following 2-Headed Shark Attack (2012), 3-Headed Shark Attack (2015) and 5-Headed Shark Attack (2017), it is the fourth instalment in the studio's series of films about multi-headed sharks. Shot on location in South Africa with a largely local cast playing Americans, it stars Brandon Auret, Thandi Sebe, Cord Newman, Naima Sebe, Tapiwa Musvosvi, Meghan Oberholzer and Jonathan Pienaar, and carried the tagline "Don't mix with the six!". It premiered on Syfy on 18 August 2018 and was released on DVD and video on demand on 31 October 2018.

Marriage counsellor William (Auret) and his wife Suzanne have set up a kind of adventure camp for couples on Corazon Island, a small Pacific island, combining physical challenges with relationship counselling to help heal dysfunctional marriages. As William puts the latest group through the course, Suzanne announces that she wants a divorce, leaving him to carry on with the remaining couples. Nearby lies a former shark research station, a floating laboratory just offshore where classified government experiments have been carried out. The group soon comes under attack from the result: a six-headed shark that kills one couple after another. Trapped on the island with minimal weapons, the survivors try to fight back, but they discover that the creature has enormous strength and an almost unstoppable ability to regenerate its heads when they are cut off, and that it can even move onto land by walking on its heads, so that no one is safe in the water or on the beach. In the end only William and Mary (Thandi Sebe) remain, and they finally defeat the shark by blowing it up with gas cylinders.

Moria's reviewer found that the series never reaches the tongue-in-cheek heights of the Sharknado films and that its only gimmick is adding heads, though Atkins does a serviceable job and the scene of the shark walking up the beach provides a moment of delirious silliness; the review faulted the effects as ranging from semi-competent to slipshod, the cheap-looking laboratory and several weak performances, including Auret's in the lead. In December 2019 the German channel Tele 5 screened the film in its series The Worst Movies of All Time.

documents.title: Black Water: Abyss
documents.overview: An adventure-loving couple convince their friends to explore a remote, uncharted cave system in the forests of Northern Australia. With a tropical storm approaching, they abseil into the mouth of the cave, but when the caves start to flood, tensions rise as oxygen levels fall and the friends find themselves trapped. Unknown to them, the storm has also brought in a pack of dangerous and hungry crocodiles.
documents.plot:
Black Water: Abyss is a 2020 Australian survival horror film directed by Andrew Traucki and written by John Ridley and Sarah Smith. A standalone sequel to Traucki's Black Water (2007), it traps a group of friends in a flooding cave system deep in the Australian forest with an enormous saltwater crocodile.

After two Japanese tourists stumble into a hidden cave and are killed by an unseen creature, five friends set out to explore the same caverns, which Cash claims to have discovered: Cash, Eric, Jen, Yolanda and Victor. Ignoring a storm warning, they descend to an underground lake, unaware that heavy rain is flooding the entrance behind them. Victor is mauled by the crocodile when he wades in after something in the water, and when Cash and Eric try the submerged entry tunnel they find it blocked; Cash is later killed. Yolanda confides that she is pregnant, and on a scouting trip through a newly found passage she tells Eric that the baby is his rather than Victor's. Jen, finding photographs that betray the affair, tries to retrieve something from the water, slips and knocks herself out, and Victor is dragged under and killed while saving her. Spotting light beneath the surface, Eric realises water is draining toward the outside and the survivors swim for it; he splashes to distract the crocodile and is taken, while Jen and Yolanda escape through the animal's lair to the shore and their car. Fleeing, Jen swerves around a fallen tree into the river, and the crocodile attacks again. Jen, though seized and dragged under, kills the beast, and the two women, their friendship strained, head home together.

Jessica McNamee plays Jen, with Luke Mitchell as Eric, Amali Golden as Yolanda, Benjamin Hoetjes as Victor and Anthony J. Sharpe as Cash. Produced by Neal Kingston, Michael Robertson and Pam Collis for Thrills & Spills, in association with Screen Queensland and Altitude Film Entertainment, it was released in Australian cinemas by R & R Films on 10 July 2020, with Altitude selling it internationally and Screen Media handling the US release. Reviews were mixed to lukewarm; critics found the relationship drama thin but praised its claustrophobic tension and simplicity, with one calling it decently scary.

documents.title: Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway
documents.tagline: The garden was just the beginning.
documents.overview: Peter Rabbit runs away from his human family when he learns they are going to portray him in a bad light in their book. Soon, he crosses paths with an older rabbit who ropes him into a heist.
documents.plot:
Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway is a 2021 comedy film directed by Will Gluck, who co-wrote the screenplay with Patrick Burleigh, based on Beatrix Potter's Peter Rabbit stories. A direct sequel to Peter Rabbit (2018), it features James Corden returning as the voice of the title character, with Rose Byrne as Bea, Domhnall Gleeson as Thomas McGregor and David Oyelowo as the publisher Nigel Basil-Jones, and Elizabeth Debicki and Margot Robbie among the voice cast. After repeated delays caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, it was released by Sony Pictures in Australia in March 2021, in the United Kingdom in May and in the United States in June.

Bea and Thomas McGregor are married, and Peter has finally accepted Thomas as part of his life. Bea has written a children's book based on Peter and his family, but Peter is upset to find that it portrays him as the naughty one. When the slick publisher Nigel Basil-Jones offers to distribute the book, he unveils a marketing plan that makes Peter look like a troublemaker, and a dejected Peter wanders off into town. There he meets Barnabas, an older rabbit who claims to have been a friend of Peter's late father and who leads a crew of animal thieves. Feeling understood at last, Peter is drawn into Barnabas's world and soon persuades Benjamin and his sisters Flopsy, Mopsy and Cottontail to join a grand heist at the farmers market, where the prize is a haul of dried fruit. Meanwhile, Thomas begins to suspect that Nigel's ideas for turning the books into flashy commercial adventures are not in the best interests of Bea's work. The heist goes awry when Peter's family are captured by animal catchers, and Peter learns that Barnabas has been using him all along and never knew his father. Ashamed, Peter turns to Thomas and Bea for help in rescuing his friends, setting off a chaotic chase in which Peter must decide what kind of rabbit he really wants to be, and Bea must decide whether her stories are worth selling out.

The film received mixed reviews from critics. On Rotten Tomatoes, 68% of 75 critics' reviews are positive, with a consensus calling it an enjoyably silly and self-aware sequel that should leave fans of the original "feeling fairly hoppy". It grossed $157 million worldwide.

documents.title: A Dog's Journey
documents.overview: A dog finds the meaning of his own existence through the lives of the humans he meets.
documents.plot:
A Dog's Journey is a heartwarming drama film released on February 15, 2019, by Universal Pictures. The movie is based on the bestselling novel "A Dog's Purpose" by W. Bruce Cameron.

The story begins with Bailey, a golden retriever who lives with his owner, Ethan (played by Dennis Quaid), and his wife, Hannah (played by Margaret O'Halloran). Bailey is a loving companion to the family, but he dies suddenly at the age of 16 due to cancer. However, in a surprising twist, Bailey finds himself reincarnated into a new body as a puppy named Buddy.

Buddy grows up with Ethan and Hannah's children, Cody (played by Bryce Gheisar) and Enzo (played by Owen Vaccaro). As Buddy navigates his new life, he forms strong bonds with the family, particularly Cody. However, when Cody dies in an accident at the age of 16, Buddy is reincarnated once again.

This time, Bailey finds himself in a new body as a dog named Duke, who becomes the loyal companion to a young girl named Molly (played by Kaitlyn Dever). As Duke grows up with Molly, he learns valuable lessons about life, love, and loyalty. However, when Molly dies due to an illness at the age of 16, Bailey is reincarnated once again.

In his next life, Bailey becomes a dog named Bailey Jr., who lives with Ethan's children as they grow up. As Bailey Jr. navigates his new life, he forms strong bonds with the family and learns valuable lessons about friendship, love, and loyalty.

Throughout the movie, we see Bailey's journey through multiple lifetimes, each time learning and growing from his experiences. Despite facing various challenges and setbacks, Bailey remains a loyal and loving companion to those around him.

The movie takes a poignant turn when Ethan is diagnosed with cancer, and Bailey finds himself reincarnated one last time as an old dog named Bailey. In this final life, Bailey is able to spend quality time with Ethan and help him through his illness. Ultimately, Bailey's love and companionship bring comfort and joy to Ethan, and he passes away surrounded by the people and dogs he loves.

The movie ends on a heartwarming note, as we see Bailey's spirit watching over Ethan from beyond the grave, knowing that he has fulfilled his purpose as a loyal companion and friend. The film is a beautiful tribute to the human-animal bond and the transformative power of love and loyalty.

Overall, A Dog's Journey is a beautifully crafted movie that explores themes of love, loyalty, and the human condition. With its heartwarming story and stunning performances, it's no wonder this movie has captured the hearts of audiences around the world.

documents.title: The Gentlemen
documents.overview: American expat Mickey Pearson has built a highly profitable marijuana empire in London. When word gets out that he’s looking to cash out of the business forever it triggers plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.
documents.plot:
The Gentlemen is a 2019 British black comedy crime film directed by Guy Ritchie. The movie follows the story of Mickey Pearson, a small-time cannabis dealer who has built a lucrative business in London.

Mickey (played by Matthew McConaughey) is a laid-back and charismatic individual who has managed to evade the law and build a successful empire with his partner, Jen (played by Michelle Dockery). However, their success attracts the attention of American gangster, Arthur Fleck (played by Joaquin Phoenix), who sees an opportunity to expand his own business into the UK market.

Arthur is a struggling comedian and small-time crook who has been reduced to selling marijuana on the streets. He becomes obsessed with Mickey's operation and decides to take him down using underhanded tactics. Arthur hires a team of thugs, including his cousin, Doug (played by Jeremy Strong), to help him infiltrate Mickey's business.

As Arthur's plan unfolds, Mickey begins to suspect that something is amiss. He enlists the help of his old friend, Danny (played by Eddie Marsan), and together they hatch a plan to take down Arthur and protect their operation.

Meanwhile, Arthur's obsession with Mickey's business grows more intense, leading him to make some reckless decisions. The situation escalates as Arthur's team becomes increasingly violent, putting everyone involved in danger.

The plot thickens as Mickey and Danny try to outsmart Arthur and his team. In a series of tense confrontations, the two sides engage in a cat-and-mouse game that takes them from London's streets to high-end nightclubs.

As the story reaches its climax, Mickey and Arthur engage in a violent showdown at a luxurious mansion. The outcome is far from certain, leaving the audience on the edge of their seats as they wonder who will emerge victorious.

In the end, Mickey emerges triumphant, but not without scars. He has managed to protect his business and outsmart Arthur, but not before realizing that he may have underestimated his opponent's determination.

Throughout the film, Ritchie's signature style is evident in the witty dialogue, clever plot twists, and stylish visuals. The cast delivers strong performances, with McConaughey bringing his trademark charm to the lead role.

Overall, The Gentlemen is a gripping and entertaining thriller that explores themes of power, loyalty, and redemption. With its talented cast, clever script, and Ritchie's direction, it's no wonder this film has become a fan favorite among crime comedy enthusiasts.

documents.title: Escape Room
documents.overview: Six strangers find themselves in circumstances beyond their control, and must use their wits to survive.
documents.plot:
Escape Room is a 2019 American psychological thriller film directed by Adam Robitel and written by Bragi Schut and Maria Melnik. The movie stars Taylor Russell, Logan Miller, Jay Ellis, Tyler Labine, Deborah Ann Woll, and Chris Janson.

The story follows six strangers who are invited to participate in a mysterious game called "Escape Room." Each participant is given a phone with a cryptic message that reads: "You're going to die tonight. You have 60 minutes to escape."

The movie begins with six individuals from different walks of life, each receiving the mysterious invitation. There's Zoe (Taylor Russell), a college student; Ben (Logan Miller), a high school student; Emily (Deborah Ann Woll), a corporate executive; Chris (Jay Ellis), a police officer; Nick (Tyler Labine), a bartender; and Angela (Mia Stammers), a young woman with a troubled past.

As the game begins, each participant is taken to a different room, where they must solve puzzles and challenges to escape. The rooms are designed to test their physical and mental limits, and the participants soon realize that they are trapped in a deadly game.

Throughout the movie, the participants work together to uncover the secrets behind the game and find a way out. Along the way, they discover that each room is connected to a larger mystery, and that the game is designed to test their moral fiber.

As the clock ticks down, the participants face numerous challenges, including physical obstacles, psychological manipulation, and even murder. The tension builds as they realize that one of them may be the killer, and that they must work together to survive.

The movie takes a dark turn when it's revealed that the game is designed by a serial killer who uses his victims' deepest fears against them. The participants soon discover that they are trapped in a series of rooms, each designed to test their psychological limits.

In the final act, the participants use all their skills and knowledge to escape the last room and confront the killer. In a thrilling climax, they manage to outsmart the killer and escape the game, but not without scars.

The movie ends with a twist: the participants are left wondering if they really escaped, or if they were just part of another game. The final shot is of the phone, still ringing with the message "You're going to die tonight."

Overall, Escape Room is a tense and thrilling movie that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats. With its clever plot twists and suspenseful atmosphere, it's a must-see for fans of psychological thrillers.

documents.title: Manou the Swift
documents.overview: The little swift Manou grows up believing he's a seagull. Learning to fly he finds out he never will be. Shocked, he runs away from home. He meets birds of his own species and finds out who he really is. When both seagulls and swifts face a dangerous threat, Manou becomes the hero of the day.
documents.plot:
Manou the Swift, also released as Birds of a Feather and Swift, is a 2019 German animated adventure comedy produced in English and directed by Christian Haas and Andrea Block, founders of the animation house LUXX Studios. The English-language voice cast features Josh Keaton as Manou, Kate Winslet as Blanche, Willem Dafoe as Yves, Cassandra Steen as Kalifa, Mikey Kelley as Luc, David Shaughnessy as Percival, Arif S. Kinchen and Nolan North as Kalifa's brothers Poncho and Yusuf, Julie Nathanson as Francoise and Rob Paulsen.

On a rocky cliff overlooking the sea on France's Côte d'Azur, a colony of seagulls lives on one side and a colony of swifts on the other, and the two species regard each other with contempt. Manou is a swift whose parents are killed before he even hatches. Left alone in the world, the chick finds his way into the nest of the seagull couple Blanche and Yves, the strong-willed but stubborn leader of the colony. Blanche is the first to discover him and take him in, and the pair raise him as their son alongside their own chick, Luc, with whom Manou forms a close bond.

As he grows up, however, Manou becomes painfully aware that he is not like the other gulls. At sailing school he clashes with a rival, Francoise, and he must win an important race to prove himself worthy of the seagull community. Eventually exiled to the swifts' side of the rock, he meets his own kind for the first time and falls for Kalifa, while Percival, a flightless, neurotic bird who lives in a cemetery and laments a lost love, provides comic relief. The real threat to both colonies comes from a swarm of rats that raid nests and steal eggs. Their attacks finally force the feuding gulls and swifts to unite, and Manou, accepting his identity as a swift, helps fight off the rats and earns the respect of both seagulls and swifts.

The film was released in various international markets during 2019, reaching British cinemas on 26 July 2019, and opened in limited release and on demand in the United States in February 2020. Reviews were largely negative. Cath Clarke of The Guardian found it virtually laugh-free and indebted to The Jungle Book. Josh Bell of Crooked Marquee praised the detailed backgrounds but found the character animation clumsy, the plot lurching between set pieces and the message of tolerance delivered without conviction, while other critics admired its scenery but faulted its predictable story and weak humor.

documents.title: The Art of Racing in the Rain
documents.original_title: The Art of Racing in the Rain
documents.tagline: Meet the dog who will show the world how to be human
documents.overview: A family dog - with a near-human soul and a philosopher's mind - evaluates his life through the lessons learned by his human owner, a race-car driver.
documents.plot:
The Art of Racing in the Rain is a 2019 American drama directed by Simon Curtis and written by Mark Bomback, based on the 2008 novel by Garth Stein. It stars Milo Ventimiglia as race car driver Denny Swift and Amanda Seyfried as his wife Eve, with Kevin Costner as the voice of Enzo, Denny's golden retriever, who narrates the story. Kathy Baker and Martin Donovan play Eve's parents.

In Seattle, the elderly and failing Enzo reflects on his life, recalling a Mongolian belief that a dog who is ready will be reincarnated as a human, and hoping that he will find Denny again in another life. Years earlier, Denny, an aspiring racing driver, adopts Enzo as a puppy and names him after Enzo Ferrari. While Denny divides his time between teaching, racing and dreaming of Formula One, Enzo absorbs his master's philosophy of racing, including the idea that a great driver must learn to anticipate and stay calm in difficult conditions such as rain.

Denny meets Eve, and although Enzo is jealous at first, he soon comes to love her. The couple marry, despite the disapproval of Eve's wealthy father Maxwell, and have a daughter, Zoë, born while Denny is away driving in the 24 Hours of Daytona. As the years pass, Denny's career advances slowly, and the family faces a devastating blow when Eve becomes seriously ill. Her illness leads to a painful custody battle in which Eve's parents try to take Zoë away from Denny, threatening everything he has built. Through it all, Enzo observes the people he loves with loyalty and wisdom, convinced that, as on the racetrack, the way to win is to keep going through the storm.

The film is told entirely from the dog's perspective and uses racing as a metaphor for life, perseverance and grief. Its final scene features a brief appearance by former Formula One driver Giancarlo Fisichella.

The Art of Racing in the Rain was released by 20th Century Fox on August 9, 2019, and grossed about 33.8 million dollars worldwide. It received mixed reviews, with 44 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it sentimental and contrived, and a Metacritic score of 43.

documents.title: The Forgiven
documents.overview: Over a weekend in the High Atlas Mountains of Morocco, a random accident reverberates through the lives of both the local Muslims and Western visitors to a house party in a grand villa.
documents.plot:
The Forgiven is a 2022 drama film directed by Michael Winterbottom, starring Jesse Eisenberg, Mia Goth, and Timothée Chalamet. The movie takes place on a luxury safari in Botswana and follows the story of John Russell (Jesse Eisenberg), a wealthy American businessman who has just been released from prison after serving time for insider trading.

John is accompanied by his girlfriend, Lucy (Mia Goth), and her brother, Nick (Timothée Chalamet). The group is on a luxury safari to celebrate Lucy's birthday. However, their trip quickly turns into a nightmare when John gets drunk and accidentally kills the driver of their safari vehicle.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that John's past mistakes have caught up with him, and he must confront the consequences of his actions. The group is forced to navigate the complexities of John's situation, while also dealing with their own personal demons.

Throughout the film, Michael Winterbottom employs his signature style of non-linear storytelling, jumping back and forth in time to reveal the events leading up to the accident. This narrative structure adds to the sense of tension and unease, as the audience is left wondering what will happen next.

One of the standout aspects of The Forgiven is its exploration of themes such as privilege, class, and redemption. John's character is a complex and nuanced one, driven by a desire to escape his past mistakes and start anew. However, his actions are also rooted in a deep-seated sense of entitlement and arrogance.

The cast delivers strong performances across the board, with Jesse Eisenberg bringing a sense of vulnerability and desperation to his portrayal of John. Mia Goth and Timothée Chalamet also shine as Lucy and Nick, respectively, adding depth and complexity to their characters.

Overall, The Forgiven is a thought-provoking and unsettling drama that explores the darker aspects of human nature. With its non-linear narrative and complex themes, it's a film that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very end.

documents.title: Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
documents.overview: The world’s most lethal odd couple – bodyguard Michael Bryce and hitman Darius Kincaid – are back on another life-threatening mission. Still unlicensed and under scrutiny, Bryce is forced into action by Darius's even more volatile wife, the infamous international con artist Sonia Kincaid. As Bryce is driven over the edge by his two most dangerous protectees, the trio get in over their heads in a global plot and soon find that they are all that stand between Europe and a vengeful and powerful madman.
documents.plot:
Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard is a 2021 action comedy film directed by Patrick Hughes and starring Ryan Reynolds, Samuel L. Jackson, and Salma Hayek.

The movie begins with Michael Bryce (Ryan Reynolds), a top-notch bodyguard who has just been hired to protect the wife of a wealthy client, Dina (Salma Hayek). However, things take a turn when Dina is kidnapped by her ex-husband, Marcus (Samuel L. Jackson), a notorious hitman.
