documents.overview: With the world under attack by deadly creatures who hunt by sound, a teen and her family seek refuge outside the city and encounter a mysterious cult.
documents.plot:
The Silence is a post-apocalyptic horror film of 2019 directed by John R. Leonetti from a screenplay by Carey and Shane Van Dyke, adapted from Tim Lebbon's 2015 novel of the same name. Kiernan Shipka stars as Ally Andrews, a deaf teenager, with Stanley Tucci as her father Hugh, Miranda Otto as her mother Kelly, Kate Trotter as her grandmother Lynn, John Corbett as the family friend Glenn, Dempsey Bryk as her boyfriend Rob and Billy MacLellan as a sinister reverend.

Cave researchers accidentally release a unknown species of pterosaur-like predators from a mine. The creatures, called Vesps, kill the team and swarm toward the noisiest places they can find. Ally lost her hearing in a car crash; when news footage reveals the attacks and the government tells people to stay inside and silent, she persuades her parents to head for the countryside. Glenn joins them, but on a jammed interstate he goes off-road and crashes into a herd of deer. The family dog's barking draws the Vesps, and Glenn fires his gun to lure them away and is devoured. Hugh realizes the creatures are blind and hunt purely by sound, so he burns Glenn's car as a decoy and the family continues on foot.

At a remote house the owner is killed and Kelly is bitten. While Hugh and Ally search a store for antibiotics, they discover Vesp eggs gestating in corpses and escape by setting off the sprinklers; they also meet the reverend of a cult called the Hushed. Kelly recovers, and Ally learns online that the Vesps cannot survive cold, so the family plans to go north. The tongueless reverend tracks them down and says Ally is fertile, revealing that he wants her for the cult; Hugh drives the members off at gunpoint. Later, phones planted by the cult ring around the house and summon the Vesps. The cultists seize Ally, and Lynn sacrifices herself by screaming, drawing the creatures onto herself and the captors. The family rescues Ally from the rest and Hugh beats the reverend to death. Weeks later they reach the Refuge in Alaska, where Ally reunites with Rob and hunts Vesps with a bow, wondering who will adapt first, the creatures or humanity.

Shipka and Tucci were cast in 2017, and filming began in Toronto that September. After its original distributor ran into financial trouble, Netflix released the film on 10 April 2019; it also played theatrically in seven countries, grossing $2.3 million. Reviews were largely negative; Rotten Tomatoes gave it 30%, with its consensus calling the premise derivative.

documents.title: After the Wedding
documents.overview: Seeking funds for her orphanage in India, Isabelle travels to New York to meet Theresa, a wealthy benefactor. An invitation to attend a wedding ignites a series of events in which the past collides with the present while mysteries unravel.
documents.plot:
After the Wedding is a thought-provoking drama that delves into the complexities of human relationships and the consequences of our actions. The film masterfully weaves together multiple storylines, exploring the intricacies of love, guilt, redemption, and personal growth.

At its core, After the Wedding is a nuanced examination of the human condition, probing the darker aspects of our nature and the devastating effects of our choices. The movie delves into the theme of guilt and its corrosive power, revealing how it can consume us and destroy relationships. As the characters grapple with their past mistakes and confront the consequences of their actions, they are forced to confront the true extent of their own culpability.

The film also explores the complexities of love and relationships, highlighting the ways in which our desires and expectations can lead us down a path of destruction. The characters' struggles to reconcile their past and present selves serve as a powerful reminder that personal growth is often a painful and difficult process.

Furthermore, After the Wedding touches on the theme of redemption, suggesting that it may be possible for individuals to make amends and find forgiveness, not just from others, but also from themselves. The movie's exploration of this idea raises important questions about the nature of morality and the possibility of personal transformation.

Ultimately, After the Wedding is a haunting and thought-provoking film that challenges its viewers to confront the complexities of human relationships and the consequences of our actions.

documents.title: Come Away
documents.tagline: A story about courage, wonder and never growing old.
documents.overview: Before Alice went to Wonderland, and before Peter became Pan, they were brother and sister. When their eldest brother dies in a tragic accident, they each seek to save their parents from their downward spirals of despair until finally they are forced to choose between home and imagination, setting the stage for their iconic journeys into Wonderland and Neverland.
documents.plot:
Come Away is a 2020 fantasy drama film that tells the story of the origins of Peter Pan and the Darling children. The movie delves into the complexities of family dynamics, particularly the relationships between parents and children.

At its core, Come Away explores the theme of the struggle for power and control within families. The character of Mother (played by Nicole Kidman) is a complex figure who embodies both nurturing and authoritarian qualities, reflecting the push-and-pull nature of motherhood. Her relationship with her children, particularly Peter (played by Harris Dickinson), is fraught with tension as she navigates the challenges of raising them in a world that seems determined to hold them back.

The film also touches on the theme of imagination and its role in shaping our experiences and perceptions of reality. The Darling children's adventures in Neverland serve as a metaphor for the power of imagination to transcend the mundane and tap into the magic of childhood. Through their journey, the characters learn to harness the transformative potential of imagination, finding freedom and empowerment in the process.

Furthermore, Come Away grapples with the idea of identity and how it is shaped by our relationships with others. Peter's struggles to find his place within his family and society serve as a catalyst for his growth and self-discovery. His journey is one of self-actualization, as he learns to navigate the complexities of adulthood while holding onto the essence of his childhood imagination.

Overall, Come Away offers a nuanced exploration of the human experience, delving into the intricate web of relationships that shape our lives and the power of imagination to transform and transcend them.

documents.title: The Christmas Chronicles
documents.tagline: Santa's in town early this year
documents.overview: Siblings Kate and Teddy try to prove Santa Claus is real, but when they accidentally cause his sleigh to crash, they have to save Christmas.
documents.plot:
The Christmas Chronicles is a 2018 American Christmas fantasy film directed by Chris Columbus and written by Jon Erwin and Scott Brickell. The movie stars Kurt Russell, Goldie Hawn, Darby Camp, Judah Lewis, and Kaitlyn Dever.

The story begins on December 23rd, where we meet two siblings, Kate (Darby Camp) and Teddy (Judah Lewis), who are struggling to find the perfect Christmas gift for their mother. They are disappointed when they discover that Santa Claus has stopped coming to their town due to a lack of good deeds. Feeling hopeless, they decide to take matters into their own hands.

That night, while out on a bike ride, Kate and Teddy stumble upon a strange and magical sleigh driven by a jolly old man named Kris (Kurt Russell). To their surprise, it's Santa Claus! However, he's not the traditional, bearded Santa they expected. This Santa is more rugged and modern, with a penchant for rock music.

As they spend more time with Santa, Kate and Teddy learn that he needs their help to save Christmas. A group of naughty kids, led by a spoiled and entitled boy named Burt (Bobby Coleman), have stolen the magical crystal that powers Santa's sleigh. Without it, Christmas will be cancelled.

Santa tasks Kate and Teddy with helping him retrieve the crystal, which leads them on an adventure through the city, where they encounter various obstacles and challenges. Along the way, they also meet a friendly reindeer named Rudy (voiced by Ken Jeong).

As the night unfolds, Kate and Teddy learn valuable lessons about teamwork, kindness, and the true spirit of Christmas. They also discover that Santa is not just a mythical figure but a real person who has been watching over them since childhood.

In the end, Kate and Teddy successfully retrieve the crystal, and Santa's sleigh is restored to its former glory. With the magical crystal in hand, Santa is able to deliver presents to all the good boys and girls around the world. The movie concludes with a heartwarming scene of Kate, Teddy, and their mother enjoying a festive Christmas dinner together.

Throughout the film, Kurt Russell shines as the modern-day Santa Claus, bringing a fresh and exciting spin to the character. His chemistry with Darby Camp and Judah Lewis is undeniable, making their characters' friendship and partnership feel authentic and endearing.

The Christmas Chronicles has become a beloved holiday classic, praised for its nostalgic charm, witty humor, and positive message about the importance of kindness and generosity during the festive season.

documents.title: Five Feet Apart
documents.tagline: When Life Keeps You Apart, Fight For Every Inch.
documents.overview: Seventeen-year-old Stella spends most of her time in the hospital as a cystic fibrosis patient. Her life is full of routines, boundaries and self-control — all of which get put to the test when she meets Will, an impossibly charming teen who has the same illness. There's an instant flirtation, though restrictions dictate that they must maintain a safe distance between them. As their connection intensifies, so does the temptation to throw the rules out the window and embrace that attraction.
documents.plot:
Five Feet Apart is a 2019 American romantic drama film directed by Justin Baldoni and written by Mikki Daughtry and Toby Kebbell. The movie stars Haley Lu Richardson, Cole Sprouse, and Graham Verchere.

The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where cystic fibrosis patients are dying off due to the lack of a cure. The film follows the lives of two teenagers, Stella (Haley Lu Richardson) and Will (Cole Sprouse), who meet at a support group for CF patients.

Stella is a 17-year-old girl who has been living with CF since she was born. She is determined to live life to the fullest despite her illness. Will, on the other hand, is a 18-year-old boy who has just received his diagnosis and is struggling to come to terms with it.

The two teenagers meet at a support group meeting, where they are both told by their doctor that they have only five feet of lung capacity left due to the disease. This sets them off on a journey of self-discovery and exploration as they try to make the most of the time they have left.

As Stella and Will spend more time together, they develop strong feelings for each other. However, their relationship is complicated by the fact that they are both CF patients who need to maintain social distancing in order to prevent the spread of the disease.

Despite this, the two teenagers find ways to be together, often sneaking around and finding creative ways to spend time with each other. They also become close friends with Will's sister, Meredith (Molly Gordon), who is also a CF patient.

As the story progresses, Stella and Will face numerous challenges, including hospitalizations, medication side effects, and the emotional toll of living with a terminal illness. Through it all, they find ways to support each other and make the most of their time together.

One of the central themes of the movie is the importance of human connection in the face of adversity. Despite the many obstacles that Stella and Will face, they are able to find joy and love in each other's company.

The film also explores the complexities of grief and loss. As Stella and Will navigate their relationships with each other and those around them, they must confront the reality of their own mortality.

Ultimately, Five Feet Apart is a heart-wrenching but ultimately uplifting film that celebrates the power of human connection and love in the face of adversity. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Stella and Will finding ways to make the most of their time together despite the challenges they face.

Overall, Five Feet Apart is a powerful and emotional film that explores themes of love, loss, and resilience in the face of adversity. With outstanding performances from its cast, including Haley Lu Richardson and Cole Sprouse, the movie is sure to leave audiences moved and inspired.

documents.title: Asterix: The Secret of the Magic Potion
documents.original_title: Astérix - Le Secret de la Potion Magique
documents.overview: Following a fall during mistletoe picking, Druid Getafix decides that it is time to secure the future of the village. Accompanied by Asterix and Obelix, he undertakes to travel the Gallic world in search of a talented young druid to transmit the Secret of the Magic Potion.
documents.plot:
Asterix: The Secret of the Magic Potion (French: Astérix: Le Secret de la Potion Magique) is a French animated adventure comedy of 2018 co-directed by Alexandre Astier and Louis Clichy, from a screenplay by Astier based on the characters of René Goscinny and Albert Uderzo. A sequel to Asterix: The Mansions of the Gods (2014), it was the first Asterix production without Roger Carel as the hero; Christian Clavier voices Asterix, with Guillaume Briat as Obelix, Bernard Alane as Getafix, Daniel Mesguich as the villain Sulfurix (Demonix in English), Lévanah Solomon as Pectine and Alex Lutz as Teleferix.

After falling from a tree and breaking his foot, the druid Getafix confronts his own mortality and resolves to pass the recipe for his strength-giving magic potion to a worthy successor. Escorted by Asterix and Obelix, with the inventive village girl Pectine stowed away in his cauldron, he attends a gathering of druids that is disrupted by his old rival Sulfurix, then tours Gaul to audition young candidates. The village men go along, leaving Cacofonix and the women behind with a reserve of potion to hold off the Romans.

Sulfurix offers the secret to Julius Caesar and, with the scheming Senator Tomcrus, plots to besiege the village until its potion runs out. He secretly coaches the gifted young druid Teleferix to impress Getafix, who duly chooses him, and burns the druids' sacred forest. As the village runs dry, Sulfurix steals the gathered ingredients and freezes Obelix with a spell. Lacking one ingredient, he boosts a flawed batch with his own fire magic, drinks it and attacks Gauls and Romans alike. Getafix reveals to Pectine that the missing element is a drop of earlier potion hidden in the handle of his golden sickle, and she brews a new batch. When Sulfurix becomes a giant, Gauls and Romans unite, and Getafix shapes the legionaries into a giant centaur steered by Obelix that defeats him. Teleferix is sent home to begin his training again, while Pectine cannot get the recipe out of her head, hinting that she may one day succeed Getafix.

Distributed in France by SND from 5 December 2018, the film took close to $7 million in its first five days.

documents.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
documents.tagline: A quest to save her world.
documents.overview: Long ago, in the fantasy world of Kumandra, humans and dragons lived together in harmony. But when an evil force threatened the land, the dragons sacrificed themselves to save humanity. Now, 500 years later, that same evil has returned and it’s up to a lone warrior, Raya, to track down the legendary last dragon to restore the fractured land and its divided people.
documents.plot:
Raya and the Last Dragon is a 2021 animated fantasy adventure film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios. The movie takes place in the fictional world of Kumandra, where humans and dragons coexisted in harmony until a curse caused the dragons to disappear.

The story follows Raya (voiced by Kelly Marie Tran), a skilled warrior from the kingdom of Kumandra who is on a quest to find the last dragon, Sisu. According to legend, Sisu's tears have the power to heal the curse that has ravaged Kumandra, causing widespread destruction and chaos.

Raya sets out on her journey with her trusty companion, Namaari (voiced by Awkwafina), who is initially portrayed as a rival but later becomes an ally. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous landscapes, ferocious creatures, and other warriors seeking to exploit the curse for their own gain.

As Raya delves deeper into the heart of Kumandra, she discovers that Sisu's disappearance is linked to her own past and the reason behind the curse. The film features stunning animation, action-packed sequences, and a richly detailed world inspired by Southeast Asian cultures.

Throughout her journey, Raya learns valuable lessons about courage, friendship, and the importance of embracing her own identity. With the help of Sisu, she ultimately discovers that the key to breaking the curse lies within herself and the power of unity among the people of Kumandra.

The film features a talented voice cast, including Gemma Chan as the voice of the dragon Sisu, and a memorable soundtrack by Alan Menken and Opetaia Foa'i. Raya and the Last Dragon is a heartwarming and visually stunning adventure that celebrates the beauty of diversity and the strength of community.

documents.title: Overcomer
documents.tagline: What do you allow to define you?
documents.overview: After reluctantly agreeing to coach cross-country, high school basketball Coach John Harrison helps the least likely runner attempt the impossible in the biggest race of the year.
documents.plot:
Overcomer is a 2019 American Christian sports drama film written and directed by Alex Kendrick and his brother, Jon Erwin, under the production company Kendrick Brothers. The movie stars Shania Twain, Aryn Wright-Thompson, and Alex Kendrick.

The story revolves around Hannah Lee Scott (played by Aryn Wright-Thompson), a high school cheerleader who is struggling to find her place in life after being cut from the team due to her weight. She meets Jesus Christ through a Christian outreach program called "NASCAR: Drive for Christ," which aims to spread Christianity through NASCAR racing.

Hannah befriends Tripp (played by Alex Kendrick), a former high school basketball star who has lost his faith and is now working as an assistant coach at the same high school where Hannah attends. As they spend more time together, Hannah shares her struggles with Tripp, and he begins to see her in a different light.

Meanwhile, Hannah's rival, Kelly Foster (played by Shania Twain), is also struggling with her own faith crisis. Kelly was once a devout Christian but has since become disillusioned with the church due to its perceived hypocrisy. As she gets to know Hannah, Kelly starts to question her own values and eventually finds redemption through her relationship with Hannah.

Throughout the movie, Hannah and Tripp work together to help their teammates overcome personal struggles and find faith in Jesus Christ. Along the way, they learn valuable lessons about perseverance, forgiveness, and the importance of living a life that honors God.

As the story unfolds, Hannah's relationships with her friends and family become more complicated. Her parents are divorced, and she struggles to connect with them due to her weight issues. Tripp, on the other hand, has a strained relationship with his father, who is a former pastor.

The climax of the movie takes place during a high school basketball game, where Hannah's team faces off against Kelly's rival team. As the game reaches its peak, Hannah and Kelly have a heart-to-heart conversation that leads to their mutual redemption and forgiveness.

In the end, Hannah finds her place in life as a leader on the cheerleading squad, and Tripp rediscovers his faith through his relationship with Hannah. The movie concludes with a powerful message about the transformative power of Jesus Christ and the importance of living a life that honors Him.

Overall, Overcomer is a heartwarming and inspiring film that explores themes of faith, redemption, and perseverance in the face of adversity.

documents.tagline: The fight for the future has begun.
documents.overview: A lowly utility worker is called to the future by a mysterious radio signal, he must leave his dying wife to embark on a journey that will force him to face his deepest fears in an attempt to change the fabric of reality and save humankind from its greatest environmental crisis yet.
documents.plot:
"2067" is a 2020 Australian science fiction film directed by Luke Evans. The movie follows the story of Trevor Dorschner, a former police officer who wakes up in a cryogenic facility with no memory of his past life.

The main themes of "2067" include:

1. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: Trevor's journey is a metaphor for self-discovery as he tries to uncover his true identity and purpose. As he navigates the world, he begins to question his own existence and the nature of reality.
2. **Free Will vs. Determinism**: The film explores the tension between free will and determinism, raising questions about whether our choices are truly our own or if they're predetermined by external factors.
3. **Existentialism and Human Existence**: "2067" grapples with existentialist ideas, encouraging viewers to confront the meaninglessness of life and the search for purpose in a seemingly indifferent universe.
4. **Technology and Its Impact on Humanity**: The movie critiques the consequences of relying too heavily on technology, highlighting the potential risks and unintended consequences of scientific advancements.

Throughout the film, Trevor's experiences serve as a catalyst for exploring these themes, leading to a thought-provoking and introspective narrative that challenges viewers to consider the complexities of human existence.

documents.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Black Panther - Trouble in Wakanda
documents.original_title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Black Panther - Trouble in Wakanda
documents.overview: After speaking at the Wakanda Embassy, Black Panther fights Thanos and fends him off with the help of fellow Avengers Captain America, Thor, Iron Man, Hulk, and Black Widow. After regaining conscious, Thanos is approached by Erik Killmonger and Ulysses Klaue in a plot where they will obtain the Vibranium in Wakanda to empower Thanos. When Black Panther discovers this plot, he must work with Shuri, Okoye, and the Avengers to defeat them.
documents.plot:
LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Black Panther – Trouble in Wakanda is a 2018 American animated superhero special produced by Lego and Marvel Entertainment, with animation by Pure Imagination Studios. Directed by Michael Black and written by Mark Hoffmeier, with Stan Lee among its producers, it is a playful Lego reimagining of Black Panther and Avengers: Infinity War. The voice cast features James C. Mathis III as T'Challa / Black Panther, Keston John as Erik Killmonger, Daisy Lightfoot as Shuri, Yvette Nicole Brown as Okoye, Trevor Devall as Ulysses Klaue and Isaac C. Singleton Jr. as Thanos, with Mick Wingert as Iron Man, Travis Willingham as Thor, Roger Craig Smith as Captain America, Laura Bailey as Black Widow, Fred Tatasciore as Hulk and Liam O'Brien as Doctor Strange.

Being king of Wakanda is hard work, especially when the king is also the Black Panther. After T'Challa gives a speech at the Wakanda Embassy, Thanos arrives from outer space threatening to destroy Earth, and Black Panther leaps into action, driving off the Mad Titan with the help of fellow Avengers Captain America, Thor, Iron Man, Hulk and Black Widow. The weakened Thanos regains consciousness only to be approached by the rogue villains Killmonger and Klaue, who propose a plan to seize the vibranium hidden in Wakanda and use it to restore his power. To reach it, Klaue kidnaps T'Challa's sister Shuri, and Black Panther teams up with his loyal bodyguard Okoye to rescue her by braving Wakanda's dangerous Maze of Tal-Recs. Sneaking into the vibranium mine, the pair discover that Killmonger and Klaue have already used the precious metal to recharge Thanos, who is now stronger than ever. With his homeland in danger, Black Panther must join forces with Shuri, Okoye and the Avengers to defeat the villains before Wakanda is destroyed.

The special was made up of five shorts, "Speeches & Sandwiches", "Something Strange", "The Maze of Tal-Recs", "Mining Mayhem" and "Vibranium Vengeance", which were released one by one on Marvel's YouTube channel Marvel HQ in May and June 2018. The complete 22-minute compilation premiered on Disney XD in early June 2018.

documents.title: The Photographer of Mauthausen
documents.tagline: Based on an incredible real story
documents.overview: Spanish photographer Francesc Boix, imprisoned in the Mauthausen-Gusen concentration camp, works in the SS Photographic Service. Between 1943 and 1945, he hides, with the help of other prisoners, thousands of negatives, with the purpose of showing the freed world the atrocities committed by the Nazis, exhaustively documented. He will be a key witness during the Nuremberg Trials.
documents.plot:
The Photographer of Mauthausen (Spanish: El fotógrafo de Mauthausen) is a 2018 Spanish historical drama directed by Mar Targarona, based on the true story of Francisco (Francesc) Boix, a Spanish Republican photographer imprisoned in the Mauthausen-Gusen concentration camp complex in Austria during the Second World War. Mario Casas, who lost about twelve kilograms to play the starving prisoner, stars as Boix, with Richard van Weyden as the SS photographer Paul Ricken, Alain Hernández as Valbuena, Adrià Salazar as Anselmo Galván, Stefan Weinert as the camp commandant Franz Ziereis and Macarena Gómez as Dolores.

After fighting for the Republic in the Spanish Civil War, Boix fled into exile in France, where he was captured by the Germans and deported to Mauthausen, the camp that held more Spaniards than any other, over seven thousand. Stripped of their nationality by the Franco regime, the Spanish inmates have no country to return to. Boix's skills and quick wits help him survive: he is assigned to the camp's SS photographic laboratory, where his job is to photograph new arrivals, and Ricken, whose interest in photography leads him to take the young Spaniard under his wing, draws him into an uneasy relationship in which Boix challenges the officer's ambiguous view of the reality they record.

Working in the laboratory, Boix realizes that the images documenting the camp could one day prove the crimes committed there. With the help of fellow prisoners he begins hiding negatives, risking his life and theirs. He witnesses countless atrocities, among them the killing of a group of Jewish children caught trying to escape, whose bodies he photographs. Boix and his comrades then search for ways to smuggle the negatives out of the camp, drawing a series of outsiders into their dangerous plan. After the liberation he takes many more photographs at Mauthausen, and the negatives he and his companions saved become key evidence against senior Nazis at the Nuremberg trials, where Boix testifies as a witness.

Filmed in late 2017 in Terrassa and in Budapest, on camp sets previously used for The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas and Escape to Victory, the film was released in Spain by Filmax on 26 October 2018 and later on Netflix. Reviews were mixed: critics praised Casas's committed performance and the film's attention to a neglected chapter of Spanish history, but some found its escape subplots meandering and its supporting characters thin.

documents.title: Assimilate
documents.overview: Three friends making a web series about their town discover that their neighbors are being killed and replaced by creatures who are perfect copies of their victims.
documents.plot:
Assimilate is a psychological sci-fi thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The film's narrative revolves around a young woman, Sarah, who undergoes an experimental procedure to enhance her cognitive abilities, only to find herself trapped in a world where she must confront the darkest corners of her own psyche.

At its core, Assimilate explores the theme of identity and how it is shaped by our experiences, relationships, and perceptions. As Sarah navigates this alternate reality, she begins to question what is real and what is just a product of her own mind. This existential crisis serves as a catalyst for her journey, forcing her to confront the darkest aspects of herself and the true nature of her existence.

The film also touches on the theme of control and manipulation, highlighting how those in power often use their influence to shape and mold individuals to suit their own agendas. Sarah's situation is a prime example of this, as she finds herself trapped in a world where she is forced to conform to the desires of others, stripping her of any sense of autonomy or agency.

Furthermore, Assimilate explores the idea of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. Sarah's experiences are marked by a deep-seated sense of pain and vulnerability, which serves as a driving force behind her actions throughout the film. The movie suggests that trauma can be both a source of strength and a crippling burden, leaving individuals to navigate the complexities of their own emotional landscapes.

Ultimately, Assimilate is a thought-provoking thriller that challenges viewers to confront the darker aspects of human nature and the fragility of our perceptions.

documents.title: Darlin'
documents.overview: Found at a Catholic hospital filthy and ferocious, feral teenager Darlin’ is whisked off to a care home run by The Bishop and his obedient nuns, where she’s to be rehabilitated into a "good girl" as an example of the miraculous work of the church. But Darlin’ holds a secret darker than the "sins" she is threatened with, and she is not traveling alone. The Woman who raised her, equally fierce and feral, is ever present in the shadows of Darlin’s psyche and is determined to come for her no matter who tries to get in her way.
documents.plot:
Darlin' is a 2019 American horror film written and directed by Pollyanna McIntosh, in her directorial debut, who calls it a social issue horror film. It is the third, standalone part of a loose trilogy following Offspring (2009) and Lucky McKee's The Woman (2011), in which McIntosh played the feral title character, a role she reprises here. Lauryn Canny stars as the teenage girl raised in the wild, with Bryan Batt, Nora-Jane Noone and Cooper Andrews.

At the end of The Woman, the young Darlin' Cleek and her siblings left their abusive family to live in the wilderness with the feral Woman. Years later, Darlin', now a teenager, has become wild herself and roams the wintry forest with her adoptive mother. At the Woman's urging, she goes to a hospital, where she is struck by an ambulance. After treatment she is sent to St. Philomena's, a Catholic boarding school, where nuns and pupils try to civilise her. Tony, a kind gay nurse who first befriended her, tries to keep watch over her, but the school turns him away.

Unable at first to speak, she is called Darlin' after the name on her bracelet. Gradually she relearns language, makes friends with other girls, especially the rebellious tomboy Billy, and struggles to adapt, while the school's teachings about the Devil disturb her. The ambitious bishop who oversees the school hopes to exploit her as a miracle for publicity and money. Meanwhile the Woman makes her way through the city to reclaim her daughter, killing those who stand in her way, while befriending a group of homeless sex workers; Tony helps her find Darlin'.

The bishop, a paedophile who once abused Sister Jennifer when she was a child, approaches Darlin' and discovers that she is pregnant. Darlin' reveals that her sister Peggy died in childbirth and that the Woman sent her to the city to give birth safely. Terrified that she is carrying the Devil, she drinks bleach before her First Communion, but only falls ill. During the ceremony Sister Jennifer plays a recording of the bishop confessing his crimes, and as Darlin' goes into labour, the Woman storms the church and kills him.

Tony, his partner, Sister Jennifer and Billy deliver Darlin's baby daughter, and as sirens approach, Darlin' asks the Woman to take the child far away, and she carries the infant out of the church. Reviews were mixed to positive, with a 69% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes; the Los Angeles Times found it equal parts disgusting and grandiose.

documents.title: The Croods: A New Age
documents.tagline: The future ain't what it used to be.
documents.overview: Searching for a safer habitat, the prehistoric Crood family discovers an idyllic, walled-in paradise that meets all of its needs. Unfortunately, they must also learn to live with the Bettermans -- a family that's a couple of steps above the Croods on the evolutionary ladder. As tensions between the new neighbors start to rise, a new threat soon propels both clans on an epic adventure that forces them to embrace their differences, draw strength from one another, and survive together.
documents.plot:
The Croods: A New Age is a 2020 animated adventure comedy film produced by DreamWorks Animation, not Universal Pictures.

In this movie, the prehistoric family, the Croods, embark on a new journey as they leave their cave to explore the outside world. The story begins with Eep (voiced by Emma Stone), the eldest daughter of Grug (voiced by Nicolas Cage) and Ugga (voiced by Catherine Keener), who is eager to experience life beyond their cave.

However, things take a turn when the Croods meet Guy (voiced by Ryan Reynolds), a charming and resourceful caveman who claims to be an expert on the outside world. Eep becomes fascinated with Guy's stories of adventure and excitement, which sparks tension between her and Grug, who is hesitant to leave their cave.

As the family sets out on their journey, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, wild animals, and rival cavemen. Along the way, Eep forms a bond with Guy, while Grug struggles to accept the idea of leaving his comfort zone.

The movie features stunning animation, humor, and heartwarming moments as the Croods learn to adapt to new situations and trust each other. The film also explores themes of family, love, and acceptance, making it an entertaining and endearing experience for audiences of all ages.

Overall, The Croods: A New Age is a delightful animated adventure that offers plenty of laughs, excitement, and emotional depth.

documents.title: Mirage
documents.tagline: Who would you stop time for?
documents.overview: During a mysterious thunderstorm, Vera, a young mother, manages to save a life in danger, but her good deed causes a disturbing chain of unexpected consequences.
documents.plot:
Mirage (Spanish: Durante la tormenta, "During the Storm") is a 2018 Spanish mystery drama co-written and directed by Oriol Paulo, who is known for intricately plotted thrillers. It stars Adriana Ugarte and Chino Darín, alongside Álvaro Morte, Javier Gutiérrez and Nora Navas. The film combines a murder mystery with a time-bending premise, in which a television set allows communication across a gap of a quarter of a century.

In 1989, during the fall of the Berlin Wall and a violent electrical storm that lasts 72 hours, a boy named Nico is recording a video at home when he sees a struggle in the house next door. He goes over and finds the body of his neighbor's wife, Mrs. Weiss, and her husband, Ángel Prieto, holding a knife. As Nico flees, he is struck and killed by a car. In 2014, Vera Roy, her husband David and their daughter Gloria move into Nico's old house, where they find an old television, a video recorder and Nico's tapes.

When a storm like the one in 1989 strikes, Vera discovers that she can see and talk to Nico through the television. She warns him to stay off the road, saving his life, but wakes the next morning in an altered reality: she is no longer married to David, and her daughter Gloria was never born. Desperate to restore her life, Vera goes to the police, where Inspector Leira, skeptical but intrigued, agrees to help her if she can provide proof. Following clues from both timelines, they uncover the truth about Mrs. Weiss's death and the secrets of the people around Nico, while Vera races to use the remaining hours of the storm to reconnect with the past and recover her daughter.

The film explores fate, memory and the consequences of altering the past, weaving its twists into an intricate structure; it was later remade in Hindi as Dobaaraa (2022) and in Indonesian.

Distributed by Warner Bros. in Spain, Mirage was released theatrically on November 30, 2018, and on Netflix in March 2019. Reviews were generally positive, with 71 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes. The Hollywood Reporter found it satisfyingly complex but lacking depth, while likening it to a fun ride on a finely calibrated roller coaster.

documents.title: The Way Back
documents.overview: A former basketball all-star, who has lost his wife and family foundation in a struggle with addiction, attempts to regain his soul and salvation by becoming the coach of a disparate ethnically mixed high school basketball team at his alma mater.
documents.plot:
The Way Back is a 2020 American sports drama film directed by Peter Berg and written by Matthew Spiegel. The movie stars Ben Affleck, Janina Gavankar, Charlie Hunnam, and Michaela McAdams.

The main themes of The Way Back revolve around the struggles of addiction, redemption, and personal growth. The story follows Jack Cunningham (played by Ben Affleck), a former high school basketball star who lost his way in life after a tragic accident involving his younger brother's death. He becomes an alcoholic and loses touch with his family.

The film takes us through Jack's journey as he returns to his alma mater, East Catholic High School, as the new basketball coach. Through his interactions with his players, particularly a troubled teenager named Brian (played by Charlie Hunnam), Jack begins to confront his past demons and work towards redemption.

Throughout the movie, we see themes of:

1. Redemption: Jack's journey is one of self-discovery and making amends for past mistakes.
2. Addiction: The film portrays the devastating effects of addiction on individuals and their loved ones.
3. Personal growth: As Jack works to rebuild his life and help his players, he learns valuable lessons about responsibility, accountability, and the importance of human connection.

The movie also explores the complexities of masculinity, particularly in the context of male relationships and the pressures placed on men to be strong and stoic.

Overall, The Way Back is a powerful and emotional drama that delves into the darker aspects of human nature while offering a message of hope and redemption.

documents.title: Brittany Runs a Marathon
documents.overview: A young woman decides to make positive changes in her life by training for the New York City Marathon.
documents.plot:
Brittany Runs a Marathon is a 2019 American comedy-drama film that explores the theme of self-discovery and personal growth through the protagonist's journey of running a marathon. The movie delves into Brittany's struggles with her own identity, body image, and mental health as she navigates her way through life.

The film highlights the importance of perseverance and resilience in overcoming obstacles and finding one's purpose. Through Brittany's character, the movie showcases the transformative power of physical activity and the impact it can have on both physical and mental well-being.

Moreover, the movie touches upon themes of loneliness, friendship, and human connection. Brittany's relationships with her family, friends, and even strangers she meets along her running route serve as a catalyst for her growth and self-discovery.

The film also explores the societal pressures and expectations placed on women, particularly in terms of body image and beauty standards. Brittany's journey is a powerful commentary on the need to redefine what it means to be beautiful and strong, both inside and out.

Overall, Brittany Runs a Marathon is a heartwarming and inspiring film that celebrates the human spirit's capacity for growth, transformation, and self-discovery.

documents.title: The Perfection
documents.tagline: It's time to face the music
documents.overview: When troubled musical prodigy Charlotte seeks out Elizabeth, the new star pupil of her former school, the encounter sends both musicians down a sinister path with shocking consequences.
documents.plot:
The Perfection is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, particularly in the realm of music and performance. At its core, the film explores the theme of obsession, as embodied by the complex and multifaceted character of Claire Fitch, a cello prodigy with an unrelenting drive for perfection.

Through Claire's character, the film examines the blurred lines between genius and madness, highlighting the devastating consequences of an all-consuming passion that can both elevate and destroy. The movie also touches on the theme of trauma, as Claire's past is slowly revealed to be marred by a tragic event that has left her with emotional scars.

Furthermore, The Perfection critiques the cutthroat world of classical music, where the pursuit of excellence can lead to ruthless competition and exploitation. The film raises questions about the true cost of artistic ambition and the toll it takes on one's mental health.

Ultimately, The Perfection is a thought-provoking exploration of the darker corners of human psychology, where the lines between reality and fantasy are constantly blurred.

documents.title: Ride Your Wave
documents.overview: Hinako is a surf-loving college student who has just moved to a small seaside town. When a sudden fire breaks out at her apartment building, she is rescued by Minato, a handsome firefighter, and the two soon fall in love. Just as they become inseparable, Minato loses his life in an accident at sea. Hinako is so distraught that she can no longer even look at the ocean, but one day she sings a song that reminds her of their time together, and Minato appears in the water. From then on, she can summon him in any watery surface as soon as she sings their song, but can the two really remain together forever? And what is the real reason for Minato's sudden reappearance?
documents.plot:
Ride Your Wave is a 2019 Japanese romantic drama film directed by Keishi Ōtomo and produced by Toho. The movie tells the story of two young women, Akira and Hinata, who meet at an all-girls surf competition.

The film begins with Akira (played by Fumi Nikaido), a talented surfer from Hokkaido, competing in a surfing tournament. She is determined to win, but her competitive spirit also makes her come across as arrogant and dismissive of others. After the competition, Akira meets Hinata (played by Kanna Hashimoto), a free-spirited young woman who has just moved to Tokyo from Hokkaido.

Despite their initial differences, the two women form an unlikely bond over their shared love of surfing. As they spend more time together, Akira begins to open up and show her vulnerable side to Hinata. The two women start dating, and their relationship blossoms as they explore the city and the ocean together.

However, their happiness is short-lived, as Akira's competitive spirit soon gets the better of her. She becomes increasingly obsessed with winning, causing tension in her relationship with Hinata. Meanwhile, Hinata struggles to find her place in Tokyo and feels like she doesn't quite fit in.

As the story progresses, it becomes clear that both women are struggling with their own personal demons. Akira's competitive nature is rooted in a deep-seated insecurity, while Hinata's free-spirited nature hides a fear of commitment. Through their relationship, they learn to support and understand each other, but ultimately, their differences prove too great.

The film's climax features an intense surfing competition, where Akira faces off against her rival, a talented surfer named Yui (played by Rina Sasaki). The competition is fierce, but in the end, Akira emerges victorious. However, as she stands on the podium, basking in the glory of her win, she realizes that it's not just about winning – it's about finding happiness and fulfillment.

The film ends with Akira and Hinata standing together on the beach, watching the sunset over the ocean. They share a tender moment, and it becomes clear that their relationship has been transformed by their experiences. Akira has learned to balance her competitive spirit with her love for Hinata, while Hinata has found a sense of belonging and purpose.

Throughout the film, Ōtomo explores themes of identity, competition, and relationships. The movie is a poignant portrayal of two women navigating their lives and finding happiness in each other's company. Ride Your Wave is a beautiful and uplifting film that celebrates the power of love and self-discovery.

documents.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
documents.original_title: In the Shadow of the Moon
documents.overview: In 1988, Philadelphia police officer Thomas "Locke" Lockhart, hungry to become a detective, begins tracking a serial killer whose crimes defy scientific explanation. When the killer mysteriously resurfaces nine years later, Locke's obsession with finding the truth threatens to destroy his career, his family, and possibly his sanity.
documents.plot:
In the Shadow of the Moon is a 2019 American science fiction thriller film directed by Jim Mickle and written by Gregory Weidman and Geoff Tock. Boyd Holbrook stars as the Philadelphia police officer Thomas Lockhart, with Cleopatra Coleman as Rya, Michael C. Hall as Lockhart's brother-in-law, Holt, Bokeem Woodbine as his partner Maddox and Rudi Dharmalingam as the physicist Naveen Rao.

In Philadelphia in 1988, several people die of brain hemorrhages, each with a similar puncture wound. The police learn from a dying victim that the attacker is a black woman with an injured hand. Chasing the suspect into the subway, Lockhart hears her reveal details of his life, including that his wife is giving birth to a girl that day, before she is crushed by a train in a struggle, just as she predicted. The case is closed, but Lockhart's wife dies in childbirth. Nine years later, a new wave of identical killings begins. Lockhart, now a detective raising his daughter Amy, discovers that keys found on the dead woman belong to an aircraft built in 1996, and Rao claims the killings prove time travel. At an airfield, Lockhart finds the same woman, alive and unaged; she accidentally kills Maddox, takes Lockhart on a small plane and pushes him into the sea before crashing. By 2006 Lockhart is a drunken private investigator, and Amy lives with Holt. Learning that one of the 1988 victims ran a white nationalist militia, he concludes that the woman is moving back in time and eliminating its members, but Holt dismisses him. Using Holt's stolen badge, Lockhart reaches the leader's extremist former girlfriend just after her murder, shoots the fleeing assassin in the hand and sees her vanish into a time machine on the beach where her plane crashed, before Holt arrests him. In 2015, Rao abducts him and explains that he devised the remotely triggered injections the woman uses, aimed at people who inspired a future atrocity. Escaping, Lockhart confronts the woman, who reveals that she is Rya, his granddaughter, born that very day, and that a militia attack starts a civil war in 2024. Realizing that he caused her death in 1988, he lets her continue her mission. Later, the elderly Rao triggers the injections, erasing the attack and the war, and Lockhart reunites with his family and his newborn granddaughter.

Shot in Toronto in 2018, the film premiered at Fantastic Fest on 21 September 2019 and began streaming on Netflix six days later. Reviews were mixed (59% on Rotten Tomatoes).

documents.title: Midsommar
documents.overview: Several friends travel to Sweden to study as anthropologists a summer festival that is held every ninety years in the remote hometown of one of them. What begins as a dream vacation in a place where the sun never sets, gradually turns into a dark nightmare as the mysterious inhabitants invite them to participate in their disturbing festive activities.
documents.plot:
Midsommar is a 2019 folk horror film written and directed by Ari Aster, produced by Lars Sylvesten Gyllenhaal and Thomas A. Svedius for A24.

The story begins with the introduction of Dani (Florence Pugh), a graduate student in anthropology who has recently experienced a family tragedy. Her sister, Christiane (Ellora Torchia), died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound after being raped by their father, Ross (Jack Reynor). The family is still reeling from this loss and struggles to cope with the aftermath.

The family decides to take a trip to Sweden for the summer solstice festival in Pomerania, where they hope to find some healing and closure. They are joined by Christiane's boyfriend, Mark (Will Poulter), and his friends, Josh (William Jackson Harper) and Connie (Archie Madekwe). The group is initially excited about the trip but soon becomes increasingly uneasy as they experience strange occurrences and cultural differences.

Upon arrival in Sweden, the family discovers that the local community, known as the Hårga people, are preparing for their midsummer festival. They are welcomed with open arms by the community's leader, Constance (Villalmade Estel), who seems to be hiding secrets about her past and intentions.

As the group becomes more immersed in the festival, they begin to experience a series of bizarre and disturbing events. The Hårga people seem to be watching them, and the group starts to feel like they are being manipulated by some unseen force. Dani begins to suspect that something is amiss, but her warnings fall on deaf ears.

The plot takes a dark turn as the group becomes more entrenched in the festival's rituals and traditions. They participate in a series of disturbing ceremonies, including a pagan ritual where they are forced to wear flowers in their hair and dance around a maypole. The group soon realizes that they have been lured into a trap by the Hårga people.

As tensions rise, Dani becomes increasingly unhinged, and her mental state begins to deteriorate. She starts to experience hallucinations and visions, which she believes are connected to the festival's dark magic. Mark, who has become infatuated with Constance, is also drawn into the cult-like behavior of the Hårga people.

The climax of the film takes place in a remote farmhouse, where the group is held captive by the Hårga people. Dani and her friends are forced to participate in a series of gruesome and ritualistic ceremonies, which culminate in a shocking and disturbing finale.

Throughout the film, Aster explores themes of grief, trauma, and the dangers of cultural appropriation. The film's use of folk horror elements and its critique of modern Western society's relationship with paganism and traditional cultures are thought-provoking and unsettling.

Ultimately, Midsommar is a slow-burning, atmospheric horror film that builds tension through its eerie setting and disturbing imagery. While it may not be for everyone, the film has received widespread critical acclaim for its originality, style, and sheer audacity.

documents.title: Bad Education
documents.tagline: Some people learn the hard way.
documents.overview: A superintendent of a school district works for the betterment of the student’s education when an embezzlement scheme is discovered, threatening to destroy everything.
documents.plot:
Bad Education is a 2019 American biographical crime drama film directed by Cory Finley. The movie is based on the true story of Vito LoGrasso, a high school teacher who was convicted of embezzling over $500,000 from his school.

The main theme of Bad Education revolves around the corrupting influence of power and greed. The protagonist, Frank Tassone, played by Hugh Jackman, is a charismatic and well-respected school administrator who becomes embroiled in a web of deceit and embezzlement. As he rises through the ranks, his obsession with wealth and status consumes him, leading him to compromise his values and relationships.

The film also explores the theme of toxic masculinity, as Frank's behavior is driven by a desire to prove himself as a man and maintain control over those around him. His actions are motivated by a need for validation and respect, which ultimately leads to his downfall.

Furthermore, Bad Education touches on the theme of class struggle and economic inequality. The film highlights the stark contrast between the wealthy and privileged lives of those in power and the struggles faced by the working-class individuals who are often left behind.

The movie also delves into the theme of identity and performance, as Frank's character is revealed to be a masterful manipulator who uses his charm and charisma to hide his true nature. This theme is particularly evident in the film's portrayal of Frank's relationships with those around him, including his wife and colleagues, whom he expertly deceives.

Overall, Bad Education is a thought-provoking drama that explores the darker aspects of human nature, revealing the devastating consequences of unchecked ambition and greed.

keywords.name: based on magazine, newspaper or article

documents.overview: At the height of the First World War, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a message that will stop a deadly attack on hundreds of soldiers.
documents.plot:
1917 is a 2019 British war film directed and produced by Sam Mendes, who co-wrote it with Krysty Wilson-Cairns, partly inspired by his grandfather's stories of the First World War. George MacKay and Dean-Charles Chapman star as two young British soldiers, with Mark Strong, Andrew Scott, Richard Madden, Claire Duburcq, Colin Firth and Benedict Cumberbatch in supporting roles. Cinematographer Roger Deakins and editor Lee Smith designed the film to appear as two continuous shots.

On April 6, 1917, after the German army's apparent withdrawal to the Hindenburg Line, Lance Corporals Tom Blake and William Schofield are summoned by General Erinmore. Aerial reconnaissance has shown that the retreat is a trap, and a battalion of the Devonshire Regiment is set to attack the following morning, straight into the German defenses. With telephone lines cut, the two men must carry a written order across enemy territory calling off the assault and saving 1,600 men, among them Blake's older brother, Joseph.

Crossing no man's land, they enter the abandoned German trenches, where a booby-trapped bunker collapses and nearly kills Schofield before Blake pulls him free. At a deserted farmhouse, they rescue a German pilot from his burning plane, but he fatally stabs Blake. Schofield promises the dying Blake that he will complete the mission, and continues alone, briefly traveling with a passing British unit. At the shattered town of Écoust-Saint-Mein, he is knocked unconscious in a firefight with a sniper. Waking at night, he moves through the burning ruins, meets a French woman sheltering an infant and gives them food, then escapes German soldiers by leaping into a river and being swept over a waterfall.

Downstream, Schofield reaches the Devons as the final wave prepares to attack. Unable to push through the crowded trenches in time, he sprints across the open battlefield as the first troops go over the top and delivers the order to Colonel Mackenzie, who wearily calls off the attack. Schofield finds Joseph alive, tells him of his brother's death and hands over Tom's belongings, then rests beneath a tree, looking at photographs of his own family.

1917 premiered in London in December 2019 and was released by Universal Pictures. It was a critical and commercial success, grossing over $446 million worldwide, and won three of its ten Academy Award nominations, for cinematography, sound mixing and visual effects, along with the Golden Globe and BAFTA for Best Film.
production_companies: Canadian Film or Video Production Tax Credit (CPTC)

documents.title: Roald Dahl's The Witches
documents.overview: In late 1967, a young orphaned boy goes to live with his loving grandma in the rural Alabama town of Demopolis. As the boy and his grandmother encounter some deceptively glamorous but thoroughly diabolical witches, she wisely whisks him away to a seaside resort. Regrettably, they arrive at precisely the same time that the world's Grand High Witch has gathered.
documents.plot:
The Witches, also known as Roald Dahl's The Witches, is a 2020 dark fantasy film co-produced and directed by Robert Zemeckis, who wrote the screenplay with Kenya Barris and Guillermo del Toro, based on Roald Dahl's 1983 novel. The second screen adaptation of the book, after the 1990 film, it stars Anne Hathaway, Octavia Spencer, Stanley Tucci, Kristin Chenoweth and Jahzir Bruno, with narration by Chris Rock. It moves the story to 1960s Alabama.

After his parents die in a car accident in Chicago, young Charlie Hansen goes to live with his grandmother Agatha in Demopolis, Alabama, who gives him a pet mouse he names Daisy. When a witch tries to lure Charlie with a snake and a sweet at a store, Agatha's appearance scares her off, and Agatha explains that a witch once turned her childhood friend Alice into a chicken. Fearing the witch will return, Agatha takes Charlie to a grand hotel where her cousin is executive chef, and teaches him to recognize witches by their gloves, wigs, toeless feet and keen noses for children.

Charlie meets a greedy but friendly boy, Bruno Jenkins, then hides under the stage of the ballroom when a convention of witches arrives. Their ruler, the Grand High Witch, unveils a plan to open sweet shops and feed the world's children a potion, Formula 86, that turns them into mice. Bruno, who has already eaten a chocolate bar laced with the potion, is transformed in front of the gathering, and Charlie is caught and turned into a mouse too, though he, Bruno and Daisy escape. They learn that Daisy was once an orphan girl named Mary. Charlie steals a bottle of the potion from the Grand High Witch's room and pours it into the witches' soup, and at dinner the Grand High Witch recognizes Agatha as the woman whose friend she bewitched. As the other witches turn into rats, the mice and Agatha confront the Grand High Witch in her room, and the mice fire potion into her mouth with a mousetrap, transforming her into a rat. Agatha traps her, takes her trunk of money and potion, and lets her cat, Hades, kill her. Charlie and Agatha later travel the world hunting witches.

Pulled from theatrical schedules by the COVID-19 pandemic, the film was released by Warner Bros. on HBO Max in the United States on October 22, 2020, opening in theaters elsewhere later that month. Critics found it inferior to the 1990 version, with 50% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 47, although Hathaway's performance won some praise.

documents.title: Rim of the World
documents.tagline: Saving the world is alien to them
documents.overview: Stranded at a summer camp when aliens attack the planet, four teens with nothing in common embark on a perilous mission to save the world.
documents.plot:
Rim of the World is a 2019 science fiction adventure film directed by Jonathan Liebesman and written by Mark Fergus, Hawk Ostby, and Michael Mitchell. The movie stars Jack Black, Marlon Wayans, and Adam DeVine.

The story begins with three friends, Scott (Jack Black), Oscar (Marlon Wayans), and Ethan (Adam DeVine), who are on a road trip to attend their friend's wedding in Las Vegas. However, their plans are disrupted when they stumble upon an alien spacecraft that has crash-landed in the desert.

As they explore the ship, they discover that it is a reconnaissance vessel from an advanced alien civilization known as the "Xenomorphs." The Xenomorphs have been monitoring Earth for decades and have developed a plan to invade the planet. The three friends soon realize that they are now at the center of this invasion.

The aliens begin to hunt them down, using their advanced technology to track and eliminate any human who gets in their way. Scott, Oscar, and Ethan must use their wits and whatever resources they can find to survive against the Xenomorphs' relentless attacks.

As the stakes grow higher, the three friends discover that the Xenomorphs are not just mindless killers but also have a complex social hierarchy with different castes and roles. They also learn that the aliens have been studying human behavior and psychology, making them even more formidable opponents.

Throughout their journey, Scott, Oscar, and Ethan face numerous challenges and obstacles as they try to evade capture and find a way to stop the Xenomorph invasion. Along the way, they encounter other humans who are fighting back against the alien threat, including a group of rebels led by a mysterious figure known only as "The Architect."

As the battle between humans and Xenomorphs reaches its climax, Scott, Oscar, and Ethan discover that the aliens' ultimate goal is to harvest human DNA for their own purposes. The three friends must use all their skills and resources to outsmart the Xenomorphs and prevent a catastrophic invasion of Earth.

In the end, Scott, Oscar, and Ethan manage to defeat the Xenomorphs and save humanity from extinction. However, not before they realize that the aliens' technology has left behind a mysterious artifact that could potentially be used for good or evil in the future.

Overall, Rim of the World is an action-packed sci-fi adventure that explores themes of friendship, teamwork, and the human condition in the face of overwhelming odds.

documents.title: Brightburn
documents.overview: What if a child from another world crash-landed on Earth, but instead of becoming a hero to mankind, he proved to be something far more sinister?
documents.plot:
Brightburn is a 2019 American superhero film directed by David F. Sandberg and written by Brian Reilly. The movie stars Elizabeth Banks, David Denman, and Jeremy Irvine.

The story begins with the introduction of Brandon Breyer (played by Josh Lemke), an orphan boy who grows up in a foster home with his adoptive parents, Kent and Evelyn Breyer (played by Lizzy Caplan and Jay O. Sanders). The family is loving and supportive, but there's an undercurrent of tension due to the mysterious circumstances surrounding Brandon's birth.

As Brandon grows older, he begins to exhibit extraordinary abilities, including superhuman strength, speed, and agility. However, his powers are accompanied by a dark and violent streak, which makes him increasingly isolated from those around him.

The turning point in Brandon's life comes when he is discovered by Dr. Emma Cale (played by Elizabeth Banks), a psychologist who specializes in treating individuals with extraordinary abilities. Emma recognizes the potential of Brandon's powers and offers to help him control them.

However, as Brandon becomes more confident in his abilities, he begins to struggle with his own morality. He starts to see himself as a hero, destined to save humanity from an alien threat that is threatening Earth. This delusion is further fueled by Emma's manipulation, who uses her knowledge of Brandon's powers to control him.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Brandon's abilities are not just physical but also telepathic and telekinetic. He can read minds and move objects with his mind, making him a formidable force. However, this power comes at a terrible cost, as he struggles to maintain control over his emotions and actions.

The climax of the movie revolves around Brandon's confrontation with an alien spaceship that has landed on Earth. The aliens are seeking out individuals with extraordinary abilities, including Brandon, who they believe will help them conquer humanity.

In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Brandon is actually Superman's clone, created by Dr. Emma Cale as part of a government experiment to create super-soldiers. This revelation sets off a chain reaction of events that ultimately leads to Brandon's downfall.

The ending of the movie is both heartbreaking and terrifying. As Brandon struggles to come to terms with his true identity, he becomes increasingly unstable and violent. In a final confrontation with Emma, who has been manipulating him throughout the story, Brandon unleashes his full fury on her.

In the end, it is revealed that Brandon's powers have become too much for him to handle, and he is killed by his own hand. The movie ends with a sense of tragedy and loss, as we are left to ponder the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control.

Overall, Brightburn is a thought-provoking and unsettling take on the superhero genre. It raises important questions about the nature of power, morality, and the dangers of unchecked ambition.

documents.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
documents.original_title: Portrait de la jeune fille en feu
documents.overview: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.
documents.plot:
Portrait of a Lady on Fire is a 2019 historical drama film written and directed by Céline Sciamma. The film premiered at the 2019 Cannes Film Festival and received critical acclaim for its beautiful cinematography, nuanced performances, and thoughtful exploration of themes such as love, identity, and female desire.

The story takes place in 18th-century France, during the reign of King Louis XV. The film follows the relationship between Marianne (played by Adèle Haenel), a young and talented portrait painter, and Héloïse (played by Noémie Merlant), a beautiful and wealthy noblewoman who is engaged to be married.

The film begins with Marianne's arrival at Héloïse's family estate, where she is tasked with painting her portrait. As Marianne works on the painting, she becomes increasingly fascinated with Héloïse, and their mutual attraction grows stronger. Despite the societal norms that prohibit women from expressing romantic feelings towards each other, Marianne and Héloïse begin a secret affair.

As the story unfolds, we see the development of their relationship through a series of tender and intimate moments. Marianne's paintings become more expressive and sensual, reflecting her growing connection with Héloïse. The film also explores the societal constraints that women faced during this time period, including the limited options available to them for education, employment, and personal fulfillment.

Throughout the film, Sciamma masterfully captures the beauty of 18th-century France, from the lush landscapes to the opulent interiors of Héloïse's estate. The cinematography is stunning, with a focus on warm colors and soft lighting that creates a sense of intimacy and vulnerability.

As the story reaches its climax, Marianne and Héloïse must navigate the complexities of their relationship in the face of societal expectations. In a poignant and powerful finale, the two women find a way to express their love for each other, despite the obstacles that stand in their way.

One of the standout aspects of Portrait of a Lady on Fire is its thoughtful exploration of themes such as female desire and identity. The film raises important questions about the ways in which women have been marginalized and silenced throughout history, and how they can reclaim their agency and express themselves authentically.

Overall, Portrait of a Lady on Fire is a beautiful and powerful film that celebrates the beauty of human connection and the resilience of the human spirit. With its stunning cinematography, nuanced performances, and thoughtful exploration of themes, it is a must-see for anyone who loves great storytelling and compelling characters.

documents.title: Holiday in the Wild
documents.tagline: A romance off the beaten path
documents.overview: When her husband abruptly ends their marriage, empty nester Kate embarks on a solo second honeymoon in Africa, finding purpose and potential romance.
documents.plot:
Holiday in the Wild is a 2019 romantic comedy film that follows the story of a woman named Sandy, who embarks on a disastrous African safari adventure with her friends. As she navigates through the challenges of the wilderness and confronts her own personal demons, Sandy discovers new things about herself and finds love in unexpected places.

The main theme of Holiday in the Wild is self-discovery and empowerment. Through Sandy's journey, the film explores the idea that one must take risks and step out of their comfort zone to truly find themselves and discover what they want from life. The movie also touches on themes of friendship, love, and finding one's purpose.

The film features a strong female lead character who is flawed but relatable, making her journey all the more endearing and inspiring. As Sandy navigates through the challenges of the wilderness, she learns to let go of her past mistakes and find forgiveness, both for herself and others. The movie ultimately ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that it's never too late to start anew and pursue one's dreams.

Overall, Holiday in the Wild is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of self-discovery, empowerment, and the power of human connection.

documents.title: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga
documents.original_title: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga
documents.overview: Two small-town aspiring musicians chase their pop star dreams at a global music competition, where high stakes, scheming rivals and onstage mishaps test their bond.
documents.plot:
Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga is a comedy film that explores the universal theme of chasing one's dreams, despite the odds being against you. The movie follows the story of Lars Erickssong, a small-town Icelandic singer who dreams of winning the Eurovision Song Contest with his partner Sigrit Ericksdottir.

At its core, the film is about perseverance and believing in oneself, even when others doubt your abilities. Lars's journey is a metaphor for the human desire to succeed and be recognized, despite facing rejection and criticism along the way. The movie also touches on themes of friendship, love, and finding one's true purpose in life.

The film's portrayal of the Eurovision Song Contest itself serves as a backdrop for exploring these themes, highlighting the absurdity and chaos that can come with pursuing a dream. Through Lars and Sigrit's story, the movie shows how even the most unlikely individuals can find success and happiness when they stay true to themselves and support one another.

Ultimately, Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga is a heartwarming and humorous film about embracing your passions and never giving up on your dreams, no matter what obstacles come your way.

documents.title: The Tax Collector
documents.overview: David Cuevas is a family man who works as a gangland tax collector for high ranking Los Angeles gang members. He makes collections across the city with his partner Creeper making sure people pay up or will see retaliation. An old threat returns to Los Angeles that puts everything David loves in harm’s way.
documents.plot:
The Tax Collector is a 2020 American crime thriller film directed by David Ayer and written by Nick John Smith. The movie stars Bobby Soto, Natalie Martinez, and Michael Peña.

The story revolves around the character of David "Davey" Diaz (played by Bobby Soto), who is a young man struggling to make ends meet in South Los Angeles. Davey's life takes a drastic turn when he becomes involved with a local gang leader named Jesse Morales (played by Michael Peña). Morales, also known as "The Tax Collector," is a ruthless and cunning crime lord who demands loyalty from his associates.

As Davey becomes more deeply entrenched in the gang, he begins to uncover dark secrets about Morales's past and the true nature of their operation. The movie takes a turn when it is revealed that Morales has been using his gang as a front for a larger scheme: collecting taxes from local businesses under threat of violence.

Davey soon finds himself caught between his loyalty to Morales and his growing sense of unease with the gang's activities. As tensions rise, Davey begins to question whether he can truly escape the life he was born into.

Meanwhile, Jesse's sister, Ana (played by Natalie Martinez), becomes a key player in the story as she navigates her own complicated relationships with her brother and the local community. Through Ana's character, the movie explores themes of family, loyalty, and redemption.

As the plot unfolds, Davey is forced to confront Morales about his true intentions and the harm caused by the gang's actions. The movie builds towards a climactic showdown between Davey and Morales, with the fate of those around him hanging in the balance.

Ultimately, the film concludes with a sense of resolution for some characters, but not without leaving room for interpretation regarding the future of others. The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving viewers to ponder the consequences of Davey's choices and the lasting impact of his involvement with Morales's gang.

Overall, The Tax Collector offers a gripping portrayal of life in South Los Angeles, exploring themes of loyalty, family, and redemption through its complex characters and intricate plot.

documents.title: Otherhood
documents.overview: Three suburban moms travel to New York City to visit their sons.
documents.plot:
Victoria & Abdul is a 2017 historical drama film that tells the story of an unlikely friendship between Queen Victoria and an Indian clerk named Abdul Karim. The movie explores several themes, including cultural exchange, prejudice, and the power of human connection.

At its core, the film is a heartwarming tale of how two individuals from different walks of life came together, bridging the gap between their cultures and backgrounds. The story highlights the challenges faced by Abdul Karim as he navigates the complexities of British society, where he is met with suspicion and prejudice due to his Indian heritage.

The movie also delves into the theme of loneliness and isolation, particularly in Queen Victoria's character. Her life has been marked by duty and responsibility, leaving her feeling disconnected from the world around her. Abdul Karim's presence in her life serves as a catalyst for change, introducing her to new experiences and perspectives that help her find joy and companionship.

Furthermore, the film touches on the theme of colonialism and its impact on indigenous cultures. The story is set against the backdrop of the British Empire's expansion into India during the late 19th century, highlighting the complexities and contradictions of this period in history.

Ultimately, Victoria & Abdul is a film about the transformative power of human connection and the importance of embracing diversity and understanding. Through its portrayal of an unlikely friendship between Queen Victoria and Abdul Karim, the movie shows that even in the face of adversity, people from different backgrounds can come together and find common ground.

documents.title: Reprisal
documents.overview: Jacob, a bank manager haunted by a violent heist that took the life of a coworker, teams up with his ex-cop neighbor, James, to bring down the assailant. While the two men work together to figure out the thief’s next move, Gabriel, the highly-trained criminal, is one step ahead. When Gabriel kidnaps Jacob’s wife and daughter, Jacob barrels down a path of bloodshed that initiates an explosive counterattack and brings all three men to the breaking point.
documents.plot:
Reprisal is an American action thriller of 2018 directed by Brian A. Miller and written by Bryce Hammons. Frank Grillo stars as Jacob, a bank manager, with Bruce Willis as his neighbor James, a retired police officer, Johnathon Schaech as the bank robber Gabriel, Olivia Culpo as Jacob's wife Christina and Natali Yura as Maribel.

Jacob, the son of a police officer who died, manages a bank branch and is struggling financially because of the mounting medical bills of his daughter Sophia, who suffers from an extremely aggressive form of type 1 diabetes. One day a robber storms the bank, kills a guard, forces Jacob to open the vault and hand over the money, and then uses Jacob and another employee as decoys to make his getaway. Jacob and James study the robbery alongside earlier heists. Picking out the thief's signature habits, Jacob identifies him as a man named Gabriel and predicts that his next target will be an armored car.

He is right. During the armored car robbery Gabriel kills one guard and wounds another, Maribel, who knows Jacob from the bank; Jacob intervenes and saves her, and she is taken to the hospital. Jacob also sees where Gabriel stashes the stolen money, and while the robber is burning down his hideout in his late father's abandoned factory, Jacob takes the cash and hides it behind his house. Gabriel soon discovers the loss and realizes who is responsible. To get to Jacob, he tracks Maribel to the hospital, guns down an investigator interviewing her and forces her at gunpoint to call Jacob and ask him to come. He then kills her and heads for Jacob's house, where he kidnaps Christina and Sophia.

Arriving too late with James, Jacob receives a call from Gabriel demanding that he come alone with the stolen money as ransom. With James's help, Jacob arranges the drop-off and an attempt to rescue his family, but the exchange goes badly wrong and turns into a bloody shootout in which Gabriel kills several police officers before James finally shoots him dead. Six months later, Jacob has left banking and joined the local police force as a rookie officer, following in his father's footsteps.

The project was announced in February 2017, with Emmett/Furla/Oasis Films producing and Willis attached to star, and principal photography began in Cincinnati, Ohio, that August. The film was released in 2018 and received overwhelmingly negative reviews, with an approval rating of 8% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 19.

documents.title: The Outpost
documents.overview: A small unit of U.S. soldiers, alone at the remote Combat Outpost Keating, located deep in the valley of three mountains in Afghanistan, battles to defend against an overwhelming force of Taliban fighters in a coordinated attack. The Battle of Kamdesh, as it was known, was the bloodiest American engagement of the Afghan War in 2009 and Bravo Troop 3-61 CAV became one of the most decorated units of the 19-year conflict.
documents.plot:
