Now a young woman, Abby has never stopped believing that he may still be alive, and she sets out to discover what happened to him.

Her search leads her to a shocking truth: the epidemic never existed. It was an elaborate deception used to conceal the existence of magic. Her city was seized long ago by practitioners of dark magic, who wiped out the other sorcerers, outlawed magic and tried to erase every trace of it, using the supposed disease as a pretext to purge the city of anyone with magical abilities. For years the Special Department has continued to seize people who show signs of power, while most citizens have no idea that their rulers are not protectors but jailers. One day Abby discovers that magical powers are awakening within her. Frightened, she tries to suppress them, but the magic only grows stronger, and agents of the Special Department begin to hunt her. Forced to flee her home, she finds unexpected allies among people living outside the law and embarks on a dangerous journey that transforms her understanding of magic, her father's fate and the true nature of the world in which she lives.

Abigail was one of the more ambitious Russian fantasy productions of its time, notable for its elaborate steampunk sets, costumes and visual effects. Reviewers frequently compared its story of a young heroine with hidden powers rebelling against an oppressive regime to Western young-adult franchises. The film was released in English-speaking territories under the same title.

documents.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Chronicle of the Moon Exploration
documents.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の月面探査記
documents.overview: During a Japanese robotic exploration to find life on the other side of the moon, Nobita is watching from Earth and sees the moon turn yellow. With the help of Doraemon, the pair travel to the moon and create bunnies that will build their own colony. After he returns, Nobita tells his class about their adventure but no one will believe him. That is until a new student and his sister arrive who appear to come from a very far away place...
documents.plot:
Doraemon: Nobita's Chronicle of the Moon Exploration is a 2019 Japanese animated science fiction film directed by Tsutomu Shibayama. The movie follows Nobita Nobi, a young boy who travels back in time to the age of dinosaurs with his robotic cat Doraemon.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. Friendship and camaraderie: Throughout the adventure, Nobita learns valuable lessons about friendship and teamwork from his friends, including Shizuka, Suneo, and Rikizo.
2. Exploration and discovery: The film celebrates the thrill of exploration and discovery as Nobita and Doraemon venture into the unknown, encountering new species and experiencing the wonders of prehistoric times.
3. Environmentalism and conservation: The movie highlights the importance of preserving our planet's natural resources and protecting endangered species, as seen in the dinosaurs' struggle to survive in a changing environment.
4. Time travel and its consequences: The film explores the concept of time travel and its potential consequences, as Nobita navigates the challenges of interacting with his past self and altering the course of history.

The movie also features some comedic elements, showcasing Doraemon's signature wit and resourcefulness as he helps Nobita overcome obstacles and find creative solutions to problems.

Overall, Doraemon: Nobita's Chronicle of the Moon Exploration is a heartwarming and entertaining adventure that promotes valuable life lessons and encourages viewers to appreciate the wonders of science, nature, and friendship.

documents.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One
documents.original_title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One
documents.tagline: We all share the same fate.
documents.overview: The seventh instalment of the Mission: Impossible franchise.
documents.plot:
Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning Part One is a 2023 American action spy film directed by Christopher McQuarrie, who wrote it with Erik Jendresen, and the seventh film in the series, following Fallout (2018). Shooting began in Italy in February 2020, was halted by the COVID-19 pandemic and wrapped in September 2021, with locations including Norway, Britain and the UAE. With a gross budget estimated at $291 million, it is among the most expensive films ever made. After several delays, it premiered in Rome on June 19, 2023, and Paramount Pictures released it in the United States on July 12.

On its first mission, the Russian stealth submarine Sevastopol activates an experimental artificial intelligence through a two-part cruciform key. The AI, which comes to call itself the Entity, tricks the crew into torpedoing themselves and vanishes into cyberspace, and world powers race to obtain the key and control it. IMF agent Ethan Hunt recovers one half from former MI6 agent Ilsa Faust, faking her death to protect her from a bounty, then confronts CIA director Eugene Kittridge and vows to destroy the Entity. With teammates Benji Dunn and Luther Stickell he tries to intercept the second half at Abu Dhabi airport, but a thief named Grace steals his piece, and Ethan recognizes Gabriel, a figure from his past who now serves the Entity. After a chase through Rome with Grace, Ethan and Ilsa follow her to a party in Venice thrown by arms dealer Alanna Mitsopolis, who holds the other half and plans to sell the complete key aboard the Orient Express. Gabriel, aided by the assassin Paris, kills Ilsa.

On the train, Gabriel murders Denlinger, the director of national intelligence, who alone knew that the key opens a chamber on the sunken Sevastopol holding the Entity's source code. Grace, disguised as Alanna, pickpockets the key back from Kittridge, the buyer. Gabriel takes it after a fight atop the train and blows up a bridge, and Ethan and Grace escape the runaway carriages, helped by Paris, whom Gabriel has turned on. Grace asks to join the IMF while Ethan, having lifted the key from Gabriel, flies off to continue the mission.

Cruise stars with Hayley Atwell as Grace, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg, Rebecca Ferguson, Vanessa Kirby and Esai Morales as Gabriel. It won near-universal acclaim, with 96% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and Oscar nominations for sound and visual effects, the series' first, yet its $571.1 million gross was seen as a disappointment.

documents.title: Project Gemini
documents.overview: After depleting Earth's resources for centuries, humankind's survival requires an exodus to outer space. An international expedition is quickly formed to find a suitable new planet, but when plans go awry, the crew is suddenly stranded without power on a strange planet, where something unimaginable lies in wait.
documents.plot:
Project Gemini (Russian: Zvyozdny razum, literally "Star Mind") is a 2022 Russian science fiction thriller directed by Serik Beyseu. The film depicts a space mission sent to terraform a distant planet that encounters an unknown force with plans of its own. Egor Koreshkov and Alyona Konstantinova lead an ensemble cast that also includes Konstantin Samoukov, Nikita Dyuvbanov, Viktor Potapeshkin, Pyotr Romanov and Aleksandr Kuznetsov. It was released in Russian cinemas in January 2022 and later distributed internationally under its English title.

The story takes place in the near future, when a mysterious virus is wiping out plant life on Earth and the oxygen in the atmosphere has fallen to dangerous levels, threatening humanity with slow suffocation. Scientists discover an ancient alien device known as the Sphere, which they believe seeded life on Earth, together with a warp drive built by the same vanished civilisation. An international team of researchers, among them the scientist Steve, launches Project Gemini, a mission to carry a copy of the Sphere to a distant world and turn it into a new home for humankind.

During the voyage the warp drive malfunctions and the ship is forced to stop early near a young planet whose thin and unstable atmosphere requires the crew to wear oxygen masks outside. When the ship's pilot disobeys orders and goes out to inspect the engine, he is found dead, and Steve is suspended from command. With little choice, the crew decide to accelerate their plans and begin the terraforming process on the planet below. Flashbacks show Steve with his girlfriend Amy, to whom he gave a bracelet fashioned from a fragment of the original Sphere. As the crew set up the device, they discover that they are not alone, and that something on the planet is reacting to the Sphere in ways nobody anticipated, endangering both the mission and the survivors' lives.

The film mixes the conventions of space survival drama and creature horror with ideas about the origins of life and humanity's responsibility for its own planet. Its production design and visual effects were ambitious for a Russian genre release of its scale.

Project Gemini received mostly unfavourable reviews from international critics, who found the story derivative of earlier space horror films such as Alien and Prometheus, though some praised its visuals.

documents.title: New Order
documents.overview: In the near future, a popular uprising in Mexico City interrupts a wedding held at the home of a wealthy family. After the riots have been quashed, they discover the bride has gone missing and plea with the military to help locate her.
documents.plot:
New Order is a 2020 South Korean film directed by Lee Seung-wan, not Teorema. 

The movie revolves around a young woman named Ji-hyun who returns to her hometown after a long absence and becomes involved in the lives of those around her. As she navigates her relationships with her family members and friends, she begins to confront her own past and the societal expectations placed upon her.

One of the main themes of New Order is the struggle for identity and self-discovery. Ji-hyun's journey is a metaphor for the challenges many people face in finding their place in the world and defining themselves outside of societal norms.

Another significant theme is the exploration of family dynamics and relationships. The film delves into the complexities of family ties, revealing the intricate web of emotions, secrets, and unspoken expectations that can bind families together.

The movie also touches on the idea of social hierarchy and class differences in Korean society. Ji-hyun's experiences highlight the disparities between different social classes and the ways in which these divisions can affect individuals' lives.

Lastly, New Order explores the theme of nostalgia and the past's impact on the present. The film's use of nostalgic settings and characters serves as a reminder that our past experiences shape us into who we are today, and that confronting these memories is essential for personal growth.

Overall, New Order is a thought-provoking drama that delves into universal themes of identity, family, social class, and nostalgia, offering a nuanced exploration of the human experience.

documents.title: The Traitor
documents.tagline: The true story about the man who brought down the Mafia
documents.overview: Palermo, Sicily, 1980. Mafia member Tommaso Buscetta decides to move to Brazil with his family fleeing the constant war between the different clans of the criminal organization. But when, after living several misfortunes, he is forced to return to Italy, he makes a bold decision that will change his life and the destiny of Cosa Nostra forever.
documents.plot:
The Traitor (Italian: Il traditore) is a 2019 biographical crime drama co-written and directed by Marco Bellocchio. It tells the story of Tommaso Buscetta, the Sicilian Mafia boss who became the first major pentito, or state witness, against Cosa Nostra. Pierfrancesco Favino stars as Buscetta, with Maria Fernanda Cândido as his wife Cristina, Fabrizio Ferracane as Pippo Calò, Fausto Russo Alesi as judge Giovanni Falcone, Luigi Lo Cascio as Totuccio Contorno and Nicola Calì as Totò Riina.

In the 1980s, at the height of Mafia power, the Palermo families and the rising Corleonesi faction led by Riina keep up a show of friendship while competing for control of the drug trade. Buscetta, known as the "boss of two worlds", senses that war is coming and moves to Brazil, where he lives under the name Roberto Felici. As he predicted, a bloody feud breaks out after he leaves, and among its victims are two of his sons and his brother. Arrested and tortured by Brazilian police and facing likely death on extradition, Buscetta is offered a way out by Falcone: cooperation in exchange for state protection.

Long alienated from Cosa Nostra's ruthless violence and attached to an older idea of a Mafia that protected the poor, and seeking revenge for the attacks on his family, he agrees and becomes the first such collaborator in Italian history. His revelations make possible the Maxi Trial of 1986, held in a bunker courtroom in Palermo with 475 defendants, where his testimony and that of Contorno lead to the conviction of many mobsters. The Mafia retaliates in 1992 with the Capaci bombing, which kills Falcone, his wife Francesca Morvillo and three police escorts. Buscetta, living under protection in the United States, returns to Italy to honor his pact with Falcone and testify in the "trial of the century" involving the Christian Democrat leader Giulio Andreotti, which exposed ties between the state and the Mafia.

The Traitor premiered in competition at the 2019 Cannes Film Festival. 01 Distribution released it in Italy on 23 May 2019, and it opened in France that October. Sony Pictures Classics released it in the United States on 31 January 2020. The film earned $8.9 million worldwide and was Italy's submission for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film, though it was not nominated. Reviews were positive: Rotten Tomatoes reported an 85% approval rating, noting that it tells its story energetically despite staying near the surface of its hero.

documents.title: The Call
documents.tagline: A call from a serial killer... She'll begin to hunt your past.
documents.overview: Connected by phone in the same home but 20 years apart, a serial killer puts another woman’s past — and life — on the line to change her own fate.
documents.plot:
The Call is a 2020 South Korean psychological thriller film directed by Lee Joon-myeong and produced by Next Entertainment World.

The main themes of The Call revolve around the complex relationships between mothers, daughters, and the societal expectations placed upon them. The story follows a mother-daughter duo who are struggling to cope with their troubled past, and how they navigate through their complicated emotions towards each other.

One of the primary themes is the exploration of the complexities of mother-daughter relationships, particularly in the context of trauma, guilt, and forgiveness. The film delves into the emotional scars that can be left on individuals after experiencing traumatic events, and how these experiences can shape one's perception of themselves and their relationships with others.

Another significant theme is the societal pressure placed on women to conform to traditional roles and expectations. The mother-daughter duo in the film are forced to navigate through a patriarchal society that often prioritizes men's needs over women's, leading to feelings of resentment and frustration.

The film also touches upon themes of mental health, particularly depression and anxiety, which are often stigmatized in Korean culture. The protagonist's struggles with her mental health serve as a catalyst for the events that unfold, highlighting the importance of acknowledging and addressing these issues.

Throughout the film, the director skillfully weaves together these themes to create a complex and thought-provoking narrative that challenges societal norms and expectations.

documents.title: 4x4
documents.overview: Buenos Aires, Argentina. A luxurious van is parked on the sidewalk. A man enters with the purpose of stealing whatever he can find, but when he wants to leave, he cannot. The doors do not open, the control panel does not respond: the van has become an armored box and he is trapped like a mouse.
documents.plot:
4x4 is a 2019 Argentine crime thriller written by Mariano Cohn and Gastón Duprat and directed by Cohn, who conceived it after reading news reports of car thieves trapped inside vehicles. Peter Lanzani stars as the petty criminal Ciro and Dady Brieva as the car's owner, Dr. Enrique Ferrari, with Luis Brandoni as a retired police negotiator. Its premise recalls the 1998 Argentine film Captured. Buena Vista International released it in Argentina on 4 April 2019, where it had the year's best opening weekend for a local film.

In a Buenos Aires neighbourhood, Ciro breaks into a parked SUV, starts stripping out the stereo and other valuables and vandalises the interior. When he tries to leave, the doors will not open. The vehicle is reinforced, bulletproof, soundproof and tinted, so that nobody outside can see or hear him; a bullet he fires at the windscreen ricochets into his thigh, and his phone soon dies. As the hours pass he battles heat, thirst and an infected wound.

Then the car's phone rings. The caller is Ferrari, an obstetrician who has been the victim of repeated crimes and who has turned his car into a trap. He warns that the fuel tank is rigged with explosives and begins a long, taunting dialogue, revealing that he is a widower with a daughter and grandchild and is dying of cancer. When Ciro threatens his family, Ferrari blasts freezing air into the cabin, and rewards obedience with small mercies such as a hidden water hose or a chocolate bar. Ciro grows delirious, drinks his own urine and rails against a society he says belongs to the rich. Ferrari visits Ciro's wife and son, giving them money under a pretext, and confronts him with his violent criminal record.

After Ciro's dream of escape proves an illusion, Ferrari arrives to take him away, and a public stand-off erupts when police intervene. Retired negotiator Julio Amadeo is called in, while the neighbourhood divides between those who want Ciro punished and those who want him freed. Persuaded to give up, Ferrari instead climbs into his car and detonates the explosive, killing himself. Ciro is arrested and awaits trial, and the media nickname Ferrari the "Samurai Doctor" as the case sparks a debate about crime and insecurity. The film was not released in Spanish cinemas, going instead to television.

documents.title: His House
documents.tagline: When ghosts follow, they never leave.
documents.overview: After making a harrowing escape from war-torn South Sudan, a young refugee couple struggle to adjust to their new life in a small English town that has an unspeakable evil lurking beneath the surface.
documents.plot:
His House is a 2020 British supernatural horror film directed by Remi Hasél and written by Jack Thorne. The movie follows the story of Fadi, a Sudanese refugee who, along with his wife Ugandan-born woman Ayanna, are struggling to cope with their new life in London.

The main themes of His House revolve around the struggles faced by refugees and asylum seekers, particularly those from war-torn countries like South Sudan. The film sheds light on the trauma, displacement, and cultural dislocation that many refugees experience when they are forced to flee their homes.

Throughout the movie, Fadi's experiences with PTSD and his attempts to rebuild a sense of identity and belonging in a new country serve as a powerful metaphor for the refugee experience. His House also explores themes of grief, loss, and the struggle to find hope and healing in the face of trauma.

The film's use of supernatural elements serves as a powerful allegory for the psychological toll that displacement can take on individuals. The "house" itself becomes a symbol of Fadi's inner turmoil and his struggles to reconcile his past with his present.

Ultimately, His House is a thought-provoking and deeply unsettling exploration of the human cost of war, displacement, and trauma.

documents.title: Better Days
documents.tagline: You protect the world. I'll protect you.
documents.overview: A bullied teenage girl forms an unlikely friendship with a mysterious young man who protects her from her assailants, while she copes with the pressures of her final examinations.
documents.plot:
Better Days is a 2019 Chinese drama film directed by Han Yan. The movie follows the story of a young woman named Li Xia, who returns to her hometown after being away for several years and becomes involved in a local labor dispute.

The main themes of Better Days include:

1. Class struggle: The film highlights the stark contrast between the wealthy elite and the working class, showcasing the struggles faced by the latter.
2. Social inequality: The movie exposes the deep-seated social inequalities that exist in Chinese society, particularly in rural areas where the divide between the rich and the poor is more pronounced.
3. Labor rights: The film focuses on the plight of migrant workers who are exploited and mistreated by their employers, highlighting the need for better labor protections and working conditions.
4. Identity: Li Xia's journey is also a metaphorical exploration of her own identity and sense of belonging, as she navigates between her past and present selves.

The movie features a strong ensemble cast, including Wang Kai, Wang Qianyuan, and Yu Nan, among others. The cinematography is also noteworthy, capturing the stark beauty of rural China's landscapes and the gritty realities of life in the countryside.

Overall, Better Days is a powerful and thought-provoking film that sheds light on some of the most pressing social issues facing China today.
production_companies: He Nan Dian Ying Dian Shi Zhi Zuo Ji Tuan

documents.title: The Red Ghost
documents.tagline: The snow will be painted red with Nazi blood.
documents.overview: December 30, 1941. Vyazma ('Vyazemsky cauldron') is a small detachment of Soviet soldiers, by fatal coincidence, in an unequal battle with a special unit of the Wehrmacht. However, none of them think about giving up. Each of them was ready to sacrifice his life in order to protect his native land. None of these brave people was born a hero. The myth of the red ghost is a heroic deed without a soldier's Soviet soldier in the Great Patriotic War who instilled in the animals, deadly fear of German soldiers. In place of one of the dead hero was inserted another, and the born myth of the invincible Soviet soldier. The film 'The Red Ghost' is about the hope that each soldier will have.
documents.plot:
The Red Ghost (Krasny prizrak) is a Russian war film directed by Andrey Bogatyrev, who co-edited it and was one of eight credited screenwriters. Conceived for the 75th anniversary of the Soviet victory in the Second World War, it treats the war as a stylized snowbound western. Aleksey Shevchenkov plays the title character, with Yura Borisov, Vladimir Gostyukhin, Polina Chernyshova, Wolfgang Cerny, Mikhail Gorevoy, Vyacheslav Shikhaleev and Pavel Abramenkov.

In December 1941, after the Soviet defeat and encirclement at Vyazma, a few survivors struggle through the snow to escape the German pocket. A small detachment of Red Army soldiers, a strict lieutenant, a joking, hard-drinking sailor, a wise old peasant and a frightened young soldier found frostbitten in the forest and nicknamed the Frozen One, is joined by Vera, a pregnant medical orderly, and holes up in a village with its frightened inhabitants, including a mute one-eyed old man. They are drawn into an unequal fight with a Wehrmacht hunting unit sent against partisans, led by the polished, psychopathic Braun. Haunting the winter forests is a lone, almost wordless sniper whom the Germans call the Red Ghost, half man and half phantom, who inspires animal terror and leaves heaps of enemy dead in his wake, and around whom legends grow on both sides of the front. Holding out against far superior numbers, the defenders are eventually joined by the villagers, and the young soldier, slow to take up arms, finally fights to protect the weak. Vera gives birth inside the house surrounded by Germans, and the story ends with a hand-to-hand duel under the winter sun before the lone gunman walks off into the white daylight and passes into legend. The film is dedicated to the Unknown Soldier.

It was shot in severe frost during the winter of 2017 to 2018 in an abandoned village in the Mosalsky District; the sets were built a year earlier, but filming was postponed for nine months because of unsuitable weather. Cerny, first offered a small, one-dimensional role, had the part rewritten into a determined super-soldier. Sergei Solovyov's score deliberately echoes Ennio Morricone. Its release was repeatedly postponed, and after premiering at the Moscow International Film Festival in October 2020 it opened in Russia on June 10, 2021. Kommersant called it a largely successful attempt to tell a war story in the language of the western, likening its approach to Inglourious Basterds.

documents.title: Only Mine
documents.overview: Tormented and left for dead by a scorned lover, a woman finds the strength within herself to recover and retaliate against her abuser.
documents.plot:
Only Mine is a 2019 American thriller television film directed by Michael Civille, in his first credited feature, from a screenplay by Matt Young. Produced by MarVista Entertainment, a company best known for television movies, it stars Amber Midthunder as Julie Dillon and Brett Zimmerman as David Barragan, with Chris Browning, Claudia Ferri, Walter Fauntleroy as an out-of-town detective, Ashley Holliday as Julie's best friend Suzanne and Lorenzo James Henrie as her co-worker and friend. The film runs 87 minutes and is told partly in a true-crime style, with interviews of people who know the victim.

In the small town of Coldwater Hills, Julie is a well-liked student who works as a waitress at the local diner while she waits to leave for college. She is charmed by David, a young, dashing officer newly hired by the local police, and begins dating him, seeing the romance as a fun distraction until she moves on. David, however, takes the relationship far more seriously. Even on their first date he gives her a music box, and he soon becomes possessive, needlessly suspicious of her male co-worker and angry when she does not answer his calls, telling her that he always wants to be able to find her. As he turns from doting boyfriend into controlling ex and then dangerous stalker, Julie seeks help from the police, but to no avail: David's father was also an officer on the force and a friend of the chief, and David easily charms the townspeople, who trust him more than her. Isolated, she finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse, and after being tormented and left for dead by her scorned lover, she must summon the strength to recover and fight back against her abuser. The story also weaves Native American elements into its storytelling.

The film is loosely inspired by the case of Laura Kucera, a nineteen-year-old who was shot and left for dead by an ex-boyfriend in 1994. Only Mine premiered on Netflix in the United States and other countries on 15 January 2019 and returned to the platform's charts in 2021. Reviews were moderate. Heaven of Horror gave it three out of five, finding it realistic and well cast despite its Lifetime-style production, with a convincingly creepy Zimmerman. In The Independent, Clémence Michallon called it a lean, humble, clear-headed film that never romanticizes abuse and shows how it can begin with controlling behavior, praising Fauntleroy's performance, though she conceded that it is not great cinema.

documents.title: Malibu Rescue
documents.overview: When a long list of shenanigans lands Tyler in hot water, he’s forced to suit up and spend his summer training for an elite junior lifeguard program.
documents.plot:
Malibu Rescue is a 2019 American teen comedy-drama film that revolves around the lives of three brothers who run a beach rescue operation in Malibu, California. The movie explores the complexities of family dynamics, particularly among siblings, as they navigate their relationships and personal struggles.

At its core, Malibu Rescue delves into themes of identity, loyalty, and self-discovery. The main characters are forced to confront their own insecurities and limitations as they face various challenges, both on and off the beach. As they work together to save others, they also learn valuable lessons about themselves and their place in the world.

The film also touches on the theme of social class and privilege, highlighting the differences between the wealthy families who frequent the beach and those who are less fortunate. This contrast serves as a backdrop for exploring issues of entitlement, responsibility, and empathy.

Furthermore, Malibu Rescue features a strong coming-of-age narrative, where the characters must navigate the challenges of adolescence, including first loves, peer pressure, and finding their own paths in life. The movie's lighthearted tone and comedic moments belie its thoughtful exploration of these themes, making it an engaging watch for audiences of all ages.

Overall, Malibu Rescue is a heartwarming and entertaining film that balances humor with substance, offering a relatable and endearing portrayal of family, friendship, and personal growth.

documents.title: Last Night in Soho
documents.tagline: When the past lets you in, the truth will come out.
documents.overview: A young girl, passionate about fashion design, is mysteriously able to enter the 1960s where she encounters her idol, a dazzling wannabe singer. But 1960s London is not what it seems, and time seems to be falling apart with shady consequences.
documents.plot:
Last Night in Soho is a British psychological horror film of 2021 directed and co-produced by Edgar Wright, who wrote it with Krysty Wilson-Cairns. Thomasin McKenzie stars as Eloise "Ellie" Turner, a young fashion student haunted by visions of 1960s London, with Anya Taylor-Joy as the aspiring singer Sandie, Matt Smith as her manager Jack, Terence Stamp as a silver-haired stranger, and Diana Rigg as the landlady Ms Collins. It is dedicated to Rigg and Margaret Nolan, who died in 2020.

Ellie, a sweet but fragile teenager who adores the music and fashion of the Swinging Sixties, was raised by her grandmother in Cornwall after her mother, a fashion designer, took her own life. Arriving at the London College of Fashion, she struggles to fit in, bullied by her roommate Jocasta and befriended only by John. She moves into a bedsit owned by the elderly Ms Collins, and that night dreams herself back into the 1960s, where she watches a confident blonde, Sandie, talk her way toward singing at the Café de Paris and fall for the charming manager Jack. Further dreams follow Sandie to a Soho audition and back to Ellie's very room. Ellie dyes her hair blonde, copies Sandie's style and takes a job in a pub, where a silver-haired man notices her resemblance to Sandie.

The dreams darken as Ellie sees Jack pimping Sandie to his associates, and menacing apparitions of the men who used her haunt Ellie's waking hours. After a vision of Jack apparently stabbing Sandie to death, Ellie becomes convinced the silver-haired man is Jack. The police dismiss her, and old newspapers reveal not a murder but a string of local men who vanished. Confronted by Ellie, the stranger denies killing Sandie and is then hit by a taxi; he was Lindsey, an undercover vice officer who once urged Sandie to escape. Ms Collins then reveals that she is Sandie: it was she who killed Jack when he threatened her with a knife, and she went on to murder the men she was sold to, hiding their bodies in the house. She drugs Ellie's tea, stabs John when he comes to help, and chases Ellie as fire spreads. Faced with the vengeful spirits of her victims, Sandie tries to kill herself; Ellie stops her, but Sandie tells her to save John and stays in the burning house. Later Ellie's designs triumph at her end-of-year show, and Sandie blows her a kiss from a mirror.

Premiering at Venice in September 2021, the film grossed $23 million worldwide. Critics praised Wright's style, giving it 75% on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: My Sweet Monster
documents.overview: A scandal in the royal family: the wayward princess Barbara escaped from the palace and went through the forest in search of a handsome prince. However, instead of the cherished meeting with her beloved, she is captured by Buka, the most dangerous robber of the kingdom. But it quickly becomes clear that the brisk princess is ready to turn Buka's life into a nightmare, just to reach her goal. So the restless Varvara begins to establish her own order in the forest.
documents.plot:
My Sweet Monster (Russian: Бука. Моё любимое чудище) is a 2021 Russian animated musical fantasy directed by Viktor Glukhushin and Maksim Volkov and produced by the CTB Film Company. The English-language version distributed in the United States by Lionsgate features the voices of Haylie Duff, Jon Heder and Pauly Shore.

Barbara is a young princess who longs to marry a prince, but her father, King Elijah, dismisses her romantic dreams. The scheming postman Bundy Joyce, who delivers her a love letter from a Prince Edward, blackmails the king into forcing Barbara to marry him instead. On her birthday the princess escapes from the palace and runs into the forest, where she is captured by Bogey, a gruff monster, and his companion, a rabbit, who take her back to their hideout.

Barbara gradually wins over her captors and persuades them to escort her to Edward's palace. On the journey Bogey teaches her about Mother Nature, the source of all life in the forest, and the rabbit explains that Bogey was once a human who got lost in the woods and was saved by a magic fountain, which turned him into a monster and made him the forest's protector. Meanwhile, Elijah reveals to Joyce that years earlier he took a life-giving liquid called the Spark from the same fountain to cure Barbara of an illness. Joyce builds Spark-powered robots to hunt down Bogey and sets out to find the fountain for himself.

At Edward's palace Barbara discovers that the prince she dreamed of does not exist, and Bogey comes to her rescue. Joyce's robots then capture the three friends at the fountain, and he drains its magic. Elijah arrives to disable the robots, but Joyce drinks the Spark, turns into a monstrous figure and is swallowed by a whirlwind that empties the fountain. With the magic gone, Barbara and the rabbit begin to fail, and Elijah sadly admits that he once built her a new heart. Bogey calls on Mother Nature to save them and gives up his own life to do so. Later, as Barbara grieves beside the fountain, its waters return and Bogey is restored in his original human form.

The film was released theatrically in Russia in 2022. Common Sense Media found the songs acceptable and the story somewhat complicated, calling the result standard fare with a decent but abrupt fairy-tale ending.

documents.title: Tenet
documents.overview: Armed with only one word - Tenet - and fighting for the survival of the entire world, the Protagonist journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a mission that will unfold in something beyond real time.
documents.plot:
Tenet is a 2020 spy thriller film directed by Christopher Nolan, produced by Emma Thomas and Cale Boyter, and written by Nolan.

The story follows a secret agent known as "The Protagonist" (played by John David Washington), who works for a top-secret organization. The Protagonist is tasked with preventing a global catastrophe caused by an enemy known as Andrei Sator (played by Kenneth Branagh).

The plot begins with The Protagonist, a former soldier, being recruited by his old friend Neil (played by Robert Pattinson), who works for the same organization. They are sent to meet with Neil's boss, Barbara (played by Clémence Poésy), who briefs them on their mission.

Their target is Andrei Sator, a wealthy and influential businessman who has developed a technology that allows him to invert the flow of time. This means that objects and people can move backwards through time, while the rest of the world moves forward. Sator plans to use this technology to create a global economic collapse by manipulating financial markets.

The Protagonist and Neil are sent to infiltrate Sator's operation in Russia, where they meet with his daughter Kat (played by Dimple Kapadia). They soon discover that Sator is using the inverted time technology to create a "temporal loop," which allows him to relive the same few minutes over and over again.

As The Protagonist delves deeper into Sator's operation, he realizes that the only way to stop him is to use the same technology against him. However, this requires him to invert his own time flow, which puts him at risk of becoming trapped in a temporal loop.

The plot thickens as The Protagonist and Neil encounter other characters who are also trying to prevent Sator's plan. These include Kat, who is torn between her loyalty to her father and her growing feelings for The Protagonist; and Andrei's henchman, Kirill (played by Michael Caine), who is determined to protect his employer at all costs.

As the story unfolds, Nolan employs his signature non-linear storytelling style, jumping back and forth in time and blurring the lines between reality and fantasy. The film's climax features a thrilling sequence of events as The Protagonist and Neil use their knowledge of Sator's technology to outmaneuver him and prevent the catastrophic event.

Throughout the film, Nolan explores themes of time, memory, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control. The Protagonist is a complex character, driven by a sense of duty and loyalty, but also struggling with his own identity and purpose.

Ultimately, Tenet is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that challenges viewers to keep up with its complex plot twists and turns. While it may be confusing at times, the payoff is well worth the effort, as Nolan delivers another masterclass in cinematic storytelling.

documents.title: Those Who Wish Me Dead
documents.overview: A young boy finds himself pursued by two assassins in the Montana wilderness, with a survival expert determined to protect him, and a forest fire threatening to consume them all.
documents.plot:
Those Who Wish Me Dead is a 2021 American thriller film directed by Taylor Sheridan and starring Angelina Jolie, Aidan Gillen, and Nicholas Hoult. The movie follows the story of Hannah Faber, a smokejumper who lives off the grid with her son, Connor.

The plot begins with Hannah's life being turned upside down when she is forced to leave her isolated home in Montana after her estranged husband, Connor's father, dies under mysterious circumstances. As they try to rebuild their lives, they are pursued by a group of ruthless mercenaries who will stop at nothing to get what they want.

The mercenaries, led by the cunning and deadly Victor (Aidan Gillen), have been hired by a wealthy client to capture Hannah and her son. The stakes are raised when Connor is kidnapped, and Hannah must use her skills as a smokejumper to track down the kidnappers and rescue her son.

As Hannah navigates the treacherous terrain of the Montana wilderness, she faces numerous challenges, including harsh weather conditions, treacherous terrain, and the mercenaries who will stop at nothing to capture her. Along the way, she meets Matt (Nicholas Hoult), a young boy who has also been kidnapped by the mercenaries.

As Hannah and Matt form an unlikely bond, they work together to evade their captors and find a way to escape. Meanwhile, Victor's true intentions are revealed, and Hannah must confront her own demons in order to save herself and her son.

Throughout the movie, Sheridan explores themes of motherhood, survival, and redemption. Hannah is a complex character who has been forced to grow up too quickly due to her circumstances. Her relationship with Connor is particularly poignant, as she struggles to balance her desire to protect him with her need for independence.

The action sequences in the film are intense and suspenseful, with Sheridan using the stunning natural beauty of Montana to create a sense of unease and tension. The cinematography is breathtaking, capturing the vast expanses of wilderness and the tiny moments of intimacy between Hannah and Connor.

Ultimately, Those Who Wish Me Dead is a gripping thriller that explores the complexities of human relationships and the resilience of the human spirit. With its stunning visuals, pulse-pounding action sequences, and powerful performances from its cast, this movie is sure to keep audiences on the edge of their seats until the very end.

documents.title: Bad Trip
documents.overview: Two pals embark on a road trip full of funny pranks that pull real people into mayhem.
documents.plot:
Bad Trip is a 2021 American comedy film directed by Kay Cannon and written by Cannon and Will Arnett. The movie follows the story of two friends, Nomi (Lil Rel Howery) and Jake (Will Arnett), who embark on a road trip from New York to Los Angeles.

The journey begins with Nomi, a struggling comedian, and his friend Jake, a wealthy businessman, setting out on their adventure. However, things take a turn for the worse when they pick up a hitchhiker named Amy (Anna Kendrick) in North Carolina. As they continue driving, Amy's eccentric behavior and constant complaining start to wear down Nomi and Jake.

Despite their initial reservations, the trio decides to continue their trip together, leading to a series of misadventures and hilarious encounters along the way. From run-ins with eccentric locals to bizarre roadside attractions, the group faces numerous challenges that test their friendship and sanity.

As they travel through various states, including Tennessee, Kentucky, and Arkansas, Nomi and Jake begin to realize that Amy's behavior is not just annoying but also potentially threatening. They start to suspect that she may be involved in some shady dealings, which puts them in harm's way.

Throughout the journey, the characters' personalities are on full display. Nomi is a lovable but awkward comedian who often finds himself in uncomfortable situations. Jake is a wealthy and arrogant businessman who struggles with humility. Amy, on the other hand, is a complex and mysterious character whose true intentions remain unclear until the very end.

As the trip progresses, the group faces numerous obstacles, including a run-in with a group of rough-riding bikers, a disastrous visit to a roadside attraction, and a tense confrontation with a suspicious stranger. Despite these challenges, Nomi and Jake continue to support each other, even as they begin to question their decision to pick up Amy.

In the end, the trio reaches Los Angeles, but not before facing one final test of their friendship. As they reflect on their journey, they realize that they have learned valuable lessons about trust, loyalty, and the importance of having a good sense of humor.

Overall, Bad Trip is a hilarious and entertaining comedy that explores themes of friendship, trust, and the power of laughter in the face of adversity. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and outrageous situations, this movie is sure to leave audiences laughing and entertained from start to finish.

documents.title: Reminiscence
documents.overview: Nicolas Bannister, a rugged and solitary veteran living in a near-future Miami flooded by rising seas, is an expert in a dangerous occupation: he offers clients the chance to relive any memory they desire. His life changes when he meets a mysterious young woman named Mae. What begins as a simple matter of lost and found becomes a passionate love affair. But when a different client's memories implicate Mae in a series of violent crimes, Bannister must delve through the dark world of the past to uncover the truth about the woman he fell for.
documents.plot:
Reminiscence is a 2021 science fiction film directed by Lisa Joy and written by Joy and Nathaniel Malathat. The movie stars Hugh Jackman, Rebecca Ferguson, and Cliff Curtis.

The main themes of Reminiscence revolve around the concept of memory, identity, and humanity in a world where virtual reality (VR) has become indistinguishable from reality. The story follows Nick Bannion (Hugh Jackman), a "memory detective" who uses VR to experience and manipulate memories for his clients.

One of the primary themes is the exploration of what it means to be human in a world where technology can alter or even replace our experiences. As Nick delves deeper into the mysteries of memory, he begins to question the nature of reality and his own identity. The film raises questions about the consequences of relying on technology to manipulate and control memories, and whether this can lead to a loss of authenticity and connection with others.

Another significant theme is the power dynamics at play in relationships, particularly between Nick and his partner, Dr. Lydia Mercer (Rebecca Ferguson). Their relationship is complex and multifaceted, with both characters struggling to navigate their own desires, needs, and boundaries. The film explores the tension between control and surrender, as well as the blurred lines between love and obsession.

The movie also touches on the idea of nostalgia and the human desire to hold onto memories, even if they are painful or traumatic. Nick's work as a memory detective allows him to experience and manipulate memories, but it also forces him to confront his own past and the traumas he has experienced.

Ultimately, Reminiscence is a thought-provoking exploration of what it means to be human in a world where technology is rapidly changing our experiences and relationships. The film raises important questions about identity, memory, and connection, leaving the audience to ponder the implications of these themes long after the credits roll.

documents.title: Silk Road
documents.tagline: A mastermind is a terrible thing to waste.
documents.overview: Philosophical twenty-something Ross Ulbricht creates Silk Road, a dark net website that sells drugs, while DEA agent Rick Bowden goes undercover to bring him down.
documents.plot:
Silk Road is a 2021 American biographical crime drama film directed by Tiller Russell. The movie revolves around Ross Ulbricht, a charismatic and intelligent individual who creates an anonymous online marketplace called the Silk Road.

The main theme of Silk Road is the allure and dangers of anonymity in the digital age. The film explores how Ulbricht's creation of the Silk Road allowed him to build a vast and secretive network of users, all while maintaining his own anonymity. This theme raises questions about the nature of identity, accountability, and the consequences of one's actions when they are hidden behind a veil of secrecy.

The movie also delves into the world of cryptocurrency and the dark web, highlighting the ease with which illicit activities can be conducted online. However, it also touches on the human cost of these activities, particularly for those who become entangled in Ulbricht's empire, including his own followers and users.

Furthermore, Silk Road examines the tension between individual freedom and societal responsibility. Ulbricht's character is portrayed as a complex figure, driven by both altruistic and self-serving motivations. His actions spark a moral debate about whether one should prioritize personal liberty or adhere to the law, even if it means sacrificing anonymity.

Ultimately, the film presents a thought-provoking exploration of the intersection of technology, morality, and human nature, leaving viewers to ponder the implications of Ulbricht's creation and its lasting impact on our digital landscape.

documents.title: Call Jane
documents.overview: A married woman with an unwanted pregnancy lives in a time in America where she can't get a legal abortion and works with a group of suburban women to find help.
documents.plot:
Call Jane is a 2022 American drama film directed by Martha Fiato and written by Lizzie Molyneux and Wendy Kopp. The movie is based on the true story of Karen Silkwood, an American labor union activist who fought for workers' rights in the early 1970s.

The main theme of Call Jane revolves around the struggle for women's reproductive rights and the fight against patriarchal oppression. The film explores the complexities of a woman's body and her autonomy over it, as well as the societal expectations placed upon her. Through Karen Silkwood's character, the movie sheds light on the injustices faced by working-class women who were denied basic human rights, including access to safe and affordable abortion.

The film also delves into the theme of female solidarity and the power of collective action. Karen forms a bond with her coworkers, who become her support system in the face of adversity. Together, they navigate the challenges of their jobs, personal lives, and the restrictive laws that govern their bodies.

Furthermore, Call Jane touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery. As Karen navigates her relationships and career, she must also confront her own desires and aspirations. The film suggests that women's identities are shaped by societal expectations, but it also implies that individuals have the power to redefine themselves and challenge the status quo.

Overall, Call Jane is a powerful exploration of the human experience, highlighting the struggles and triumphs of women fighting for their rights and autonomy in a patriarchal society.

documents.title: Santa's Little Helpers
documents.overview: The Minions, having been accidently dropped off at the North Pole, make the most of the situation by trying to become elves.
documents.plot:
Santa's Little Helpers is a 2019 American computer-animated Christmas comedy short film produced by Illumination and starring the Minions of the Despicable Me franchise. Running about four minutes, it was directed by Derek Drymon and Bruno Chauffard, with a story by David Feiss and a screenplay by Brett Kramer and Josh Lieb. Conceived as a "mini-movie" bonus feature, it debuted with the home-entertainment release of Illumination's 2018 feature The Grinch, appearing first with the digital release in January 2019 and then on the 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray and DVD editions in February 2019. It follows the earlier Minions mini-movie Yellow Is the New Black and precedes Minion Scouts. Pierre Coffin voices the Minions, among them Kevin, Stuart and Bob, with Carlos Alazraqui as Santa Claus, Raymond S. Persi as the Head Elf, Tara Strong as a baby reindeer and Brian T. Delaney as an adult reindeer, several of the cast also voicing elves.

Kevin, Stuart and Bob have been mailed off to Miami, but they are accidentally dropped at the North Pole instead. Spotting a light in the snow, they discover Santa's Workshop, and since it has always been their dream to meet Santa and help deliver his presents, they make the most of the situation by trying to become elves. They are not very good at it. On the toy assembly line they produce a hybrid teddy bear and train, so they are moved to gingerbread house duty. Kevin builds a beautiful gingerbread house, only for Stuart to wreck it with his gingerbread crane, while Bob manages to get himself stuck inside his own creation and Stuart starts eating the house as Kevin tries to free him. The exasperated Head Elf banishes the trio to the reindeer stables. There Bob spots a baby reindeer apparently caught in a fence post and opens the gate to help, but it is a ruse to free the reindeer from their stalls, and before long the Minions have left the whole workshop in ruins. When Santa arrives, the Minions accidentally take off with his sleigh. The short ends with the three singing a Minionese version of "Jingle Bells" over a series of photos, one of which shows them delivering presents to Who-ville, the village from The Grinch.

The short gained a wider audience on 27 November 2020, when it was broadcast on NBC as one of four mini-movies in the Minions Holiday Special, Illumination's first television special, alongside Puppy, Training Wheels and Minion Scouts.

documents.title: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop
documents.original_title: サイダーのように言葉が湧き上がる
documents.overview: After meeting one day, a shy boy who expresses himself through haiku and a bubbly but self-conscious girl share a brief, magical summer.
documents.plot:
Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop (Japanese: Saidā no Yō ni Kotoba ga Wakiagaru) is a Japanese animated romantic comedy-drama directed by Kyōhei Ishiguro and produced by Sublimation and Signal.MD. Ichikawa Somegorō VIII voices the shy haiku poet Cherry and Hana Sugisaki the masked influencer Smile, with Megumi Han, Koichi Yamadera and Kikuko Inoue. After premiering at the 2020 Shanghai International Film Festival, it was released in Japanese cinemas and on Netflix worldwide on July 22, 2021.

The story takes place over one summer in a provincial town dominated by a large shopping mall, the Oda Nouvelle. Yui Sakura, nicknamed Cherry, is a withdrawn boy who wears headphones to shut out the world and expresses his feelings only through haiku, which he posts online but cannot bring himself to read aloud. He is spending his holiday working at an elderly day care centre in the mall. Smile, a cheerful girl who posts videos online, always wears a face mask to hide her prominent front teeth, which she is self-conscious about.

During a chaotic chase between mall security and a young graffiti artist, Beaver, Cherry and Smile accidentally swap phones. After sorting out the mix-up, they begin to follow each other online and to meet in person, sharing their interests. Smile starts helping at the care centre, where the residents are rehearsing a folk dance for the mall's summer festival. One of them, Fujiyama, a former record shop owner, longs to hear an old record called "Yamazakura" one last time, though he has only its sleeve; the recording was made by his late wife.

With the help of friends from the mall, Cherry and Smile search Fujiyama's old shop and finally find the record hidden behind a refrigerator, warped by the heat. Smile invites Cherry to watch the festival fireworks with her, but the record shatters when she tries to flatten it. Then Cherry learns that his family is moving away on the day of the festival, and the two part awkwardly.

On the day of the festival, Smile discovers a playable copy of the record turned into a clock at the care centre and plans to play it during the performance. Driving past the mall, Cherry sees one of his haiku about Smile spray-painted on signs by Beaver, and rushes back to declare his love in verse in front of the crowd. As the fireworks begin, Smile removes her mask and smiles.

Critics praised its pop-art visuals and music, and it was nominated for the Mainichi Film Award for Best Animation Film.

documents.title: The Superdeep
documents.overview: In 1984, a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.
documents.plot:
The Superdeep (Russian: Kol'skaya sverkhglubokaya) is a 2020 Russian horror film directed by Arseny Syuhin, inspired by the real Kola Superdeep Borehole, the deep scientific drilling project on the Kola Peninsula in the Soviet Arctic. Set in the Soviet Union in 1984, it follows a small team of researchers and soldiers sent to investigate a mysterious outbreak at a secret laboratory built kilometers beneath the Arctic surface.

Anna Fedorova, a Soviet epidemiologist, is haunted by the death of a colleague who tested an experimental vaccine on himself after she agreed to skip safety trials to meet state deadlines. On New Year's Eve, she is summoned by Colonel Morozov of military intelligence for a clandestine mission to the Kola borehole near Murmansk. Officially a drilling site, it secretly houses an underground laboratory where strange sounds were recorded deep below the surface, after which twenty people went missing. Anna's task is to collect samples from a suspected disease outbreak concealed by the site's director, Dr. Grigoriev.

Accompanied by a squad of soldiers led by Major Mikheev, Anna arrives at the frozen facility, where a man in a lab coat survives several gunshots before killing himself with a grenade. Evacuating staff warn that the lower levels are hell. Descending into the facility, the team discovers that a parasitic fungal organism has been infecting the workers, mutating their bodies and fusing them into monstrous forms. As the team searches for survivors and pursues Grigoriev, they face the organism's growing threat and Anna realizes that the infection must never be allowed to reach the surface.

The film draws on the legends surrounding the Kola borehole and combines Cold War paranoia with body horror reminiscent of science fiction classics about isolated research stations.

The Superdeep was released in 2020 and received mixed to negative reviews, holding 29 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, with an average rating of 4.1 out of 10. Its premise draws on popular myths about sounds recorded at the bottom of the real borehole.

documents.title: The Last Frontier
documents.overview: The story of the Podolsk cadets’ heroic stand outside Moscow in October 1941. Cadets were sent to the Ilyinsky line, fighting alongside units from the Soviet 43rd Army to hold back the German advance until reinforcements arrived. Hopelessly outnumbered, young men laid down their lives in a battle lasting almost two weeks to obstruct the far superior German forces advancing towards Moscow. Around 3,500 cadets and their commanding officers were sent to hold up the last line of defense outside Moscow. Most of them remained there for eternity.
documents.plot:
The Last Frontier, also released as The Final Stand (Russian: Podolskie kursanty, literally "Podolsk Cadets"), is a 2020 Russian Second World War film directed by Vadim Shmelyov, who co-wrote the screenplay with Igor Ugolnikov, Viacheslav Fetisov and Vadim Zadorozhny. It dramatizes the stand of the Podolsk military school cadets during the Battle of Moscow in October 1941. The cast includes Aleksey Bardukov as Lieutenant Afanasy Aleshkin, Sergei Bezrukov as Captain Ivan Starchak, Evgeniy Dyatlov, Lyubov Konstantinova, Artem Gubin and Ekaterina Rednikova.

The film opens with a lengthy portrait of life at the artillery and infantry schools in Podolsk, following the officer cadets from field exercises to the barracks as they form friendships and court young women; two close friends are rivals for the affections of the same girl. In October 1941, with the cadets on the verge of completing their training and receiving their commissions, the Wehrmacht breaks through the front and a German tank column advances on Moscow. Regular army units are stretched too thin to stop it, and the cadets, many of them still boys, are abruptly ordered to the Ilyinsky defensive line, their senior officer reminding them that their fathers and brothers are already dying to hold back the enemy.

At the front, the cadets become the main barrier between the Germans and the capital. In long and brutal battles against overwhelming forces, the inexperienced recruits quickly lose their naivety and learn the realities of war at great personal cost. Holding their ground, they sacrifice their lives to fulfill their mission and buy precious days for reinforcements to arrive.

The film was shot from August to November 2018 at the VoenFilm complex in Medyn, where a village, pillboxes, a river and a stretch of the Warsaw Highway were built, with historical consultants recreating details down to the numbers of tanks and aircraft; Bezrukov's character carries a Thompson submachine gun because one was found in excavations at the Ilyinsky line. It had a budget of 450 million rubles, including 60 million from the Ministry of Culture, and received support from the Ministry of Defense and other state bodies. Central Partnership released it in Russia on November 4, 2020. Russian media reviews were generally positive, while KinoKultura's Ian Garner found it competently made and well acted but a repetition of familiar patriotic war-film tropes.

documents.title: RRR
documents.overview: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.
documents.plot:
RRR is a 2022 Indian Telugu-language action drama film directed by S.S. Rajamouli, produced by D. V. Prabhas and S. S. Rajamouli under the banner of Mythri Movie Makers and Lyca Productions.

The film is set in the late 19th century during the Indian Rebellion of 1857 against British rule. The story revolves around three main characters: Komaram Bheem (played by N.T. Rama Rao Jr.), a young Telugu warrior who joins the rebellion; Alluri Sitarama Raju (played by Ram Charan), a young boy from a poor family who becomes a skilled archer and joins the rebellion; and Malli (played by Alia Bhatt), a British woman who is forced to marry into a wealthy family but eventually joins the rebellion.

The film begins with Komaram Bheem, who is a fierce warrior, fighting against the British in the forests of Telangana. He meets Alluri Sitarama Raju, who is on his way to join the rebellion. The two men become friends and allies, and together they embark on a journey to unite the various Indian kingdoms against the British.

As the story unfolds, we see the struggles faced by the Indian people under British rule, including poverty, oppression, and lack of freedom. We also see the bravery and sacrifice of the rebels, who risk their lives to fight for their country's independence.

Throughout the film, there are several action-packed sequences, including a memorable battle scene where Komaram Bheem fights against the British army. The film also explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and sacrifice, as the three main characters put everything on the line to fight for their cause.

The film features stunning visuals, with impressive cinematography and production design that brings the Indian Rebellion of 1857 to life. The music by M.M. Keeravani is also noteworthy, with several memorable songs that add to the film's emotional impact.

Overall, RRR is a powerful and inspiring film that tells an important story about India's struggle for independence. With its strong performances, impressive action sequences, and stunning visuals, it is a must-watch for anyone interested in Indian history or action-packed dramas.

documents.title: Another Round
documents.overview: Four high school teachers launch a drinking experiment: upholding a constant low level of intoxication.
documents.plot:
Another Round is a 2020 Danish drama film directed by Thomas Vinterberg, not Zentropa Entertainments. The movie premiered at the Sundance Film Festival and received critical acclaim.

The story revolves around Martin (played by Mads Mikkelsen), a high school teacher in his mid-40s who has been feeling unfulfilled and disconnected from his life. He is married to his wife, Anja (played by Léa Seydoux), and they have two children together. However, their marriage seems to be going through the motions, and Martin feels like he's lost touch with his own desires and passions.

One day, while chatting with his colleagues at school, Martin mentions that he used to drink beer with his friends during his university days, but stopped doing so after becoming a father. This conversation sparks an idea in him - what if he were to re-examine his life by drinking beer with his students? He proposes the idea to his colleague, Thomas (played by Magnus Millien), and they decide to embark on a journey of moderate drinking with their students.

The group consists of Martin, Thomas, and two other teachers, Rasmus (played by Lars Ranthe) and Emil (played by Mathias Boe). They start meeting once a week, sharing beer and discussing life, philosophy, and the human condition. As they drink, they begin to open up about their personal struggles, fears, and desires.

Throughout the film, Martin's relationships with his family and colleagues undergo significant changes. He starts to reconnect with his wife and children, who are initially hesitant about his new behavior. Meanwhile, Thomas becomes increasingly dependent on the group's drinking sessions, which start to take a toll on his health.

As the story unfolds, Martin begins to realize that he has been living in a state of emotional numbness for years. He starts to confront his own mortality and the impermanence of life. The film takes a poignant turn when Thomas passes away suddenly, leaving the group reeling with grief.

The movie's climax is both heartbreaking and thought-provoking. Martin comes to terms with the loss of his friend and reflects on the impact that their drinking sessions had on him. He realizes that it was through these conversations that he found a sense of purpose and connection with others.

Another Round is a powerful exploration of midlife crises, friendship, and the human need for meaning and connection. The film features outstanding performances from its cast, particularly Mads Mikkelsen, who brings depth and nuance to his portrayal of Martin.

documents.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
documents.overview: After finding a host body in investigative reporter Eddie Brock, the alien symbiote must face a new enemy, Carnage, the alter ego of serial killer Cletus Kasady.
documents.plot:
Venom: Let There Be Carnage is a 2021 American superhero film directed by Andy Serkis, based on the Marvel Comics character Venom. The movie stars Tom Hardy as Eddie Brock/Venom and Woody Harrelson as Cletus Kasady/Carnage.

The story takes place after the events of the first Venom film. Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy) is still struggling with his dual identity as a journalist and a symbiote host, while also dealing with the aftermath of his last encounter with Carnage. Meanwhile, Cletus Kasady (Woody Harrelson), a serial killer who was once a patient at a psychiatric hospital, has escaped from prison and is now on the run.

As Eddie tries to balance his life as Venom, he receives a distress call from the Department of Homeland Security, which informs him that Carnage has been spotted in New York City. Believing that Carnage's presence poses a threat to humanity, Eddie sets out to track down the villainous symbiote and put an end to its destructive plans.

However, things take a complicated turn when Eddie discovers that Cletus Kasady is actually the host of Carnage, a more aggressive and violent version of the Venom symbiote. As the two symbiotes begin to interact with each other, they start to develop their own twisted bond, leading to a series of intense battles between them.

Throughout the film, Eddie struggles to maintain control over his dual identity as he navigates his complicated relationship with Carnage. Meanwhile, Cletus Kasady's backstory is slowly revealed, showcasing his troubled past and the events that led him to become the host of Carnage.

The movie features plenty of action-packed sequences, including a thrilling chase scene through New York City and an intense showdown between Venom and Carnage in a abandoned warehouse. The film also explores themes of identity, morality, and the blurred lines between good and evil.

Overall, Venom: Let There Be Carnage is a dark and entertaining sequel that expands on the complex characters and storylines introduced in the first film. With its impressive visual effects, witty dialogue, and intense action sequences, this movie is sure to delight fans of the Marvel universe.

documents.title: Crisis
documents.overview: Three stories about the world of opioids collide: a drug trafficker arranges a multi-cartel Fentanyl smuggling operation between Canada and the U.S., an architect recovering from an OxyContin addiction tracks down the truth behind her son's involvement with narcotics, and a university professor battles unexpected revelations about his research employer, a drug company with deep government influence bringing a new "non-addictive" painkiller to market.
documents.plot:
Crisis is a 2021 crime thriller written, produced and directed by Nicholas Jarecki. Its ensemble cast includes Gary Oldman as university scientist Dr. Tyrone Brower, Armie Hammer as undercover DEA agent Jake Kelly and Evangeline Lilly as architect Claire Reimann, with Greg Kinnear, Michelle Rodriguez, Luke Evans, Lily-Rose Depp, Kid Cudi and Martin Donovan. Through three interwoven storylines, the film examines the opioid epidemic from the perspectives of the pharmaceutical industry, drug traffickers and the families of victims.

Dr. Tyrone Brower, a respected researcher at Everett University, is commissioned by Northlight Pharmaceuticals to study its new drug Klaralon, marketed as the first non-addictive painkiller. His research reveals that after a week of use the drug becomes far more addictive than oxycodone. When he urges the company to delay the release, Northlight tries to buy his silence with a generous grant, and when he refuses, the company and the university, which depends on Northlight's donations, begin to destroy his reputation. Brower decides to take his findings to federal regulators.

Meanwhile, in Detroit, Jake Kelly has spent months infiltrating two fentanyl trafficking networks: an Armenian organization running pill mills across the United States and a Montreal-based operation controlled by a kingpin known as Mother. He hopes to bring them together in a deal that will allow the authorities to take them all down, driven by a personal stake: his younger sister is struggling with heroin addiction. At the same time, Claire Reimann, a recovering oxycodone addict, is devastated when her teenage son David dies of a fentanyl overdose. Convinced that he never used drugs, she discovers that he was murdered for his involvement with a smuggling ring that used young hockey players as couriers. Her search for answers takes her across the border to Montreal and onto a collision course with Kelly's operation.

The film criticizes the collusion between corporations, academia and regulators that helped fuel the opioid crisis, using a multi-strand structure to show its reach.

Crisis was released in the United States by Quiver Distribution on February 26, 2021, and was the top independent film at the box office in its opening weekend. It received mixed reviews, with 66 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 41.

documents.title: News of the World
documents.overview: A Texan traveling across the wild West bringing the news of the world to local townspeople, agrees to help rescue a young girl who was kidnapped.
documents.plot:
News of the World is a 2020 American Western drama film directed by Paul Greengrass and written by Bong Joon-ho and Peter Craig, based on the 2016 novel "News of the World" by Paulette Jiles.

The main themes of News of the World include:

1. **Redemption and Personal Growth**: The protagonist, Captain Jefferson Kyle Kidd (played by Tom Hanks), is a traveling news reader who has lost his way after the death of his wife. Through his journey with the young girl, Johanna (played by Scarlett Johansson), he finds redemption and learns to care for someone other than himself.

2. **Loneliness and Human Connection**: The film highlights the importance of human connection in overcoming loneliness. Captain Kidd's relationship with Johanna helps him to confront his past and find a new sense of purpose.

3. **Racism and Prejudice**: Set against the backdrop of post-Civil War America, News of the World explores themes of racism and prejudice. The film critiques the treatment of Native Americans by white settlers and highlights the injustices faced by indigenous communities.

4. **Empowerment and Independence**: Johanna's journey from being a captive to becoming an independent individual is a powerful symbol of empowerment. Her growth serves as a catalyst for Captain Kidd's transformation, illustrating that personal growth often requires letting go of past traumas.

5. **The Power of Storytelling**: News of the World celebrates the power of storytelling and its ability to bring people together. Through his news readings, Captain Kidd connects with communities and shares their stories, fostering understanding and empathy.

Overall, News of the World is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes through its engaging narrative and memorable characters.

documents.title: Ashfall
documents.tagline: Only one chance to save the nation.
documents.overview: A group of unlikely heroes from across the Korean peninsula try to save the day after a volcano erupts on the mythical and majestic Baekdu Mountain.
documents.plot:
Ashfall (Korean: 백두산; Baekdusan), also known as Mount Paektu, is a 2019 South Korean disaster film directed by Lee Hae-jun and Kim Byung-seo. It stars Lee Byung-hun, Ha Jung-woo, Ma Dong-seok, Jeon Hye-jin and Bae Suzy, and imagines the catastrophic eruption of the volcano on the border between China and North Korea.

When Paektu Mountain suddenly erupts, powerful earthquakes devastate both North and South Korea, and more eruptions are predicted. To prevent a final, even greater disaster, Jeon Yoo-kyung organizes an operation based on the theory of Professor Kang Bong-rae, who has long studied the volcano: detonating a nuclear bomb in a mine near the mountain to release the pressure building beneath it. Captain Jo In-chang is put in charge of a special forces team, leaving his pregnant wife, Choi Ji-young, to fend for herself in a ravaged Seoul. After their plane malfunctions and they parachute into the North, the team frees Lee Joon-pyeong, a spy within the North Korean army now held in prison, whose knowledge is needed to find the right mine.

Joon-pyeong, who wants to reach his daughter, leads them to a power station, where they extract uranium from a nuclear missile, drawing the attention of the American military and of Chinese gangsters to whom he has promised the material. In the South, Ji-young survives a tsunami and, with Professor Kang, stays behind to help when the evacuees cannot board a ship to the United States; Yoo-kyung steals military documents from the American-controlled base so they can stay in contact with In-chang. In the North, In-chang and Joon-pyeong reach the town of Bocheon, where Joon-pyeong finds his frightened daughter, Soon-ok. As another eruption scatters the gangsters and the Americans, Kang tells In-chang where the final eruption will occur. Joon-pyeong carries the bomb deep into the mine, sacrificing himself, while In-chang escapes with Soon-ok. The explosion stops the earthquakes, saving countless lives. A year later, the two Koreas jointly oversee reconstruction, and In-chang and Ji-young raise their newborn son alongside Soon-ok.

The film was released in South Korea on 19 December 2019 and in the United States the next day. It passed two million admissions in four days, ultimately grossing about $61.3 million against a budget of about $17.7 million, and received a 73% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: Space Sweepers
documents.overview: When the crew of a space junk collector ship called The Victory discovers a humanoid robot named Dorothy that's known to be a weapon of mass destruction, they get involved in a risky business deal which puts their lives at stake.
documents.plot:
Space Sweepers is a 2021 South Korean science fiction film directed by Jo Sung-hee and produced by Bidangil Pictures, CJ Entertainment, and Studio Dragon. The movie takes place in a dystopian future where humanity has colonized other planets.

The story follows Jang Geu-rin (played by Song Joong-ki), a former space junk collector who now works as a scavenger on the outskirts of Seoul. He lives with his daughter, Ji-an (played by Kim Ji-won), and her mother, who passed away due to an illness caused by pollution in the city.

One day, Geu-rin receives a message from an old friend, Captain Jang Do-won (played by Ma Dong-seok), who is now working for a private space company called "Space Sweepers." The company's mission is to clean up space debris and sell it for profit. However, the company's true intentions are shrouded in mystery.

Geu-rin joins his friend on a mission to collect a valuable piece of space junk, which turns out to be a spaceship carrying a young girl named Ji-an (played by Kim Ji-won). The girl is revealed to be an alien who was sent to Earth as a child and has been living with Geu-rin's daughter.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the Space Sweepers company is involved in a sinister plot to exploit the alien's advanced technology for their own gain. Geu-rin and his friend must navigate through treacherous space terrain and fight against rival treasure hunters to protect Ji-an and uncover the truth about her past.

Throughout the movie, the characters face numerous challenges and obstacles as they try to survive in a harsh environment. The film features stunning visual effects, heart-pumping action sequences, and emotional character development.

Ultimately, Geu-rin and his friend succeed in their mission, but not without sacrifices. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Ji-an finally finding her place in the world and Geu-rin coming to terms with his past and his role as a father figure to her.

Overall, Space Sweepers is a thrilling and emotionally resonant sci-fi film that explores themes of family, loyalty, and redemption. With its talented cast, stunning visuals, and engaging storyline, it's no wonder this movie has become a fan favorite among science fiction enthusiasts.

documents.title: Peninsula
documents.overview: A soldier and his team battle hordes of post-apocalyptic zombies in the wastelands of the Korean Peninsula.
documents.plot:
Peninsula (Korean: Bando), marketed internationally as Train to Busan Presents: Peninsula, is a 2020 South Korean post-apocalyptic action horror film co-written and directed by Yeon Sang-ho, a standalone sequel to his 2016 hit Train to Busan. It stars Gang Dong-won as Han Jung-seok, a former Marine officer haunted by guilt, Lee Jung-hyun as Min-jung, Kwon Hae-hyo as her father Elder Kim, and Kim Min-jae as Sergeant Hwang, the sadistic leader of a rogue militia.

As a zombie outbreak overwhelms South Korea and the country is placed under quarantine, Jung-seok escapes aboard an evacuation ship with his sister, her husband Chul-min and their young son. During the escape he refuses to help a desperate family after noticing that the father is bleeding. When an infected passenger turns aboard the ship, his sister and nephew are bitten, and Jung-seok seals them in their cabin.

Four years later, Jung-seok and Chul-min are living as refugees in Hong Kong when a gang of mobsters recruits them for a mission back to the abandoned peninsula: to retrieve a truck containing twenty million dollars, in exchange for half the money. They find the truck, but the noise draws a horde of zombies, and the team is ambushed by Unit 631, a degenerate militia that stages survival games pitting captives against the undead. Chul-min is captured, while Jung-seok is rescued by two young sisters, Joon-yi and Yu-jin, who live in hiding with their mother Min-jung and grandfather Elder Kim. Jung-seok realizes that Min-jung is the woman he abandoned four years earlier.
