The film is known for its elaborate set pieces, including a chaotic chase and shootout in the traffic around the Arc de Triomphe, and for its themes of loyalty, friendship and the cost of freedom.

John Wick: Chapter 4 premiered in London on March 6, 2023, and was released in the United States on March 24, shortly after Reddick's death. It grossed 447 million dollars worldwide, the highest of the series, and received critical acclaim, with 94 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 78.

documents.title: Super Me
documents.overview: Sang Yu is so exhausted from trying to stay awake. Every time he closes his eyes, a demon chases and kills him in his dreams. One night Sang realizes he has a special power: he can bring treasures from his dreams into reality. Almost overnight, he becomes a rich man. But his wealth also attracts the attention of a ruthless gangster.
documents.plot:
Super Me (Chinese: 超级的我) is a 2019 Chinese fantasy film that mixes action, comedy, romance and drama, written and directed by Zhang Chong as his second feature after The Fourth Wall. It was released in Chinese cinemas in April 2021 and picked up by Netflix, which began streaming it internationally on 8 May 2021. The project was originally to be produced by Anthony and Joe Russo through their Chinese venture Anthem Pictures, but the brothers withdrew and the film was ultimately made by the Shanghai companies Hehe Pictures and Black Ant Entertainment.

Taiwanese actor Darren Wang plays Sang Yu, a struggling, impoverished screenwriter whose scripts have never been filmed. Crippled by writer's block and months of insomnia, he cannot deliver the screenplay demanded by his producer San Ge (Cao Bingkun), and every time he does fall asleep a demonic blue creature hunts him down and kills him in his dreams. After losing his apartment and ending up on the streets, Sang reaches the point of attempting suicide, but a street pancake vendor stops him and advises him to remind himself, during his next nightmare, that he is only dreaming so that he can wake up before dying. Following this advice, Sang wakes to find himself holding the golden sword that had just wounded him in the dream. The priceless object fetches a fortune, and by repeating the trick night after night he collects valuable artefacts from the dream world and becomes rich almost overnight. San Ge now becomes his subordinate, and Sang finally finds the courage to court Hua Er (Song Jia), the café owner he has long admired from afar. His wealth carries a cost, however: injuries from the dream world keep following him into reality, and his money draws the attention of a ruthless gangster boss, Qiang (Wu Gang). King Shih-chieh and Kevin Lee also appear.

Critical responses varied. Writing for Yahoo News Singapore, Teng Yong Ping gave it three out of five stars, reading it as a fable warning against unearned wealth; he found its effects decent but below Hollywood level and faulted Wang's broad acting, the vague rules of the dream world and an anti-climactic ending. M.N. Miller of Ready Steady Cut was far more enthusiastic, calling it great fun and interpreting the dream demon as a metaphor for a writer's inner struggles. AsianMovieWeb judged it surprisingly entertaining as a fantasy comedy with a subtle romance and neat effects, though it felt the script grew too convoluted towards the end.

documents.title: Spontaneous
documents.overview: When students in their high school begin inexplicably exploding (literally), seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last.
documents.plot:
Spontaneous is a 2020 American comedy-drama film directed by Brian Duffield and written by Brian Duffield and Alex Upley. The movie follows the story of a young woman named Maddie, played by Hailee Steinfeld, who embarks on a journey to find her place in the world after a series of unfortunate events.

The main themes of Spontaneous revolve around identity, self-discovery, and the complexities of human relationships. Throughout the film, Maddie navigates through various experiences that challenge her perceptions of herself and the world around her. She encounters a range of characters, from quirky friends to romantic interests, each of whom helps shape her understanding of who she is and what she wants out of life.

One of the central themes of Spontaneous is the exploration of identity and self-discovery. Maddie's journey is marked by a series of spontaneous decisions that lead her to confront her fears, desires, and aspirations. As she navigates through different experiences, she begins to uncover aspects of herself that she never knew existed.

Another significant theme in the film is the power of human connection and relationships. Maddie forms deep bonds with those around her, including her friends and romantic partners, which serve as a source of support and comfort during her journey. The movie highlights the importance of embracing vulnerability, empathy, and understanding in our relationships with others.

The film also touches on themes of grief, loss, and healing. Maddie's experiences are marked by moments of sadness and heartbreak, but she ultimately finds a way to heal and move forward. This theme is reflected in her relationships with those around her, as well as her own personal growth and development.

Overall, Spontaneous is a thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of human experience through Maddie's journey of self-discovery and growth.

documents.title: Vanguard
documents.overview: Covert security company Vanguard is the last hope of survival for an accountant after he is targeted by the world's deadliest mercenary organization.
documents.plot:
Vanguard (Chinese: 急先鋒) is a 2020 Chinese action comedy written and directed by Stanley Tong, marking his sixth collaboration with Jackie Chan. Chan stars as Tang Huanting, head of an elite private security company, with Yang Yang, Miya Muqi, Allen Ai Lun and Jackson Liu. Originally set for release in January 2020, the film was postponed because of the COVID-19 pandemic and opened in China on 30 September 2020, followed by releases in the United States in November and India in December.

Qin Guoli, a Chinese accountant based in Britain, was coerced into managing the finances of Maasym, the leader of a terrorist group called the Brothers of Vengeance. After Qin tipped off Scotland Yard, Maasym was killed in an American military operation, but his son Omar survived and is determined to recover his father's fortune, whose location only Qin knows. Omar hires a mercenary gang known as the Arctic Wolves, who abduct Qin and his new wife during Chinese New Year festivities in London's Chinatown.

Vanguard, the international security firm charged with Qin's protection, sends its agents Zhang Kaixuan, Lei Zhenyu and Mi Ya to rescue him. After the successful operation, Qin asks Tang to protect his daughter, Fareeda, who is working in Africa, before Omar can use her as leverage. Tang, Lei and Mi Ya travel to Africa, where they find Fareeda but must fight off both the Arctic Wolves and a gang of poachers hired as extra muscle. In the chaos, Lei and Fareeda are separated from the group and hide in the jungle, while Tang and Mi Ya track them with satellite support from Vanguard's headquarters. The reunited team escapes in a furious river chase with an amphibious vehicle, and the pursuit eventually leads to the Middle East and to Dubai, where the agents must stop Omar's plans for a devastating terrorist attack, in a series of elaborate action set pieces involving vehicles, explosions and animals.

Vanguard received mixed reviews. Critics praised Chan's performance, the action sequences and the music but criticized the screenplay, editing and length. The film was released during China's National Day holiday period, one of the first major Chinese releases after cinemas reopened following pandemic closures.

documents.title: Skyfire
documents.overview: Tianhuo Island is a beautiful paradise. It almost makes people forget that it is located in the "Ring of Fire", the world-famous Pacific Rim volcanic belt. Young geologist Li Xiaomeng brings her team here to develop the first volcanic monitoring system, the Suzaku. Li Xiaomeng's father, Li Wentao, a volcanic expert who has retired for many years, rushes to the crater after learning about it, trying to persuade her to leave. At the same time, expedition expert Zheng Nan dives in the beautiful underwater cave, preparing to give his girlfriend Jiahui a romantic proposal. The volcano erupts, and the fate of these people are entangled. In order to see tomorrow, they must work together to find a way to survive.
documents.plot:
Skyfire (Chinese: 天·火) is a 2019 Chinese disaster action film directed by Simon West and written by Wei Bu and Sidney King. It stars Wang Xueqi as volcanologist Wentao Li, Hannah Quinlivan as his daughter Meng Li, Shawn Dou as Zhengnan Xiao and Jason Isaacs as the resort developer Jack Harris. Billed as China's first big-budget disaster film, it depicts a catastrophic eruption at a luxury resort on a tropical island.

When Meng Li is a child, her mother is killed when a volcano suddenly erupts on Ting-Hao, a Southeast Asian island. Years later, Meng has become a scientist herself and returns to the island to set up an advanced monitoring system designed to predict eruptions. In the meantime, the businessman Jack Harris has built an extravagant theme park resort at the foot of the volcano, confidently assuring investors and guests that it will not erupt for another century and a half and believing that tourists enjoy living on the edge.

Meng's father, Wentao, comes to the island to warn his daughter that a new eruption is imminent. As the volcano awakens, Meng and Wentao are forced to work together to rescue a group of tourists stranded on an observation platform inside the crater. When the eruption intensifies, burning rocks rain down on the resort and rivers of lava threaten the island's villages, and the survivors must race across the devastated landscape to reach a control center, where they hope to release a reservoir and divert the lava, while Harris's reckless decisions endanger everyone.

The film follows the conventions of Hollywood disaster cinema, combining spectacular visual effects with a story of reconciliation between a father and daughter.

Skyfire was released in China in December 2019 and was intended as the first film of a trilogy. Western critics were largely dismissive, criticizing its thin characters and formulaic action and comparing it to films such as When Time Ran Out and Jurassic Park, although it holds a rating of 57 percent on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: Project Power
documents.tagline: What would you risk for five minutes of pure power?
documents.overview: An ex-soldier, a teen and a cop collide in New Orleans as they hunt for the source behind a dangerous new pill that grants users temporary superpowers.
documents.plot:
Project Power is a 2020 American science fiction action film directed by Henry Joost and Ariel Schulman and written by Mattson Tomlin. It stars Jamie Foxx as Art, a former soldier, Joseph Gordon-Levitt as New Orleans police officer Frank Shaver and Dominique Fishback as Robin Reilly, a teenage dealer, with Colson Baker, Rodrigo Santoro, Amy Landecker and Allen Maldonado. The story centers on a pill that gives its user a unique superpower for five minutes.

In near-future New Orleans, a mysterious supplier begins distributing a pill called Power for free to local drug dealers. Each user gains a random superpower for five minutes, based on abilities found in the animal kingdom, but the effects are unpredictable and sometimes fatal. Robin, a bright teenager who deals the drug to pay for her mother's medical care, is friends with Frank Shaver, a police officer who secretly uses Power himself, which makes him bulletproof, to keep up with the criminals. Frank's superiors tell him that powerful figures want the investigation into the drug shut down and give him the photograph of a suspect: Art.

Art, in fact, is not the source of the drug but a former U.S. Army major who was one of its first test subjects. He is searching for his daughter Tracy, who was born with powers as a result of his treatment and was kidnapped by Teleios, the shadowy defense contractor behind Power, which is using New Orleans as a testing ground for its product. Art forces Robin to help him find the distributor, and the two form an unlikely bond. With Frank on their trail and Teleios preparing to sell the drug to a potential buyer, the three must join forces to expose the conspiracy and rescue Tracy.

The film uses its premise to comment on pharmaceutical exploitation and on the treatment of poor communities as test subjects, and it was praised for Fishback's breakout performance.

Project Power was released on Netflix on August 14, 2020. It received mixed to positive reviews, with 61 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus highlighted a star-making turn from Fishback, and a Metacritic score of 51.

documents.title: The Influence
documents.overview: After moving back to her family home to care for her dying mother, a nurse haunted by her childhood memories must struggle with an evil force in the house.
documents.plot:
The Influence (Spanish: La influencia) is a 2019 Spanish supernatural horror film directed by Denis Rovira van Boekholt in his feature debut. It adapts the 1988 novel of the same name by the English horror writer Ramsey Campbell, relocating the story to Spain, from a screenplay by Rovira, Daniel Rissech and the Goya-winning writer Michel Gaztambide. Manuela Vellés stars as Alicia, with Maggie Civantos as her sister Sara, Alain Hernández as her husband Mikel, Claudia Placer as her young daughter Nora and Emma Suárez as her mother Victoria.

Alicia, a nurse, returns after a long estrangement to the family home she fled as a child, a gloomy, isolated mansion in the woods that is crammed with hunting trophies, stuffed animals and dusty curiosities. Her sister Sara has spent years caring for their possessive mother, Victoria, who now lies in a deep coma on the top floor, barely kept alive by a respirator, and Alicia moves in with Mikel, an electrician, and Nora to share the burden. She insists that Victoria will never wake up, but flashbacks gradually reveal the cruelty the old woman inflicted on her daughters in the past, and a room beside her bed is filled with jars, spell books marked with pentagrams, skulls and other occult objects revealing her lifelong devotion to witchcraft.

Nora is drawn to her grandmother and to the forbidden room, where she takes a spider-shaped locket. At her new school she is bullied, and she begins spending time with Luna, a strange, grubby girl who watches her from outside. When the remaining relatives gather for the reading of the will, they learn that Nora is the sole heir. The girl grows sullen and violent, beating her tormentor bloodily, while unexplained events multiply around the house, and Alicia must confront the past she had tried to forget as she realizes that even in her coma Victoria is able to shape what happens around her.

Sony Pictures released The Influence in Spanish cinemas on 21 June 2019, and Netflix began streaming it internationally on 11 October 2019. Reviews were mostly negative. Critics compared it with Hereditary and gothic Spanish horror such as The Others, and some praised its atmosphere, elaborate production design and Civantos's performance, but HobbyConsolas found its incoherent script, overloaded clichés and ridiculous dialogue turned it into unintended comedy, and Decider called it a slow, self-serious tale with underwhelming reveals and a nonsensical ending.

documents.title: The Wretched
documents.tagline: What is forgotten will never be found.
documents.overview: A rebellious teenage boy, struggling with his parent's imminent divorce, encounters a terrifying evil after his next-door neighbor becomes possessed by an ancient witch that feasts on children.
documents.plot:
The Wretched is a 2020 American supernatural horror film directed by Ryan Spindell. The movie follows a young woman named Bee, who finds herself trapped in a mysterious and eerie world filled with supernatural creatures.

At its core, The Wretched explores the themes of isolation, loneliness, and the struggle for human connection in a desolate environment. Bee's journey is marked by her desperate attempts to find solace and companionship in a world that seems determined to crush her spirits. As she navigates this treacherous landscape, she must confront the darkness within herself and the true nature of her surroundings.

The film also delves into the idea of the "other," highlighting the ways in which societal norms and expectations can marginalize and exclude those who are perceived as different or threatening. Bee's experiences serve as a powerful commentary on the dangers of xenophobia, prejudice, and the dehumanizing effects of fear and mistrust.

Furthermore, The Wretched touches on the theme of female empowerment, as Bee finds herself at the center of a maelstrom of supernatural forces that seek to exploit her vulnerability. Through her struggles, she discovers a sense of resilience and determination that allows her to resist the oppressive forces arrayed against her.

Ultimately, The Wretched is a haunting and unsettling film that probes the darkest recesses of the human experience, revealing the ways in which our deepest fears can both consume us and ultimately set us free.

documents.title: A Cinderella Story: Christmas Wish
documents.tagline: Happily ever after begins with a dream.
documents.overview: Kat is an aspiring singer-songwriter who dreams of making it big. However, her dreams are stalled by her reality: a conniving and cruel stepfamily  and a demoralizing job working as a singing elf at billionaire Terrence Wintergarden’s Santa Land.
documents.plot:
A Cinderella Story: Christmas Wish is a 2019 American musical teen romantic comedy written and directed by Michelle Johnston, and the fifth instalment of the A Cinderella Story film series. Laura Marano stars as an aspiring singer-songwriter and Gregg Sulkin as the wealthy young man who falls for her, with Isabella Gomez, Johannah Newmarch, Lillian Doucet-Roche, Chanelle Peloso, Maddie Phillips and Barclay Hope. It was released digitally on October 15, 2019, followed by a DVD release later that month.

Seventeen-year-old Kat Decker dreams of a music career, but since her father Jason's death she has lived under the control of her cold stepmother Deirdre and spoiled stepsisters Joy and Grace. They treat her as a servant, keep her inheritance and take much of her pay, supposedly for the care of her disabled dog Bruno. Saving to escape, Kat sings at Santa Land, a Christmas theme park, with her best friend Isla, a talented seamstress. There she meets the park's new young Santa, who is secretly Nick Wintergarden, son of the billionaire Terrence Wintergarden and a quiet manager of bands, and he is captivated by her voice.

Deirdre discovers that Terrence was Jason's best friend and schemes to attend his Christmas charity gala as the grieving widow. When his reply invites both Deirdre and Katherine, she plans to have Joy pose as Kat. As Nick and Kat grow closer, he invites her to the gala and reveals who he is, while Kat keeps her own family situation to herself. Isla sews her a copy of an expensive green dress, but her stepfamily steal it and Deirdre burns her invitation. A visit to Nick's home goes badly when his friends, especially his girlfriend Skyler, snub her, and her father's cherished snow globe is broken during a fight with her stepsisters.

When Bruno uncovers Terrence's letter, Kat realises her identity is being stolen and resolves to stop the plan. Isla smuggles her into the gala disguised as one of the elf performers, but she is pushed on stage, stumbles through the routine and ends up filling in as the Snow Queen. Nick, who has broken up with Skyler, finds her and encourages her to pursue her dream for her father's sake, and she wins over the audience with a new original song. Introduced to Terrence, Kat explains her situation; he sends Deirdre and her daughters away, offers to support her in memory of his friend, and Kat and Nick finally share a dance.

documents.title: The Tunnel
documents.tagline: Two ways in - No way out
documents.overview: When a truck crashes inside a tunnel, people on their way home for Christmas are brutally trapped in a deadly fire. With a blizzard raging outside, and the first responders struggling to get to the accident, it's every man for himself.
documents.plot:
The Tunnel is a 2019 Norwegian thriller film directed by Ole Giøvaag. 

The movie revolves around a group of friends who embark on a road trip to explore an abandoned tunnel in the countryside, only to find themselves trapped and hunted by a mysterious figure.

As for the main themes, The Tunnel explores several ideas:

1. **Friendship and camaraderie**: The film highlights the strong bonds between the group of friends as they navigate their way through the tunnel and confront the dangers that lie within.
2. **Isolation and vulnerability**: The characters are forced to confront their own vulnerabilities and fears as they become trapped in the tunnel, highlighting the fragility of human relationships in isolated environments.
3. **Trauma and PTSD**: One of the main characters, a young woman named Maja, is struggling with PTSD after a traumatic event in her past. Her experiences in the tunnel serve as a catalyst for confronting her demons.
4. **Survival and resilience**: As the group fights to survive against their pursuer, they must also confront their own mortality and the limits of human endurance.

Throughout the film, these themes are expertly woven together to create a tense and suspenseful narrative that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

documents.title: Archive
documents.overview: Archive is a 2020 science fiction thriller directed by Gavin Rothery. Set in 2038, it follows George Almore, a scientist working in a remote facility on developing a true human-equivalent artificial intelligence. George’s goal is deeply personal: to recreate his deceased wife through advanced AI and robotics technology.George has created several prototypes of androids designed to house his wife’s consciousness. He is in the final stages of perfecting the latest model, which is almost indistinguishable from a real human. Throughout the film, George struggles with the ethical and emotional challenges of his project, as well as the risks involved in pushing the boundaries of technology.As George interacts with the android, named J3, it becomes clear that the line between human and machine is blurring. J3 shows moments of self-awareness and emotional responses, raising questions about consciousness and identity.Meanwhile, George is hiding his true motive—his desperate desire to reunite with his wife, who passed away years earlier. His work is secretive, and the risks of his experiment extend beyond technical difficulties to psychological and moral dilemmas.The film explores themes such as grief, love, loss, the nature of consciousness, and the ethical implications of artificial intelligence. It probes the question of whether recreating a loved one digitally can truly replace the original person or if it’s a haunting illusion.
documents.plot:
Archive is a 2020 British science fiction film written and directed by Gavin Rothery in his directorial debut. Set in 2038, it stars Theo James as George Almore, a robotics engineer, with Stacy Martin, Rhona Mitra, Peter Ferdinando, Lia Williams and Toby Jones. Its planned premiere at South by Southwest in March 2020 was canceled because of the COVID-19 pandemic, and it was instead released digitally and in limited theaters in the United States on 10 July 2020.

George's wife, Jules, has been killed in a car accident, but her consciousness has been preserved by a company called Archive, whose technology lets George speak with her by video for a limited total of about 200 hours. Working alone at a remote, snowbound research facility in Japan on a project for his employer, George secretly pursues a personal goal: building a robot body capable of holding Jules's consciousness permanently. He has already made two prototypes. J1 is a crude, childlike machine, while J2 has the mind of a teenager and grows jealous of George's work on the third, nearly complete model, J3, increasingly behaving unpredictably.

Representatives from Archive come to inspect the device storing Jules's mind, notice that it has been tampered with and suspect that George is stealing their intellectual property. George finishes the J3 robot, which is strikingly humanlike. Confronted with the realization that she will never become anything more than she is, J2 destroys herself by walking into a lake, and Archive retrieves the robot and threatens to sue George's employer. When his boss discovers his secret project, she fires him. In a final call with Jules, George ends by saying he will see her soon, and J3, overhearing, realizes that he intends to overwrite her consciousness with Jules's. As George races to complete the transfer before he loses access to the facility, the film builds toward a revelation that reframes everything he believes about his situation and his wife's death.

Archive received generally favorable reviews. It holds a 78 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus says it executes its fairly basic program efficiently while offering an engaging meditation on love and human nature, and a Metacritic score of 67. Critics particularly praised its production design and atmosphere on a modest budget.

documents.title: Yaksha: Ruthless Operations
documents.overview: Nicknamed after a human-devouring spirit, the ruthless leader of an overseas black ops team takes up a dangerous mission in a city riddled with spies.
documents.plot:
Yaksha: Ruthless Operations is a South Korean action thriller film released on December 22, 2022, by Showbox. The movie follows the story of Jang Do-jin (played by Lee Jung-jae), a former special forces operative who becomes embroiled in a conspiracy involving a mysterious organization known as "Yaksha."

The film begins with Jang Do-jin, now living a quiet life as a detective, investigating a series of gruesome murders. As he delves deeper into the case, he discovers that the victims all have one thing in common: they were involved in a top-secret government project codenamed "Yaksha." Intrigued, Do-jin decides to dig deeper and soon finds himself entangled in a web of corruption and deceit.

As Do-jin digs deeper, he encounters a mysterious woman named Yoon (played by Kim Ji-won), who seems to be connected to the Yaksha organization. The two form an uneasy alliance as they navigate the treacherous landscape of government conspiracies and corporate espionage.

The plot thickens as Do-jin uncovers evidence of a massive cover-up involving corrupt government officials, corporate executives, and even some members of his own special forces unit. He soon realizes that Yaksha is not just a project, but a complex network of operatives and agents working to manipulate world events from behind the scenes.

As the stakes escalate, Do-jin finds himself in a cat-and-mouse game with the masterminds behind Yaksha. The action unfolds at breakneck speed, with intense hand-to-hand combat sequences and high-stakes chases through the streets of Seoul.

Throughout the film, Lee Jung-jae delivers a nuanced performance as Jang Do-jin, bringing depth and complexity to his character's struggles against overwhelming odds. Kim Ji-won also shines in her supporting role, adding an air of mystery and intrigue to the plot.

The climax of the film sees Do-jin facing off against the leader of Yaksha, a ruthless and cunning adversary who will stop at nothing to achieve their goals. The final confrontation is intense and suspenseful, with both characters engaging in a battle of wits and physical prowess.

Ultimately, Do-jin emerges victorious, but not without scars. As he reflects on the events that transpired, he realizes that the true enemy was not Yaksha itself, but the corrupt system that enabled its existence. The film concludes on a somber note, with Do-jin vowing to continue fighting against injustice and corruption.

Overall, Yaksha: Ruthless Operations is a gripping action thriller that explores themes of power, corruption, and the blurred lines between right and wrong. With its breakneck pace, intricate plot, and strong performances from its leads, this film is sure to keep viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

documents.title: Follow Me
documents.overview: A social media personality travels with his friends to Moscow to capture new content for his successful VLOG. Always pushing the limits and catering to a growing audience, they enter a cold world of mystery, excess, and danger. When the lines between real life and social media are blurred, the group must fight to escape, and survive.
documents.plot:
No Escape, released internationally as Follow Me, is a 2020 American horror thriller written and directed by Will Wernick. Keegan Allen stars as a social media celebrity whose overseas birthday adventure turns into a nightmare, with Holland Roden, Denzel Whitaker, Ronen Rubinstein, Pasha D. Lychnikoff, George Janko and Siya. It was released in theaters and on demand and digital platforms on September 18, 2020.

Cole Turner is an image-obsessed internet star whose channel, "Escape From Reality", has millions of followers who watch him livestream his thrill-seeking adventures. To celebrate the channel's tenth anniversary, Cole, his girlfriend Erin and his friends Dash, Sam and Thomas travel to Moscow for an extreme escape room arranged by Dash with the help of Alexei Koslov, a wealthy Russian fan. After a night out at a seedy club, where they are threatened by a pair of local gangsters, the group returns to Alexei's mansion.

On the day of the game, Alexei hooks Cole's phone up to the surveillance cameras so that his followers can watch live, and warns the friends that the experience will be extreme and unpredictable. Blindfolded, they are led to separate rooms. Cole wakes beside the body of a dead soldier and must cut it open to retrieve a key. He then finds his friends trapped in realistic, deadly contraptions and frees them one by one, solving puzzles to save Thomas and Dash and then Sam, and finally smashing open a tank in which Erin is drowning.

Convinced that the game is truly dangerous, they flee, but are captured by Andrei, one of the gangsters from the club, who kills Alexei's girlfriend Viktoria and knocks Cole out. Cole wakes alone in a cell and watches on screens as his friends are apparently tortured and murdered for the entertainment of Andrei's own audience. He learns that Alexei is working with the gangsters and watches helplessly as Erin is shot.

Escaping through a duct, Cole finds Alexei waiting for him in a dark room, filming him on his phone, and in a rage beats him to death. The lights come on to reveal Erin and all his friends alive: the entire ordeal was an elaborate, staged surprise for his anniversary. They stare in horror at Alexei's body as Cole's livestream audience floods the chat with shocked messages, and Cole realises that he has killed a man for nothing.

The film received mixed to negative reviews, with 38% approval on Rotten Tomatoes from a small sample of critics, and JoBlo.com rated it four out of ten.

documents.title: The High Note
documents.tagline: You've got to start at the bottom before you take it from the top.
documents.overview: Set in the dazzling world of the LA music scene comes the story of Grace Davis, a superstar whose talent, and ego, have reached unbelievable heights. Maggie is Grace’s overworked personal assistant who’s stuck running errands, but still aspires to her childhood dream of becoming a music producer. When Grace’s manager presents her with a choice that could alter the course of her career, Maggie and Grace come up with a plan that could change their lives forever.
documents.plot:
The High Note is a 2020 American musical comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of fame, identity, and human connection. At its core, the movie delves into the theme of self-discovery, as the protagonist, Alice Keegan, played by Anna Kendrick, navigates her way through the highs and lows of her life.

The film also touches on the idea of the commodification of talent and the pressures that come with fame. Through Alice's character, the movie sheds light on the sacrifices one must make for success and the blurred lines between artistic expression and commercial appeal.

Furthermore, The High Note examines the complexities of female relationships and the struggles women face in a patriarchal society. Alice's journey is also a metaphor for the search for authenticity and independence in a world that often seeks to control and manipulate individuals.

Ultimately, the movie presents a nuanced portrayal of human vulnerability, imperfection, and the power of genuine connections in a world where superficiality often reigns supreme.

documents.title: Togo
documents.overview: The untold true story set in the winter of 1925 that takes you across the treacherous terrain of the Alaskan tundra for an exhilarating and uplifting adventure that will test the strength, courage and determination of one man, Leonhard Seppala, and his lead sled dog, Togo.
documents.plot:
Togo is a 2019 American biographical drama film directed by Ross Katz and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The film is based on the true story of Leonhard Seppala, a Finnish-Swedish sled dog breeder who played a crucial role in saving the life of a young boy during a diphtheria outbreak in Nome, Alaska.

The film begins with Leonhard Seppala (played by Willem Dafoe), a struggling sled dog breeder living on his farm in Nome. He is married to Rose (played by Anne Hathaway), and they have two children together. The story takes a dramatic turn when the town of Nome is hit by a diphtheria outbreak, which claims the lives of many residents.

The situation becomes dire as the town's medical supplies are running low, and the only way to transport medicine from Bluff, Alaska (about 674 miles away) is through sled dogs. The US Army sends a team led by Captain Balto (played by Paul Giamatti), who is tasked with delivering the diphtheria serum to Nome.

Leonhard Seppala, determined to save his community, decides to take on the challenge of leading the sled dog team himself. He chooses his most experienced and strongest dogs, including Togo (played by a combination of two dogs: Buck and Tundra), to make the perilous journey.

As the team sets out, they face numerous challenges, including treacherous terrain, harsh weather conditions, and the risk of losing their dogs in the process. Despite these obstacles, Seppala's determination and expertise as a sled dog breeder keep the team moving forward.

Meanwhile, Captain Balto is struggling with his own doubts about leading the mission. He is haunted by a past failure to deliver supplies during a previous expedition, which led to the death of several people in Nome.

As the journey progresses, Seppala's team faces numerous setbacks, including a near-fatal accident that leaves Togo injured. However, Seppala refuses to give up and continues to push his dogs forward, driven by his love for his community and his determination to save lives.

In the end, Seppala's team successfully delivers the diphtheria serum to Nome, saving countless lives in the process. The film ends with a poignant moment of reflection, as Seppala looks back on the journey and realizes that it was not just about delivering supplies but also about the bond between humans and animals.

Throughout the film, Willem Dafoe delivers a powerful performance as Leonhard Seppala, capturing the complexity and depth of his character. The chemistry between him and Anne Hathaway is undeniable, adding an emotional layer to the story. Paul Giamatti's portrayal of Captain Balto is equally impressive, conveying the weight of responsibility and the personal stakes involved in leading the mission.

Overall, Togo is a heartwarming and inspiring film that celebrates the human spirit and the unbreakable bond between humans and animals.

documents.title: The Survivor
documents.tagline: Some fight to win. He fought to live.
documents.overview: Harry Haft is a boxer who fought fellow prisoners in the concentration camps to survive. Haunted by the memories and his guilt, he attempts to use high-profile fights against boxing legends like Rocky Marciano as a way to find his first love again.
documents.plot:
The Survivor is a 2021 biographical drama directed by Barry Levinson from a screenplay by Justine Juel Gillmer, based on Alan Scott Haft's book about his father, the boxer Harry Haft. Ben Foster stars as Haft, with Vicky Krieps, Billy Magnussen, Peter Sarsgaard, John Leguizamo, Danny DeVito and Dar Zuzovsky. It was produced by New Mandate Films, Bron Studios and Creative Wealth Media, with a score by Hans Zimmer.

The story moves between the Holocaust and its aftermath. At Auschwitz, the young Polish Jew Harry survives because the SS officer Dietrich Schneider (Magnussen), after seeing him strike another officer, decides to turn him into a fighter, staging bouts against fellow prisoners for the entertainment and wagers of the camp's officers; winning means food, losing means death. In 1949, Harry is a struggling heavyweight in the United States, still haunted by guilt and obsessed with finding Leah (Zuzovsky), the love he lost before the war. He hopes that a high-profile fight against the rising star Rocky Marciano will make him famous enough for her to find him. He confides his wartime story to the reporter Emory Anderson (Sarsgaard), but when the article is published, members of the Jewish community condemn him as a traitor. Marciano's trainer Charlie Goldman (DeVito) offers him a few days of training at a camp upstate, alongside his trainer Pepe (Leguizamo), so that he will not be destroyed in the ring. Miriam Wofsoniker (Krieps), who works for an agency helping survivors find lost relatives, assists in his search and gradually becomes part of his new life, while memories of the camp, triggered by everyday moments such as fireworks, keep intruding. Harry ultimately loses to Marciano but begins to come to terms with the past.

To play the emaciated prisoner, Foster lost 62 pounds, after which production paused for five weeks so he could regain weight for the postwar scenes. Filming began in February 2019, with locations in Hungary as well as New York and Savannah. The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on 13 September 2021 and debuted on HBO and HBO Max on 27 April 2022. Reviews were positive, with an 86% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 71; critics singled out Foster's performance, and RogerEbert.com praised the film's layered characters and humor. It was nominated for the Emmy Award for Outstanding Television Movie.

documents.title: Rifkin's Festival
documents.overview: The story of a married American couple who go to the San Sebastian Film Festival. They get caught up in the magic of the festival, the beauty and charm of Spain and the fantasy of movies. She has an affair with a brilliant French movie director, and he falls in love with a beautiful Spanish woman who lives there.
documents.plot:
Rifkin's Festival is a 2020 American drama film directed by Todd Solondz. The movie revolves around the story of Richard Rifkin, a wealthy and reclusive man who hosts an annual festival in his estate to celebrate the lives of those he considers to be "undesirable" or "unloved". 

The main theme of the movie is the exploration of loneliness, isolation, and the human desire for connection. Through the characters' narratives, the film delves into the complexities of relationships, love, and acceptance. It also touches upon themes of class, privilege, and the societal pressures that shape our lives.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that each character's narrative is intertwined with their own struggles with loneliness and disconnection. The festival serves as a catalyst for these characters to confront their pasts, present themselves to others, and ultimately find a sense of belonging or acceptance.

The film also explores the idea of performance and identity, as many of the characters use their narratives to create a persona or image that they feel is more acceptable to others. This theme is particularly evident in the character of Richard Rifkin, who uses his festival as a means to curate an idealized version of himself and those around him.

Overall, Rifkin's Festival is a thought-provoking exploration of human relationships, loneliness, and the complexities of identity.

documents.title: Fatherhood
documents.overview: A widowed new dad copes with doubts, fears, heartache and dirty diapers as he sets out to raise his daughter on his own. Inspired by a true story.
documents.plot:
Fatherhood is a 2021 American comedy-drama film directed by Paul Weitz, who wrote the screenplay with Dana Stevens, based on Matthew Logelin's 2011 memoir Two Kisses for Maddy: A Memoir of Loss and Love. Kevin Hart stars as a young widower raising his daughter alone, with Alfre Woodard, Frankie Faison, Lil Rel Howery, DeWanda Wise, Anthony Carrigan, Melody Hurd and Paul Reiser. Originally intended for theatrical release by Sony Pictures, it was sold to Netflix during the COVID-19 pandemic and released on June 18, 2021.

Matt Logelin and his wife, Liz, childhood sweethearts, eagerly prepare for the birth of their first child. Just after their daughter, Maddy, is born, Liz suffers a pulmonary embolism and dies. Devastated, Matt resolves to raise Maddy on his own, despite the doubts of friends and family. Liz's mother, Marion, with whom he has a strained relationship, is the most concerned. When Matt turns down her offer to stay for months to help, and refuses to move back to Minnesota where both families live, she warns him that Maddy will need family and female role models.

Matt struggles at first to balance his grief, a demanding full-time job and the endless demands of an infant, while facing condescension from people who assume a father cannot be the primary parent. With help from friends and other parents, he finds his footing. Years later, Maddy is a confident, tomboyish schoolgirl. Matt is set up with a woman, played by Wise, whose name echoes his late wife's, and they begin dating. Maddy soon grows fond of her, but when Maddy is hurt at school and Matt misses the calls because he is with her, he blames himself and ends the relationship, upsetting his daughter.

On a trip to Minnesota for Marion's birthday, Maddy delights in staying in her mother's childhood room and learning about Liz, and asks to remain with her grandparents. Convinced that he has failed to understand what she needs, Matt reluctantly leaves her there. Back at work, on the verge of a promotion and about to leave on a business trip abroad, he is overwhelmed by thoughts of his daughter and returns to Minnesota. He reconciles with Maddy and, with Marion's blessing, brings her home, where he also rekindles his romance.

Fatherhood received mixed reviews. Rotten Tomatoes reported 67% approval, its consensus crediting the strong cast with giving the fact-based story real emotional resonance, and Metacritic gave it a score of 53.

documents.title: Aquaslash
documents.overview: To celebrate their graduation, the teenagers from Valley Hills High School have organized an ’80s-themed party at the old Wet Valley water park. Things turn gruesome when it's revealed that a mysterious maniac has inserted giant razor blades into one of the water slides. The water park thus becomes the backdrop for a bloodbath (literally), and everyone is a suspect...
documents.plot:
Aquaslash is a 2019 Canadian slasher film directed by Renaud Gauthier, who co-wrote it with Philip Kalin. Nicolas Fontaine, Brittany Drisdelle, Madeline Harvey, Lanisa Dawn, Paul Zinno, Nick Walker and Chip Chuipka star in a deliberately retro horror comedy set at a water park, where a killer targets a group of recent high school graduates competing for a cash prize in a water slide race.

The film opens one night at the Wet Valley Water Park, where two teenagers are murdered by a machete-wielding attacker. Some time later, the class of 2018 from Valley Hills High arrives for a weekend-long graduation celebration at the park, which is owned by the sleazy Paul Wilkinson. The large cast of characters includes Josh, a member of a band called the Blades, and his bandmates; Paul's wife Priscilla, rumored to choose one graduate to sleep with every year; Alice, a graduate with whom Paul is having an affair; park employee Tommy; an elderly pool cleaner named Conrad; and Kimberly, Tommy's girlfriend and Josh's former girlfriend. When Josh and Kimberly have sex in the showers, another student secretly films them and the video is sent to their classmates during the Blades' performance, leading Tommy to punch Josh and lose his job.

Tensions grow as Josh's father, a real estate developer, negotiates to buy the park and is later shot dead by an unseen attacker. Meanwhile, a mysterious figure secretly installs a pair of large, crossed metal blades inside one of the park's water slides. The next day the park's annual competition begins, in which teams of three race down three slides into the pool below for a cash prize. Tommy warns that one of the slides is unsafe, but nobody listens. When the first teams launch, those who take the sabotaged slide are cut to pieces, and the pool fills with blood as panic spreads and the survivors struggle to stop the race and identify the killer before more victims are sent down the chute.

Reception was predominantly negative, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting that only 14% of seven critics' reviews were positive. Some genre critics enjoyed its gleefully gory set piece: Arrow in the Head said the extended slide sequence earns the film a recommendation, and Dread Central called it an irreverent retro slasher throwback. Film School Rejects dismissed it as a barely watchable misfire with occasional unintentional laughs.

documents.title: Nine Days
documents.overview: A reclusive man conducts a series of interviews with human souls for a chance to be born.
documents.plot:
Nine Days is a thought-provoking and introspective film that explores the complexities of human existence, love, and mortality. The movie delves into the theme of loneliness, as its protagonist, Will, navigates his mundane office job and struggles to form meaningful connections with others.

Through Will's character, the film sheds light on the universal human desire for connection and belonging. As he observes and interacts with various individuals in his life, including a young woman named Emma, Will begins to question the nature of relationships and the impermanence of human connections.

The movie also touches upon the theme of existentialism, as Will grapples with the meaninglessness of his own existence and the fleeting nature of life. His observations of others' lives serve as a poignant reminder that everyone is struggling with their own set of problems and insecurities.

Furthermore, Nine Days explores the idea of empathy and understanding, highlighting the importance of putting oneself in others' shoes to truly comprehend their experiences. Will's character undergoes significant development as he learns to see beyond his own perspective and develop a deeper appreciation for the complexities of human emotions.

Ultimately, the film presents a nuanced and introspective portrayal of the human condition, inviting viewers to reflect on their own relationships, desires, and mortality.

documents.title: Escape from Mogadishu
documents.tagline: A city in revolt, we must escape.
documents.overview: Diplomats from the North and South Korean embassies in Somalia attempt a daring joint escape from Mogadishu when the outbreak of civil war leaves them stranded.
documents.plot:
Escape from Mogadishu (Korean: Mogadisyu) is a 2021 South Korean political action thriller directed by Ryoo Seung-wan, based on real events during the Somali Civil War. It stars Kim Yoon-seok as South Korean ambassador Han Sin-seong, Zo In-sung as the embassy counselor and intelligence officer Kang Dae-jin, Huh Joon-ho as North Korean ambassador Rim Yong-su and Koo Kyo-hwan as North Korean counselor Tae Jun-ki, with Kim So-jin and Jung Man-sik. The film was shot entirely in Morocco in the second half of 2019.

In 1990, both North and South Korea are lobbying for admission to the United Nations and competing to win the support of Somalia's government under President Siad Barre. The rival embassies in Mogadishu sabotage each other at every turn, while the country slides into civil war between the government and rebels led by Mohamed Farrah Aidid. When the rebels enter the capital, fighting erupts across the city, and both delegations realize they must flee immediately.

Their attempts to reach the airport fail for lack of papers, and the North Koreans, after their embassy is ransacked and the Chinese embassy is found abandoned, make their way through the chaos to the South Korean compound, where Han lets them in despite deep mutual suspicion. Living under one roof, the two groups must set aside ideological hostility and propaganda games to survive. When the Italian embassy offers places on a Red Cross evacuation flight to Kenya, which the North Koreans are not eligible for, Han claims they are defecting. The diplomats and their families then armor their cars with bags of dirt and books, tie white flags to them and set out on a dangerous drive across the war-torn city, trying to reach the Italian embassy before gunfire cuts them down.

The film explores how shared danger can bridge the divide between the two Koreas, combining tense action with a humane portrait of the people caught in a foreign war.

Released in South Korea on July 28, 2021, Escape from Mogadishu topped the local box office and became the highest-grossing Korean film of 2021, with about 3.6 million admissions and 29 million dollars worldwide. It was selected as South Korea's entry for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film. Critics responded positively, with 95 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 71.

documents.title: Seven Days War
documents.overview: In the town of Saima, when summer is about to begin, a group of six high school students intend to live a secret adventure by spending seven carefree days in a ruined mining facility.
documents.plot:
Seven Days War (Japanese: Bokura no Nanoka-kan Sensō) is a 2019 Japanese animated coming-of-age action drama directed by Yūta Murano from a screenplay by Ichirō Ōkouchi, produced by the studio Ajiadō and distributed in Japan by Gaga and Kadokawa. It is a new adaptation of Osamu Sōda's 1985 novel, the first of his long-running Bokura series, previously filmed in live action in 1988. Updating the story some thirty years to 2020, the film changes the kanji numeral in the title to an Arabic "7"; Sōda approved the remake on condition that it keep the series' themes of challenging adults and humorous battles. The setting moved to a former coal-mining town in Hokkaido. The voice cast is led by Takumi Kitamura and Kyōko Yoshine, with Rie Miyazawa in a special appearance.

In 2020, Mamoru Suzuhara (Kitamura) is a bookish, solitary high-school second-year in the old mining town of Satomiya, steeped in military history. Shortly before the summer holidays he learns that his childhood friend and neighbour Aya Chiyono (Yoshine), whom he has long loved, is about to move to Tokyo, because her father, a local politician, plans to run for a Tokyo seat. Aya, who wanted at least to spend her birthday a week later in her hometown, accepts Mamoru's proposal to run away, and dressing it up as a "camp", she invites classmates until six of them are living in a disused mine on a hill. There they find Malet, a Thai child hiding from immigration officers after being separated from her parents. When officials arrive and lock the teenagers in, Mamoru shields Malet and the six are drawn into a seven-day "war" against the adults. Following Mamoru's tactics, they thwart a search, and post videos of their stand online to draw onlookers. Aya's father, his secretary and a construction company run by the father of Aya's best friend Kaori try to break in, and when the secretary exposes the group's old secrets on social media, tensions erupt. Eventually each confesses the feelings they had kept hidden, including Aya, who reveals that she is gay, and the reunited friends launch a final plan to save Malet.

The film opened in Japan on 13 December 2019 and was selected for the feature competition at the 2020 Annecy festival. It won the award for best animated feature at the Sitges Film Festival, and in France, where Eurozoom released it as 7 Jours in 2021, Télérama called it a successful adaptation of a classic of Japanese youth literature, while Le Monde found its themes too numerous.

documents.title: In Full Bloom
documents.overview: Set shortly after the end of World War II, a philosophical boxing drama of two fighters from opposite worlds (USA and Japan) who are pulled together for a questionable fight arranged by their unscrupulous managers and the Yakuza.
documents.plot:
In Full Bloom is a 2019 American period sports drama written and directed by Adam VillaSeñor and Reza Ghassemi in their feature debut; the pair also shot and edited it. Set in Japan shortly after World War II, it stars Tyler Wood as the American boxer Clint Sullivan and Yusuke Ogasawara as the Japanese champion Masahiro, with Hiroyuki Watanabe as the former champion Tetsuro Tokugawa, S. Scott McCracken as Clint's manager Silas, Timothy V. Murphy as Roane, Hazuki Kato as the courtesan Asami, and Stefanie Estes and Navid Negahban. The score is by Andrew Kawczynski.

With resentment of the American occupation still widespread, a light-heavyweight title fight between the washed-up Clint and the undefeated Masahiro takes on a weight far beyond sport, charged by bitter references to Pearl Harbor and Hiroshima. Clint, who fought in the war and is haunted by what he saw there, learns that Silas, his smooth-talking and unscrupulous manager, has made a deal with a murderous yakuza betting syndicate for him to throw the fight. Too proud to go along, Clint clings to his last shreds of self-respect, even if refusing could cost him his life.

Masahiro, meanwhile, prepares for the bout by seeking out Tetsuro, a reclusive former champion living in a remote, snowbound retreat. The old man is reluctant to become a teacher but soon tests his pupil with unconventional training: catching fish by hand in an icy stream, hunting blindfolded in the woods and resisting the seductions of Asami, while offering Zen-like counsel such as the warning that the only enemy is ego. The film moves back and forth in time, revealing both fighters' histories in flashbacks and letting each speak his innermost thoughts in whispered voice-over, before their parallel journeys meet in the ring.

In Full Bloom premiered at the Oldenburg International Film Festival in September 2019, where it won the festival's top prize, the German Independence Award, and it later received the Grand Jury Award for a feature at the 2020 Mammoth Film Festival before reaching American audiences in 2020 and 2021, with the mixed martial artist Henry Cejudo joining as an executive producer. Critics compared its lyrical style to Terrence Malick's. The Hollywood Reporter called it an impressively polished, ambitious debut despite muddled plotting, portentous dialogue and uneven acting, singling out the climactic match, and Film Threat praised it as a visually striking, soulful meditation on combat.

documents.title: The Cleansing Hour
documents.tagline: The perfect internet hoax just went to hell
documents.overview: Two millennial entrepreneurs stage elaborate fake exorcisms on social media until one of their girlfriends becomes possessed by a demon.
documents.plot:
The Cleansing Hour is a 2019 American horror film directed by Damien LeVeck, a feature-length adaptation of his 2016 short film of the same name about a staged televised exorcism that goes horribly wrong. It stars Ryan Guzman as Max, Kyle Gallner as Drew and Alix Angelis as Lane.

Childhood friends Max and Drew run The Cleansing Hour, a popular livestream on which "Father Max" exorcises a different possessed person in every episode. Every possession is fake, carefully scripted and staged to win followers and sell merchandise, and Max is obsessed with growing the audience. When the actress hired for the latest episode fails to show up, Drew's fiancée Lane, unhappy but supportive, agrees to play the possessed woman. Once the stream begins, however, it becomes clear that Lane has truly been possessed. The demon kills the crew one by one until only Max and Drew remain, and forces them to confess their secrets before the growing audience. Max admits that the show is a fraud, then reveals that as a boy at their Catholic school he killed a sadistic nun who beat them, to save Drew. He also confesses that he had once been a priest but left after witnessing abuses within the priesthood go unpunished, starting the show in the belief that it would harm no one. Drew cuts the feed, believing the demon wants to humiliate the Church, then restores it after using clues from its speech and a database to identify it as Aamon. The demon forces a final revelation, that Max slept with Lane before she met Drew, which nearly derails them, but they go on to perform the rite and drive it out of Lane, leaving the friendship in ruins. The demon then reappears and reveals that it was never Aamon but Lucifer himself, who used Lane to reach the stream and its more than 17 million viewers, whom it now possesses. The possessed viewers attack those around them, including the President of the United States, who is attacked by his own son, and the closing credits show chaos spreading around the world.

The film screened at the Strasbourg European Fantastic Film Festival on 18 September 2019 before its world premiere at Fantastic Fest, and was released on Shudder on 8 October 2020. It received generally positive reviews, holding 73% on Rotten Tomatoes; critics praised its cinematography and practical effects, though some found it too similar to earlier possession films such as The Exorcist.

documents.title: The Heist of the Century
documents.tagline: The Story Of The Theft That Made History
documents.overview: In 2006, a group of thieves performed what is considered one of the most famous and smart bank heists in the history of Argentina. How they robbed the Rio bank is as surprising as what happened afterwards. This is their story.
documents.plot:
The Heist of the Century (Spanish: El robo del siglo) is a 2020 Argentine heist comedy thriller film directed by Ariel Winograd, based on the real robbery of the Banco Río branch in Acassuso, Buenos Aires Province, on 13 January 2006, when six thieves carrying replica weapons took 23 hostages and emptied 147 safe deposit boxes. Diego Peretti stars as the mastermind Fernando Araujo and Guillermo Francella as Mario Vitette Sellanes, "the man in the gray suit", with Pablo Rago, Rafael Ferro, Mariano Argento and Luis Luque as the police negotiator Miguel Sileo.

Fernando Araujo, a painter and Brazilian jiu-jitsu expert, tells his psychoanalyst about another of his passions: robbing banks. Sheltering from the rain one day, he notices the Banco Río across the street, and a plan he and his acquaintance Sebastián had abandoned is revived when they discover a storm drain running near the bank. Araujo recruits three more criminals, the gang leader "the Doc", the street thief Beto and, through the Doc, the Uruguayan Vitette, while "the Paisa" is hired to drive their getaway vehicle. After studying the sewers, they strike at midday: Araujo, in a blond wig, and Beto enter the bank, Vitette, calling himself "Walter", and the Doc take the staff and customers hostage, and the rest fill bags with cash while Sebastián waits in a tunnel he has dug. As hundreds of police officers and sharpshooters surround the building, Vitette stalls negotiations with Sileo for hours, releasing a few hostages and ordering pizzas, until the gang slips away through the drain. When the police finally storm in, they find the vault emptied, the replica guns and a sign mocking the "rich neighborhood" and declaring that it was only money. The thieves split the loot and go their separate ways, but months later Beto's wife, embittered after he leaves her for another woman, informs on them. One by one they are arrested: Beto, the Paisa, Sebastián, Vitette, who surrenders, and finally Araujo, caught by gendarmes during a spiritual retreat in the mountains of San Juan. Later, Araujo walks out of prison to find Vitette waiting for him in a red car.

The script was co-written by producer Alex Zito and the real Araujo, and filming took place in Buenos Aires and Mendoza in 2019. Released by Warner Bros. on 16 January 2020, the film had the second-biggest opening day for an Argentine film, sold about two million tickets and received positive reviews.

documents.title: The Marvels
documents.overview: Carol Danvers, Monica Rambeau, and Kamala Khan trade places with each other every time they use their powers and must team up to fix their problem.
documents.plot:
The Marvels is a Marvel Studios superhero film from 2023, based on Marvel Comics. The sequel to Captain Marvel (2019) and a continuation of the miniseries Ms. Marvel (2022), it is the 33rd film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Nia DaCosta directed and co-wrote it with Megan McDonnell and Elissa Karasik. Brie Larson stars as Carol Danvers, with Teyonah Parris as Monica Rambeau, Iman Vellani as Kamala Khan, Zawe Ashton as Dar-Benn and Samuel L. Jackson as Nick Fury.

After Danvers destroyed the Supreme Intelligence, the artificial intelligence ruling the Kree, the resulting civil war left their home world, Hala, stripped of air, water and sunlight over thirty years, and the Kree came to call her "the Annihilator". Their new leader, Dar-Benn, finds one of a pair of legendary Quantum Bands and uses it to tear open a new jump point in the network used for travel across space, disrupting the whole system. When Danvers and Captain Monica Rambeau touch two affected jump points, they swap places with each other and with Kamala Khan, the teenage hero on Earth who wears the other Band, and the three fight Kree attackers, wrecking Kamala's home. Rambeau concludes that their light-based powers are entangled, swapping them whenever all use them at once.

The trio reunite at a Skrull refugee colony on the planet Tarnax, which Danvers helped found, where peace talks with the Kree collapse and Dar-Benn opens a jump point that drains Tarnax's atmosphere to replenish Hala. Calling themselves "the Marvels", the heroes realise that Dar-Benn is targeting worlds dear to Danvers and that her ruptures threaten the entire universe. On the water world Aladna, where people communicate in song, they warn Prince Yan, Danvers's husband by diplomatic arrangement, but Dar-Benn steals the planet's water. On Fury's space station, Danvers's Flerken Goose gives birth to kittens that swallow the crew to carry them to safety. Dar-Benn seizes Kamala's Band and is destroyed by using both at once, opening a rift between realities. Rambeau seals it but is trapped on the other side, while Danvers rekindles Hala's sun. Kamala begins recruiting young heroes, starting with Kate Bishop, and a mid-credits scene finds Rambeau in a parallel universe.

The film premiered in November 2023. Reviews were mixed, with 63% on Rotten Tomatoes, and it became the lowest-grossing film in the franchise, earning $206.1 million worldwide; Deadline Hollywood estimated its losses at $237 million.

documents.title: Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin
documents.overview: Margot, a documentary filmmaker, heads to a secluded Amish community in the hopes of learning about her long-lost mother and extended family. Following a string of strange occurrences and discoveries, she comes to realize this community may not be what it seems.
documents.plot:
Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin is a 2021 American supernatural horror film directed by William Eubank and written by Christopher Landon, produced by Jason Blum and series creator Oren Peli. A reboot and the seventh installment in the Paranormal Activity series, it stars Emily Bader as Margot, a documentary filmmaker, with Roland Buck III as her cameraman Chris, Dan Lippert as sound recordist Dale, Henry Ayres-Brown as Samuel and Tom Nowicki as Jacob. Like the earlier films, it is presented as found footage.

Margot, who was abandoned as a baby outside a hospital by her mother, Sarah, sets out with her friend Chris to make a documentary about her origins. Through a genetics website she connects with Samuel, a young relative from an Amish community, who leads Margot, Chris and Dale to the remote farm where her mother grew up. Jacob, the community's patriarch and Margot's grandfather, welcomes them, explaining that Sarah left after becoming pregnant and is presumed dead.

During their stay, strange events multiply: a little girl speaks cryptically about Sarah, Margot sees a spirit in her mother's old room, and the crew secretly witnesses a nocturnal ritual in which a two-headed goat is sacrificed. Breaking into the community's forbidden church, Margot and Chris discover paintings of the demon Asmodeus and a deep pit. They soon learn that the settlement is not truly Amish and that its members descend from a Norwegian village that trapped a demon inside a woman's body, passing it from mother to daughter through the generations. Margot realizes that she was lured to the farm because she is the next in line, and her friends must try to save her as the community prepares to complete the ritual.

The film moves the franchise away from its suburban home setting toward folk horror, with more polished visuals than earlier entries.

Originally planned for theatrical release, the film was delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic and premiered on Paramount+ on October 29, 2021. It received generally negative reviews, with 32 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 37.

documents.title: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
documents.original_title: ドラゴンボール超 スーパーヒーロー
documents.tagline: A super awakening and calamity is born.
documents.overview: The Red Ribbon Army, an evil organization that was once destroyed by Goku in the past, has been reformed by a group of people who have created new and mightier Androids, Gamma 1 and Gamma 2, and seek vengeance against Goku and his family.
documents.plot:
Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero is a 2022 Japanese animated martial arts fantasy adventure film and the sequel to Dragon Ball Super: Broly (2018). The twenty-first animated feature in the Dragon Ball franchise, it was the first to be produced mainly in CGI and the last Dragon Ball film made under the supervision of creator Akira Toriyama before his death in March 2024; Toriyama supplied the concept and character designs. Its Japanese voice cast includes Masako Nozawa, Toshio Furukawa, Yuko Minaguchi, Hiroshi Kamiya and Mamoru Miyano.

Commander Magenta, head of Red Pharmaceuticals, plans to revive the Red Ribbon Army, once led by his late father, Commander Red, before Goku destroyed it more than three decades earlier. With his assistant Carmine, he recruits Dr. Hedo, the superhero-obsessed grandson of Dr. Gero, a convicted grave robber, by convincing him that Bulma's Capsule Corporation is an evil organization bent on world domination. While Goku, Vegeta and Broly train on Beerus's planet, Piccolo, frustrated that Gohan is neglecting his potential, is attacked by the android Gamma 2 and follows him back to the Red Ribbon base. He learns that Hedo has built the androids Gamma 1 and Gamma 2 to defeat Capsule Corporation and has reluctantly used his grandfather's designs to create an improved Cell, known as Cell Max. Unable to reach Goku and Vegeta, Piccolo has the dragon Shenron unlock his full potential. Learning that Magenta plans to kidnap Gohan's daughter Pan to lure him into a trap, Piccolo volunteers to carry out the abduction himself and has Pan play along. Enraged, Gohan storms the base and overpowers Gamma 1 in his "Ultimate" form, while Piccolo unleashes a powerful new transformation against Gamma 2 and convinces him that Magenta has lied about Capsule Corporation. Turning against the Red Ribbon Army, the Gammas side with the heroes, but Magenta unleashes Cell Max, a giant, rampaging monster. Reinforced by Goten, Trunks, Android 18 and Krillin, the heroes fight back; Gamma 2 sacrifices himself in a failed attempt to destroy it, and after Piccolo is beaten, Gohan awakens a new "Beast" form and kills Cell Max with a Special Beam Cannon. Bulma then offers a repentant Hedo and Gamma 1 jobs at Capsule Corporation.

Delayed by a cyberattack at Toei Animation, the film was released in Japan on June 11, 2022, and internationally that August. It received positive reviews and grossed about US$102.5 million worldwide, the second-highest for a Dragon Ball film.

documents.title: Halloween Kills
documents.overview: The nightmare isn't over as unstoppable killer Michael Myers escapes from Laurie Strode's trap to continue his ritual bloodbath. Injured and taken to the hospital, Laurie fights through the pain as she inspires residents of Haddonfield, to rise up against Myers. Taking matters into their own hands, the Strode women and other survivors form a vigilante mob to hunt down Michael and end his reign of terror once and for all.
documents.plot:
Halloween Kills is a 2021 American slasher film from director David Gordon Green, who wrote it with Danny McBride and Scott Teems. It is the sequel to Halloween (2018) and the twelfth entry in the Halloween franchise. Jamie Lee Curtis returns as Laurie Strode alongside Judy Greer as her daughter Karen, Andi Matichak as granddaughter Allyson, Will Patton as Frank Hawkins and Anthony Michael Hall as Tommy Doyle, with James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle sharing the role of Michael Myers.

The story resumes on Halloween night 2018, moments after the previous film. Deputy Hawkins, stabbed and left for dead, is rescued and vows to finish Michael off; a flashback to 1978 shows a young Hawkins accidentally killing his own partner and stopping Dr. Loomis from shooting the captured Michael. While Laurie is rushed into surgery at Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, Michael escapes her burning house, slaughters the firefighters sent to put out the blaze and murders more locals as he heads back into town. At a bar, Tommy and fellow survivors of 1978, Marion Chambers, Lindsey Wallace and Lonnie Elam, are marking the anniversary of his capture when they learn of the killings. Tommy whips up a mob of vengeful townspeople to hunt Michael down, and Allyson joins them with her ex-boyfriend Cameron to avenge her father.

The mob realises Michael is heading for his childhood home, where he kills the current owners. At the hospital, the hysteria turns lethal when the crowd mistakes Lance Tivoli, an escaped mental patient, for Michael and chases him until he leaps to his death, despite Karen's efforts to stop them. Lonnie and Cameron are killed in the Myers house, but Karen stabs Michael with a pitchfork, takes his mask and lures him into the waiting mob, which appears to kill him. Michael rises and massacres them all, including Tommy and former sheriff Leigh Brackett, then kills Karen in his old house as Laurie watches from her hospital window.

Delayed a year by the COVID-19 pandemic, the film premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2021 and was released in October simultaneously in theatres and on Peacock. It grossed $133.4 million worldwide, but reviews were mixed, with 38% on Rotten Tomatoes and 42 on Metacritic. It was followed by Halloween Ends.

documents.title: See You Soon
documents.overview: A U.S. soccer star suffers a career-threatening injury in the run-up to the World Cup, and during his recovery, embarks on an epic romance with a Russian single mom.
documents.plot:
See You Soon (Russian: До скорой встречи) is a 2019 American-Russian romantic drama directed by David Mahmoudieh from a screenplay by Jenia Tanaeva and Mike Cestari. Tanaeva, who also produced, makes her screen debut as Lana Kalinina, a Russian single mother, opposite Liam McIntyre as the American soccer star Ryan Hawkes, with Harvey Keitel as Ryan's demanding agent, Poppy Drayton as his fiancée Elise, Oleg Taktarov as Lana's husband Ruslan and Larisa Malevannaya as her grandmother. Mark Isham composed the score, and Tanaeva has said the story was inspired by An Affair to Remember.

Ryan's World Cup hopes collapse when he suffers a potentially career-ending leg injury in a drunk-driving crash. Escaping the media frenzy and leaving behind his materialistic fiancée, he boards a luxury cruise ship to drink away his troubles. Lana, trapped in an unhappy marriage to the abusive, hard-drinking Ruslan, has left her young son Danny in the care of her loving grandmother and taken a temporary job as a bartender on the same ship.

Ryan flirts with her at the bar, and despite their very different lives the two are soon drawn together. After they spend an innocent night on a beach, Lana returns to the ship late and is fired, and the couple head off to a tropical resort, where their romance blossoms. Ryan wants to take the relationship further, but Lana proposes a test: if he still feels the same in two months, he should come and find her in a square in St. Petersburg at the start of the city's White Nights.

Back home, Lana leaves her husband, but a series of misfortunes conspires to keep the lovers apart. Danny suffers a life-threatening head injury, and Ryan is asked by the Make-A-Wish Foundation to visit sick children in a hospital. Through it all, Lana's young son may hold the key to bringing the couple together, and the story builds to Ryan's daring leap across a drawbridge and a triumphant return to the soccer field.

The film premiered on Russian television early in 2019 before Vertical Entertainment gave it a limited theatrical release in the United States on 26 July 2019. Critics were largely dismissive of its contrived plot and computer-generated backdrops: The Hollywood Reporter said it made Cinderella seem grittily realistic, and Variety described it as the best kind of bad movie, while several reviewers were puzzled by Keitel's presence.

documents.title: Violet Evergarden: Eternity and the Auto Memory Doll
documents.original_title: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン 外伝 - 永遠と自動手記人形 -
documents.overview: Isabella, the daughter of the noble York family, is enrolled in an all-girls academy to be groomed into a dame worthy of nobility. However, she has given up on her future, seeing the prestigious school as nothing more than a prison from the outside world. Her family notices her struggling in her lessons and decides to hire Violet Evergarden to personally tutor her under the guise of a handmaiden.  At first, Isabella treats Violet coldly. Violet seems to be able to do everything perfectly, leading Isabella to assume that she was born with a silver spoon. After some time, Isabella begins to realize that Violet has had her own struggles and starts to open up to her. Isabella soon reveals that she has lost contact with her beloved younger sister, whom she yearns to see again.  Having experienced the power of words through her past clientele, Violet asks if Isabella wishes to write a letter to Taylor. Will Violet be able to help Isabella convey her feelings to her long-lost sister?
documents.plot:
Violet Evergarden: Eternity and the Auto Memory Doll is a 2019 Japanese animated film based on Kana Akatsuki's light novel series Violet Evergarden. Produced by Kyoto Animation and distributed by Shochiku, it was directed by Haruka Fujita from a script by Takaaki Suzuki and Tatsuhiko Urahata. Yui Ishikawa voices Violet, with Minako Kotobuki, Aoi Yūki, Takehito Koyasu, Kouki Uchiyama and Aya Endo in the cast. The film was completed only a day before the arson attack on Kyoto Animation's studio in July 2019, and it was released in Japanese cinemas that September. Netflix began streaming it internationally in April 2020.

Set after the events of the anime series, the film follows Violet, a former child soldier who now works as an Auto Memory Doll, a professional writer of letters for those who cannot express their feelings. She is sent to a prestigious boarding school for girls at the request of a noble family to tutor Isabella York, who is being trained as a debutante before her presentation to society. Isabella is unhappy at the school, struggles to fit in and has no interest in the refined skills she is expected to master, and she suffers from periodic coughing fits.

Initially suspicious of Violet, Isabella warms to her when she realises that Violet has no interest in her aristocratic status. She eventually confides that she was born Amy Bartlett, the illegitimate child of the York family, and grew up in poverty, caring for an orphan named Taylor whom she raised as a younger sister. When the York family tracked her down and demanded that she join them, she accepted in exchange for a promise that Taylor would be given a better life. Before leaving the school, Violet helps Isabella write a letter to Taylor. Three years later, Taylor runs away from her orphanage and arrives at the CH Postal Company in Leiden, determined to become a postman like Benedict Blue, who once delivered her sister's letter. Violet teaches the girl to read, and together with Benedict they set out to find Isabella and deliver a letter of their own.

The film is structured in two parts, centred on the sisters Isabella and Taylor, and explores the bonds between family members separated by circumstance, as well as Violet's own growth in understanding human emotions. It was noted for the detailed, painterly animation characteristic of Kyoto Animation.

It was followed in 2020 by Violet Evergarden: The Movie, which concluded the story.

documents.title: The Knight Before Christmas
documents.tagline: A modern day romance with a medieval twist
documents.overview: A medieval English knight is magically transported to present day where he ends up falling for a high school science teacher.
documents.plot:
The Knight Before Christmas is a 2019 Christmas fantasy romantic comedy directed by Monika Mitchell and written by Cara J. Russell. Vanessa Hudgens stars as a small-town science teacher and Josh Whitehouse as a medieval knight transported to the present day, with Emmanuelle Chriqui, Harry Jarvis and Ella Kenion in supporting roles. It was filmed in Ontario, with Charleville Castle in Ireland standing in for the knight's home, and released on Netflix on November 21, 2019.

In 1334, near Norwich, England, the knight Sir Cole Lyons takes part in a Christmas hawking contest with his brother, Geoffrey. In the woods, Cole meets an old woman and kindly offers to escort her to shelter.
