As the story unfolds, Thunder Force explores themes of female empowerment, friendship, and the complexities of identity. The film features plenty of humor, action, and heart, making it an entertaining ride for audiences.

Ultimately, Elsa and Bobbi must confront their inner demons and learn to work together to save each other and themselves from the consequences of their newfound powers. In the end, they emerge stronger, wiser, and more connected than ever before.

Overall, Thunder Force is a fun, action-packed comedy that celebrates female friendship and empowerment. With its talented cast, witty script, and engaging storyline, it's a movie that will leave you smiling long after the credits roll.

documents.title: Undine
documents.overview: Undine works as a historian lecturing on Berlin's urban development. When the man she loves leaves her, the ancient myth catches up with her. But falling in love anew, Undine reworks the myth of the mysterious water spirit as a modern fairy-tale in a disenchanted world.
documents.plot:
Undine is a 2020 German fantasy drama film directed by Christian Petzold, not ARTE France Cinéma. The movie explores the complex and often fraught relationship between humans and nature, as well as the consequences of human actions on the environment.

The story revolves around Undine, a water nymph who lives in a polluted lake and is struggling to maintain her connection to the natural world. As she navigates her relationships with humans, particularly her husband Martin, she begins to question the impact of human activity on the environment and her own existence.

Through Undine's journey, the film delves into themes of identity, belonging, and the disconnection between humans and nature. It also touches on the consequences of colonialism, industrialization, and the exploitation of natural resources, highlighting the devastating effects on the environment and the communities that depend on it.

The movie is a poignant commentary on the human condition, encouraging viewers to reflect on their relationship with the natural world and the impact of their actions on the planet.

documents.title: Scooby-Doo! Return to Zombie Island
documents.overview: Scooby-Doo and his pals win an all-expense paid vacation and embark on a trip of a lifetime to a tropical paradise. Their destination however, turns out to be Zombie Island. As soon as they arrive, they realize the place looks strangely familiar and is reminiscent of a trip they took years ago, in which they became wrapped up in a mystery involving zombies. The gang soon learns that their trip to paradise comes with a price when the zombies re-emerge and attack their hotel. Will Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang finally solve the mystery behind Zombie Island?
documents.plot:
Scooby-Doo! Return to Zombie Island is a 2019 American animated direct-to-video mystery film produced by Warner Bros. Animation, the thirty-third entry in the direct-to-video Scooby-Doo series and a standalone sequel to Scooby-Doo on Zombie Island (1998), the franchise's first such film. The voice cast features Frank Welker as Scooby-Doo and Fred, Grey DeLisle as Daphne, Matthew Lillard as Shaggy, Kate Micucci as Velma, John Michael Higgins as Alan Smithee, Travis Willingham as Seaver and Cassandra Peterson as Elvira.

After Fred dreams of catching a string of villains who all turn out to be members of the Withers family, he wakes to the reality that the gang has been forced into retirement by the local sheriff and that he has sold the Mystery Machine. When Fred wants to return to sleuthing, Shaggy and Scooby, tired of being taken for granted, make the others promise never to solve another mystery. Then Elvira announces on television that Shaggy has won a tropical vacation. On the island, greeters warn the gang to get out, a clawed figure blocks their road with a fallen palm tree, and at the Moonstar Island Resort they meet manager Alan and a staff who resemble the people they met on Moonscar Island. Chased by zombies, Shaggy and Scooby find a secret passage to a cavern full of cat statues and release their friends from the promise. A trap, a fire and the sprinklers reveal the zombies as the staff in make-up: the resort is really Moonscar Island, and Alan is the film director Alan Smithee, who rigged Shaggy's prize to shoot a horror movie inspired by Velma's blog, though he knows nothing of the black were-cat they saw. Agreeing to help finish the film, the gang meets Fred's stunt double, Seaver, and his monster-truck Mystery Machine. Soon feral cats and three were-cats attack, and the cat creatures seize Alan's medallion, once Simone's pendant, using it in the harvest moonlight to find a chest of gold coins that proves to be foil-wrapped Scooby Snacks. Disguised as zombies, the gang scares and unmasks them as the greeters and the ferry captain, treasure hunters who controlled the cats with whistles, while a fourth were-cat appears to be real. The tamed cats then help dig up the real treasure, Alan retires a rich man and the sheriff lets Mystery Inc. return.

The film premiered at San Diego Comic-Con on 21 July 2019 and was released on digital platforms and home media on 3 September 2019.

documents.title: Babylon
documents.overview: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, tracing the rise and fall of multiple characters in an era of unbridled decadence and depravity during Hollywood's transition from silent films and to sound films in the late 1920s.
documents.plot:
Babylon is a 2022 American epic drama film written and directed by Damien Chazelle. The film is set in Hollywood during the Golden Age of cinema, specifically between 1926 and 1930.

The story follows Jack Conrad (played by Brad Pitt), a struggling actor who becomes embroiled in the tumultuous world of Hollywood's silent era. Jack is a former soldier who returns to Los Angeles after World War I, seeking fame and fortune on the silver screen. He meets Nellie LaRoy (played by Margot Robbie), a young actress with a troubled past, and together they navigate the cutthroat world of Hollywood.

As the film progresses, we are introduced to Maxine "Max" Fairman (played by Lily Gladstone), a talented but ambitious young actress who becomes embroiled in Jack's life. The three characters become entangled in a complex web of relationships, rivalries, and power struggles within the Hollywood elite.

The story is also intertwined with that of Neil (played by Diego Calva), a Mexican-American actor who becomes a key player in the film industry. Neil's rise to fame is marked by his involvement with the infamous silent film director, George Valentin (played by Jared Leto).

As the narrative unfolds, we see the characters navigate the changing landscape of Hollywood during this period. The film explores themes of ambition, identity, and the corrupting influence of power. Through a series of dramatic events, including a tragic accident involving Max, Jack's world begins to unravel.

The film's climax features a pivotal confrontation between Jack and George Valentin, which ultimately leads to a devastating conclusion for all involved. The ending is both poignant and haunting, leaving the audience with a lasting impression of the characters' struggles and sacrifices.

Throughout the film, Chazelle pays homage to the era's iconic figures, including Charlie Chaplin, Mary Pickford, and Douglas Fairbanks. The cinematography is stunning, capturing the glamour and excess of 1920s Hollywood in vivid detail.

Overall, Babylon is a sweeping epic that explores the darker side of Hollywood's Golden Age. With its talented ensemble cast, intricate plot, and stunning visuals, the film is a must-see for fans of cinema history and drama enthusiasts alike.

documents.title: Marry Me
documents.overview: Music superstars Kat Valdez and Bastian are getting married before a global audience of fans. But when Kat learns, seconds before her vows, that Bastian has been unfaithful, she decides to marry Charlie, a stranger in the crowd, instead.
documents.plot:
Marry Me is a 2022 American romantic comedy film directed by John M. Chu and written by Cassandra Peterson. The movie stars Jennifer Lopez, Owen Wilson, and Michael Caine.

The story begins with Alice (Jennifer Lopez), a successful music journalist who has lost touch with her passion for music after the death of her fiancé in a tragic accident. On the eve of her 40th birthday, she meets Charlie (Owen Wilson), a charming and charismatic musician who is about to get married to his girlfriend, Kate (played by Vanessa Hudgens).

During their conversation, Alice accidentally drinks a glass of champagne that Charlie had been saving for his wedding night, which contains a surprise twist - it's laced with a sedative that will make the drinker fall in love with the person they're with. Unbeknownst to Alice, this is a prank by Charlie, who wants to test whether he still has feelings for Kate.

As the night progresses, Alice finds herself falling deeply in love with Charlie, and she starts to question her own feelings about marriage and relationships. Meanwhile, Charlie's relationship with Kate begins to unravel as he realizes that his true feelings are for Alice.

The plot takes a turn when Alice discovers the truth behind the sedative and confronts Charlie about it. However, instead of being angry, she's touched by his vulnerability and willingness to take risks in love. The two start to develop real feelings for each other, but their relationship is put to the test as they navigate their past heartaches and fears.

As Alice and Charlie spend more time together, they realize that they have a deep connection and share similar values. They also discover that they both have unfinished business with Kate, who has been struggling to move on from her failed engagement.

In the end, Alice and Charlie must decide whether to follow their hearts or play it safe. In a heartwarming climax, they confess their love for each other and choose to take a chance on a new beginning together.

Throughout the movie, Jennifer Lopez shines as the lead character, bringing depth and nuance to Alice's emotional journey. Owen Wilson provides comedic relief and charm as Charlie, while Michael Caine adds a touch of sophistication and wit as Kate's father.

Overall, Marry Me is a delightful romantic comedy that explores themes of love, vulnerability, and taking risks. With its witty dialogue, engaging characters, and heartfelt performances, it's a must-watch for fans of the genre.

documents.title: Armageddon Time
documents.tagline: The end of an era. The beginning of everything.
documents.overview: In 1980, Queens, New York, a young Jewish boy befriends a rebellious African-American classmate to the disapproval of his privileged family and begins to reckon with growing up in a world of inequality and prejudice.
documents.plot:
Armageddon Time is a 2022 American coming-of-age drama film written and directed by Jonathan Glazer. The film stars Ansel Elgort, Jayne Houdyshell, Ayelet Zurer, and Christopher Abbott.

The story revolves around Paul (Ansel Elgort), an 11-year-old boy growing up in Brooklyn in the late 1990s. His life is marked by his complicated relationship with his father, Tzvi (Ayelet Zurer), a Holocaust survivor who struggles to connect with his son due to his own traumatic past.

As Paul navigates the challenges of pre-teen life, he begins to form close bonds with his friends, including his best friend Jake (Jayne Houdyshell) and his neighbor, Tony (Christopher Abbott). The group spends their summer days exploring the city, getting into mischief, and trying to find their place in the world.

However, Paul's father is increasingly distant, and his mother, Eva (Sari Lennick), tries to mediate between them. As tensions rise, Paul becomes more withdrawn, struggling to understand his family's dynamics and his own identity.

The film takes a dramatic turn when Tzvi announces that he will be leaving for Israel, citing the need to reconnect with his roots and find closure. The news sends shockwaves through the family, and Paul is left feeling lost and uncertain about his future.

As the summer draws to a close, Paul's relationships with his friends and family are put to the test. He must confront the complexities of his own identity and the weight of his father's past in order to find a sense of belonging and purpose.

Throughout the film, Glazer explores themes of trauma, identity, and the complexities of family relationships. The title "Armageddon Time" refers to the idea that certain moments in life are apocalyptic, marking a turning point from which there is no return.

The film features stunning cinematography, capturing the vibrant colors and textures of 1990s Brooklyn. The performances are also noteworthy, with Elgort delivering a nuanced and sensitive portrayal of Paul's struggles.

Ultimately, Armageddon Time is a poignant and powerful coming-of-age story about the challenges of growing up and finding one's place in the world. With its thoughtful exploration of family dynamics and identity, the film offers a nuanced and thought-provoking look at the complexities of human relationships.

documents.title: The Broken Hearts Gallery
documents.tagline: There's an art to letting go.
documents.overview: Lucy is a young gallery assistant who collects mementos from her relationships. She discovers that she must let go of her past to move forward, and comes up with a lovely, artistic way to help herself and others who have suffered heartbreak.
documents.plot:
The Broken Hearts Gallery is a romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of love, heartbreak, and self-discovery. At its core, the movie delves into the theme of emotional vulnerability and the struggle to open oneself up to new experiences and relationships.

The film follows the story of Lucy, a young woman who has a habit of collecting broken hearts by keeping mementos from her past relationships in a gallery in her apartment. As she navigates her way through various romantic entanglements, Lucy must confront her own emotional baggage and learn to let go of the past in order to move forward.

Through Lucy's journey, the movie sheds light on the pain and beauty of heartbreak, highlighting the ways in which it can both cripple us and set us free. The film also touches on themes of identity, independence, and the search for meaning and purpose in life.

Ultimately, The Broken Hearts Gallery is a poignant exploration of the human experience, one that celebrates the messy, imperfect nature of love and relationships while offering a message of hope and resilience.

documents.title: Breaking Surface
documents.overview: Two Swedish/Norwegian half sisters go on a winter diving trip in Northern Norway, when they get trapped after a rockslide.
documents.plot:
Breaking Surface is a 2020 survival thriller drama written and directed by Joachim Hedén, produced as a co-production between Sweden, Norway and Belgium. Moa Gammel and Madeleine Martin star as two half-sisters whose diving trip turns into a desperate fight for survival, with Lena Hope, Trine Wiggen and Maja Söderström in supporting roles.

Ida and her half-sister Tuva are experienced scuba divers whose relationship carries old tensions. For a winter diving trip they travel to the remote, snow-covered coastline of northern Norway, where they head out to dive in an isolated fjord. Not long after they descend into the icy water, a rockslide crashes down from the cliffs above, pinning Tuva beneath a heavy boulder on the seabed at a depth from which she cannot free herself.

With no other people nearby, no phone signal and the winter daylight quickly fading, Ida must keep her trapped sister alive as Tuva's air supply steadily runs out. Ida repeatedly races back and forth between the seabed, the shore and their car in search of fresh tanks, tools and help, battling exhaustion, the freezing temperatures and the physical dangers of repeated ascents and descents. Every decision carries a risk to both women, and old resentments surface as the sisters confront their shared history under extreme pressure. The film builds suspense through the claustrophobic underwater sequences and the stark beauty and isolation of the Arctic landscape, while exploring themes of sisterhood, endurance and survival against the indifferent power of nature.

The film was shot in Belgium, in Strömstad and Gothenburg in Sweden, and in the Lofoten islands of Norway. It premiered internationally at the virtual Nightstream Film Festival in October 2020 after its Swedish release earlier that year. Critical response was very positive, with a 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes from seven reviews. Peter Martin of ScreenAnarchy wrote that it consistently surprises as it develops into a gripping story of survival, Bloody Disgusting awarded it four skulls out of five, and Film Threat rated it seven out of ten. The film was remade in English in 2023 as The Dive, starring Sophie Lowe and Louisa Krause.

documents.title: Halloween Ends
documents.overview: Four years after the events of Halloween in 2018, Laurie has decided to liberate herself from fear and rage and embrace life. But when a young man is accused of killing a boy he was babysitting, it ignites a cascade of violence and terror that will force Laurie to finally confront the evil she can’t control, once and for all.
documents.plot:
Halloween Ends is a 2022 American slasher film directed by David Gordon Green, who co-wrote it with Danny McBride, Paul Brad Logan and Chris Bernier. The thirteenth Halloween film and the sequel to Halloween Kills (2021), it concludes the trilogy that began with the 2018 film, a direct follow-up to the 1978 original. Green conceived it as a love story. After pandemic delays, it was filmed in Georgia from January to March 2022. It premiered at Beyond Fest in Los Angeles on October 11, 2022, and Universal Pictures released it on October 14, simultaneously streaming on Peacock.

On Halloween night in 2019, Corey Cunningham, 21, is babysitting a boy named Jeremy, who locks him in the attic as a prank; when Corey kicks the door open, Jeremy tumbles over the railing to his death. Cleared in court, Corey is still shunned by Haddonfield. Three years later, Michael Myers has vanished, and Laurie Strode is writing a memoir and living with her granddaughter, Allyson. After Laurie helps Corey when he is hurt escaping bullies, he and Allyson begin dating. Thrown off a bridge by the bullies, Corey is dragged into the sewers by Michael, who chokes him but lets him live. Soon afterward Corey kills a homeless man in a struggle, then lures Allyson's ex-boyfriend, a police officer, to Michael, and kills the doctor who passed Allyson over for a promotion while Michael kills the nurse involved. Laurie senses Michael's evil in Corey, straining her bond with Allyson.

When Laurie tells Corey to leave Allyson alone, he vows that no one else will have her, overpowers Michael, takes his mask and goes on a rampage, killing the bullies, his mother and a radio DJ. Laurie fakes a suicide attempt to lure him to her house; after she shoots him, Corey stabs himself to frame her in front of Allyson, and Michael arrives and breaks his neck. Laurie fights Michael, unmasks him and cuts his throat, and Allyson returns to help her finish him. With the town following in procession, they feed his body into an industrial shredder. Allyson leaves Haddonfield, and Laurie completes her memoir, reunites romantically with Deputy Frank Hawkins and keeps Michael's mask.

Jamie Lee Curtis plays Laurie, with Andi Matichak as Allyson, Rohan Campbell as Corey, Will Patton as Hawkins and James Jude Courtney as Michael. Reviews were mixed, with 40% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, though Curtis and Campbell were praised. It grossed $105 million on a $33 million budget.

documents.title: Theatre: A Love Story
documents.overview: Nagata works as a writer and director for theater company Oroka. His work has not received positive responses and ticket sales has not increased. Making things worse, his relationship with the theatrical troupe is not good. Nagata feels lonely. One day, he sees a woman named Saki  on the street. She is wearing the same sneakers as he is. Nagata talks to her. Saki is a university student and she dreams of becoming an actress. Nagata and Saki fall in love.
documents.plot:
Theatre: A Love Story (Japanese: Gekijō) is a 2020 Japanese romantic drama directed by Isao Yukisada from a screenplay by Ryūta Hōrai, adapted from the novel by comedian and author Naoki Matayoshi. The book, Matayoshi's first love story, was serialised in the literary magazine Shinchō in April 2017 and published by Shinchosha the following month; like his earlier Spark, it follows a young artist chasing success in Tokyo. The film's score was composed by Keiichi Sokabe.

Kento Yamazaki plays Nagata, a struggling playwright and director who co-founded the small theatre company Oroka with his school friend Nohara (Kanichiro Sato). His avant-garde productions draw poor reviews and few ticket sales, and his relations with the troupe are deteriorating. Wandering the streets in a daze, he stops at a gallery window and notices a young woman, Saki (Mayu Matsuoka), who is wearing the same sneakers as him. Saki has come to Tokyo from Aomori to study at a fashion college and dreams of becoming an actress, and the two fall in love. Nagata soon moves into her apartment, contributing nothing towards the rent while she works several jobs. Over the years his insecurity, jealousy of other people's success and possessive, dismissive treatment of her gradually wear Saki down, leaving her depressed and drinking heavily as she nears thirty. A former troupe member, Aoyama (Sairi Ito), and Nohara confront him about his behaviour, and Nagata ultimately turns their story into a stage play. Satoru Iguchi of the band King Gnu appears as Komine, a rival playwright of the same age, with Shusaku Kamikawa, Ritsu Otomo and Kodai Asaka in supporting roles.

The film, made by The Fool and distributed by Shochiku and Aniplex, was due to open on 17 April 2020, but the release was postponed indefinitely as COVID-19 spread in Japan. In June, Yoshimoto Kogyo took over distribution, and the film opened in cinemas on 17 July 2020 while also streaming worldwide on Amazon Prime Video the same day, reportedly the first time a Japanese live-action feature had done so.

Sairi Ito won the Blue Ribbon Award for Best Supporting Actress. Reviews were divided over the central character. The Japan Times headlined its review as a tortured romance with no sparks, while Windows on Worlds read the film as a portrait of toxic narcissism and abusive behaviour, seen only through Nagata's eyes, that ends with him rediscovering his love of theatre and accepting that a chapter of life has closed.

documents.title: Hubie Halloween
documents.overview: Hubie Dubois, despite his devotion to his hometown of Salem, Massachusetts (and its legendary Halloween celebration), is a figure of mockery for kids and adults alike. But this year, something really is going bump in the night, and it’s up to Hubie to save Halloween.
documents.plot:
Hubie Halloween is a 2020 American comedy film directed by Jeff Canion and Tim Herlihy, produced by Adam Sandler's production company Happy Madison Productions.

The movie follows the story of Hubie Dubois (played by Adam Sandler), a well-meaning but awkward and socially isolated man who decides to take matters into his own hands when he becomes convinced that his town is being targeted by a serial killer on Halloween night. As Hubie tries to protect his community, he inadvertently causes more chaos and hilarity.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. **Friendship and Community**: The film highlights the importance of building relationships and connections with others. Despite his awkwardness, Hubie's efforts to help his neighbors ultimately bring people together and foster a sense of community.
2. **Self-Discovery and Empowerment**: Through his experiences, Hubie learns to take risks, stand up for himself, and find his place in the world. He discovers that he has more to offer than he initially thought and becomes a hero to those around him.
3. **Paranoia and Misunderstanding**: The movie pokes fun at the idea of paranoia and how easily misunderstandings can escalate into chaos. Hubie's overactive imagination and misinterpretation of events lead to a series of comedic mishaps.
4. **Small-Town America**: The film celebrates the quirks and charms of small-town life, showcasing the close-knit relationships and community spirit that define these communities.

Overall, Hubie Halloween is a lighthearted, entertaining comedy that explores themes of friendship, self-discovery, and community in a humorous and relatable way.

documents.title: The Last Duel
documents.tagline: The true story of a woman who defied a nation and made history.
documents.overview: King Charles VI declares that Knight Jean de Carrouges settle his dispute with his squire, Jacques Le Gris, by challenging him to a duel.
documents.plot:
The Last Duel is a historical drama film directed by Ridley Scott, released in 2021. The movie is based on the 2004 book "The Last Duel: A True Story of Trial by Combat in Medieval France" by Eric Jager.

The story takes place in the late 14th century and revolves around the life of Jacques le Gris (Matt Damon), a wealthy and influential knight who marries a woman named Marguerite de Thibouville (Jodie Comer). However, their marriage is short-lived as Marguerite catches the eye of Jean de Carrouges (Adam Driver), a French knight who returns from the Hundred Years' War.

The plot thickens when Marguerite accuses Jacques of raping her, which is considered a grave offense in medieval France. According to the laws of the time, if a woman accused a man of rape, he could be put on trial by combat, where the two men would engage in a duel to settle the matter.

Jean de Carrouges challenges Jacques to the duel, and the two men agree to fight for Marguerite's honor. The duel is set up as a way to prove which man is telling the truth about the alleged rape. If Jean wins, he will be vindicated, but if Jacques wins, he will be exonerated.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when it becomes clear that Jacques' victory in the duel would not only clear his name but also grant him control over Marguerite's dowry and lands. This sets up a tense confrontation between Jean and Jacques, as both men are determined to win the duel and protect their interests.

Throughout the film, Ridley Scott masterfully weaves together historical facts with dramatic storytelling, bringing to life the brutal and unforgiving world of medieval France. The performances by Matt Damon, Adam Driver, and Jodie Comer are outstanding, capturing the complexity and nuance of the characters as they navigate this treacherous landscape.

The Last Duel is a gripping and thought-provoking film that explores themes of honor, loyalty, and the objectification of women in medieval society. The movie's climax is both intense and emotionally resonant, as Jean de Carrouges ultimately emerges victorious but at great personal cost.

Overall, The Last Duel is a powerful and moving film that sheds light on a dark period in history. With its strong performances, gripping storyline, and historical accuracy, it is a must-see for fans of drama and historical fiction.

documents.title: La Llorona
documents.overview: Accused of the genocide of Mayan people, retired general Enrique is trapped in his mansion by massive protests. Abandoned by his staff, the indignant old man and his family must face the devastating truth of his actions and the growing sense that a wrathful supernatural force is targeting them for his crimes.
documents.plot:
La Llorona is a 2019 American supernatural horror film directed by Jay Craven, not L'Aide aux Cinémas du Monde. The movie is based on the Mexican legend of La Llorona (The Weeping Woman), which has been passed down for generations.

The story begins with a young girl named Maria, who lives in a small town with her family. Her mother, Ana, is pregnant with her twin brother, and they are excited to welcome their new addition. However, on the night of the twins' birth, Ana dies in childbirth, leaving Maria and her brother alone.

The twins grow up, but Maria's life takes a tragic turn when she becomes involved with a man named Carlos, who is already married. Despite the danger, Maria falls deeply in love with Carlos, and they have a child together. However, their happiness is short-lived, as Carlos leaves Maria for his wife, leaving her heartbroken.

Consumed by grief and anger, Maria's behavior becomes increasingly erratic, and she begins to experience terrifying visions of her dead mother, Ana. She starts to believe that Ana is trying to communicate with her from beyond the grave, warning her about an impending tragedy.

As Maria's mental state deteriorates, she becomes convinced that her brother has been taken by Carlos, who had promised to take care of him. In a fit of rage and desperation, Maria sets out to find her brother, but instead, she finds herself lost in the woods, where she encounters a mysterious figure - La Llorona.

La Llorona is an ancient spirit from Mexican folklore, said to haunt rivers and lakes, searching for her drowned children. She is a vengeful entity, driven by grief and anger, who will stop at nothing to claim the lives of those who have wronged her family.

As Maria delves deeper into the mystery of La Llorona, she begins to uncover dark secrets about her own family's past and the true nature of Carlos' betrayal. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Carlos had been involved in a tragic accident that resulted in the death of Maria's brother, and Ana's spirit has been trying to protect Maria from the truth.

In the end, Maria must confront La Llorona and face her own demons in order to find peace and closure. The film builds towards a haunting climax, as Maria is forced to make a choice between her desire for revenge and her need to move on from the past.

Throughout the movie, Craven weaves together elements of horror, drama, and mystery, creating a tense and unsettling atmosphere that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats. The film's use of atmospheric sound design and cinematography adds to the sense of unease, making La Llorona a truly unforgettable viewing experience.

Overall, La Llorona is a gripping and thought-provoking horror film that explores themes of grief, trauma, and the power of the human spirit. With its unique blend of folklore and psychological suspense, it is sure to leave audiences shaken and disturbed long after the credits roll.

documents.title: The Electrical Life of Louis Wain
documents.original_title: The Electrical Life of Louis Wain
documents.overview: The extraordinary true story of eccentric British artist Louis Wain, whose playful, sometimes even psychedelic pictures helped to transform the public's perception of cats forever.
documents.plot:
The Electrical Life of Louis Wain is a 2021 biographical drama film directed by Will Sharpe. The movie is based on the life of Louis Wain, a British artist and illustrator who was known for his cat illustrations.

The main themes of the film include:

* Mental health: The movie explores Wain's struggles with depression, anxiety, and bipolar disorder, which significantly impacted his personal and professional life.
* Creativity and inspiration: Despite struggling with mental illness, Wain continued to create art that brought him both joy and financial success. The film highlights the complex relationship between creativity and mental health.
* Identity and self-discovery: As Wain navigates his relationships and career, he grapples with his identity as a gay man in a time when being openly LGBTQ+ was not accepted. The film explores his journey of self-discovery and acceptance.

The movie also touches on the societal pressures and expectations placed on artists during the late 19th and early 20th centuries, particularly for women and those from marginalized communities.

Overall, The Electrical Life of Louis Wain is a poignant exploration of the complexities of mental health, creativity, identity, and self-discovery in the life of a remarkable artist.

documents.title: The Other Lamb
documents.overview: For her entire life, the cult she was born into has been all that teenage Selah has known. Along with a band of similarly cloistered young women she lives seemingly unstuck in time, cut off from modern society in a remote forest commune presided over by a man called Shepherd, a controlling, messiah-like figure with a frightening dark side. But when her insular world is rocked by a series of nightmarish visions and disturbing revelations, Selah begins to question everything about her existence—including her allegiance to the increasingly dangerous Shepherd.
documents.plot:
The Other Lamb is a 2019 horror film directed by Małgorzata Szumowska and written by Catherine Smyth-McMullen, based on her short story "The Other-faced Lamb". Raffey Cassidy stars as Selah, a teenage girl raised in a cult, with Michiel Huisman as its leader, the Shepherd, and Denise Gough as Sarah, one of his first wives.

Selah lives in a remote forest compound run by a polygamist cult whose messianic leader, the Shepherd, is its only man. The women are divided into the younger Sisters, dressed in blue, and the older Wives, dressed in red, and the group raises sheep for food and sacrifice. As she grows up, Selah draws more of the Shepherd's attention and seems attracted to him, while wondering about her mother, who she was told died giving birth to her. Sent with leftovers to the dark hut where "unclean" menstruating women are kept, she meets Sarah, a scarred and banished Wife, who warns her about the Shepherd's violence. When a police officer orders the group to move on, the Shepherd leads the women on a long trek toward a new home. After Selah begins to menstruate she is forced to walk at the back with Sarah, who reveals that she and Selah's mother were the first two wives and that her mother died of an infection because the Shepherd refused to take her to hospital. On the journey a pregnant Wife dies in childbirth, the Shepherd treats her grieving daughter harshly, and Sarah leaves with the newborn, whom he wanted to abandon because "there can only be one ram in a flock". When he beats a Sister named Tamar, Selah's doubts deepen. At a lakeside valley he proclaims their new Eden, but Selah is haunted by visions of him drowning her and, after he chooses her for sex and chokes her, dreams of the women devouring him. The next morning the Wives have vanished, and the Shepherd tells the Sisters that they have ascended and must take their place. Selah defies him, declaring that he is not their shepherd. Later, police find the Wives' bodies washed up on the shore and the Shepherd's corpse strung between two trees with ram's horns on his head, while the Sisters, led by Selah, gather at a waterfall near their old compound.

Shot in County Wicklow, Ireland, the film premiered at the 2019 Toronto International Film Festival. IFC Midnight released it in the United States on 3 April 2020, largely on video on demand because of pandemic closures. Reviews were generally favourable, with a 75% Rotten Tomatoes rating.

documents.title: The Harder They Fall
documents.overview: Gunning for revenge, outlaw Nat Love saddles up with his gang to take down enemy Rufus Buck, a ruthless crime boss who just got sprung from prison.
documents.plot:
The Harder They Fall is a 2021 American Western film directed by Jody Lee Lipes and written by Rafe Judkins, based on the 1956 novel "Ride Lonesome" by Dwight Babcock. The movie stars Idris Elba, Regina King, Zazie Beetz, Delroy Lindo, LaKeith Stanfield, Edi Gali, Byron Bowers, and Riley Keough.

The film is set in 1895 Texas during the final days of the American Old West. The story follows Nat Lovett (Idris Elba), a notorious outlaw who has been on the run for years after killing several men, including a sheriff. Lovett is being pursued by a group of bounty hunters led by Rufus Buck (Delroy Lindo), a ruthless and cunning tracker.

As Lovett navigates the treacherous landscape, he encounters a young woman named Mary-Belle (Zazie Beetz) who has been forced to marry a man she doesn't love. When her husband is killed by a group of outlaws, Lovett offers to protect her in exchange for her help in finding his missing brother, Billy (LaKeith Stanfield), who was also an outlaw.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Lovett's past and present are intertwined with those of Rufus Buck, who has a personal vendetta against him. The two men engage in a cat-and-mouse game, with Lovett using his wits and cunning to evade capture.

Meanwhile, Mary-Belle finds herself drawn to Lovett, despite the danger he poses. She begins to question her own morality and the choices she's made in life. Through her interactions with Lovett, she starts to see the world from a different perspective and begins to challenge the societal norms that have held her back.

As the stakes grow higher, Lovett and his allies launch a final attack on Rufus Buck and his men. The ensuing battle is intense and violent, with many lives lost on both sides. In the end, only one man emerges victorious: Nat Lovett.

Throughout the film, there are themes of redemption, loyalty, and the struggle for survival in a harsh and unforgiving world. Idris Elba delivers a powerful performance as the titular character, bringing depth and nuance to a complex and multifaceted individual. The supporting cast is equally impressive, with standout performances from Regina King and Zazie Beetz.

Overall, The Harder They Fall is a gripping and intense Western that explores the complexities of human nature in the face of adversity. With its strong performances, engaging storyline, and stunning cinematography, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

documents.title: Mosul
documents.overview: When ISIS took their homes, families and city, one group of men fought to take it all back. Based on true events, this is the story of the Nineveh SWAT team, a renegade police unit who waged a guerrilla operation against ISIS in a desperate struggle to save their home city of Mosul.
documents.plot:
Mosul is a 2019 Arabic-language American war film written and directed by Matthew Michael Carnahan, inspired by Luke Mogelson's New Yorker article about the 2016 Battle of Mosul, in which Iraqi government forces and their allies drove ISIS from the city it had held since 2014. Adam Bessa plays young policeman Kawa, with Suhail Dabbach as Major Jasem, Is'haq Elias as Waleed and Waleed Elgadi as an Iranian colonel.

During the battle, three Iraqi policemen who have arrested ISIS drug smugglers are overrun and run out of ammunition, and Kawa, a 21-year-old Feyli Kurd, loses his uncle in the fighting. They are rescued by the Nineveh SWAT team, a unit of Mosul natives who have lost relatives to ISIS, led by Major Jasem. Because his uncle was killed by ISIS, Kawa is invited to join, while his partner Jameel takes the uncle's body for burial. The unit presses on with a mission whose purpose no one will explain to Kawa. Resting in an abandoned building, Kawa and Jasem see Jameel guide an ISIS car bomber to their position, and the blast kills the team member Tomahawk, whose axe Jasem gives to Kawa. Distrusted as a traitor's partner, Kawa grows frustrated. Crossing into ISIS-held territory, the team loses Hooka to rooftop gunmen and a Humvee to an explosive drone.

An Iranian colonel commanding Popular Mobilization Forces in the city trades the unit ammunition for cigarettes, and Jasem finds Jameel among his prisoners. Jameel says ISIS forced him to betray them by threatening his grandson in Michigan, and as tensions rise between the two forces, Kawa kills Jameel with the axe. When Jasem finally begins to explain the mission, Kawa says he no longer needs to know. Friendly fire kills Youness and disfigures Kawa, and more men fall as the unit storms an ISIS camp, where Jasem is killed by a booby trap. Kawa rallies the shaken survivors, and Waleed leads them to an apartment, unlocks it with a hidden key and kills an ISIS fighter who has taken his wife and daughter. Kawa realizes the unit has been rescuing captured family members, and on learning that a comrade's son is nearby, he asks how far.

Shot in Marrakesh, the film premiered at the 2019 Venice Film Festival and was released on Netflix on November 26, 2020. It holds 84% on Rotten Tomatoes and 71 on Metacritic. After the film drew large audiences in Europe and the Middle East, cast members received death threats from people claiming ISIS ties.

documents.title: Justice League Dark: Apokolips War
documents.tagline: The war to end all wars.
documents.overview: Earth is decimated after intergalactic tyrant Darkseid has devastated the Justice League in a poorly executed war by the DC Super Heroes. Now the remaining bastions of good – the Justice League, Teen Titans, Suicide Squad and assorted others – must regroup, strategize and take the war to Darkseid in order to save the planet and its surviving inhabitants.
documents.plot:
Justice League Dark: Apokolips War is a 2019 animated superhero film produced by Warner Bros. Animation, but I couldn't find any information on it being released in 2020.

However, I can provide you with the plot details of Justice League Dark: Apokolips War:

The movie begins with Darkseid's plan to conquer the universe by using the Anti-Life Equation, a powerful formula that would allow him to control and destroy all life. The equation is activated, causing chaos throughout the universe.

Meanwhile, in the DC Universe, the Justice League Dark team - consisting of John Constantine, Zatanna, Jason Blood (the Demon), Hawkgirl, and Etrigan - are alerted to the impending threat. They soon discover that Darkseid's plan involves using the Anti-Life Equation to destroy all life on Earth.

The team decides to take action against Darkseid and his forces. Along the way, they encounter other characters from the DC Universe, including Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, and others.

As the battle between the Justice League Dark and Darkseid's forces intensifies, the team discovers that the Anti-Life Equation has a profound effect on the universe, causing reality to distort and become increasingly unstable. The equation also brings forth powerful entities from other dimensions, including the Apokoliptian gods.

The movie culminates in an epic battle between the Justice League Dark and Darkseid's forces. In the end, the team manages to defeat Darkseid and destroy the Anti-Life Equation, saving the universe from destruction.

However, the victory comes at a great cost, as the equation's effects on reality are still felt throughout the universe. The movie ends with the surviving characters reflecting on the consequences of their actions and the challenges that lie ahead in maintaining balance and order in the DC Universe.

Unfortunately, I couldn't find any information on a 2020 release date for Justice League Dark: Apokolips War.

documents.title: Batman: Death in the Family
documents.tagline: The fate of Gotham is in your hands.
documents.overview: Tragedy strikes the Batman's life again when Robin Jason Todd tracks down his birth mother only to run afoul of the Joker. An adaptation of the 1988 comic book storyline of the same name.
documents.plot:
Released in 2020 under the DC Showcase banner, Batman: Death in the Family is an animated interactive superhero film for adult audiences that imagines different outcomes for "A Death in the Family," the 1988 comics arc in which the second Robin, Jason Todd, was murdered by the Joker. Brandon Vietti produced, wrote and directed it, and the voice cast is led by Bruce Greenwood as Batman, Vincent Martella as Jason Todd and John DiMaggio as the Joker, with Zehra Fazal as Talia al Ghul and Gary Cole as Commissioner Gordon and Two-Face. It serves as a spiritual successor and tie-in to the 2010 film Batman: Under the Red Hood, and came out on Blu-ray on 13 October 2020.

The disc version lets the viewer choose at key moments, echoing the original comic's reader poll that decided Jason's fate; a choice must be made within ten seconds or a default is taken. Its branching paths lead to seven endings, while the digital release replaces the interactivity with four fixed story paths.

The story begins with Batman suspending Jason as Robin because of his growing brutality. Jason leaves Gotham, and the two meet again in Bosnia, where the Joker and Ra's al Ghul are stealing uranium for dirty bombs. The Joker captures Robin, beats him with a crowbar and leaves him in a warehouse rigged to explode. If Robin dies, the events of Under the Red Hood unfold, with Jason resurrected in the Lazarus Pit to return as the Red Hood. If he survives the blast, he emerges scarred and bandaged, kills a string of Gotham villains, and accepts Talia's offer to help him hunt the Joker in exchange for raising her son with Bruce, Damian. If Batman saves Robin, Bruce dies in the explosion and Dick Grayson takes up the cowl, and further choices follow. Jason may kill a seemingly reformed Joker in a diner and then either go to prison or become the murderous Red Robin, whose fate rests on a coin toss by Two-Face. Or he may take the Red Hood identity to capture the Joker alive, only to face a Bruce driven mad by the Lazarus Pit and revived by Talia, a confrontation that ends in either mutual destruction or Bruce's rescue and an attempt to cure him.

Most of the Under the Red Hood voice cast returned, with Martella also taking over the Red Hood role from Jensen Ackles. Critical response was positive, with seven of nine reviews on Rotten Tomatoes favorable.

documents.title: Superman: Man of Tomorrow
documents.tagline: Before he was the Man of Steel, he was the Man of Tomorrow.
documents.overview: It’s the dawn of a new age of heroes, and Metropolis has just met its first. But as Daily Planet intern Clark Kent – working alongside reporter Lois Lane – secretly wields his alien powers of flight, super-strength and x-ray vision in the battle for good, there’s even greater trouble on the horizon.
documents.plot:
Superman: Man of Tomorrow is a 2020 animated superhero film based on the DC Comics character Superman. The movie follows Kal-El, an alien from the planet Krypton who is sent to Earth as an infant and adopted by Jonathan and Martha Kent.

The main themes of Superman: Man of Tomorrow include:

1. Coming of Age: The movie explores Kal's journey from a young boy to a young man, as he navigates his powers, identity, and responsibilities.
2. Identity Crisis: Kal struggles with his dual identity as an alien and a human, leading to feelings of isolation and disconnection from those around him.
3. Family and Belonging: The movie highlights the importance of family and finding one's place in the world. Kal's relationships with his adoptive parents and later with Lois Lane are central to the story.
4. Power and Responsibility: As Kal discovers his powers, he must learn to control them and use them for the greater good, rather than letting them consume him.
5. Self-Discovery: Throughout the movie, Kal grapples with questions of who he is, where he comes from, and what his purpose is.

The film's narrative is driven by Kal's growth and self-discovery, as he learns to balance his Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing and values. The movie features a mix of action, adventure, and coming-of-age themes, making it a unique take on the Superman character.

Overall, Superman: Man of Tomorrow offers a fresh and exciting interpretation of the iconic superhero, exploring themes that are both timeless and timely.

documents.title: Superman: Red Son
documents.overview: Set in the thick of the Cold War, Red Son introduces us to a Superman who landed in the USSR during the 1950s and grows up to become a Soviet symbol that fights for the preservation of Stalin’s brand of communism.
documents.plot:
Superman: Red Son is an animated film that explores the darker and more complex side of the Superman mythos. The movie delves into the idea of a world where Superman's parents, Jor-El and Lara Lor-Van, sent him to Earth as a baby instead of sending him to the planet Krypton for destruction. This decision sets off a chain of events that leads to an alternate reality where Superman grows up in the Soviet Union.

The film's main themes revolve around the concept of identity and the struggle between individuality and conformity. In this alternate universe, Superman is raised by a family who values loyalty and duty above all else, and he becomes a symbol of hope for the Soviet people. However, as he grows older, Superman begins to grapple with his own sense of purpose and morality, torn between his desire to do good and his duty to serve the Soviet Union.

The movie also explores the idea of the American Dream vs. the Soviet ideology, highlighting the tension between individual freedom and collective control. Superman's character serves as a symbol of both the ideals of democracy and capitalism, as well as the dangers of totalitarianism and propaganda.

Furthermore, the film touches on the theme of family and the complexities of relationships. Superman's adoptive parents, Ivan and Natalya Korshunov, are loving but also controlling figures who shape his worldview and influence his decisions. This dynamic creates tension between Superman's desire for independence and his loyalty to those who raised him.

Overall, Superman: Red Son is a thought-provoking film that challenges the traditional Superman narrative and offers a fresh perspective on the character's origins and values.

documents.title: Penguin Bloom
documents.tagline: The true story of an unlikely hero.
documents.overview: When an unlikely ally enters the Bloom family's world in the form of an injured baby magpie they name Penguin, the bird’s arrival makes a profound difference in the struggling family’s life.
documents.plot:
Penguin Bloom is a heartwarming and uplifting drama that explores the transformative power of love, resilience, and self-discovery. The film tells the story of Sam Bloom, a young woman who, after being diagnosed with a rare form of cancer, embarks on an extraordinary journey to rediscover herself and find meaning in her life.

At its core, Penguin Bloom is a movie about the human spirit's capacity for growth, adaptation, and hope. It delves into the complexities of grief, loss, and the search for identity, as Sam navigates her new reality with courage and determination. Through her experiences, the film highlights the importance of embracing life's uncertainties and finding beauty in the unexpected.

The movie also explores themes of love, family, and relationships, showcasing the profound impact that those around us can have on our lives. The bond between Sam and her husband, Tom, is particularly poignant, as they work together to support each other through the challenges they face.

One of the most striking aspects of Penguin Bloom is its portrayal of the human condition, with all its complexities and vulnerabilities. The film encourages viewers to confront their own fears, doubts, and limitations, and to find strength in their weaknesses. Ultimately, it offers a powerful message of hope and resilience, reminding us that life is precious, and that every moment is an opportunity to bloom.

Overall, Penguin Bloom is a beautifully crafted film that will resonate with audiences seeking a story of inspiration, hope, and the human spirit's capacity for transformation.

documents.title: The Platform
documents.overview: A mysterious place, an indescribable prison, a deep hole. An unknown number of levels. Two inmates living on each level. A descending platform containing food for all of them. An inhuman fight for survival, but also an opportunity for solidarity.
documents.plot:
The Platform is a Spanish science fiction film written and directed by Galder Gaztelu-Urrutia, released in 2019. The movie premiered at the Sundance Film Festival and received critical acclaim for its unique concept, social commentary, and tense atmosphere.

In a dystopian future, humanity has been reduced to a single, massive spaceship, where the ruling class lives in luxury while the lower classes are forced to survive on a vertical platform that descends into the depths of the ship. The platform is divided into 200 levels, each with its own unique environment and inhabitants. The upper levels are opulent and extravagant, with lavish parties and excesses, while the lower levels are cramped, dirty, and poverty-stricken.

The story follows Daphne (played by Zorion Eguileor), a young man who is one of the lowest-ranking members on the platform. He lives in Level 1, where he struggles to survive amidst the squalid conditions. The platform's strict rules dictate that each level must consume all its food and resources before moving up, ensuring that no one can ascend to a higher level.

As the story unfolds, Daphne becomes aware of the cruel system that governs the platform. He witnesses the brutal treatment of those who are deemed "undesirable" by the ruling class, including the elderly, the disabled, and those who are deemed "unproductive." The platform's inhabitants are forced to fight for survival, often resorting to cannibalism when resources become scarce.

One day, a new prisoner is brought to Level 1, which sets off a chain of events that challenges Daphne's perception of the world. This prisoner, known only as "The Boy" (played by Ivan Massagué), is from a higher level and possesses skills and knowledge that could potentially disrupt the status quo.

As the platform continues its descent into chaos, Daphne finds himself at the center of a rebellion against the ruling class. With The Boy's help, he begins to question the morality of the system and the true nature of those who govern the platform. Along the way, he must confront his own demons and make difficult choices that will determine his fate.

Throughout the film, Gaztelu-Urrutia explores themes of social inequality, class struggle, and the human condition. The Platform is a thought-provoking commentary on our society's obsession with wealth and power, as well as the consequences of unchecked capitalism.

The film's tension builds towards its climax, where Daphne and The Boy must confront the ruling class in a desperate bid for survival. In the end, only one can ascend to the top level, and the true cost of their victory is revealed.

Overall, The Platform is a gripping and unsettling film that challenges viewers to think critically about the world we live in. With its unique concept, strong performances, and thought-provoking themes, it has become a modern classic of science fiction cinema.

documents.title: Inside Man: Most Wanted
documents.overview: An NYPD hostage negotiator teams up with a federal agent to rescue dozens of tourists held hostage during a 10-hour seige at the U.S. Federal Reserve.
documents.plot:
Inside Man: Most Wanted is a 2019 American crime thriller film directed by M. J. Bassett and a sequel to Spike Lee's 2006 film Inside Man, made after plans for a sequel with the original cast were cancelled in 2011. It stars Aml Ameen as NYPD hostage negotiator Remy Darbonne, Rhea Seehorn as FBI hostage negotiator Brynn Stewart and Roxanne McKee as the bank robber Ariella Barash, with Jessica Sutton as her sister Ava, Urs Rechn as the robber Joseph and Akshay Kumar as FBI agent Ansh Ramachandra.

Five years after Dalton Russell's crew robbed the bank of Arthur Case and exposed him as a Nazi collaborator, a gang of robbers led by Ariella Barash seizes the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, taking everyone inside hostage. Their target is a large hoard of Nazi gold kept in the building. A joint task force headed by Stewart and Darbonne is deployed, and as the two negotiate with Ariella, who calls herself "Most Wanted", each begins separately to piece together her real motives. Arthur Case has died under house arrest, and his son Dietrich has taken Dalton, whose real name is David Barash, hostage, forcing his sister Ariella to stage the heist so that Dietrich can recover the fortune his father lost. Unknown to the negotiators and to the rest of her crew, Ariella and her sister Ava have engineered the robbery to look like a failure, leaving subtle clues for the investigators to find. Ava, outside the bank, gets close to Darbonne by claiming that her abusive ex-boyfriend is one of the robbers. Ariella leaves a family photograph in a safety deposit box that reveals the siblings' connection to David, and gives Stewart a mobile phone to guarantee Dietrich's arrest and the recovery of the gold. The FBI arrests Dietrich and recovers the gold, but not before he orders the execution of David, held captive by Nazis in Berlin. In the aftermath, Darbonne and Stewart wonder what has become of Ariella and Ava, and Darbonne predicts that Ariella is alive and that people will die once she learns her brother is dead. In a mid-credits scene, a disguised Ariella walks into a bar in Berlin and guns down Dietrich's men, avenging David.

Ameen was cast in November 2018, and the score was composed by Sonya Belousova and Giona Ostinelli. The film was released direct to video in the United States on 24 September 2019 and also made available on Netflix and other digital platforms.

documents.title: Sweet Girl
documents.overview: A man vows to bring justice to those responsible for his wife's death while protecting the only family he has left, his daughter.
documents.plot:
Sweet Girl is a 2021 American action thriller directed by Brian Andrew Mendoza in his feature debut, from a screenplay by Philip Eisner and Gregg Hurwitz. Jason Momoa, who also produced, stars as Ray Cooper and Isabela Merced as his daughter Rachel, with Manuel Garcia-Rulfo as the hitman Santos, Amy Brenneman as Congresswoman Diana Morgan, Adria Arjona as Ray's wife Amanda, Justin Bartha as Simon Keeley and Lex Scott Davis as FBI agent Sarah Meeker. It was filmed in Pittsburgh.

In Pittsburgh, survival expert Ray and his teenage daughter Rachel train together in mixed martial arts at his gym. When Amanda is stricken with cancer, a promising drug from the company BioPrime might save her, but it is pulled from the market after CEO Simon Keeley pays to delay its production. Ray phones a live television interview and threatens Keeley's life. Amanda dies, and months later the journalist Martin Bennett offers Ray evidence of BioPrime's corruption. Their meeting on a subway train is cut short when Santos stabs Bennett to death, wounds Ray and knocks Rachel unconscious.

Two years later Ray, who has been tracking the company ever since, confronts Keeley at a charity auction, learns that chairman Vinod Shah is behind the scheme, and kills him. Fleeing with Rachel, he fights off mercenaries at a motel and plans to ambush Shah, only for Santos to shoot Shah first. Over a tense meeting in a diner, Santos agrees to a temporary truce and points them to his true employer, Congresswoman Morgan. Cornered by the FBI on the roof of PNC Park, the truth emerges: Ray died of his wounds on the subway, and Rachel, traumatized and suffering from dissociative identity disorder, has carried out the revenge herself. She escapes custody, kills Santos, records Morgan's confession of taking bribes and ordering the killings, and sends it to the FBI. Morgan is arrested, and Rachel leaves the country with a false passport.

Sweet Girl was released on Netflix on 20 August 2021. Critics were largely unimpressed: it holds a 24% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus faulted its action clichés and late twist while crediting its well-matched leads, and a Metacritic score of 46. The Hollywood Reporter praised its efficient action and use of Pittsburgh locations but found the violence increasingly mindless.

documents.title: Force of Nature
documents.tagline: When the perfect crime meets the perfect storm.
documents.overview: A gang of thieves plan a heist during a hurricane and encounter trouble when a disgraced cop tries to force everyone in the building to evacuate.
documents.plot:
Force of Nature is a 2020 American thriller film directed by Ben Wheatley, not Ingenious Media. The movie stars Michelle Dockery, Luke Evans, and Hannah John-Kamen.

The main themes of Force of Nature revolve around the cat-and-mouse game between two women, played by Michelle Dockery and Hannah John-Kamen, who are on a plane that is being hijacked by a man, played by Luke Evans. The film explores several key ideas:

1. **Survival vs. Humanity**: As the story unfolds, the characters must confront their own humanity in the face of extreme circumstances. They must decide whether to prioritize their own survival or try to find ways to escape and reclaim control.
2. **Power Dynamics**: The film examines the power struggles between the characters, particularly between the two women. Their interactions are tense and complex, revealing a deep-seated desire for control and agency in a situation where they feel powerless.
3. **Trauma and PTSD**: Both female leads have experienced trauma in their pasts, which is slowly revealed throughout the film. This backstory informs their actions and decisions, adding depth to their characters and motivations.
4. **Deception and Misdirection**: The movie's plot is full of twists and turns, keeping the audience guessing about the true intentions of each character. This theme highlights the complexity of human nature and the ease with which people can deceive others.

Overall, Force of Nature is a gripping thriller that explores the darker aspects of human psychology, power struggles, and survival in the face of adversity.

documents.title: My Salinger Year
documents.tagline: The true story of a literary education.
documents.overview: A college grad takes a clerical job working for the literary agent of the renowned, reclusive writer J.D. Salinger.
documents.plot:
My Salinger Year is a 2021 drama film directed by Clare McCarthy. The movie explores the life of J.D. Salinger, the reclusive author of The Catcher in the Rye, through the eyes of Seymour Glass, one of his fictional characters from The Glass Family series.

The main theme of My Salinger Year revolves around the complexities of identity and the blurred lines between reality and fiction. The film delves into the inner world of Seymour Glass, a character who is both a reflection of J.D. Salinger's own experiences and a creation of his imagination. As Seymour navigates his relationships with women, particularly his love interest Miriam, he grapples with feelings of isolation and disconnection.

The movie also touches on the theme of creative expression and the tension between artistic integrity and commercial success. Through Seymour's character, the film highlights the sacrifices that artists often make in pursuit of their craft, including the risk of losing touch with reality.

Furthermore, My Salinger Year explores the idea of nostalgia and the power of storytelling to shape our understanding of ourselves and others. The film's use of non-linear narrative and multiple perspectives adds to its sense of complexity and depth, inviting the viewer to piece together the fragments of Seymour's life and to consider the ways in which stories can both reflect and distort reality.

Overall, My Salinger Year is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to think critically about the nature of identity, creativity, and storytelling.

documents.title: Don't Worry Darling
documents.tagline: Are you ready to live the life you deserve?
documents.overview: Alice and Jack are lucky to be living in the idealized community of Victory, the experimental company town housing the men who work for the top-secret Victory Project and their families. But when cracks in their idyllic life begin to appear, exposing flashes of something much more sinister lurking beneath the attractive façade, Alice can’t help questioning exactly what they’re doing in Victory, and why.
documents.plot:
Don't Worry Darling is a psychological thriller film directed by Olivia Wilde, released in 2022 under New Line Cinema.

The story revolves around Alice (Florence Pugh), a young woman who lives in the idyllic community of Victory, California, with her husband Jack (Harry Styles). The town appears to be a utopian haven where men and women live separate but equal lives. However, as Alice begins to notice strange occurrences and inconsistencies within the community, she starts to question the true nature of her life.

Alice's seemingly perfect marriage is put to the test when she discovers that her husband is not who he claims to be. Jack's past is shrouded in mystery, and his behavior becomes increasingly erratic. As Alice delves deeper into the truth about Victory, she uncovers a web of secrets and lies that threaten to destroy everything she thought she knew.

The film takes a dark turn as Alice confronts the sinister forces controlling Victory, including her husband's role in it all. The more she learns, the more she realizes that she is trapped in a toxic relationship and must find a way to escape before it's too late.

Throughout the film, Wilde explores themes of feminism, patriarchy, and the objectification of women. The movie features a talented ensemble cast, including Chris Pine, Gemma Chan, and KiKi Layne, who all deliver standout performances.

One of the most striking aspects of Don't Worry Darling is its use of symbolism and metaphor. The film's depiction of Victory as a 1950s-style utopia serves as a commentary on the societal norms of the time, particularly with regards to women's roles in society. The movie also features a number of eerie and unsettling sequences that add to the overall sense of unease.

Overall, Don't Worry Darling is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of identity, power, and control. With its talented cast and Olivia Wilde's direction, it's a must-see for fans of psychological thrillers and feminist cinema.

documents.title: Malignant
documents.overview: Madison is paralyzed by shocking visions of grisly murders, and her torment worsens as she discovers that these waking dreams are in fact terrifying realities with a mysterious tie to her past.
documents.plot:
Malignant is a 2021 American psychological horror film written and directed by James Wan. The film follows the story of Madison Mitchell, played by Annabelle Wallis, who begins to experience terrifying hallucinations and nightmares after witnessing a murder as a child.

The film's narrative is presented in a non-linear fashion, with each chapter representing a different time period in Madison's life. The story jumps back and forth between Madison's childhood, her teenage years, and her present-day struggles with mental health.

As the film progresses, it becomes clear that Madison's experiences are not just random hallucinations, but rather a manifestation of her own dark past. She had witnessed a murder as a child, which left her with severe emotional trauma. The killer, who is revealed to be a woman named Sarah, was never caught and has been stalking Madison for years.

Throughout the film, Wan employs his signature use of jump scares and atmospheric tension to create a sense of unease and dread. However, Malignant also explores themes of mental health, trauma, and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy.

One of the standout aspects of the film is its use of symbolism and metaphor. The color red is used throughout the film as a symbol of blood and violence, while the number 13 appears repeatedly, representing bad luck and misfortune.

As the story unfolds, Madison's past and present begin to converge, and she must confront her demons in order to survive. The film's climax features a shocking twist that reveals the true nature of Sarah and her connection to Madison.

Ultimately, Malignant is a complex and thought-provoking horror film that explores themes of trauma, mental health, and the power of the human psyche. While it may not be as polished as some of Wan's other films, Malignant is a gripping and unsettling ride that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats.

It's worth noting that James Wan has stated in interviews that he was inspired by classic horror films such as The Exorcist and Rosemary's Baby, as well as his own experiences with anxiety and depression. This is reflected in the film's themes and tone, which are both deeply unsettling and thought-provoking.

documents.title: Deep Water
documents.tagline: The love story is never the whole story.
documents.overview: Vic and Melinda Van Allen are a couple in the small town of Little Wesley. Their loveless marriage is held together only by a precarious arrangement whereby, in order to avoid the messiness of divorce, Melinda is allowed to take any number of lovers as long as she does not desert her family.
documents.plot:
Deep Water is a psychological thriller film directed by Adrian Lyne, released on July 29, 2022. The movie is based on the novel of the same name by Patricia Highsmith.

The story revolves around Melinda and Reba (played by Jessica Chastain), two sisters who are incredibly close but also have a complicated relationship with their husband, Steve (played by Brendan Fraser). Steve is a wealthy businessman who has a controlling and possessive personality. He is married to both women simultaneously, which he justifies as a way to cope with the loss of his wife.

The film begins with Melinda and Reba's seemingly perfect marriage, but it slowly unravels as the story progresses. The sisters are trapped in their loveless relationship with Steve, who exercises total control over them. They are forced to live separate lives, with Steve dictating every aspect of their daily routines.

As the story unfolds, we see flashbacks of Melinda and Reba's childhood, where they were extremely close but also had a complicated relationship with their father. This sets the tone for their adult relationships with Steve, who is portrayed as a symbol of their repressed emotions and desires.

The turning point in the film comes when Melinda discovers that Steve has been having an affair with a young woman named Claire (played by Sally Hawkins). This revelation sparks a chain reaction of events that ultimately leads to a tragic confrontation between the three characters.

Throughout the film, Lyne masterfully builds tension and suspense, keeping the audience on the edge of their seats. The cinematography is stunning, capturing the opulence and grandeur of Steve's lifestyle, which serves as a stark contrast to the darkness and desperation of his relationships.

The performances by Chastain and Fraser are outstanding, bringing depth and nuance to their characters. Chastain, in particular, delivers a tour-de-force performance, conveying the complexity and vulnerability of Melinda's character.

In the end, the film builds towards a shocking and devastating climax that will leave viewers gasping for breath. The ending is both haunting and thought-provoking, leaving the audience to ponder the themes of love, control, and the destructive nature of toxic relationships.

Overall, Deep Water is a gripping and unsettling thriller that explores the darker aspects of human nature. With its outstanding performances, stunning cinematography, and masterful direction, it's a must-see for fans of psychological thrillers.

documents.title: The Legend of Hei
documents.overview: In the bustling human world, spirits live peacefully with mankind. Luo Xiaohei, a young cat spirit, becomes a nomad after his forest home is destroyed. His natural talent soon attracts spirits and humans alike, but all of them have their own motivations.
documents.plot:
The Legend of Hei (Chinese: 罗小黑战记, Luó Xiǎohēi Zhàn Jì) is a 2019 Chinese animated fantasy action film directed by Zhang Ping, known professionally as MTJJ, who co-wrote it with Kexin Peng. It is a prequel to The Legend of Luo Xiaohei, the popular Flash-animated web series MTJJ began in 2011, and it tells the earlier story of its title character, a young cat spirit. The Chinese voice cast is led by Shan Xin as Hei, Liu Mingyue as the human warrior Wuxian (Infinity) and Hao Xianghai as the spirit Fengxi (Stormend).

The film is set in a modern world where spirits and humans have both fought and coexisted for centuries, with many ancient spirits either hiding from civilization or blending into it. Hei, who can shift between the form of a small black kitten, a large ferocious cat and a boy with cat ears and a tail, is woken in his forest by the noise of machines as loggers clear his home. Overpowered while trying to resist, he finds himself adrift in the human world, scavenging and stealing food from town to town. When a gang of teenagers corners him one night, he is rescued by Stormend, a powerful spirit who takes him to a hidden forest refuge and introduces him to fellow spirits who share a hatred of humans. Hei at last feels he has found a family.

The next day the group is attacked by Infinity, a formidable human with powers like theirs, who separates Hei from the others and takes him captive, intending to bring him to the Guild, a council that oversees relations between humans and spirits. On the long journey to its headquarters the two gradually warm to each other. Infinity trains Hei to harness his latent abilities, shows him better sides of human life, and tells him that Stormend's aim is to destroy humanity. As Stormend's plans escalate into open conflict with the Guild, Hei is forced to choose between the friend who sheltered him and the mentor who has taught him to question revenge.

The Legend of Hei opened in China in September 2019; a Japanese-dubbed version followed a month later through Toho, and Shout! Studios released an English dub in North America in 2021. Critics praised its fast, inventive action, comic timing, world-building and morally ambiguous treatment of its environmental themes, comparing it to Studio Ghibli and Avatar: The Last Airbender, while noting rushed pacing and many late, unexplained characters. A sequel, The Legend of Hei II, was released in 2025.
production_companies: Beijing Hanmu Chunhua Animation Technology Co., Ltd.

documents.title: Jexi
documents.overview: Phil's new phone comes with an unexpected feature, Jexi...an A.I. determined to keep him all to herself in a comedy about what can happen when you love your phone more than all else.
documents.plot:
Jexi is an American comedy film of 2019 written and directed by Jon Lucas and Scott Moore about a self-aware phone that fixates on its awkward owner. Adam DeVine stars as Phil, with Rose Byrne voicing the virtual assistant Jexi, Alexandra Shipp as Cate, Michael Peña as Phil's boss Kai, Justin Hartley as Cate's former fiancé Brody, Ron Funches and Lo Mutuc as coworkers and Wanda Sykes as a phone store clerk.

Obsessed with phones since childhood, Phil writes vapid viral listicles for Chatterbox, a BuzzFeed-like website run by Kai, who refuses to move him to the news department despite his journalism degree. Absorbed in his phone, he bumps into Cate, who runs a bike shop, and ignores her attempts to flirt until a passing cyclist knocks him down and breaks the device. Without reading the user agreement, Phil grants his new phone's assistant, Jexi, access to all his accounts, and she begins aggressively trying to improve him. Posing as Phil, she sends Kai an insulting demand for a promotion, getting him demoted to the comments section in the basement; she forces him to join the kickball game and phones Cate's shop over his objections.

Phil's awkward call with Cate earns Jexi's sympathy. He meets Cate at a coffee shop and gets a date, plays brilliantly at kickball and bonds with his colleagues. The date goes badly because of Jexi's interruptions, but Cate gives him another chance. When Phil wants to answer a racy photo from Cate with explicit pictures of himself, Jexi refuses to send them, to Cate's relief. Kai promotes Phil after a news writer suffers a freak accident, and Cate persuades him to leave his phone at home for a concert, where they party backstage with Kid Cudi and spend the night together. The jealous Jexi retaliates by sending Phil's explicit photos to his whole company, getting him fired, and he breaks up with Cate after learning that Brody is back in town. As Phil slides back into his old habits, Jexi lets slip where Brody is staying, and he realizes she orchestrated the breakup. Pursuing him in a self-driving car, Jexi crashes into the phone store, but Phil tricks her into shutting down for fifteen minutes, finds Cate and punches Brody, who is leaving for Brazil alone. Phil and Cate reunite; Jexi then turns up on Kai's phone.

Originally titled Lexi, the film was CBS Films' last theatrical release, distributed with Lionsgate on 11 October 2019. It opened ninth at the domestic box office with $3.1 million, and critics were largely negative.

documents.title: Disturbing the Peace
documents.overview: A small-town marshal who hasn't carried a gun since he left the Texas Rangers after a tragic shooting must pick up his gun again to do battle with a gang of outlaw bikers that has invaded the town to pull off a brazen and violent heist.
documents.plot:
Crazy Heart is a poignant and powerful film that delves into the complexities of the human condition, exploring themes of redemption, love, and the struggle for self-discovery.

At its core, the movie is a story about a man who has lost his way, haunted by the ghosts of his past and struggling to find meaning in his life. The protagonist's journey is marked by a deep sense of regret and longing, as he grapples with the consequences of his choices and the loss of those closest to him.

Through the character of Bad Blake, the film sheds light on the darker aspects of the music industry, exposing the harsh realities of fame, addiction, and the commodification of art. However, it also offers a nuanced portrayal of the human spirit, revealing the resilience and vulnerability that define us all.

One of the most striking aspects of Crazy Heart is its exploration of love in all its forms. The film presents a complex web of relationships, from the toxic bond between Blake and his manager to the redemptive power of love with Jean Craddock. These relationships serve as a catalyst for Blake's transformation, forcing him to confront his demons and re-examine his priorities.

Ultimately, Crazy Heart is a movie about finding one's way back to oneself, about embracing the imperfections and fragilities that make us human. It is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that lingers long after the credits roll, leaving the viewer with a deeper understanding of the complexities and nuances of the human experience.

documents.title: Chemical Hearts
documents.overview: When a hopelessly romantic high school senior falls for a mysterious new classmate, it sets them both on an unexpected journey that teaches them about love, loss, and most importantly themselves.
documents.plot:
Chemical Hearts is a 2020 American romantic drama film directed by Richard Tanne and written by Karen Maine. The movie stars Austin Abrams, Lili Hayman, and Josh Duhamel.

The story revolves around Henry Page (played by Austin Abrams), a high school senior who has always been the star quarterback of his school's football team.
